title: Senior C++/iOS Engineer - User Platform
description:
We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration.
   

  

 Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Collaborate with a highly autonomous and supportive engineering squad responsible for Spotify’s delegated authorization and session management platforms.
* Design, build, and evolve critical infrastructure powering Spotify applications and partner integrations using shared C++ libraries and native Swift on iOS.
* Develop secure, reliable, and performant delegated authorization flows, including token issuance, refresh, revocation, and session lifecycle management across multiple platforms.
* Partner with client and backend engineers to integrate with core authorization services, token issuance, client registration, and token revocation.
* Improve how credentials and access tokens are securely stored and managed on-device while balancing security, reliability, and application performance.
* Contribute to the evolution of Spotify’s authorization frameworks, Spotify-specific implementations, enabling new platforms and product experiences.
* Drive technical improvements, share knowledge with teammates, and help shape the long-term technical direction of delegated authorization and session management.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have strong proficiency in C++, along with experience building native iOS applications in Swift, or you're excited to develop your expertise in Swift while applying your C++ skills.
* You have experience designing, building, or maintaining security-sensitive systems such as authorization, authentication, token management, credential storage, or related platforms.
* You bring a systems-thinking mindset and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges that span client and backend technologies.
* You have a solid understanding of software architecture, secure system design, and modern authorization protocols such as OAuth 2.0.
* You approach problems thoughtfully, with strong attention to detail and a focus on building secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
* You communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with engineers across multiple teams and technical disciplines.
* You have experience working with shared cross-platform codebases and understand how native platform layers interact with common C++ libraries.
* You enjoy working on large-scale distributed systems where your contributions improve experiences for hundreds of millions of Spotify users.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Backend Software Engineer – AI Assist
description:
**Join Telavox as a Backend Software Engineer – AI Assist 🤖**
 Are you a backend engineer who wants to see AI run in production, not in a demo? AI Assist turns every recorded phone call on the Telavox platform into a transcript, a summary and action items for the people who took the call. We are looking for an engineer who is at home where distributed systems, telephony, and large language models meet.
   

  

 In this role, placed in Malmö or Stockholm, you'll build and run the services behind AI Assist: turning a finished call into text and insight, and delivering the result to our apps and our admin portal. You'll work in a small team with a lot of ownership, shaping what to build together with the product manager day to day, and what you ship reaches real customers and partners the same week.
   

  

 If you'd like to take the next step in your career and are excited by the challenge of making AI dependable at scale, this is your opportunity!
   

  

**About The Job**
 AI Assist is live today, sold both directly and through telecom operators across Europe, and usage is growing month over month. You'll join the team that owns it end to end, from the transcription pipeline to the APIs our apps and customers use. Much of the work is classic backend engineering with an AI twist: asynchronous processing, third-party model APIs, access control, metering, and data that has to be handled correctly under GDPR and EU data-residency requirements.
   

  

 You'll work side by side with a colleague focused on model evaluation and transcription quality, with the AI Agents team next door building our AI agent platform, and with the telephony, apps and platform teams whose systems yours plug into.
   

  

**Our stack:** 
 Java and Spring Boot, Kubernetes, and Google Vertex AI with Gemini and other model providers for transcription and analysis.
   

  

**Your Day-to-day Work May Include**
* Designing, implementing and testing new capabilities in the AI service, from summaries a customer can shape themselves to the controls an admin needs to roll the product out.
* Evolving the transcription pipeline together with the telephony and platform teams.
* Integrating LLM and speech APIs in a production setting: asynchronous processing, quotas and rate limits, and keeping data within the EU.
* Building the APIs that serve transcripts to our apps, our admin portal and our customers, with access control and data retention done right.
* Owning what you ship: observability, alerting, and the follow-up when something fails.


**About You**
 You're a product-minded backend engineer who likes owning a service from design to production, and who is comfortable in a system that spans several teams and a telephony platform with two decades of history. You care about correctness where it matters (who may read what, what is stored for how long, what a customer is billed for), and you enjoy the pace of a small team with customers and partners waiting for what you build. You don't need to be an AI researcher. You need to be the engineer who makes AI dependable.
   

  

**Key Skills And Experience We're Looking For**
* Several years building backend services in Java, preferably with Spring Boot
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous processing, and system integration across service boundaries
* Experience running services in production: monitoring, observability, and debugging in a distributed system
* Experience with relational databases and queue-based or job-based architectures
* Proficient in English, both spoken and written


**Good-to-have Skills**
* Python, which we use alongside Java across the AI domain
* Experience calling LLM or speech-to-text APIs from production code (Gemini, OpenAI or similar)
* Experience deploying and running services on Kubernetes
* Familiarity with telephony concepts (SIP, call recording, PBX) or with GDPR and data-residency requirements in practice


****Join us at Telavox 💚****
 Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
   

  

 Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
   

  

 We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
   

  

 Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
   

  

**How to apply!**
 At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.
   

  

 We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.

title: Fullstackutvecklare Java
description:
Vill du jobba med teknik i framkant, samtidigt som du bidrar till samhällsnyttan? Hos oss får du intressanta arbetsuppgifter i samhällets hjärta, kombinerat med utvecklingsmöjligheter och balans mellan arbete och fritid. Upptäck ett mångsidigt uppdrag!
   

  

**Om jobbet**
 Du ingår i ett team som utvecklar och förvaltar Skatteverkets gemensamma tjänster för ärendehantering och diarieföring. Teamet har stor frihet att organisera sitt arbete och tar gemensamt ansvar för leveranserna. Med samhällsnyttan i fokus utvecklar vi hållbara och framtidssäkra lösningar med låg teknisk skuld.
   

  

 Du arbetar som fullstackutvecklare med tyngdpunkt på backend i en modern utvecklingsmiljö med bland annat Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, Vue, Kubernetes och Oracle Web Logic Server. Vi arbetar agilt enligt SAFe och lägger stor vikt vid samarbete, kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling.
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas både tekniskt och professionellt genom kunniga kollegor, innovationssprintar och goda möjligheter till intern rörlighet inom en av Sveriges största IT-organisationer. Vi värnar om balansen mellan arbete och fritid och erbjuder flexibel arbetstid, möjlighet till att delvis arbeta hemifrån samt friskvårdsförmåner.
   

  

 Skatteverkets IT-avdelning arbetar aktivt för att främja en inkluderande arbetsplats som präglas av jämställdhet och mångfald där alla medarbetare får lika möjligheter att bidra och utvecklas. Läs mer på Jobba med it hos oss | Skatteverket.
   

  

 Du tillhör Gemensamma tjänsteenheten på IT-avdelningen, med placering i Sundbyberg. Vi är cirka 30 medarbetare idag.
   

  

**Om dig**
 För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss på Skatteverket behöver du vara lyhörd, tänka nytt och ta ansvar. I arbetet är gott omdöme och förståelse för rättssäkerhet och säkerhet viktigt. Du ska också leva upp till vår medarbetarpolicy.
   

  

**I Det Här Jobbet Ska Du**
* ha god samarbetsförmåga, vara hjälpsam och ha ett gott bemötande
* ha förmågan och viljan att lära dig nya saker, vara flexibel och öppen för förändringar
* ha god problemlösningsförmåga, se mönster och kunna göra avgränsningar
* vara målfokuserad och bidra till att syftet med verksamheten uppnås
* agera medvetet och professionellt utifrån en god självinsikt
* uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska.


**Du Ska Även Ha**
* avslutad akademisk utbildning inom datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande område, alternativt flerårig aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som systemutvecklare
* flerårig aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av systemutveckling i Java
* aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av agilt utvecklingsarbete, gärna i SAFe eller liknande ramverk


 Det är önskvärt att du har aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av Oracle Web Logic Server och Openshift Container Platform samt tekniker och verktyg som TypeScript och Springboot.
   

  

**Bra att veta**
 Anställningen är tillsvidare och kan inledas med provanställning i sex månader.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

 På skatteverket.se/jobb kan du exempelvis läsa om vår samhällsbärande roll, fördelarna med att jobba hos oss och hur det går till när du söker våra jobb.
   

  

 När du ansöker bifogar du ditt cv. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar och du ska därför inte bifoga det i din ansökan.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Fullstack .NET Developer - PropTech Startup - Stockholm

* Work across .NET, Azure, event-driven architecture, and React.

* Experience with event-driven development.

**For more information, please email l.letchford@tenthrevolution.com.**

title: Backendutvecklare .NET/Azure till prisbelönt digitalbyrå
description:
***Att vakna på morgonen med längtan att gå till jobbet!***
 Vi har ett mål att alla som jobbar hos oss ska trivas så mycket att man vaknar med ett leende på måndag morgon. Vi är kanske inte Sveriges bästa bolag inom alla punkter men vi är Sveriges näst bästa bolag enligt Great Place to Work 2020. Vi tror att det beror på vår energi och nyfikenhet, vårt sätt att välkomna olikheter och våra erfarenheter som vi gärna delar med oss av.
   

  

 Rebel and Bird är ett av B3s dotterbolag som tar hand om kunders önskemål och krav och förädlar dessa till flerfaldigt prisbelönta tekniska lösningar. Du blir inte nedbunden i gamla tekniker utan får möjligheten att jobba med det senaste inom backend och utvecklas med oss varje dag. Vårt absolut tydligaste mål med verksamheten är att alla ska ha kul på jobbet. Det låter som en plattityd men det är vårt stora mål. Vi försöker (när så går) att träffas och göra roliga saker utanför arbetstid någon gång i månaden utöver julfest, sommarfest och konferenser.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
 Du kommer arbeta både i interna och externa åtaganden, dvs i våra egna produktutvecklingsteam där vi tar helhetsgrepp på våra kunders önskemål, från koncept till UX och publicerad webb samt ibland på konsultbasis i våra kunders team. Vi har i dagsläget tre större åtaganden men en hel del mindre inhouse-projekt och externa konsultåtaganden. Här är två större inhouse-åtaganden:
   

  

* Parks and Resorts - Vi utvecklar hela webblösningen inhouse i samarbete med kundens redaktörer och produktägare för samtliga parker. Den tekniska plattformen utvecklas med contentful/gatsby och .NET/Azure. Vi har blivit uppmärksammade nationellt för detta arbete, dels med ett silver i Svenska Designpriset 2019 för Kolmården, en nominering i Svenska Designpriset 2020 för Gröna Lund (prisutdelningen har ännu inte skett så vi vet inte var vi landar) samt Kolmården seger i IDG topp-100 för bästa turismsajt.
* Filmstaden - Har du bokat/köpt biobiljett? Kanske inte på sistone men innan året som gud glömde gjorde du antagligen det har du använt vår lösning. Vi ansvarar för all extern webb samt vissa interna delar. Med denna sajt vann vi IDG topp100 2018 (då SF Bio). Webben utvecklas i en episervermiljö med .NET och Azure.


**Vi tror att du har:**
* Ca 5 års erfarenhet av att arbeta skarpt som utvecklare. Det är viktigt att du arbetat i enterprise-projekt med webb för många slutanvändare.
* .NET och Azure-kompetens


**Det är meriterande om du har:**
* Kapacitet att ta tead-roll i våra projekt.
* Kompetens inom Episerver och Contentful-erfarenhet, Xamarin
* Erfarenhet som konsult


**Vi erbjuder**
 Vi är en flexibel arbetsplats som kommer erbjuda distansarbete även när pandemin är över. För dem som vill jobba från kontoret på Sveavägen är det bara att komma in och jobba, dem som föredrar distansarbete kommer jobba primärt hemifrån men vara på kontoret 1-2 dagar i veckan i alla fall av primärt sociala skäl. Vi vill inte bara vara en namnlista på Slack. Utöver den naturliga komptensutvecklingen som sker av att arbeta i team med likasinnade erbjuder vi både externa och interna utbildningar. Vi startar exempelvis ett nytt initiativ vi kallar Kompetensnätverk - Från utvecklare till arkitekt, där en av våra lösningsarkitekter guidar dem som vill mot mer kunskap inom arkitektur för att förbereda dig för en roll som lösningsarkitekt om du så önskar.
   

  

 Läs mer om hur det är att jobba på B3 och Rebel and Bird och hur vi arbetar med wellness och våra sociala initiativ här
   

  

 Klicka på ansökan eller tveka inte att kontakta Jocke Ginsburg på telefonnummer: 073-8133010 eller email: jocke@rebelandbird.com

title: Erfaren systemutvecklare Backend Java till Folksam
description:
Folksam genomgår en spännande transformation där vi går från systemcentrisk arkitektur till kundcentriska lösningar baserade på delade, återanvändbara komponenter, flöden och förmågor.
 



  





 Vi söker nu systemutvecklare backend inom Java som kan hjälpa oss att driva denna förändring tillsammans med oss inom avdelning Kommunikation och betalning. Den vi söker ska vara en erfaren javautvecklare som vill vara med och forma både plattformen och våra arbetssätt. Välkommen till Folksam – där du växer och gör skillnad.
 



  





**Det här gör du som systemutvecklare på Folksam** 




 Som systemutvecklare inom backend kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i att utveckla och konsolidera förmågor för betalning, notifieringar, säkra meddelanden och annan kundkommunikation för att förbättra kundupplevelsen. Du kommer att arbeta i ett team med andra utvecklare för att vi gemensamt ska uppnå våra mål. Teamet levererar funktionalitet kontinuerligt och ofta med fokus på snabb och ständigt ökande effekthemtagning. All utveckling sker i Java, med ett tätt samarbete mellan IT och verksamhet.
 



  





 Avdelningens huvudansvar finns i två domäner - kommunikation och betalning. Kommunikation bygger och förvaltar tjänster som notifieringar, säkra meddelanden, digitala formulär och centrala brevutskick. I betalningar hanterar vi tjänster för att visa och ändra betalningar. Vi bygger tjänster utifrån ett microserviceperspektiv och event. Vi värderar kvalitet högt för att våra system skall vara hållbara och förvaltningsbara.
 



  





**Är du den vi söker?** 




 Vi söker dig med minst sju års arbetslivserfarenhet som backendutvecklare. Du har kunskap och erfarenhet från design av återanvändbara backendtjänster samt implementation och integration, gärna inom bank och/eller försäkring.
 



  





 Vidare har du erfarenhet från detaljerad högnivåarkitektur från dokument till körbar kod samt Oauth2 och eventbaserad arkitektur. Vi ser att du har en högskole/universitetsutbildning inom IT-området.
 



  





 Det är meriterande:
 


* Erfarenhet av att driva nyutveckling och förvaltning av det utvecklade systemet.
* Att arbeta i en reglerad bransch såsom bank eller försäkring.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta enligt DevOps-principer.
* Regelverkserfarenhet så som DORA och GDPR.



  





 Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och förmågor. För att lyckas i uppdraget ser vi att du behöver vara kommunikativ, kreativ, lösnings- och resultatorienterad. Du tar ansvar för din uppgift och duktig på att bryta ned komplexa problem i hanterbara delar. Vi ser att du är en lagspelare som gärna involverar kollegor och arbetar tvärfunktionellt. Kunskapsöverföring till övriga team-medlemmar sker löpande som en del av det dagliga arbetet i teamet.
 



  





**Här kan du göra skillnad** 




 Välkommen till Folksam – här driver du viktiga frågor framåt. Från de avgörande detaljerna till de stora perspektiven, med fokus på att förenkla våra kunders vardag. Det gör att du bidrar till något större, oavsett roll. Här finns det många roliga, utvecklande jobb och du har goda chanser till en spännande karriär.
 



  





 Vi tror på ett hållbart arbetsliv och jobbar aktivt med inkludering och mångfald. Våra moderna kontor bjuder in till samarbete och lärande, här får vi saker att hända! Du har flexibiliteten att kunna varva arbete på kontoret med att jobba hemifrån, utifrån verksamhetens behov.
 



 Läs mer och se filmer om livet hos oss på
 
 folksam.se/jobb-och-karriar.
 




  





**Så söker du jobbet** 




 Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan senast 12 oktober 2026.
 




 Här
 
 kan du läsa mer om vilka bakgrundskontroller som kan vara aktuella i den här rekryteringen.
 



  





 Vill du veta mer om jobbet är du välkommen att kontakta Per Ruthström, avdelningschef, 072-468 72 58.
 



  





 Fackliga representanter: Akademikerföreningen Per Hansson 070-831 60 67, Forena Morgan Svensson 073- 423 59 12 och Handels Mikael Carlsson 070-831 51 32.

title: Systemutvecklare inom rättsväsendet
description:
Vi söker nu en systemutvecklare till en myndighet verksam inom rättsväsendet med ansvar för brottsutredningar och lagföring. Du blir en del av ett etablerat team som arbetar med vidareutveckling och förvaltning av ett verksamhetskritiskt system där kvalitet, stabilitet och verksamhetsförståelse är centrala delar av arbetet.
   

  

**Vad vi gör**
 Vi på Decerno är specialister på skräddarsydda digitala lösningar och är stolta över att våra uppdrag bidrar till samhällsnytta.
   

  

 Vi fokuserar på uppdrag där vi kan ta helhetsansvar och bemanna med team av våra egna medarbetare. Genom nära och långsiktiga samarbeten med våra kunder skapar vi hållbara lösningar utifrån varje verksamhets unika behov.
   

  

 Sedan starten 1984 har vi haft en stark etisk policy som vägleder vilka uppdrag vi tar oss an. Därför väljer vi aktivt bort uppdrag inom vapenindustrin, spel om pengar, tobak och alkohol.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som systemutvecklare kommer du tillsammans med ett etablerat team att vidareutveckla ett av Sveriges större verksamhetskritiska system inom rättsväsendet. Teamet arbetar aglit enligt Scrum och består av flera olika kompetenser samt har ett gemensamt ansvar för lösningens kvalitet, systemdesign och arkitektur.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:
   

  

* Javautveckling i ett större verksamhetskritiskt system
* Databasutveckling i Oracle
* Kravarbete och integrationer mellan olika system och myndigheter
* Vidareutveckling och förvaltning av befintliga lösningar


 Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor i Stockholm. Vi arbetar enligt en hybridmodell som kombinerar flexibiliteten i distansarbete med nära samarbete på våra kontor och hos kund. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning. Säkerhetsprövning kan ingå i rekryteringsprocessen.
   

  

**Är det här du?**
* Har minst fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och känner dig bekväm med att arbeta i Java. Erfarenhet av C#/.NET är också relevant.
* Har ett genuint intresse för AI och LLM-teknologier, och aktivt följer med i vad som händer på området
* Kommunicerar väl på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift


 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du som person är driven, självgående och tar ansvar för dina leveranser och på ett naturligt sätt bygger relationer och skapar förtroende.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete inom offentlig sektor eller myndighetsverksamhet. Vi ser även positivt på kunskap om eller intresse för konfiguration och användning av AI-modeller.
   

  

**Varför Decerno?**
 I våra medarbetarundersökningar blir det gång på gång tydligt att det är de fantastiska kollegorna, de roliga och utmanande projekten och möjligheten att bidra till samhällsnytta som gör att våra medarbetare trivs så bra hos oss.
   

  

 Några ytterligare aspekter vi gärna vill lyfta fram:
   

  

* En flexibel arbetsplats med större frihet att planera vardagen för att få arbete och privatliv att gå ihop
* Extra föräldraförmåner eftersom vi tycker att familjen är viktigast
* Löpande kompetensutveckling genom vår egen Dec Academy
* Sociala aktiviteter och hälsosatsningar
* Friskvårdsbidrag och ett generöst försäkringspaket


 Låter det som ditt nästa steg i karriären? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

**AI i rekryteringsprocessen**
 För att förbättra vår rekryteringsprocess använder vi AI-stöd. Alla ansökningar granskas alltid av våra rekryterare. Vi låter aldrig AI fatta egna beslut. Du har alltid rätt att få mer information om hur vi använder AI. Kontakta oss via rekrytering@decerno.se vid frågor.

title: Senior IT Developer - SAP
description:
**Job ID: 5835**
 Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior IT Developer with deep skills in the SAP-area.
   

  

 Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Meet theCore Finance Technology Team. Our role is to manage financial accounting and manage group procurement and third-party suppliers and contracts. Our team is also managing analysis and performance of Nordea business with its customers.
   

  

 The team is represented by people across the Nordics and Poland.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 Main responsibilities in this role:
   

  

**Act as a Senior IT developer in our SAP deliveries:**
* Lead the technical design and implementation of SAP reporting and analytics solutions across the SAP landscape, supporting Finance and Accounting business processes.
* Drive the development and optimisation of SAP data models, reporting solutions and integrations, ensuring alignment with architecture standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts and Architects to shape requirements and define scalable technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership through mentoring, code reviews, design reviews, solution governance and active participation in SAFe Agile ceremonies.
* Contribute to the future SAP S/4HANA reporting landscape, including CDS Views, PaPM, Embedded Analytics, Snowflake and Power BI.


**Who You Are**
 This is the right role for you if you are a hands-on developer who takes pride in clean, accurate development and thrive collaborating with others to reach success.
   

  

**Your background and skills include:**
* Strong experience as an SAP developer working with reporting and data warehousing solutions, with expertise in one or more of the following areas: ABAP, BW, BPC or S/4HANA.
* Strong experience designing, developing and testing SAP solutions in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong SQL, data modelling and analytical problem-solving skills, and ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Proven experience acting as a technical lead, in an Agile delivery model using Scrum, SAFe and DevOps principles.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.


**It would be ideal if you also:**
* Have experience with SAP S/4HANA reporting technologies such as CDS Views, PaPM and Embedded Analytics.
* Have knowledge of SAP BTP and SAP Integration Suite.
* Have experience defining reporting and analytics roadmaps across SAP and non-SAP platforms.
* Have knowledge of Finance, Accounting and regulatory reporting processes.


**What We Offer**
 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

 People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
   

  

 A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
   

  

 Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
   

  

 If this sounds like you, get in touch!
   

  

**Next steps**
 Submit your application no later than 22/10/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Karin Gyllenstrand.
   

  

 We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.
   

  

 We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
   

  

 We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.
   

  

 We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
   

  

 We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.
   

  

 Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think.
   

  

 For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Who are Benifex?** 
 💚💜
   

  

 We are a fast-moving technology company, and
 **one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world.** 
 We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build
 **workplace technology** 
 that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to
 **build remarkable experiences that employees love.** 
 Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best,
 **we need brilliant people** 
 on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀
   

  

**Why should you apply? 🌟**
* Impact: work on a product suite used by millions of people that improves employee experience and wellbeing.
* Scale: a big focus of our engineering teams is building features and services to support our customers globally.
* Autonomy: have an input into the product roadmap and technically lead features/services.
* Development: this is a crucial part of our aim to ensure a seamless experience across FPS.
* Top 10 Employer, Sunday Times Best Places to Work Awards
* Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and benefits space


**Role Overview 🚀**
 As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will work across frontend and backend areas that support Benifex employee experience products, mobile app, and platform look and feel.
   

  

 The team is responsible for operational continuity, technical stability, and continuous improvement beyond the product roadmap, which means the work often involves balancing new development with careful maintenance, refactoring, and production reliability.
   

  

 This role suits someone who enjoys complex domains, established systems, and end-to-end ownership. You will contribute to frontend development in React, TypeScript, and Angular, while also designing and maintaining backend services, APIs, and integrations using Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL.
   

  

 We are also on a journey to use AI more deliberately in our daily engineering work. We are looking for someone who has practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows, or who wants to keep exploring how these tools can help us move faster, improve quality, understand complex codebases, and reduce repetitive work without lowering our engineering standards.
   

  

**Great Benefits**
 🧠 ITP1 pension.
   

  

 ❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.
   

  

 📝 Collective agreement.
   

  

 💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.
   

  

 🤸 Generous wellness allowance.
   

  

 ✈️ 30 vacation days / year.
   

  

 💰 Referral bonuses.
   

  

 🌟 Enhanced parental pay.
   

  

 🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.
   

  

**Responsibilities 🤘**
* Design, build, and maintain fullstack features across employee experience products and platform UI areas.
* Build frontend functionality in React and TypeScript and support existing Angular-based applications.
* Develop and maintain backend services, APIs, and data flows using Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL.
* Integrate frontend experiences with reliable, well-designed APIs and platform services.
* Safely evolve a large, long-lived codebase through incremental refactoring and technical debt reduction.
* Treat reliability, security, performance, accessibility, and maintainability as core parts of delivery.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation, and knowledge-sharing.
* Help investigate bugs and production issues, identify root causes, and prevent recurring problems.
* Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical decisions within the team.
* Use AI-assisted and agentic coding tools thoughtfully as part of daily development, code exploration, testing, refactoring, and documentation.
* Help the team learn where AI adds value, where human judgement is still essential, and how to use these tools responsibly in a complex production codebase.


**What are we looking for? 🔎**
* Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL: Needed to build and maintain backend services, APIs, and data-driven functionality.
* React, TypeScript, and Angular: Needed to contribute across both future frontend development and existing FPS frontend areas.
* API design and integration: Important for creating dependable interfaces between frontend, backend, and platform services.
* Testing, CI/CD, and observability: Needed to deliver reliable changes and diagnose issues in production-like environments.
* AI-assisted and agentic coding: Practical experience using AI coding tools to explore codebases, generate or refactor code, write tests, support reviews, or accelerate delivery while maintaining strong engineering judgement.


**Please note:** 
 Our recruitment process will begin in mid-to-late August, once the hiring team has returned from their summer holidays. We appreciate your patience and look forward to reviewing your application.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving and reading your application!
   

  

**Our Interview Process ✌**
 Benifex understand the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible, typically a 2-2.5 week timeframe.
   

  

 📞 Initial informal call with the Talent team
   

  

 ⏳ Interview with our Engineering Director 30-45 min
   

  

 🧪 Technical Task
   

  

 🔎 Technical Interview - 60 min
   

  

 🤩 Final interview with VP of Engineering - 30-45 min
   

  

  

  

**We are a proud member of the Disability Confident employer scheme.**
**If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage during the recruitment process, please let us know with your application.**

title: Senior Engineer
description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!
 



  





 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
 



 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
 



  





**About the Role** 




 You love solving problems with technology. At your previous job you were the person who really got stuff done, and because you understood how everything worked you were someone people often came to for help. At Tandem, those skills will be applied to problems that really matter - problems that help ensure our healthcare system functions properly. You’ll be designing, implementing, and debugging high-stakes, complex systems together with other engineers who are deeply engaged and care about both our mission and the technology we build.
 



 You’ll work across the stack and collaborate closely with multiple teams, contributing to technical decisions, supporting others through collaboration and knowledge sharing, and helping ensure our systems are performant, reliable, and continuously improving.
 



 This is a high-impact role where you’ll help shape both the product and the way we build it. You’ll be responsible for writing excellent code, taking ownership of well-defined problem areas, and driving features and improvements from design to production. If you’re excited about building meaningful products and tackling challenging technical problems in a fast-moving environment, we’d love to meet you.
 



  





**What you will do:** 



* Design and develop complex systems - from data processing pipelines to APIs and client integrations that are critical to clinician workflows.
* Contribute to building and scaling cloud infrastructure to ensure high availability, performance, and security.
* Influence technical direction within your team through hands-on work, thoughtful design, and clear documentation.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders, including clinicians and designers, to ensure we're solving the right problems with the right solutions.
* Make and contribute to technical decisions across backend and frontend systems, including Python, TypeScript, React, and Kubernetes.
* Support and grow other engineers across the team through code reviews, design feedback, and strategic guidance.
* Continuously improve engineering practices, tooling, and code quality within your team.



  





**What You Bring** 



* A strong track record of delivering technical projects end-to-end in a fast-moving product environment.
* Solid experience building and deploying scalable backend systems.
* Experience working with cloud infrastructure and distributed systems, combined with a strong product mindset — you care about impact, not just code.
* A bias toward ownership, proactivity, and collaboration.
* Clear and effective communication skills, and the ability to contribute to technical and product discussions.



  





**Bonus Points** 



* Hands-on experience with LLM-based applications.
* Experience working with streaming audio, transcription systems, or real-time media pipelines.
* Experience building authentication servers and systems.
* Experience with Kubernetes and Azure
* Proficiency with modern frontend technologies, especially TypeScript and React.
* Participation in open-source projects or technical communities.
* Experience in health-tech.



  





**Location** 




 We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the Epicenter building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
 



 Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
 


1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
2. Technical interviews with some of our Engineering team
3. System Design Interview at our office - Join us in the Stockholm office for a lunch and a Product focused System Design interview to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.
4. Follow-up interview with our CTO & Co-Founder



  





**Benefits** 



* Competitive salary & company stock options
* 30 days/year of paid vacation
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives
* Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents
* Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
* Mental health support through our partner Mindler
* Pension program
* Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.



*We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.*

description:
Playground Tech
   

  

* Stockholm
* Hybrid


 Cloud Developer – Building high-performance DevEx tools in Go/Golang
   

  

 The world of cloud is changing. Fast. And we want you, who thrive on the bleeding edge and build cleanly in
 **Go** 
 , to transform the Cloud space with us!
   

  

 We’re growing our team with a low-ego, collaborative, and backend-focused Cloud Developer who sees
 **Golang** 
 as their home turf and
 **Developer Experience (DevEx)** 
 as their main product. You are the force multiplier for client engineering teams: the connective tissue that builds internal tooling, CLI tools, microservices, and paved roads that allow everyone else to ship faster, safer, and with true engineering discipline, especially in an AI-accelerated dev world.
   

  

 If you love the simplicity, concurrency, and raw speed of Go, and get a kick out of building tools that other developers actually enjoy using, this is your Playground.
   

  

 At heart, this is a developer-productivity role. On assignment, you are the one who elevates a client's entire engineering engine:
   

  

* Go as the core language: You'll build internal services, custom CLIs, operator tooling, and lightweight backends primarily written in Go. Of course, we realize that you probably enjoy other languages as well (could be Java, Python, Typescript, .NET etc.) and this role is not at all limited to Go, it just has to be a proven weapon of choise in your arsenal
* The Cloud is your substrate: You bridge code, infrastructure, and delivery pipelines (CI/CD, IaC) so that shipping code to AWS, Azure, or GCP feels effortless for the rest of the team
* DevEx in the AI Era: Client teams are shipping faster than ever with AI coding tools. Your job is to build the surrounding guardrails, testing harnesses, and Go-based tooling that keep that speed safe, reliable, and clean


 You’re less about churning out standard end-user business logic, and more about eliminating friction, reducing toil, and building the high-speed infrastructure that other devs rely on daily.
   

  

 What this role is (and is not)
   

  

**What This Role Is**
* Primary Go/Golang Development: Designing and building fast, concurrent, and reliable internal services, CLI tools, libraries, and developer platforms
* Smoothing the path to production: Developing CI/CD, build pipelines, and paved roads that make shipping code fast, safe, and repeatable
* Elevating team velocity: Doing the architectural and connective work that acts as a force multiplier for whole engineering orgs
* Bringing discipline to AI workflow: Creating the harnesses, guardrails, and integrations that let teams leverage AI without introducing chaos


**What This Role Is Not**
* Not a "vanilla" feature dev: You won't be stuck in standard CRUD/backlog feature loops. Your product is the developer platform itself
* Not a frontend or pure Data/ML role: You consume and integrate AI services and cloud primitives
* You don't train ML models or build data pipelines as your core craft


 Who are you?
   

  

 Your temperament matters as much as your code. You’re a curious, low-ego builder who takes pride in system craftsmanship, writes clean and maintainable Go code, and communicates clearly.
   

  

**Skills & Background**
* Go (Golang) is your primary language and home turf: You know its concurrency patterns, standard library, and ecosystem inside out.
* 5+ years in software engineering / backend / cloud engineering, with a genuine passion for building for builders
* Comfort or depth in at least one secondary modern language (e.g., Python, C#, Java, or TypeScript)
* Cloud & IaC experience: Solid foundation in AWS, Azure, or GCP, combined with Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi or Terraform preferred)
* Demonstrable engagement with AI tooling: Whether it’s building CLI wrappers around LLMs, using AI coding assistants in your workflow, or integrating AI SDKs into Go apps
* Fluency in Swedish and English (as client engagements are primarily conducted in Swedish)


 Bonus: Kubernetes experience (managed or self-managed).
   

  

 Note: no \*ss-hats wanted or needed.
   

  

 Let's Play!
   

  

 Applying to us is a breeze!
   

  

* Upload your resumé or use your Linkedin profile
* Answer the choice-questions (no "please-rewrite-your-resume" nonsense, promise)
* Feel free to include links to your portfolio, GitHub or similar if you have stuff you're proud of that you want to share with us


**Important Notes**
* Playground Group does not provide visa sponsorship or relocation support
* Applicants must already have a permanent and independent right to work in Sweden
* As part of the final stage of the recruitment process, a background check conducted by a third party will be carried out.

title: React Native Developer
description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a React Native Developer for the next phase of growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will own the mobile product experience end-to-end, making real decisions about how a shared codebase should be structured, not just building features inside one. You’ll be working cross-functionally across mobile, web, and design, and your mission is to build robust features that power our rapid global expansion.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain high-performance, cross-platform (iOS, Android, web) features in our unified codebase for cross-market deployment.
* Ensure code quality through continuous testing, code reviews, and robust software architecture practices.
* Drive the implementation of AI frameworks and automated agents to shift our platform toward an agentic-first operating model.
* Optimize app performance and maintain strict security standards across high-volume financial systems.
* Use tools to monitor stability and product usage, and act on what they surface.
* Translate customer needs and UX designs into seamless, scalable frontend components.


 What we’re looking for
   

  

 You bring a structured, quality-driven approach to mobile architecture and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You take full accountability for your code, enjoy collaborating within cross-functional teams, and actively look for ways to optimize delivery through modern technology.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Several years of experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-level React Native applications, ideally including Expo.
* Proven background taking architectural ownership of mobile application frameworks.
* Strong TypeScript fluency; comfort with Redux Toolkit/RTK Query or an equivalent state-management approach.
* Hands-on experience with automated testing (unit/integration + E2E) and a disciplined code review practice.
* Professional fluency in English with strong cross-functional communication skills.


**Why Qred?**
 This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
   

  

 One Last Thing
   

  

 This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
   

  

*Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.*
 Qred is an international FinTech scale-up that specializes in digital financing solutions for small businesses, with operations in the Nordics, Benelux, Germany and Brazil. We are passionate about helping small businesses thrive and grow, by providing them with business loans and credit cards. Right now we’re in an exciting phase of our journey that focuses on growth through smart product development and technology fueled by international expansion.

title: Embeddedutvecklare (C/C++ utvecklare)
description:
Vill du arbeta i teknikens framkant och utveckla framtidens smarta och tekniskt avancerade system? Vi söker en
 **Embeddedutvecklare** 
 som trivs i en dynamisk utvecklingsmiljö där du får arbeta nära både hårdvara och mjukvara, lösa komplexa problem och skapa robusta lösningar med höga krav på prestanda och kvalitet.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 I rollen som Embeddedutvecklare kommer du att vara involverad i hela utvecklingskedjan för inbyggda system, från design och implementation till integration, verifiering och felsökning. Du blir en viktig länk mellan mjukvara och hårdvara och arbetar nära våra tvärfunktionella team för att ta fram produkter där kvalitet, tillförlitlighet och funktion står i centrum.
   

  

**Som Embeddedutvecklare kommer du bland annat att:**
* Utveckla och implementera hårdvarunära mjukvara i C och/eller C++.
* Arbeta med utveckling och konfiguration i Linux och/eller realtidsoperativsystem (RTOS).
* Genomföra systemintegration samt avancerad felsökning på både hårdvaru- och mjukvarunivå.
* Ta ansvar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen, från idé och arkitektur till test, verifiering och färdig produkt.
* Delta i och driva kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete (continuous improvement) av koden, verktygen och utvecklingsprocesserna.
* Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med bland annat hårdvarukonstruktörer, testingenjörer och projektledare.


**Vi söker dig som har:**
* Har en Civil- eller högskoleingenjörsexamen inom exempelvis datateknik, elektroteknik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande.
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av C och/eller C++.
* Erfarenhet av embedded systems och hårdvarunära mjukvaruutveckling.
* Goda kunskaper i Linux och/eller realtidsoperativsystem (RTOS).
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av felsökning på både hård- och mjukvarunivå.
* God erfarenhet av Git och versionshantering.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


**Det är meriterande om du även har:**
* Erfarenhet av Python eller andra scriptspråk.
* Erfarenhet av automatiserade tester, CI/CD och moderna testmiljöer.
* Kunskaper eller erfarenhet inom FPGA, elektronik eller kommunikationssystem/protokoll.


**Personliga egenskaper**
 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen som embeddedutvecklare ser vi att du har en mycket god analytisk förmåga och problemlösningsförmåga. Du är nyfiken, kvalitetsmedveten och fascineras av hur hårdvara och mjukvara samverkar i komplexa system.
   

  

 Vi lägger stor vikt vid att du är självständig och har ett högt eget driv, samtidigt som du har en god kommunikations- och samarbetsförmåga och trivs med att arbeta i tvärfunktionella team. Du motiveras av att arbeta med förbättringsarbete och strävar alltid efter att optimera både lösningar och arbetssätt.
   

  

 Syntronic erbjuder en trygg anställning i en dynamisk och framåtriktad miljö. Att vi är ett team är vår styrka, därför ser vi att du arbetar tillsammans på plats med oss på kontoret – när du inte behövs hos någon av våra kunder förstås!
   

  

**Vi erbjuder**
 På Syntronic blir du en del av en härlig gemenskap där din röst hörs och dina idéer välkomnas. Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetstider, balans mellan arbete och fritid samt regelbundna karriärutvecklingssamtal och interna workshops för din utveckling. Utöver detta får du förmånliga förmåner och försäkringar. Hos oss får du inte bara ett jobb - du får en plats att växa och trivas både personligt och professionellt. Välkommen till Syntronic!
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan, som ska vara oss tillhanda senast 22 oktober.
   

  

 Vi gör urval löpande och matchar din profil mot aktuella och kommande uppdrag hos våra kunder. Våra processer kan därför variera i tid beroende på när rätt möjlighet dyker upp. Just nu ser vi ett ökat behov av den här kompetensen på marknaden, och det kan innebära spännande nya möjligheter för dig framöver.
   

  

 Bakgrundskontroller kan förekomma.
   

  

 Av kommunikation- och kvalitetssäkringsskäl ber vi dig att skicka in din ansökan digitalt via vårt system och inte via e-post.
   

  

 Vi kan använda AI och automatiserade verktyg som stöd i vår rekryteringsprocess. Alla beslut om urval och anställning fattas alltid av människor.

title: Senior Principal Runtime Engineer
description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Runtime team at Sambanova is a seasoned engineering team with a proven track record of delivering cutting-edge system software solutions for AI and machine learning applications in the enterprise & commercial landscape.
   

  

 Runtime is responsible for the lowest levels of the SambaNova stack, efficiently interacting with the hardware to provide the best application performance and maximize hardware utilization. We handle all aspects of software infrastructure to enable higher level applications, including:
   

  

* High performance user libraries
* Operating System interface/integration
* Data model manipulation for scaling
* Networking/communication intra and inter node
* Orchestration of partitioned workloads
* Error monitoring and tools for system management and observability


 We build a high performance, distributed and scalable software execution environment for SambaNova DataScale & Cloud platforms to support data-flow applications such as ML training and inference and HPC applications.
   

  

 We are searching for a software engineer who will work on all parts of the runtime stacks, supporting AI, ML, and scientific applications in high-performance distributed systems. You will participate in building, testing and deploying next-generation high-performance compute systems for AI applications at scale. We expect the candidate to have a strong background in programming, building and testing software in distributed systems, performance tuning of large scale systems, and good teamwork and planning skills.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work on design and implementation of new and enhanced features of the runtime stack to support high performance and scalable ML inference and training applications
* System software (drivers and kernel) support for the next generation silicon.
* Design user-space libraries for high performance and high utilization of HW resources.
* User-facing tools (analysis, job and HW management, profiling, debugging, etc) for Datascale systems.
* Collaborate with other teams including Hardware, ML Application, Compiler, DevOps.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent and with 3-5 years of industry experience
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python
* Experience with user space libraries, operating systems, and kernel drivers
* Experience working with highly concurrent and distributed systems, with a focus on performance and scalability


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with different types of fabrics, such as PCIe, Infiniband, and RoCE
* Experience with fast networking stacks, such as RDMA
* Good communication skills and enthusiasm to help colleagues


**Submission Guidelines**
 Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.
   

  

**EEO Policy**
 SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Benefits Summary For US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions**
 SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.
