title: Snowflake. Developer
description:
What makes Cognizant a unique place to work? The combination of rapid growth and an international and innovative environment! This is creating a lot of opportunities for people like YOU — people with an entrepreneurial spirit who want to make a difference in this world. At Cognizant, together with your colleagues from all around the world, you will collaborate on creating solutions for the world's leading companies and help them become more flexible, more innovative and successful.
   

  

**The role**
 Snowflake Developer is responsible for designing, building, and optimizing data pipelines using Snowflake and IDMC. Build and maintain ETL/ELT workflows and data pipelines using Snowflake and IDMC to process large datasets efficiently. Design data models, create and maintain views, stored procedures, and other database objects in Snowflake, optimize data storage, and ensure scalability in Snowflake. Implement data governance, access controls, and encryption to protect sensitive information.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 
* Analyse business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* 
* Design, develop, and implement ETL/ELT pipelines to migrate data from Teradata to Snowflake.
* 
* Optimize migration processes ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and performance.
* 
* Create and manage Snowflake objects (tables, views, schemas, stages, procedures).
* 
* Implement partitioning, clustering, and performance tuning strategies.
* 
* Implement and manage Snowflake features such as Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, and Time Travel
* 
* Develop and maintain data models, schemas, and stored procedures in Snowflake SQL
* 
* Monitor and tune Snowflake performance, including warehouse sizing and query optimization and ensure efficient resource utilization and cost optimization.
* 
* Manage external stages, storage integrations, data security, access controls, and role-based permissions in Snowflake
* 
* Automate data ingestion from various sources using Snowflake connectors and external stages using different file format, code pages, and any integration with Saas tools (e.g. dbt cloud, Fivetran, Databricks etc).
* 
* Rewrite and optimize Teradata SQL scripts, macros, and stored procedures for Snowflake compatibility.
* 
* Develop reusable scripts for automation of migration tasks (Python, Shell etc.).
* 
* Conduct data reconciliation between Teradata and Snowflake post-migration.
* 
* Work closely with data architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements.
* 
* Document migration processes, best practices, and technical solutions.


**Technical Skills**
* 
* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake cloud data warehouse.
* 
* Knowledge of Snowflake features: Time Travel, Cloning, Micro-partitions, Streams & Tasks.
* 
* Hands on experience in Snowflake features like external stages, Snowpipe, storage integration, File Formats, RBAC etc
* 
* Strong experience with SQL and various database technologies (Oracle, Teradata SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.).
* 
* Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD practices for data pipelines and workflows.
* 
* Experience in data engineering or database development, particularly with data migrations.
* 
* Experience in different batch processing and data loading/transformation strategies.
* 
* Proficiency in scripting for automating regular or repeating task (python, shell scripting etc).
* 
* Understanding of Teradata architecture, SQL, and utilities (BTEQ, FastLoad, MultiLoad, TPT).
* 
* Experience in analysing and converting Teradata-specific functions to Snowflake equivalents.
* 
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* 
* Snowflake SnowPro Certification is a plus
* 
* Experience in banking and financial services will be preferred.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer (Multiple Domains)
description:
**About Wolt**
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
   

  

 Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
   

  

 Analytics at Wolt is a business-critical area that covers three different teams: data science, regional business operations, and analytics engineering. The complexity of online delivery, differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, and vast amounts of data make our work truly interesting!
   

  

 Now we are looking for three experienced
 **Senior Analytics Engineers** 
 to join our Analytics Engineering teams. We have three domains available:
 **Consumer, Merchant, or Ads** 
 . You can work in
 **Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki** 
 .
   

  

**About The Role**
 The role is focused on the business needs - you’ll be working within a cross-functional team, making sure your teammates get the insights needed for their operations. The role requires interpreting the needs and requests of our internal stakeholders from business and product, and transforming them into actionable data. Data Scientists working in the domain will be your closest partners in your day-to-day work, as your solutions will enable them to create relevant experiments, A/B tests, and analyses.
   

  

**Your daily work will include**
* Developing reporting and metrics quality as a whole, from understanding the needs of the business to providing easily understandable and actionable data.
* Working on our centrally maintained data integrations and data pipelines powering our Data Warehouse, our data models, and dashboards. You'll get to utilize our modern tech stack as part of your work (Snowflake, SQL, Looker, Wolt Inhouse ETL, Airflow, Dagster, Github).
* Design and implement complex data pipelines with dependency control, orchestration, and auto-materialisation logic.
* Develop a self-service data modelling strategy and partner with Analytics and other stakeholders for implementation.
* Increase data literacy across the domain and expertise through hands-on training and documentation.
* Lead, mentor, and guide more junior team members.


 Our humble expectations
   

  

* 5+ years of experience working as an Analytics Engineer or BI Developer.
* Strong hands-on experience with data integrations, data pipelines, data models, metric development, and dashboards.
* Tech skills: Snowflake, SQL, Airflow, DBT, Looker, or other visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, etc.
* Advanced SQL skills and ability to write optimized queries for large data sets.
* Strong business acumen and product-oriented thinking with significant experience in the design and implementation of analytics and reporting data models.


 What we offer
   

  

* The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
* You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the location above. 💙
* You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.


 Next steps
   

  

 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
   

  

 For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Product+ Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via zhanna.filintseva@wolt.com
   

  

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
   

  

*Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .*

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Techster Solutions** 
 befinner i dagsläget sig i en spännande tillväxtfas och söker nu fler kollegor, inledningsvis dig med minst
 **3+** 
 års erfarenhet och som kan stärka teamet.
   

  

 Du kan förvänta dig en omväxlande miljö, dagarna kan se väldigt olika ut - men en sak är säkert, här får du använda dina kompetenser och sätter själv gränsen för hur mycket du vill utvecklas. Som ett kunskapsbolag är det viktigt för oss att våra specialister delar med sig av sin kompetens och får kollegorna att växa.
   

  

**Rollbeskrivning** 
 :
   

  

 Vi söker nu en senior Data Engineer.
   

  

 Uppdragsbeskrivning:
   

  

 Kund söker en driven och framåtsträvande senior data engineer till Digitaliseringsenheten. Enheten ingår i avdelningen för verksamhetsstöd och ansvarar för verksamhetsnära digitala lösningar som stöder myndighetens kärnverksamhet.
   

  

 Digitaliseringsenheten arbetar agilt i fyra utvecklingsteam och präglas av innovation, nytänkande och höga ambitioner.
   

  

 Som senior data engineer blir du en nyckelperson i utvecklingen och förvaltningen av vårt datalager och våra BI-lösningar. Du kommer att driva tekniska beslut, optimera dataprocesser och säkerställa robusta, långsiktiga lösningar som skapar värde för verksamheten samt analysera och lösa komplexa problem på djupet.
   

  

 Placering: kunds kontor i Stockholm men med möjlighet till visst distansarbete.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
* Designa, utveckla och underhålla datalager, ETL-flöden och SSAS-kuber för rapportering och analys.
* Bygga datamodeller i SSAS som möjliggör effektiva och användarvänliga Power BI-lösningar.
* Felsöka, analysera och lösa komplexa problem i datalager och dataprocesser, från rotorsak till färdig lösning.
* Driva tekniska beslut kring arkitektur, datamodellering, datakvalitet och optimering av kuber.
* Samarbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå behov och omvandla dem till datadrivna beslutsstöd.
* Coachning och mentorskap av kollegor i teamet, inklusive standardisering av kod och processer.
* Bidra till en insiktsdriven myndighet genom att identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och föreslå nya lösningar.


 Krav
   

  

 Skallkrav:
   

  

* Relevant högskoleutbildning inom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller annan teknisk utbildning som bedöms relevant.
* Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet som data engineer med fokus på datalager, ETL, BI-lösningar eller motsvarande.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i SSAS (SQL Server Analysis Services) och erfarenhet av att bygga kuber, datamodeller och measures för analys och rapportering.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av att skriva och optimera komplexa queries.
* Erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL Server on-prem, inklusive Management Studio och databasadministration på utvecklingsnivå.
* God förståelse för datamodellering och databasdesign (t.ex. 3NF och Kimball).
* Vana vid Git och versionshantering, samt dokumentation av kod och dataprocesser.
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.
* Utvärdering av de personliga egenskaperna kommer att ske vid en eventuell intervju


 Börkrav:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila team och nära kärnverksamheten.
* Erfarenhet av att driva förbättringar inom datakvalitet, datastyrning och best practices.


**Ansökan**
 Tror du att du är
 **Techster Solutions** 
 nästa stjärna? Tveka då inte att skicka in din ansökan redan nu. Urval sker löpande och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Arbetsplats och kultur
   

  

 Vi är ett entreprenördrivet IT företag, med både produktkunskap och försäljning (Techster AB) och konsultativa tjänster (Techster Solutions AB). Det innebär att vi är mycket öppna för nya tekniska lösningar, kunskapsutbyte och ständigt lärande. Att ha roligt och samtidigt behålla den familjära andan utan hierarkier är lika viktigt.
   

  

 Vi vill skapa det konsultbolag som du alltid velat jobba för, men kanske inte hittat ännu. Redan idag har vi en blandning av seniora och yngre medarbetare, såväl som män och kvinnor. Det vill vi fortsätta att bygga på. Så välkommen med din ansökan!

title: AI Operations Engineer
description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can design, build and operate AI solutions that create real business value, removing manual work, improving processes and helping colleagues focus on higher-value work.
 



  





 The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you build can be used by colleagues within weeks. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI practice from the beginning and see your work create visible impact across the business.
 



  





 At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.
 



  





**About the AI Hub** 




 The AI Hub is a new function within People & Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.
 



  





 We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.
 



  





 The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.
 



  





**The role** 




 Your users are your colleagues.
 



 You'll build the systems, automations and AI-powered solutions that consultants, support teams, sales teams and back-office functions rely on to do their work. You'll work directly with the people experiencing the problem, helping shape solutions that fit how work actually happens.
 



  





 This is a small team with a short path from idea to implementation. Some opportunities can move from a conversation on Monday to a solution in production that same week. Others require deeper technical design, data modelling or integration work. You'll help make those calls and take ownership of what gets built long after launch.
 



  





 You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The
 
 AI Business Partner
 
 leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. You lead technical design, engineering and operations. Both of you are involved while the problem is being defined and stay close after launch to ensure solutions create lasting value.
 



  





 Some examples of what is already live
 



 This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:
 


* An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
* Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
* Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.



  





 The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




 You'll typically be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution, from the first conversation through to operation and continuous improvement.Your work will include:
 


* Building AI agents, automations and integrations that remove manual work and improve how teams operate.
* Working directly with colleagues to understand problems and shape practical solutions.
* Designing data models, workflows and integrations that support reliable AI solutions.
* Deciding where automation makes sense, where AI adds value and where human judgement should remain part of the process.
* Owning the solutions you build, including reliability, monitoring, security and cost management.
* Improving solutions based on how people actually use them.
* Creating documentation and reusable patterns that allow others to understand, maintain and extend your work.



  





**Our technology stack** 




 Today we use Claude Code and Anthropic models, our own MCP servers running on Azure Container Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions and Logic Apps. We already have agentic workflows running in production.
 



  





 The tools will change. If something better comes along and you can make the case for it, you'll have room to improve the setup. Whatever we run needs to be secure, understandable, maintainable and cost-effective.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




 We're less interested in a specific career path than in your ability to build reliable solutions that people depend on.You'll likely bring:
 


* Experience building integrations, backend services, automations or internal platforms.
* Strong technical foundations in areas such as Azure, Microsoft Graph, APIs, serverless technologies, Python or C#.
* Experience delivering AI-powered solutions that real users rely on.
* Good technical judgement and the ability to choose simple solutions when they solve the problem.
* An understanding of security, reliability and operational ownership.
* Awareness of the trade-offs between capability, speed, complexity and cost.
* The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues.



  





 You care about the work behind the request, not just the technology. You want to understand how people use what you've built, whether they trust it and how it can be improved over time.
 



 You don't need HR or HCM experience. If this sounds broadly like you, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**What success looks like** 




 Your first few weeks will be about understanding our infrastructure, the solutions already running and the colleagues who use them.
 



  





 You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager on new opportunities, helping assess what is technically possible and where the best place to start might be.
 



 We want you building early, while giving you enough time to understand the environment you're responsible for.
 



  





 By day 90, we'd expect you to have taken ownership of parts of the existing platform, contributed to new solutions entering production, and built strong relationships with the colleagues using them.
 



  





**Why join CatalystOne?** 




 This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and see your work used by colleagues across the company.You'll have the chance to:
 


* Build solutions that create visible business impact.
* Work directly with the people using what you build.
* Shape how the AI Hub develops.
* Experiment with modern AI technologies while staying focused on real business outcomes.
* Take ownership from idea through production and continuous improvement.



  





 If you're excited by the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems and help shape the future of work at CatalystOne, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**Benefits** 




 As well as your salary, you’ll receive:
 


* Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
* Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
* Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
* Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.
* Flexible work setup: A hybrid model that supports your work life balance, with at least three days a week in the office.
* And more: Local benefits vary slightly by office, and we are happy to walk you through the details.



  





*CatalystOne does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. CatalystOne will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to the specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to CatalystOne on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.* 




  





*We would like to inform you that all candidates who receive a job offer will be subject to a background check.*

title: System Engineer, Technology Trading FX | SEB, Sweden
description:
Are you an experienced System Engineer who enjoys combining hands-on development with platform stability and continuous improvement? Join Technology Trading FX/MM and help us develop robust and scalable solutions in a business-critical FX trading environment.
   

  

 Our department is part of Technology Trading and consists of around 60 professionals responsible for the development and maintenance of systems supporting FX trading. We operate in a fast-paced environment where time-to-market, stability and quality are essential to business success.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a System Engineer in our FX Trading development team, you will work hands-on with the Murex platform, developing new data flows and contributing to a stable, scalable and high-performing trading environment. Using a structured and engineering-focused approach, you will build robust and maintainable solutions that support both current business needs and the platform’s long-term development.
   

  

 Working closely with colleagues across technology and business, you will analyze and improve application workflows, strengthen system integrations and drive performance enhancements across the platform. A significant part of the role involves investigating and resolving complex production issues, supporting platform upgrades and identifying opportunities to improve operational stability through monitoring, automation and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will play an important role in ensuring the reliability, scalability and performance of the platform while working with technologies such as PostgreSQL, Linux and modern DevOps practices. At the same time, we are exploring how AI and new engineering tools can simplify workflows and improve operational insight. We are therefore looking for someone who is curious, eager to challenge existing ways of working and motivated to help move both the platform and the team forward.
   

  

**Your Background And Skills**
 You have experience working with financial systems, trading platforms or risk management environments. title: Azure Data Engineer to Handelsbanken
description:

**Your Team**
 You will be part of a team of data engineers who are all passionate about building robust and scalable data pipelines. Your team is responsible for building and operating the foundations of the data modeling to enable scalable, reliable, and business-driven analytics on the data platform to enable data engineers from around the bank to build high-performant data pipelines and data products. The team will also be working closely to team within ingestion, data platform and BI and of course, our domains end-user around the bank.
   

  

 The position is based at our office in central Stockholm.

* Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and transformations in Azure Databricks and dbt, contributing to the evolution of our data architecture and engineering practices.

 On top of your technical tasks, you will be expected to actively contribute with your knowledge, experience and personality in building a high-performing team.

This role is focused on data pipeline engineering and development, not platform infrastructure; familiarity with platform concepts is useful but not the focus. You understand Swedish and are willing to improve your skills, or already speak it.
   

  

 Technical skills:
   

  

* Strong hands on experience with SQL, PySpark, and Python for building and optimizing data pipelines and transformations.

title: Juniora Analysts till Deloitte Digital (Stockholm) - Jan 2027
description:
Deloitte är en globalt ledande leverantör av Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal och Consultative Services. Med mer än 470 000 medarbetare i över 150 länder hjälper vi våra klienter och vår omvärld att lösa komplexa problem och nå ambitiösa mål genom områdes- och branschexpertis, global räckvidd och allianser med de största tech-leverantörerna. Det som definierar Deloitte är vår strävan efter att göra en meningsfull skillnad. För oss innebär det långsiktig utveckling och resultat för våra klienter och deras företag, idéer och handlingar som också bidrar till en positiv samhällsutveckling. Det handlar även om att stärka våra medarbetare och främja deras utveckling.
   

  

  




**Jobbeskrivning**

 Inom Deloitte Digital stödjer du Deloittes kunder med strategi, rådgivning och systemimplementation för att utveckla deras e-handels-, försäljning-, kundservice- och marknadsföringsfunktioner. En stor del av ditt arbete inkluderar implementation av system så som Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Adobe som Commercetools. Förutom systemutveckling bygger Deloitte Digital skräddarsydda lösningar i tech stacks som React, Next.js, Swift, Kotlin. I vårt team finner du utvecklare (frontend / backend), applikationsspecialister, kravanalytiker och verksamhetsutvecklare. Hos oss kommer du kunna stärka din tekniska kompetens och jobba med bland annat utveckling, teknisk arkitektur, data och systemintegration. Du kommer att arbeta nära klient för att stärka deras kundupplevelse genom strategiska och taktiska initiativ samtidigt som du utvecklar djup branschkunskap och verksamhetsförståelse.
   

  

  




**Kvalifikationer**

 Vi söker dig som:
   

  

  




* Är nyexaminerad med en masterexamen inom systemvetenskap eller ingenjörsvetenskap, med inriktning mot data.
* Har relevant arbetserfarenhet eller stort intresse för data, kodning och systemutveckling samt businessförståelse och bransch-kompetens.


 Meriterande:
   

  

  

* Goda studieresultat, internationell erfarenhet och relevant engagemang vid sidan av studierna
* Goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans i ett team, med målmedvetenhet, engagemang och driv
* Intresse för hur digitalisering / AI och ny teknik kan utveckla verksamheter och branscher


*Om du är osäker på om du uppfyller ovan kvalifikationer uppmuntrar vi dig att skicka in en ansökan ändå.*
**Ytterligare information**

**Vi erbjuder**
  

 Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor som är experter inom sina områden. Du får arbeta med spännande, komplexa uppdrag, både på global och nordisk nivå, i team som alltid värderar ditt perspektiv. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att erbjuda dig möjligheter att driva din personliga utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig praktisk erfarenhet, en personlig coach som långsiktigt stöttar dig i din karriär och kontinuerlig feedback och support från mer erfarna kollegor.
   

  

  





 Du får möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag som hjälper andra aktörer i deras resa mot en mer hållbar organisation, samtidigt som vi arbetar målmedvetet med våra egna ambitioner inom både klimat, miljö och socialt ansvar. Vi ser ett värde i att våra medarbetare har olika erfarenheter vilket främjar nytänkande och bidrar till fler perspektiv.
   

  

  





**Ansökan**
  

 Du ansöker online. Din ansökan ska bestå av:
   

  

  




* CV


* Betygskopior från högskola/universitet - De betyg som du laddar upp bör inte vara utdragna senare än 2 månader tillbaka i tiden.


 I det första steget laddar du upp ditt CV. I nästa steg laddar du upp dina universitetsbetyg (över hittills avklarade kurser) samt svarar på frågor som är kopplade till rollen, inklusive en motivering till varför du sökt denna roll. Observera att både CV samt fullständiga betyg behöver laddas upp för att din ansökan ska ses som fullständig. Vi tillämpar löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid inskickad ansökan ska du få ett bekräftelsemejl från oss. Får du inte detta mejl råder vi dig att skicka in din ansökan på nytt. Om du söker flera tjänster hos oss ber vi dig att i dina ansökningar tydliggöra vilken roll du är mest intresserad av.
   

  

  


 Som ett kvalitativt led i Deloittes rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll, detta för att öka kännedomen om våra framtida medarbetare, trygga arbetsmiljön för våra medarbetare och möta regelkrav. Processen för bakgrundskontroller genomförs i samarbete med ToFindOut. https://tofindout.se/sv/faq/. För de tjänster som Deloitte efterfrågar universitetsbetyg genomförs en verifiering som en del i rekryteringsprocessen. För frågor hänvisar vi till ansvarig rekryterare i processen.
   

  

  





**Frågor**
  

 Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare William Lim, wilim@deloitte.se
   

  

  





 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

  





**What impact will you make?**




 På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
**About eComID** 




  





 eComID is building the Shopping Passport for modern commerce - a shopper context layer that enables brands to understand and personalize every shopper from their very first visit. By combining AI-powered sizing, conversational search and intelligent product discovery, we’re making online shopping smarter, more personal and less wasteful.
 



 Launched in Stockholm in 2024, eComID is already operating at scale, reaching more than 20 million shoppers every month. We recently raised a $17.4 million seed round - the largest in European fashion-tech history and the second-largest globally.
 



 We’re backed by H&M Group, Stadium, leading international VCs and some of Europe’s most successful industry leaders and technology founders, including Helena Helmersson, Sebastian Knutsson, Maria Raga and Alan Mamedi.
 



 Now, we’re bringing together exceptional people with warm hearts to build a world-class fashion-tech company from Stockholm. If you want to solve meaningful problems, move fast and help shape how the world shops, this is the place to do it.
 



  





  





**What you will work on** 




  





 We are looking for a Solutions Engineer who can work closely with our brands, understand their technical setup, and help them successfully integrate and launch EcomID.
 



 You will sit between customers, product, and engineering. Your job is to make integrations smooth, solve technical problems quickly, and ensure brands get real value from our products.
 



 This is not a traditional support role. You will own technical onboarding, help shape integration decisions, and bring what you learn from customers directly back into the product.
 



 You will work directly with brands from technical discovery through launch and beyond, including:
 


* Leading the technical onboarding of new brands
* Understanding customer systems, ecommerce platforms, APIs, data flows, and integration constraints
* Helping brands integrate EcomID into their existing technical stack
* Guiding customer engineering teams through implementation and launch
* Troubleshooting integration issues across frontend, backend, APIs, and data
* Configuring and validating integrations before going live
* Working closely with our engineering team when deeper technical changes are required
* Writing scripts, prototypes, or small integration components when useful
* Helping customers understand our APIs, SDKs, data requirements, and technical capabilities
* Identifying recurring integration problems and turning them into better tooling, documentation, or product improvements
* Supporting complex technical conversations during the sales process
* Helping define scalable onboarding processes as EcomID grows
* Acting as a technical partner to some of the largest brands we work with



 You will have a direct impact on how quickly customers can launch and how successfully they use EcomID.
 



  





**What we are looking for** 




  





 We are looking for someone who is technically strong, comfortable working directly with customers, and enjoys solving ambiguous problems.
 



 You should have experience with several of the following:
 


* Working in a customer-facing technical role
* Integrating APIs, SDKs, or web-based products
* Understanding web applications and modern frontend/backend architectures
* JavaScript or TypeScript
* Python or another general-purpose programming language
* HTTP, REST, RPC, authentication, webhooks, and common integration patterns
* Debugging issues across different systems and environments
* Working directly with engineers and technical stakeholders at customers
* Translating technical problems into clear explanations and practical solutions
* Managing multiple customer integrations in parallel
* Taking ownership of projects from discovery through launch



 Experience with ecommerce platforms, fashion technology, data integrations, or AI-powered products is a plus.
 



 We care more about technical curiosity, judgement, and communication than whether you have used our exact stack before.
 



  





  





**Our current tech stack** 




  





 Today our core stack includes:
 



**Languages:** 
 Python, Go, TypeScript
 



**Services/libraries:** 
 GCP, BigQuery, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, Apache Beam, Kubeflow, Feast, PyTorch, Typesense, Milvus, ConnectRPC
 



 You do not need deep experience across all of these technologies, but you should be comfortable understanding technical systems and learning quickly.
 



  





**What we value** 




  





 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Takes ownership and follows problems through to resolution
* Enjoys working directly with customers
* Can explain technical concepts clearly without unnecessary complexity
* Is comfortable moving between technical detail and business context
* Thinks about the customer outcome, not just the integration itself
* Is proactive in identifying problems before they become blockers
* Can debug unfamiliar systems methodically
* Knows when to solve something directly and when to involve engineering
* Builds trust with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Brings customer feedback back into product and engineering
* Looks for ways to turn one-off solutions into scalable improvements
* Is comfortable in a fast-moving environment where every integration may look slightly different



  





  





**What we offer** 




  




* **A best-in-class team with warm hearts and no ego.** 
 We care deeply about the quality of our work, while staying kind, humble, and easy to work with. The goal is always to build the best product possible, not to win internal arguments.
* **A direct connection to customers and product.** 
 You will see first-hand how brands use EcomID and have a strong voice in how we improve the product.
* **Real ownership.** 
 You will own technical onboarding and integrations from discovery through launch, with the freedom to solve problems in the way that makes the most sense.
* **Work closely with engineering and AI.** 
 You will collaborate directly with the teams building our products and help translate customer needs into better technical solutions.
* **Visible impact.** 
 The work you do directly affects how quickly customers launch, how successful they are, and how EcomID scales.
* **A broad technical scope.** 
 You will work across APIs, frontend integrations, backend systems, data flows, ecommerce platforms, and AI-powered products.
* **Freedom to improve how we work.** 
 If you see a better way to onboard customers, build tooling, improve documentation, or simplify an integration, we want you to drive it.
* **High standards without unnecessary process.** 
 We care about thoughtful execution and strong customer outcomes while keeping communication direct and decision-making fast.
* **The chance to shape the next stage of the company.** 
 You will help define how EcomID works with customers as we scale to more brands and more complex integrations.



  





  





**Benefits** 




  




* **Holiday:** 
 25 days of paid holiday per year
* **Health allowance:** 
 5,000 SEK wellness allowance per year
* **Office:** 
 Work from our office in central Stockholm
* **Office perks:** 
 Weekly breakfasts and snacks throughout the day
* **Tech:** 
 Your choice of computer, phone, and phone contract
* **Learning & growth:** 
 Annual budget for courses, books, and conferences
* **Insurance:** 
 Extensive coverage, including private healthcare insurance
* **Pension:** 
 Private pension insurance via SPP

title: Technical Lead – Microsoft Entra / Global Secure

You will take a leading technical role in developing a scalable and resilient Global Secure Access platform, and you will also contribute to the maintenance, support and continued development of other functionality within Microsoft Entra.
   

  

 As a consultant with us, you will have the opportunity to work with one of our clients, who are leading companies within industry, technology and IT security. You will help strengthen secure access, implement Zero Trust solutions and build resilient, sustainable platforms.

* Leading the onboarding and migration of internal applications from VPN and similar solutions to Private Access
* Analysis of application connectivity requirements, including DNS, TCP/IP, ports, routing, authentication and TLS
* Establishing technical standards, configuration baselines, deployment patterns and rollback procedures
* Monitoring of platform health, connector availability, capacity, traffic flows, authentication and policy synchronisation
* Leading complex incident resolution, root-cause analysis and problem management

* Coordination of technical activities with Microsoft Support and internal platform teams
* Contribution to future service expansion, including Entra Internet Access where relevant
* Mentoring of other engineers and promoting knowledge sharing across the organisation
* Implementing changes through appropriate change-management and release processes


 You will work closely with the Product Owner and the wider IAM team, as well as the Network, Endpoint/Client, Security, SOC, Service Desk, infrastructure and application teams. In this role you drive the technical direction independently while collaborating across many interfaces within the organisation.
   

  

**Requirements:**

* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID in a large enterprise environment
* Practical experience with identity-based access control, security groups, application assignments and entitlement models

title: Principal Application Engineer - EDA Verification
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years deep in verification and you know the difference between a tool that works in a demo and one that holds up when a design team is three weeks from tapeout with a functional coverage gap they cannot explain. You are the engineer who walks into a room full of stressed designers, asks three clarifying questions, and finds the root cause while everyone else is still talking about symptoms.
   

  

 You do not just know the tools, you know how teams actually use them under pressure, where the workflows break, and what workarounds become technical debt six months later. You have debugged enough customer environments to spot a setup issue in minutes and enough design complexity to explain a formal property failure to someone who has never written one.
   

  

 You have embraced the emergence of AI in semiconductor engineering and understand both its potential and its limitations. You recognize how AI can enhance EDA workflows by accelerating debug, assisting with assertion and property generation, improving coverage analysis, surfacing insights from large verification datasets, and helping engineers navigate increasingly complex designs. More importantly, you know that AI delivers the greatest value when combined with strong engineering judgment, and you are comfortable helping customers integrate AI-driven capabilities into practical design and verification flows that improve productivity and accelerate time to results.
   

  

 Mentorship comes naturally to you. You have shown junior engineers how to think through a problem, not just how to run a command. You push back on R&D when a feature does not match what customers actually need, and you do it with enough technical grounding that they listen.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will work directly with the design teams building the chips that power everything, and the tools you support will be the ones they depend on when it matters most.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Serve as the primary technical resource for key customers across Sweden and the Nordic region, supporting verification workflows using Synopsys EDA tools including VCS, Verdi, and VC Formal
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in customer design environments, working directly with design and verification teams on-site and remotely
* Collaborate with Synopsys R&D teams to escalate critical customer issues, provide field feedback, and influence product roadmap based on real deployment challenges
* Mentor and develop junior applications engineers, building their technical depth and customer engagement skills
* Deliver technical presentations, training sessions, and best practice guidance to customer teams on verification methodologies and tool usage
* Act as a regional technical leader, representing customer needs internally and driving solutions that improve both product capability and customer success


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Enable Nordic customers to tape out complex semiconductor designs on schedule by resolving critical verification bottlenecks and tool deployment challenges
* Accelerate junior team members' growth, building a stronger regional applications engineering capability that scales customer support across the territory
* Shape Synopsys verification tool development by feeding high-quality field intelligence back to R&D, ensuring product evolution matches real-world design challenges
* Strengthen customer relationships and technical trust, positioning Synopsys as the verification partner of choice for the region's leading semiconductor companies
* Reduce time-to-resolution for escalated technical issues by bringing deep tool knowledge and customer environment expertise to every engagement
* Drive adoption of advanced verification methodologies across your customer base, improving design quality and reducing costly respins
* Build institutional knowledge within the European applications team, documenting solutions and best practices that benefit the broader organization


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related semiconductor or electronics discipline
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in semiconductor design, ASIC development, or EDA applications engineering
* Strong foundation in digital design verification concepts, methodologies, and flows
* Based in or near Stockholm, Sweden, with opportunity to travel regularly within the Nordic region and occasionally internationally
* Proven ability to work directly with customer engineering teams, diagnose technical issues in complex environments, and drive them to resolution
* Experience with Synopsys verification tools such as VCS, Verdi, or VC Formal is a strong plus
* Solid communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a customer site, assess a broken verification environment, and have a working theory within the first hour, not because you have seen that exact issue before, but because you know how to isolate variables and ask the right diagnostic questions
* Mentorship is not a checkbox for you, when a junior engineer gets stuck, you sit with them long enough to make sure they understand the why, not just the fix
* You push back when it matters, if a customer request does not make technical sense or an R&D solution misses the actual problem, you say so and you bring the data to back it up
* You are comfortable with ambiguity, customer environments are messy, requirements are incomplete, and you move forward anyway without waiting for perfect information
* You manage your own calendar, your customer commitments, and your travel logistics without needing someone to keep you on track
* You can explain a complex verification concept to a hardware engineer who has never used formal tools and make it clear enough that they can try it themselves the next day


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join the European EDA Applications Engineering Team, a regionally distributed group of technical specialists supporting Synopsys verification customers across Europe. The team works closely with R&D, sales, and field applications engineers globally, and you will have the opportunity to mentor junior team members while collaborating with senior technical leaders across the organization. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Cloud Operations Lead
description:
**Bygg nästa generation Cloud Operations på Norteam!** 




  





**Cloud Operations Lead** 




 På Norteam bygger vi moderna Microsoft-miljöer för kunder som ställer höga krav på säkerhet, stabilitet och affärsvärde. Nu söker vi en erfaren teknisk ledare som vill ta stort ansvar i vidareutvecklingen av vårt Cloud Operations-erbjudande och forma hur vi arbetar med Azure, Microsoft 365, drift, förvaltning och teknisk innovation framåt.
 



  





 Det här är en roll för dig som vill och kan ta ansvar för helheten, samtidigt som teknikdrivet är så starkt att du inte vill släppa den operativa tekniken.
 



  





 Du kommer att vara en av våra mest seniora tekniska profiler och arbeta nära CTO, kunder och övriga specialister för att utveckla både våra tjänster och vårt sätt att leverera dem.
 



  





 Initialt ligger inget personalansvar i rollen men ambitionen är att du över tid mer formellt äger området och bygger ditt team. Beroende på dina drivkrafter och kompetenser kan det ligga närmre eller lite längre bort – vi letar först och främst efter rätt person, detaljerna i rollbeskrivning & organisationstillhörighet är sekundärt.
 



  





**Vad kommer du göra?** 




 Du kombinerar tekniskt djup med ett brett ansvar för cloud-drift, förvaltning och tjänsteutveckling. I praktiken innebär det att du:
 


* Säkerställer säkerhet, stabilitet och robusthet i våra kunders Azure- och Microsoft 365-miljöer
* Tar ansvar för komplexa tekniska frågor och fungerar som senior eskaleringspunkt
* Driver utvecklingen av nya tjänster, erbjudanden och tekniska koncept
* Utvecklar standarder, ramverk och arbetssätt för drift och förvaltning
* Identifierar förbättringar och driver dem hela vägen till implementation
* Utvärderar ny teknik och omsätter den till affärsnytta för våra kunder
* Bidrar i presale, workshops och tekniska dialoger med kunder
* Stöttar och coachar andra tekniker i komplexa frågeställningar



  





 Vi förväntar oss inte att du kan allt. Vi förväntar oss däremot att du är personen som tar ansvar för att hitta vägen framåt när ingen annan har svaret.
 



  





**Dina första 12 månader** 




 Det första året handlar om betydligt mer än att sätta sig in i våra befintliga miljöer. Vi vill att du ska vara med och bygga upp nästa fas av Cloud Operations på Norteam. Efter dina första 12 månader ser vi att du har:
 



  





**Tagit ett tydligt tekniskt ledarskap** 




 Du är en naturlig referenspunkt inom Azure, Microsoft 365 och närliggande infrastruktur. Teamet kan luta sig mot dig i designbeslut, felsökning och tekniska vägval.
 



  





**Höjt kvaliteten i våra leveranser** 




 Du har etablerat förbättrade arbetssätt, standarder och ramverk som gör våra leveranser mer robusta, säkra och skalbara.
 



  





**Drivit modernisering och innovation, och bidragit till utvecklingen av vårt Cloud-erbjudande** 




 Du har identifierat ny teknik, utvärderat dess potential och omsatt den till konkreta tjänster, förbättringar och erbjudanden, samt drivit utveckling av hur vi levererar, förvaltar och vidareutvecklar.
 



  





**Skapat grund för framtida tillväxt** 




 Du har varit med och lagt grunden för ett växande teknikområde som på sikt kan omfatta fler specialister och tekniker.
 



  





**Vem är du?** 




 Vi tror att du är en mycket erfaren teknisk generalist med tyngd inom Azure och M365. Du har sannolikt arbetat med drift, infrastruktur, cloud och Microsoft-plattformen under många år och utvecklat en bred förståelse för hur moderna IT-miljöer faktiskt fungerar i praktiken. Du är van att ta ansvar för helheten snarare än enskilda komponenter.
 



  





 Du trivs med att:
 


* Ta ägarskap
* Fatta tekniska beslut
* Lösa komplexa problem
* Utmana befintliga arbetssätt
* Driva förbättringar
* Utveckla både teknik och människor omkring dig



  





 Framför allt har du ett starkt eget driv. När du stöter på något du inte kan idag ser du till att lära dig det och du har en stark drivkraft att ständigt lära dig nya tekniker.
 



  





**Kompetens vi gärna ser!** 




  





 Mycket stark kompetens inom
 


* Microsoft Azure
* Microsoft 365
* Identitet och säkerhet
* Hybrid IT-infrastruktur
* Windows Server
* Drift och förvaltning i större miljöer



  





 Meriterande
 


* Nätverk
* Intune
* Terraform, Bicep eller annan Infrastructure as Code
* Azure Landing Zones
* Automation och scripting
* Monitoring och observability
* PKI och certifikathantering
* ITIL eller motsvarande arbetssätt



  





**Varför Norteam?** 




 Du får en ovanligt stor möjlighet att påverka. Vi är tillräckligt stora för att hantera komplexa kundmiljöer, men tillräckligt små för att en enda person faktiskt kan göra stor skillnad.
 



  





 Hos oss får du:
 


* En nyckelroll i ett bolag med höga ambitioner
* Möjlighet att växa med bolaget och vara en central del av en spännande tillväxtresa
* En kultur & värderingsdriven entreprenöriell miljö med högt engagemang och driv
* Stort mandat att påverka teknikval och arbetssätt
* Nära samarbete med CTO & övrig ledningsgrupp
* Korta beslutsvägar och hög förändringstakt
* Tjänstepension, försäkringar, årliga utlandsresor & konferenser och optionsprogram



  





**Om rollen & ansökan** 




**Titel:** 
 Cloud Operations Lead
 



**Placering:** 
 Stockholm (Bromma)
 



**Arbetsform:** 
 Primärt från kontoret med möjlighet till hybridarbete
 



 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, skicka med fördel in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid frågor om Norteam eller rollen, vänligen kontakta David von Grothusen, Head of HR, david.von.grothusen@norteam.se.
 



  





**Om Norteam** 




*Norteam hjälper företag att få ut mer av Microsofts plattformar och tjänster. Med specialistkompetens inom moln, säkerhet, modern arbetsplats, data och AI hjälper vi våra kunder att skapa en modern, säker och effektiv IT-miljö. Vi kombinerar teknisk spets med ett nära samarbete och tror på långsiktiga relationer, både med kunder och medarbetare.* 




  





*Sedan starten har Norteam vuxit snabbt och etablerat sig som en av Sveriges ledande Microsoft-partners. Tillväxten är ett resultat av vår kultur lika mycket som vår kompetens. Vi bygger ett bolag där människor får ta ansvar, utvecklas och vara med och påverka. Hos oss är det naturligt att dela kunskap, utmana etablerade arbetssätt och hjälpas åt för att nå gemensamma mål. Nu fortsätter vi resan.* 




  





*Vi investerar i nya kompetensområden, stärker vårt kunderbjudande och skapar fler möjligheter för både kunder och medarbetare. För dig som vill vara med och bygga något långsiktigt innebär det en chans att påverka på riktigt. Vi söker människor som vill mer än att bara göra ett bra jobb. Människor som vill utvecklas, dela med sig av sin kompetens och vara med och bygga framtidens Norteam. För när bolaget växer får också våra medarbetare möjlighet att växa med det. Det är så vi skapar värde, för våra kunder, för varandra och för vår gemensamma framtid.*
