title: Master Thesis Student
description:
**Title: Master theses students (2, possibly 4 positions, each 30 ECTS or 45 ECTS thesis) Process for field quality monitoring / Tool for field quality monitoring**
 The research and development divisions of Scania, Man and International have merged into a common research and development organisation under the name Traton.
   

  

 Traton's control system development is an important part of meeting our ambitious sustainability goals with an ecosystem of sustainable transport. Among other things, a uniform diagnostics and component design for the desired vehicle life length is important and a part of Traton being a world leader.
   

  

 Our sections are responsible for drive train control system pre-development, hardware, software, field quality and after-market tools. This means that together we follow the Scania product from its cradle to its end of use.
   

  

 We are a strong multi-cultural team with different backgrounds and experience, where a devotion for technical development and requirements balancing are the common denominator. Together we normally supervise 10-30 theses students a year and we regularly get the feedback that our way of working is characterized by an inclusive, positive and helpful attitude.
   

  

 With us, you will have the opportunity to do your thesis on a major company leading the development towards a sustainable future. You will have the opportunity to develop your engineering skills, to learn if the Scania work culture suits your future career goals and to show your abilities and talents over 20 weeks of thesis work.
   

  

**Thesis assignment:**
 As for all theses the work will be divided in four phases. Starting with the tentative research question an iterative information survey will take place during the first four weeks ending with a more or less finalized introduction, motivation, research question, literature survey and method choice as well as a time plan. The following twelve weeks consists of the main thesis work, divided in two parts and split by a mid-term seminar feedback option. Finally it’s time to write up the thesis and present it orally both at Scania and the grading university.
   

  

 The research of these theses will be focused on the field quality monitoring. More specific field quality is followed up for many reasons (i.e. warrantee, emission legislations, technical development, repair and maintenance contracts, truck chassis workshop repairs and the spare part sales) and is, within the organization, used for many reasons (i.e. in customer support, in legislatively driven reporting, in engineering development work to enhance customer satisfaction, to calculate contract costs and to estimate the future spare part use). But all of these areas have their own tools and their own processes monitoring the field quality for their specific purpose.
   

  

**The student focusing on the process** 
 will visualize the various processes used highlighting their pros and cons, taking an organizational as well as an low level and a co-worker perspective ending up with a suggestion on how to improve these processes and/or merge them in order to facilitate an easy and efficient use of the information. Also the future process perspective should be taken in on how to build in an ease for improved data gathering, storage, use and distribution.
   

  

**The student(s) focusing on the tool** 
 will visualize the various tools used highlighting their pros and cons, taking technical, organizational as well as user perspective. The final delivery is a tool demonstrator merging the information found in the different sources and presenting them in a way suitable for the end users. As a part of the final delivery also an evaluation of the tool shall be made and a part of the thesis shall address identified improvement potential in the data gathering, storage, use and distribution.
   

  

**Process student(s) profile:**
 We are looking for someone who is an imaginative, communicative, initiative-taking and structured problem solver who sees opportunities. You have a positive attitude, find it easy to make new contacts and appreciate working both in a team and on your own.
   

  

 We want you to be:
   

  

  

* Educated in project management, leadership, work flow processes.
* With experience on structured interview and/or survey as scientific tool.
* A Master student with a major in social science, environmental science, engineering management, engineering economics or similar.


 As documentation is available in multiple languages proficient in Swedish and English in speech and writing is required, the knowledge of German is considered an advantage.
   

  

**Tool student(s) profile:**
 We are looking for someone who is an imaginative, communicative, initiative-taking and structured problem solver who sees opportunities. You have a positive attitude, find it easy to make new contacts and appreciate working both in a team and on your own.
   

  

 We want you to be:
   

  

  

* Educated in, and curious on, the engineering process of automizing the merging of data from different sources.
* Skilled in programming possibly with experience in app development.
* A Master of Science student in Vehicle Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Data science or similar.


 As documentation is available in multiple languages proficient in Swedish and English in speech and writing is required, the knowledge of German is considered an advantage.
   

  

 If you have questions on the thesis or on the recruitment process please contact Dr. Ola Stenlåås, ola.stenlaas@scania.com.

title: Senior Gameplay Programmer [Unannounced Project]
description:
**Company Description**
 Massive Entertainment is a world-renowned AAA game development studio located in Malmö, Sweden, and a proud part of the Ubisoft family. Our diverse and talented team of over 700 professional's hails from more than 50 countries, all driven by a shared passion for crafting memorable gaming experiences.
   

  

 At Massive, we are committed to pushing the boundaries of creativity and technology, currently leading projects such as Tom Clancy’s The Division 3 while continuously working on our live games Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora, Star Wars Outlaws, and Tom Clancy’s The Division 2.
   

  

 We're also at the forefront of tech innovation, developing our proprietary Snowdrop engine, which powers many of Ubisoft’s flagship titles, and contributing to Ubisoft Connect, Ubisoft's digital ecosystem and distribution platform.
   

  

 Join us, and you'll have the opportunity to do what you love while shaping the future of interactive entertainment.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to work on an unannounced project.
   

  

 As a Senior Gameplay Programmer within our team, you will help bring dynamic and engaging gameplay experiences to life, with a strong focus on destruction systems and interactive environments. You will work closely with programmers, designers, artists, and testers to design, implement, and evolve gameplay features using our in-house engine, Snowdrop. Throughout the full lifecycle of feature development, you will contribute both to what we create and how we create it, with a meaningful impact on technical quality and player experience.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, implement, debug, and iterate on gameplay systems related to destruction and environmental interaction in collaboration with game designers
* Develop features in a C++ multithreaded engine using modern programming techniques
* Own the technical realization of complex gameplay features, from early prototypes to final implementation
* Collaborate closely with physics-aligned systems and engine features to ensure destruction behaviors feel consistent, responsive, and believable
* Optimize systems with strong performance awareness, including algorithms, memory usage, and bandwidth considerations
* Support designers and artists by exposing robust, usable gameplay tools and data
* Troubleshoot and resolve gameplay and system-level issues related to destructible content and systemic interactions
* Document systems and workflows to share knowledge and enable team adoption
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions to maintain high-quality, maintainable code


**Qualifications**
**What you bring to the team**
* Strong experience programming in C++ within game development
* Solid understanding of gameplay architecture and system-driven design
* Interest in and practical knowledge of destruction systems, physics-adjacent gameplay, or systemic world interactions
* Ability to work comfortably in a multithreaded, performance-critical environment
* Clear communication skills and a collaborative, team-focused mindset


**Additional Information**
 Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!
   

  

 You can also find a summary of the Massive Job Perks here.
   

  

**Questions?** 
 We're more than happy to answer them! Please contact Anton Brunzell, Talent Acquisition Partner for this position
   

  

 All your application information will be kept confidential according to EEO & GDPR guidelines.

Du är noggrann, bryter gärna ner komplexa problem i hanterbara delar och arbetar effektivt med hjälp av olika verktyg och metoder, inklusive AI-lösningar. Du trivs i en agil miljö där samarbete och aktivt lyssnande är viktigt, och du ställer relevanta frågor för att skapa förståelse. Med ett öppet sinne och god anpassningsförmåga tar du dig an nya teknologier och ramverk. title: Staff Software Engineer - Databases SRE | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

 This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the UK, Sweden, Spain or Germany.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer - SRE to help us support our highest value Grafana Cloud customers by increasing the reliability of our Cloud databases that are based on Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope. We provide these databases as a SaaS product from AWS, GCP, and Azure across all regions.
   

  

**Role**
 The SRE team is embedded within the Mimir, Loki, and Tempo squads and focuses on ensuring that Grafana Cloud’s database products deliver exceptional reliability for our highest-SLA customers. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Partner closely with product engineering squads (embedded model)
* Own production reliability for high-SLA and complex customer environments
* Design and implement automation to scale our reliability practices
* Ensuring our customers meet our SLO targets
* Define and evolve per-tenant SLOs and reliability models
* Proactively reduce SLO burn to prevent repeat incidents
* Serving as a primary escalation point and on-call for relevant incidents
* Lead customer-impacting incident response and post-incident reviews
* Contribute to design docs and code reviews
* Influence feature design to ensure production scalability and operability
* Build automation to eliminate toil where needed
* Improve alert quality and reduce noisy escalations


 We seek a staff software engineer operating at the intersection of customer needs, production systems, and product engineering.
   

  

 We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
   

  

**What We Seek**
* 8+ years engineering experience, 4+ in SRE/CRE/production engineering. Strong preference for those with formal customer reliability engineering experience.
* Strong Kubernetes experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.).
* Strong experience with technical leadership, leading a team through projects, mentoring other engineers on the team and serving as a force-multiplier
* Experience operating multi-tenant systems in production
* Strong experience designing and implementing SLOs
* Experience with one or more programming languages (e.g. Go, Python, Java, etc)
* Experience with Linux operating systems internals, and some knowledge of networking, cloud storage, and scaling.
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with calmly and actively participating in blame-free Incident Response, following up on actions, and writing high quality PIRs (Post Incident Reviews, a.k.a. post-mortem documents)
* Ability to reason about performance, scaling, and failure modes
* Comfortable working within an engineering team where individuals are encouraged to have a strong sense of autonomy and self-direction.
* Ability to partner deeply with product engineering teams
* We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind (this is important!)


**Your Day-to-day Will Include**
* Regular 1:1s to with your manager and colleagues
* Reviewing and creating SLOs, proactively investigating ways in which we can further reduce budget burn for those SLOs, which can be self-directed or as the result of learnings from incidents, and may include improvements to monitoring, automation, increasing self-healing, auto-scaling, etc.
* Improve observability of customers within their environments
* Designing and implementing solutions to ensure reliability and scalability of our environments can meet rapidly increasing demands
* Develop fault-tolerant design patterns ensuring that we are considering reliability at all stages of the service lifecycle.
* Collaborating with our Engineering Leaders to help define and influence product strategy, roadmaps and technical designs
* Participate in PR review and collaborating with other engineers on their Design Docs
* Teach others about Site Reliability Engineering and communicate best practices to be applied early in development of new features and functionality
* Participate in Incident Response when applicable, including investigation through to resolution, PIR, and communication with customers via Bridge calls where necessary


 In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 878,578 - SEK 1,054,294. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Copilot & AI Engineer
description:
**Sammanfattning**
 Vill du hjälpa till att forma framtiden för AI-drivet arbete? På Avanade får du möjlighet att designa, bygga och implementera banbrytande generativ AI och agentisk AI-lösningar med hjälp av den senaste Microsoft-teknologin. Vi söker en innovativ och praktisk AI-ingenjör till vår Data & AI-verksamhet. I denna roll kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med kunder och multidisciplinära team för att utveckla intelligenta lösningar som löser verkliga affärsutmaningar med hjälp av Large Language Models (LLM), AI-agenter, automation och Microsoft AI-plattformar.
   

  

 Den idealiska kandidaten kombinerar starka grundkunskaper inom mjukvaruutveckling och/eller data engineering med en passion för framväxande AI-teknologier och en vilja att ständigt lära, experimentera och innovera. Du kommer att bli en del av en livlig gemenskap av AI- och data-specialister, arkitekter, ingenjörer och konsulter som hjälper organisationer att förändra hur de arbetar genom generativ AI.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som AI-Engineer kommer du att designa och utveckla AI-drivna applikationer, copilot och agentiska lösningar i Microsofts ekosystem. Du kommer att arbeta nära kunder för att förstå affärsutmaningar, identifiera möjligheter för AI-adoption och översätta krav till säkra, skalbara och produktionsklara lösningar.
   

  

 Rollen kombinerar praktisk ingenjörskonst, lösningsdesign, snabb prototypframställning, kundnära konsultation och kontinuerlig innovation. Du kommer att bidra genom hela lösningens livscykel, från discovery och proof of concept till implementering, utvärdering och optimering.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter**
* Designa, utveckla och distribuera AI-drivna applikationer och agentiska lösningar med hjälp av Microsoft AI-teknologier.
* Bygga intelligenta agenter, copilots och arbetsflödesautomationslösningar med hjälp av Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure AI Foundry och relaterade tjänster.
* Utveckla API:er, integrationer och backend-tjänster med hjälp av Python och moderna applikationsramverk.
* Skapa proof of concepts och prototyper för att visa framväxande AI-förmågor och affärsvärde.
* Implementera prompt engineering, orkestrering, grounding och retrieval tekniker för att förbättra AI:s prestanda och tillförlitlighet.
* Bygga och optimera Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-lösningar och kunskapsåtervinning-lösningar.
* Bidra till AI-lösningsarkitektur, teknisk design, utveckling, testning, implementering och dokumentation.
* Delta i kundworkshops, discovery-sessioner, demonstrationer och tekniska diskussioner med både affärs- och tekniska intressenter.
* Tillämpa principer för ansvarsfull AI, styrningskontroller och utvärderingsramverk genom hela AI-utvecklingslivscykeln.
* Samarbeta med arkitekter, ingenjörer, konsulter, analytiker och kundteam inom agila leveransmiljöer.
* Håll dig uppdaterad med framväxande AI-teknologier, verktyg, ramverk och branschtrender, och dela kunskap inom den bredare verksamheten.


**Qualifications**
**Kompetenser och Erfarenheter:**
* Stark erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling med skicklighet i Python.
* Erfarenhet av att bygga API:er med ramverk som FastAPI, Flask eller Django.
* Kunskap om containeriseringsteknologier såsom Docker.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av stora språkmodeller (LLM), inklusive OpenAI GPT-modeller, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral eller liknande.
* Erfarenhet av att tillämpa prompt engineering-tekniker för att förbättra modellprestanda och användarupplevelse.
* Förståelse för utvärdering av AI-lösningar, testramverk och ansvarsfulla AI-praktiker.
* Kännedom om Microsofts AI-ekosystem, inklusive Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Power Automate och relaterade tjänster.
* Stark förståelse för principer för mjukvaruteknik, designmönster, säkerhet och bästa utvecklingspraxis.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila team och samarbeta över flera discipliner.
* Starka kommunikationsfärdigheter med förmåga att förklara tekniska koncept för både tekniska och icke-tekniska målgrupper.
* Förmåga att engagera sig direkt med kunder och förstå affärskrav.
* Kandidatexamen i datavetenskap, datavetenskap, mjukvaruteknik, artificiell intelligens eller en närliggande disciplin. Alternativt motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet och dokumenterad teknisk förmåga


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av följande:**
* Vektordatabaser och teknologier för semantisk sökning.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-arkitekturer och företagskunskapssystem.
* AI-orkestreringsramverk såsom Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, PromptFlow, Microsoft Agent Framework eller jämförbara teknologier.
* Agentkommunikationsstandarder och protokoll såsom Model Context Protocol (MCP) och Agent-to-Agent (A2A).
* AI workflow automation platformar som Power Automate, n8n, OpenAI Agent Builder, eller liknande verktyg.
* Git-baserade utvecklingsarbetsflöden och CI/CD-pipelines.
* Azure molntjänster och moderna applikationsimplementeringsmetoder.
* Erfarenhet av AI-kodningsassistenter och utvecklarproduktivitetsverktyg.
* Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) eller Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)-certifiering.
* Personliga projekt, bidrag till öppen källkod, forskning eller portföljarbete som involverar AI agenter, andrepiloter eller LLM-drivna applications.


**Om Dig**
 Vi söker dig som är:
   

  

* Är naturligt nyfiken och passionerad kring AI:s och framväxande teknologiers framtid.
* Tycker om att experimentera, prototypa och omvandla innovativa idéer till praktiska lösningar.
* Tar ansvar för leveranser och följer upp från koncept till slutförande.
* Trivs i snabbrörliga miljöer där prioriteringar och krav utvecklas.
* Tycker om att lära sig nya verktyg, ramverk och tekniker.
* Balanserar teknisk excellens med ett starkt fokus på kundvärde och affärsresultat.
* Är en samarbetsvillig och tycker om att arbeta över olika discipliner och perspektiv.
* Kan kommunicerar självsäkert med stakeholder på alla nivåer.
* Bidrar aktivt till kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig förbättring inom det bredare AI-samhället.


**Together We Do What Matters.**
 We work hard to provide an inclusive, diverse culture with a deep sense of belonging for all our employees. Visit our Inclusion & Diversity page.
   

  

 Create a future for our people that focuses on
   

  

* Expanding your thinking
* Experimenting courageously
* Learning and pivoting


 Inspire greatness in our people by
   

  

* Empowering every voice
* Encouraging boldness
* Celebrating progress


 Accelerate the impact of our people by
   

  

* Amazing the client
* Prioritizing what matters
* Acting as one

title: Graduate & Junior AI & Data Professionals
description:
Are you a recent graduate or about to graduate from university? Are you interested in helping organizations navigate the AI age and unlock the transformative potential of data and artificial intelligence?
   

  

 Accenture’s AI & Data graduate track is designed for graduates who want to build a career at the intersection of business, data and technology. From day one, you’ll work alongside experienced AI & Data professionals on real client challenges, helping organizations generate insights, engineer intelligent solutions and transform how they operate in the age of Generative and Agentic AI.
   

  

 As part of the graduate track, you’ll gain hands-on experience, continuous coaching and mentorship, and develop the technical, analytical and consulting skills needed to thrive in an increasingly AI-enabled business environment.
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company helping organizations reinvent through strategy, consulting, technology and operations. We combine industry, functional and technology expertise to help clients turn ambition into measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 Accenture offers graduate opportunities across Technology, AI & Data, Strategy and Consulting.
   

  

**About The AI & Data Graduate Track**
 The AI & Data graduate track focuses on helping organizations use data, analytics and artificial intelligence to generate insights, improve decision-making, transform operations and create new sources of value.
   

  

 Depending on your team and project assignments, you may work on a wide range of AI and data-related challenges across industries and functions, helping organizations unlock the transformative potential of technology and reshape how they operate in the AI age.
   

  

 AI & Data helps organizations answer questions such as:
   

  

  

- How can AI and data improve business performance and decision-making?

- How can organizations create value through advanced analytics and intelligent technologies?

- How can Generative AI and AI agents transform the way work gets done?

- How can organizations build scalable, secure and responsible AI capabilities?

- What data, technology and operating models are needed to support long-term transformation?

- How can AI and data be applied to solve complex business challenges?

**AI & Data Topics and Focus Areas**
 Depending on your team and area of specialization, you may work with topics such as:
   

  

  

- Artificial Intelligence

- Generative AI and Agentic AI

- AI Engineering

- Data Science and Advanced Analytics

- Data Engineering and Data Platforms

- Machine Learning

- AI Strategy and Transformation

- Data Visualization and Insights

- AI and Data Architecture

- Responsible AI and Governance

- Cloud-based Data and AI Solutions

 Over time, you’ll build broad AI & Data capabilities while developing deeper expertise in selected technical, analytical or strategic areas.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As part of multidisciplinary project teams, you’ll help clients solve complex business challenges and harness the transformative potential of AI and data. You’ll contribute to shaping and implementing solutions that enable organizations to operate, compete and create value in new ways.
   

  

 Examples of work may include:
   

  

  

- Collaborating with business and technical stakeholders to translate challenges into valuable AI-enabled solutions

- Collecting, analyzing and visualizing data to generate actionable insights

- Developing AI, machine learning and advanced analytics solutions

- Working with modern technologies and approaches such as Generative AI, Agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluations and guardrails

- Creating hands-on solutions using technologies such as Python, SQL and cloud platforms

- Supporting the design and implementation of scalable and transformative data and AI solutions

- Building and deploying AI-enabled products and services

- Designing modern data, AI and digital architectures

- Conducting analyses, interviews and workshops to understand client challenges and identify opportunities

- Developing AI visions, strategies and transformation roadmaps

- Identifying opportunities to apply AI and AI agents across business processes

- Supporting operating model, governance and capability development initiatives

- Developing recommendations, business cases and presentations for client stakeholders

 You will work closely with experienced AI & Data professionals while receiving ongoing coaching, mentorship and training to support your development.
   

  

**What's In It for You?**
 Joining the AI & Data graduate track provides:
   

  

  

- A dedicated AI & Data graduate track

- Experience working with the latest AI tools, technologies and methodologies

- Hands-on experience designing and implementing AI solutions for large organizations

- The opportunity to contribute to initiatives with significant transformative potential

- Early exposure to complex business, technology and data challenges

- The opportunity to contribute to the AI transformation of leading organizations

- Opportunities to develop technical, analytical and consulting capabilities

- Exposure to senior stakeholders and high-impact transformation programs

- Access to Accenture’s global expertise, methodologies and knowledge networks

- A collaborative and supportive team culture

- A strong foundation for a long-term career in AI & Data

**Who We Are Looking For**
 We’re looking for curious, ambitious and analytically minded graduates who enjoy solving complex problems and working with others.
   

  

 You:
   

  

  

- Have a master’s degree or will receive your degree before early autumn 2027

- Can start at Accenture in early autumn 2027

- Have strong academic results in a relevant field

- Are an analytical problem-solver with strong business acumen

- Have an interest in data, analytics, artificial intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI and emerging technologies

- Are curious about how organizations use AI and data to transform how they operate and create value

- Have strong written and verbal communication skills

- Are collaborative, proactive and eager to learn

- Are fluent in English and Swedish, both verbally and in writing

 Relevant educational backgrounds may include Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, Physics, Industrial Engineering & Management, Business & Economics and related disciplines.
   

  

**Office and Start Date**
 We are recruiting graduates to join our office in Stockholm in early autumn 2027. Depending on the assignment, work may take place from an Accenture office, a client location or remotely as part of multidisciplinary teams. Flexibility and mobility are therefore expected. The current AI & Data graduate team is based in Stockholm.
   

  

**Application Process**
 Please submit:
   

  

  

- CV including GPA on a five-grade scale

- Cover Letter

- University Transcripts/Grades

 Please upload all documents under
 **Upload Resume/CV** 
 .
   

  

 Only complete applications will be reviewed.
   

  

 In your cover letter, we would like to learn:
   

  

  

- Why you are interested in AI & Data

- Which AI and data-related topics interest you most

- Relevant academic, professional, extracurricular or leadership experiences

 The screening and selection process is conducted on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 Candidates progressing to the next stage will be invited to complete assessments designed to evaluate analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming the next generation of AI & Data professionals to Accenture.

title: Senior Statistical Programmer
description:
**About This Role**
 TFS HealthScience is a leading global mid-size Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development journey. Our expertise includes full-service capabilities, resourcing, and Functional Service Provider (FSP) solutions.
   

  

**The Senior Statistical Programmer** 
 will provide statistical programming expertise and strategic support to global clinical studies. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to review and interpret clinical trial data, support statistical analyses, and ensure the quality and integrity of statistical and data management deliverables produced both internally and by external partners.
   

  

 As part of our SRS/FSP team, you will be dedicated to one sponsor, a global pharmaceutical or biotechnology company that is advancing innovative therapies in areas of significant unmet medical need.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop, validate, and maintain SAS programs for clinical trial reporting and analysis.
* Generate and review SDTM and ADaM datasets in accordance with CDISC standards.
* Produce and validate Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for study reports and regulatory submissions.
* Review, assess, and interpret clinical study data to support study teams and informed decision making.
* Evaluate protocol deviations and contribute to assessments of their potential impact on study outcomes.
* Review statistical analyses, datasets, and deliverables generated by external service providers.
* Collaborate with Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Data Management teams to ensure high quality study execution.
* Contribute to data review activities and support the development of analysis specifications and programming documentation.
* Support regulatory submissions and ensure statistical deliverables are inspection-ready.
* Drive continuous improvement of programming standards, processes, and automation initiatives.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* Experience in Statistical Programming within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry.
* Strong SAS programming skills.
* Experience with CDISC standards, including SDTM and ADaM.
* Experience producing Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs).
* Solid understanding of clinical trial methodology, ICH-GCP, and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to review and interpret clinical data and statistical outputs.
* Experience working with external vendors or CRO partners is highly desirable.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within global cross-functional teams.
* Knowledge of Data Management processes and R programming is considered an advantage.


 What We Offer
   

  

 We provide opportunities for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You will join a team that values collaboration, quality, and making a difference in the lives of patients.
   

  

 Our core values of Trust, Quality, Passion, Flexibility, and Sustainability guide our decisions and shape our culture. By aligning on these values, we foster collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to excellence. Together, we make a difference.
   

  

**A Bit More About Us**
 Our journey began over 30 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. As a full-service global CRO, we build solution-driven teams working toward a healthier future. Bringing together over 600 professionals, TFS delivers tailored clinical research services in more than 50 countries, offering flexible clinical development and strategic resourcing solutions across key therapeutic areas including Dermatology, Neuroscience, Oncology, and Ophthalmology.

title: Technical Artist (Profiling) Fixed Term
description:
Avalanche Studios is looking for a talented Senior Technical Artist to join a top-tier, experienced team and help craft cutting-edge AAA open-world games.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Artist at Avalanche, you will play a critical role in pushing our proprietary technology to its limits. We are looking for an industry veteran who thrives on autonomy and can focus on performance, visual fidelity, and pipeline efficiency. Once you are familiar with our internal engine and tools, you will identify bottlenecks, optimize game content, and support artist workflows through tooling and scripting.
   

  

 If you love solving complex technical challenges, profiling and optimizing, and redefining what is visually possible, this is the playground for you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Take ownership of the game’s overall performance area, driving performance analysis and optimization across the project.
* Tune visual quality and performance to find the right balance for the target platform.
* Define, establish, and communicate performance budgets across relevant areas of the game.
* Develop and/or request tools to support performance tracking, profiling, and analysis.
* Work with telemetry data to identify performance trends, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.
* Regularly profile, analyze, and investigate in-game performance on the target platform.
* Collaborate closely with Rendering and Systems teams to achieve the best possible balance between performance and visual quality on the platform.


**Who You Are**
* Several years of professional experience as a Technical Artist within the games industry.
* Proven experience identifying bottlenecks, debugging, profiling, and optimizing game content for CPU, GPU, and memory.
* Deep understanding of game engine pipelines and graphics/rendering principles.
* Strong in scripting with Python and comfortable reading and navigating C++ codebases.
* Familiar with HLSL (or a similar shading language) and have an interest in shader development.


 Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.
   

  

**The Stockholm location**
 Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.
   

  

**Our values**
 At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply for this position, please register below and provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.
   

  

 At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

title: Data Analyst I NOCCO, Barebells & Vitamin Well
description:
***Vitamin Well Group***
*develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.* 




  





 We are building a team to lead the next phase of Vitamin Well Group’s digital business, working across e-commerce, data and AI.
 



  





 We are now looking for a
 **Data Analyst** 
 to join us in a new, global role. You will work from underlying data through to analysis – spanning data modelling, transformation and quality through to dashboards and insights – helping shape how we structure, connect and use data as our digital business grows. Working closely with our Analytics Lead and AI Lead, you will join while much of our data capability is still being built.
 



  





**About the role** 




 This is a hands-on role that brings the technical and analytical sides of data together. You will work directly with data using SQL, build and transform datasets in a modern cloud data environment, and take that work through to analysis, visualisation and business decisions.
 



  





 Your work will connect you with Digital Sales, CRM, Performance Marketing, Social, Product and Engineering. One project could involve modelling customer and transaction data, another connecting a new marketing data source or improving how we measure retention or LTV. At other times, you might start with an open-ended business question and work your way from the underlying data to an analysis that leads to action.
 



  





**What you will work on** 



* Build and maintain reliable, reusable data models and transformations.
* Turn open-ended business questions into structured analysis and actionable insights.
* Analyse customer behaviour and growth across areas such as acquisition, retention, attribution and customer lifetime value.
* Create dashboards and self-serve analytics that enable teams to understand and act on their KPIs.
* Work with different data sources, contributing to ingestion, integrations and data quality.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering on event instrumentation, schema design and data best practices.



  





**What you can expect** 



* Plenty left to build. You are joining a growing data setup, with the opportunity to improve what exists and help shape what comes next.
* Problems that are not already solved. Multiple brands, markets and digital channels bring real complexity – and plenty for someone who likes figuring things out.
* High ownership from the start. You will be expected to bring your perspective, challenge existing approaches and drive your work forward, working closely with our Analytics Lead and AI Lead.
* A fast-growing international business. Your work sits behind the digital growth of Barebells, Vitamin Well and NOCCO, with the pace and change that comes with it.



  





**Who you are** 




 You have hands-on experience working with data from source to insight. You have experience with data modelling and cloud data platforms, and know how to turn underlying data into analysis that supports business decisions.
 



  





 You move naturally between the technical and analytical sides of the work – understanding how data is structured and transformed while also investigating business questions, identifying what matters and communicating your findings clearly.
 



  





 You are curious, technically sharp and pragmatic. You enjoy getting into complex problems, finding your way forward when the answer is not obvious and taking ownership from question to solution.
 



  





**We believe you have:** 



* Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working directly with data from databases.
* Experience with analytical data modelling and transformation tools such as dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar.
* Experience working with cloud data platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS, Snowflake or Databricks.
* Experience turning data into analysis, dashboards and visualisations that support business decisions.
* A good understanding of ELT/ETL workflows and how data moves between sources and systems.
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Professional proficiency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.



  





**Chances are, you have also worked with some of the following:** 



* APIs, integrations or data pipelines.
* AI-native coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar.
* Sales and marketing data from platforms such as Shopify, GA4, Meta or Google Ads.
* AI/LLM products, event instrumentation or experimentation.



  





**How to apply** 




*Application deadline: October 12th 2026* 




 We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.
 



  





**Life at Vitamin Well Group** 




 At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.
 



  





 Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.
 



  





 Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.
 



  





*As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. title: Samverkansarkitekt inom kommunal digitalisering
description:
Inera är ett digitaliseringsbolag som bidrar till att utveckla välfärden. Vi är Sveriges digitala ingång till hälsa, vård och omsorg och utvecklar digital infrastruktur för en sammanhållen välfärd. Vi arbetar på uppdrag av kommuner och regioner. Vår vision är världens mest innovativa och omtänksamma välfärd.
 



  





 Sektionen Samverkansarkitektur och Integrationer befinner sig i centrum av den digitala utvecklingen inom svensk välfärd. Vårt uppdrag är att skapa förutsättningar för att information ska kunna delas säkert, effektivt och sömlöst mellan regioner, kommuner och andra aktörer.
 



  





 Hos oss möts teknik, arkitektur, informatik och verksamhet. Vi arbetar med interoperabilitet, integrationer, API:er, standarder och framtidens digitala infrastruktur. Det innebär att vi både utvecklar nya lösningar och förvaltar och vidareutvecklar sådant som redan idag är en viktig del av Sveriges välfärd.
 



  





 Vi har ett nära samarbete med regioner, kommuner och andra nationella aktörer och är ofta med när nya behov och initiativ tar form. Det ger dig möjlighet att komma in tidigt i utvecklingen, påverka vägval och bidra till lösningar som behöver fungera på bred front i hela Sverige.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Vill du vara med och forma den digitala arkitekturen för kommunal verksamhet i Sverige?
 



 Det kommunala arkitekturområdet är en del av kommunernas gemensamma digitaliseringssatsning Handslaget via SKR. Arbetet syftar till att ta fram gemensamma arkitekturprinciper, vägledningar och lösningar exempelvis inom skola och socialtjänst. Nu bygger vi på området och stärker teamet med ytterligare arkitekturkompetens. I rollen får du en viktig del i att säkerställa kontinuitet, dela kunskap och bidra till den långsiktiga utvecklingen av den kommunala arkitekturen.
 



  





 I rollen som it-arkitekt kombinerar du strategiskt arkitekturarbete med konkreta initiativ och projekt. Du får bland annat bidra i pågående satsningar som Mitt gymnasieval och GIF (Gemensam informationsförsörjningstjänst för ekonomiskt bistånd), samtidigt som du är med och utvecklar gemensamma arkitekturprinciper och vägledningar för kommunal verksamhet.
 



  





 Du blir en del av ett team med ett gemensamt ansvarar för att utveckla och förvalta det kommunala arkitekturområdet. Här får du möjlighet att påverkabåde den tekniska riktningen och hur området utvecklas framåt, i en kontext där lösningar behöver skapa nytta för många kommuner och verksamheter.
 



  





**Är det här du?** 




 Detta är en senior roll för dig som har minst 10 års erfarenhet av relevant arbete inom it-arkitektur, systemintegration eller närliggande områden.
 



  





 Vi söker dig som har:
 


* relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kompetens genom erfarenhet
* gedigen erfarenhet av arkitekturarbete i komplexa IT-miljöer
* förmåga att växla mellan strategiska perspektiv och praktiskt genomförande
* god förståelse för hur system, integrationer och gemensamma lösningar behöver samverka
* erfarenhet av arkitekturprinciper, standarder och andra verktyg för att skapa hållbara och skalbara lösningar
* erfarenhet från kommunal verksamhet, exempelvis skola eller socialtjänst, eller från nationella initiativ och samverkanslösningar.



  





 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du kunna se helheten, analysera komplexa frågeställningar och samtidigt omsätta dina insikter till konkreta lösningar. Du är kommunikativ och trivs med att samarbeta med olika kompetenser och aktörer för att skapa gemensam riktning.
 



  





 Du är nyfiken och drivs av att utveckla ett område som befinner sig under uppbyggnadsfas där du får möjlighet att påverka både riktning och arbetssätt framåt.
 



  





**Varaktighet och tillträde** 




 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Intervjuer kommer ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstidens slut.
 



  





**Frågor om rollen?** 




 Lotten Holm, sektionschef för samverkansarkitektur och integrationer, lotten.holm@inera.se
 



*Fackliga frågor (Vision), Monica Rosén,* 
 monica.rosen@inera.se

title: Quantum Application Specialist
description:
Intermodulation Products AB is a pioneering company developing advanced test and measurement equipment for the quantum technology sector. As we continue to expand the reach of our flagship Presto platform, we are looking for a highly technical and outgoing Quantum Application Engineer to join our team in Stockholm.
 




  






 In this role, you will be the crucial link between our technology and the global physics community. Your primary focus will be helping existing and potential customers understand how Presto can solve their most complex measurement needs across superconducting circuits, quantum sensing, computing, and communication. You will own and run live demonstrations using our in-house superconducting qubit setup, represent us at scientific conferences, and provide critical technical support for both sales and existing users. You will also travel to customer laboratories, spending time with researchers to deeply understand their experimental workflows and pain points, and bring those insights directly back to our development team. This role is perfect for a physicist who loves being hands-on with technology but finds it equally fun and energizing to interact with people.
 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Help existing and potential customers understand how the Presto platform solves specific measurement challenges in quantum tech and RF.
* Own, maintain, and present live technical demonstrations using our superconducting qubit setup.
* Represent the company at international scientific conferences, presenting our products at the booth and engaging with fellow physicists.
* Partner with the sales team to provide technical pre-sales support and system configuration advice.
* Assist customers with high-level technical support questions and troubleshooting.
* Travel to customer labs to spend time on-site, understanding their measurement pain points and workflows.
* Act as the voice of the customer, forwarding field knowledge and feature requests to our internal development team.



  





**Requirements** 



* PhD (preferred) or MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Quantum Engineering, or a highly related field.
* Strong background in experimental physics with hands-on knowledge of microwave and low-temperature measurements.
* A highly technical mindset coupled with a strong willingness and enthusiasm to engage, network, and interact with fellow physicists.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex measurement concepts clearly.
* Willingness and ability to travel to scientific conferences and customer laboratories globally.
* Good written and spoken English.





 ﻿
 





**Meritorious Qualifications:** 

 You do not need to have experience in all of the areas below. Experience in one or more is considered an advantage:
 



* Experience with Python programming, specifically for data acquisition, instrument control, and data analysis.
* Previous experience in technical sales, field application engineering, or customer-facing scientific support.
* Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting dilution refrigerators or other cryogenic systems.
* Practical experience working directly with superconducting qubits or similar solid-state quantum devices.
* Familiarity with RF/microwave instrumentation (e.g., AWGs, VNAs, digitizers, spectrum analyzers).
* Experience with experimental control software and quantum measurement frameworks (e.g., QCoDeS, Labber, Qiskit Experiments).
* Basic understanding of FPGA-based signal processing.



  






 📍 Stockholm, Sweden💼 Full-time, permanent position
 





 If you are interested in microwave control electronics and contributing to the development of quantum technologies, we would be pleased to hear from you.📩 Apply:
 
 careers@intermod.pro
 




 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

* Conscientious with good interpersonal, customer skills and commercial awareness.

title: CloudOps Engineer
description:
Acne Studios is a progressive luxury house and through collaboration and curiosity, we set high aspirations and strive for excellence. We value everyone’s contribution and embrace feedback to develop ourselves and others. We aim to minimise our environmental impact across all our operations and to address societal challenges in the way we conduct our business.
   

  

 As CloudOps Engineer at our Stockholm office, you will manage and drive change in a modern, mostly cloud-based IT environment, covering servers, storage, micro services, networking, and end-user computing. The role also spans SaaS services, identity and access management, cyber security, enterprise mobility, vendor and supplier engagements, and procurement. Under broad direction, you will design and oversee upgrades, new installations, integrations, operations, and troubleshooting across Dev, Test, and Production environments.
   

  

 CULTURE OF COLLABORATION
   

  

 We firmly believe that when you feel supported, included, and trusted, it enables you to enjoy your work and thrive in it. You will be a part of a team of colleagues with diverse roles and backgrounds, each with their unique skills and experiences.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL DO
   

  

 As CloudOps Engineer your main contribution will be to keep our network, cloud and endpoint services secure, stable and available, and to help move our remaining on-premises workloads to the cloud. You will report to the Infra Operations Manager. You will play a vital role in delivering a reliable, secure, and automated IT foundation for the business by:
   

  

* Configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting network infrastructure across offices, stores, and warehouses, as well as networking in our public cloud environments
* Planning and executing network changes and upgrades, monitoring performance and capacity, and carrying out root cause analysis on recurring faults
* Administering our endpoint management platform and cloud identity services, including device compliance, application deployment, conditional access, and single sign-on
* Operating compute, storage, and micro services in a cloud-first hybrid environment, together with our collaboration and productivity services, including backup and restore
* Maintaining security compliance across networks, servers, and endpoints through patching, threat protection, hardening, and certificate management
* Contributing to the migration of remaining on-premises workloads and services to the cloud, and to the decommissioning programme running until end of 2027
* Taking part in Incident, Problem, and Change Management, acting as escalation tier for network operations, security operations, and customer support
* Developing scripts for automation and monitoring, and keeping documentation and configuration data accurate in our ITSM platform
* Collaborating with development, service delivery, and business teams to keep critical systems available around the clock, including taking part in the on-call rotation and travelling to sites when required


 WHO YOU ARE
   

  

 You have high aspirations and focus on details that create substantial impact. You enjoy working as a team and you embrace feedback to develop yourself and others. You are curious and thrive in a dynamic environment. Cooperation, respect, and clear communication are important, along with your ambition to learn and grow. If these qualities speak to you, we would love to have you on our team.
   

  

 Specific personal qualities for this role:
   

  

* Strong interest in networking, with the curiosity to understand how traffic actually flows
* Structured and methodical, working from symptoms to root cause when troubleshooting
* Comfortable owning changes in a production environment, planning carefully and communicating impact before acting
* An automation mindset, preferring to script a task once rather than repeat it manually
* Security aware, treating compliance and hardening as part of daily work
* Self-motivated and able to prioritise independently in an environment that is actively modernising
* Calm under pressure, keeping quality and communication up during incidents
* Able to explain technical matters clearly to non-technical colleagues


 Specific experience and knowledge for this role:
   

  

* Degree in computer science or equivalent experience
* 2 to 4 years' experience within IT operations, infrastructure, or network operations
* Solid hands-on experience with network administration, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, VPN, firewalls, and wireless
* Experience with networking in at least one major public cloud platform, including hybrid connectivity
* Hands-on experience with Windows MDM through Microsoft Intune, including enrolment, compliance policies, and application deployment, as well as management of mobile devices
* Experience with Windows Server administration and virtualisation
* Working knowledge of IT security practices, including threat protection, vulnerability management, and certificate management
* Scripting skills for automation and monitoring, for example PowerShell, and familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure as code
* Experience working with ITSM processes for Incident, Problem, and Change Management
* Fluent in English


 What matters most to us is not whether you master all the listed knowledge and skills. We are dedicated to recognising the potential in each individual. We embrace diversity of people as well as ideas and viewpoints and encourage everyone's individual expression of their own identity.
   

  

 We may perform background checks for this position.

title: Master’s Thesis: Model Fusion for Automated Data Annotation
description:
**Do you want to explore the intersection of deep learning, model fusion, and automated data labeling?**
 In this thesis, we invite one or two students to develop and evaluate methods for automated dataset annotation using model fusion and consensus-based prediction techniques. The project combines predictions or representations from multiple pre-trained foundation models (e.g., vision-language models, specialized detectors, or segmenters) to generate high-confidence pseudo-labels, drastically reducing manual annotation effort while ensuring high dataset quality.
   

  

**About The Project**
 The aim is to design and evaluate an automated annotation framework leveraging model fusion to generate reliable ground-truth candidates. Within this scope, you will:
   

  

* Work with diverse domain datasets and state-of-the-art pre-trained AI models.
* Implement and benchmark model fusion strategies (e.g., ensemble voting, multi-model consensus, weight merging, or confidence-weighted aggregation).
* Develop an automated annotation pipeline that generates high-quality labels and flags low-confidence/disagreed cases for human review.
* Analyze system performance in terms of annotation accuracy, noise reduction, uncertainty calibration, and time efficiency compared to manual labeling.


**Possible Research Questions**
* RQ1: How effectively can model fusion and multi-model consensus mechanisms improve the accuracy and reliability of automated annotations compared to single-model pseudo-labeling?
* RQ2: How can uncertainty estimation and disagreement metrics between fused models be leveraged to filter noisy labels and guide active human-in-the-loop verification?


**Features & technologies**
* Deep learning & computer vision / NLP (PyTorch, Hugging Face, OpenCV)
* Model fusion & ensembling techniques (Consensus Algorithms, Model Merging, Multi-agent/Multi-model pipelines)
* Automated annotation & Active Learning (Pseudo-labeling, Segment Anything/SAM, Vision-Language Models)
* Dataset quality evaluation & noise filtering


**Who are you?**
 We are looking for one or two master’s students with an interest in machine learning, computer vision, and data engineering. Experience with Python and PyTorch/deep learning frameworks is valuable, but most importantly, you are curious, motivated, and eager to explore practical AI applications in a real-world context. A requirement for the position is the ability to communicate effectively in both Swedish and English, both verbally and in writing.
   

  

 To give you the best possible support during your thesis, we’d like you to be able to come to the office connected to the project and spend most of your time working from there.
   

  

**Application:**
 We look forward to receiving your resume, and preferably, a personal letter in which you explain why you want to write your thesis with Syntronic.
   

  

 We screen and evaluate applications on an ongoing basis. The thesis project may be filled before the application deadline.

title: E-commerce & Growth Manager till Gasoltuben
description:
Vill du ta ett helhetsansvar för en växande e-handel och vara med och driva nästa fas för Gasoltuben?


Gasoltuben söker en E-commerce & Growth Manager som vill ta ett tydligt kommersiellt ansvar för vår digitala affär. Här får du möjlighet att påverka hur vi utvecklar e-handeln, marknadsföringen och kundresan – med fokus på försäljning, lönsamhet och tillväxt.


Det här är en roll för dig som gillar att kombinera strategi och analys med att faktiskt få saker gjorda.

##### **Om Gasoltuben**


Gasoltuben startade 2011 och har vuxit till en etablerad e-handelsaktör inom gasol och gasolrelaterade produkter. Verksamheten omfattar försäljning i Sverige, Danmark och Finland samt fysiska butiker. I dag är vi 11 medarbetare och har huvudkontor, lager och showroom i Enstaberga utanför Nyköping.


Gasoltuben har byggt sin position genom att kombinera konkurrenskraftiga priser med snabba leveranser, personlig service och hög kunskap inom gasol. Sortimentet omfattar bland annat gasolflaskor, gasolgrillar, gasolkaminer, pizzaugnar, värmare och tillbehör.


Nu vill vi fortsätta utveckla den digitala affären och söker dig som vill vara med och bygga nästa version av Gasoltuben.

##### **Om tjänsten**


Som E-commerce & Growth Manager får du ett helhetsansvar för att utveckla och driva Gasoltubens e-handel framåt. Du arbetar nära ledningen och får stort mandat att identifiera möjligheter, prioritera insatser och driva dem från idé till resultat.


Ditt fokus kommer bland annat att vara att:

* Driva och utveckla e-handeln med fokus på försäljning och lönsamhet
* Ansvara för och utveckla performance marketing tillsammans med externa partners
* Analysera trafik, försäljning, marginal, konvertering och kunddata
* Identifiera möjligheter inom CRO, UX och kundresan
* Utveckla CRM, retention och marketing automation
* Planera och följa upp kampanjer tillsammans med inköp och marknad
* Identifiera, testa och utvärdera nya tillväxtkanaler
* Arbeta aktivt med SEO och digital synlighet
* Utveckla arbetssätt och uppföljning för den digitala affären
* Använda data och AI för att fatta bättre och snabbare kommersiella beslut


Du behöver inte vara specialist på varje delområde. Däremot behöver du förstå hur delarna hänger ihop och kunna driva utvecklingen framåt tillsammans med interna och externa resurser.

##### **Vi söker dig som**


Du har erfarenhet av e-handel, digital försäljning, growth eller performance marketing. Du är van vid att arbeta datadrivet och förstår sambandet mellan trafik, konvertering, ordervärde, marginal och återköp.


Som person är du affärsdriven, analytisk och självgående. Du tycker om att identifiera problem och möjligheter, men framför allt att göra något åt dem. Du kan växla mellan strategiska frågor och operativt genomförande och är bekväm med att själv kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs.


Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av exempelvis:

* Google Analytics 4
* Google Ads
* Meta Ads
* SEO
* CRM och marketing automation
* CRO och UX
* E-handelsplattformar och digital analys


Erfarenhet av samarbete med externa byråer och partners är meriterande.


Det viktigaste är inte att du kan kryssa i varje verktyg ovan. Det viktiga är att du förstår vad som driver en lönsam e-handelsaffär och kan omsätta analys till konkreta aktiviteter och resultat.

##### **Varför Gasoltuben?**


Här får du en roll med stort mandat och korta beslutsvägar. Du kommer nära både affären och ledningen och får möjlighet att påverka på riktigt.


Gasoltuben är redan en etablerad aktör med en växande digital affär, ett brett sortiment och en stark kundbas. Samtidigt finns stora möjligheter att utveckla hur vi arbetar med digital försäljning, kundrelationer och tillväxt.


Vi söker därför inte någon som bara vill förvalta en befintlig e-handel. Vi söker dig som vill analysera, prioritera, testa och bygga vidare.


Placering: Nyköping/Enstaberga


Omfattning: Heltid


Anställningsform: Tillsvidare, med 6 månaders provanställning


Låter det som nästa steg?


Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig.

*Rekryteringen görs i samarbete med* *Tillväxt Nyköping**. Urvalet sker löpande och dina svar på ansökningsfrågorna ligger till grund för bedömning av din ansökan. Den tjänst du söker är hos en av de arbetsgivare som Tillväxt Nyköping samarbetar med. Om du blir erbjuden jobbet blir det alltså denna arbetsgivare – inte Tillväxt Nyköping – som anställer dig.*

title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
#### **Do you want to build solutions that make a real difference for millions of savers and help shape the future of banking? We are looking for a passionate Software Engineer with a strong focus on modern frontend development (Angular) and a solid foundation in Java. You’ll join an environment where technical innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement are deeply valued.**

**Why Avanza?**
---------------


At Avanza, technology is more than just code — it is a tool for creating a positive impact in society. We combine high technical ambitions with a genuinely fun, flexible, and egoless work environment. We work in autonomous teams, share knowledge openly, and celebrate our successes together. For teams managing core infrastructure or critical systems, rotating on-call duty is a natural part of our commitment to operational ownership.


We are on an exciting journey. As Avanza expands into Denmark, we are undergoing a major cloud transformation toward Google Cloud Platform (GCP). By 2030, our goal is to be fully cloud-based and "AI-first”.


Avanza is currently transitioning to English as our primary language. We welcome English-speaking candidates who are comfortable working in an environment where Swedish is still used in day-to-day communication, meetings, and documentation. We expect this to evolve as we continue our transformation.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Fullstack Engineer, you will join one of our 45 agile teams, taking end-to-end ownership of your work—from the initial idea to ensuring your code runs reliably in production. For this role, we are looking for an experienced frontend developer or a full-stack developer with a clear focus and passion for frontend development.


In your day-to-day work, you will:

* Own the full stack: Design and develop scalable web applications in a microservices architecture, focusing on responsive interfaces in Angular and robust business logic in Java.
* Collaborate deeply: We strongly believe in pair and mob programming to share knowledge, improve code quality, and solve complex problems together.
* Shape our technology: Use your expertise to actively contribute to design processes and architectural decisions.
* Shape the way we work tomorrow (AI-first): You have an interest in AI and, in this role, you will actively contribute to continuously improving the interaction between people, AI, and our codebase. You will help define the standards for how AI can drive efficiency and quality in our work.
* Work cross-functionally: Partner with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Data Analysts to create seamless, optimized user journeys.

**Who are you?**
----------------


We are looking for an enthusiastic and self-driven team player. You are a proactive problem-solver who takes initiative, turns ideas into action, and isn't afraid to make mistakes along the way. You contribute to maintaining and strengthening psychological safety within the team and thrive in an environment where asking for help is just as natural as offering it.

**We believe that you**
-----------------------

* Have proven experience as a Software Engineer with in-depth knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (primarily Angular), combined with a solid foundation in Java.
* Have strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/ TypeScript.
* Experience working in cross-functional teams and an appreciation for close collaboration with non-developers, such as designers and analysts.
* Experience building and maintaining applications in complex production environments, with a strong focus on clean, testable, and well-structured code.
* Have hands-on experience with AI-assisted development and a curiosity to explore how AI can enhance our work.


Experience within Fintech, Martech, or a particular interest in UX is a plus.

**A culture of community and sustainability**
---------------------------------------------


We believe the best results are achieved in psychologically safe teams where everyone has a voice. That's why we place great importance on collaboration, openness, and enjoying our work. At Avanza, you will have the space to grow at your own pace and combine your career with a sustainable life.


Our guiding principles are Customer First, Smarter Together, and Better. For Real. We put our customers at the heart of what we do, collaborate to achieve more together, and constantly challenge the status quo to find innovative solutions that make a real difference.


We operate a hybrid working model and would love to see you in our newly renovated office at **Regeringsgatan 103**, about 2–3 days a week.

**How to apply**
----------------


Submit your application by clicking the "Apply" button below. We review applications on an ongoing basis.


We look forward to receiving your application!

*Please note that we do not accept offers from recruitment agencies or advertising sales representatives.*

title: Founding UI/UX & Brand Designer
description:
TL;DR
  
We're looking for a Founding Designer to own how Spiich looks, feels, and behaves — across product and brand. You'll define the UI/UX for every surface (web, mobile, browser extension) and shape the visual identity of the company itself. Production React/vibe coding skills are a plus, not a requirement — taste, craft, and judgment are the job.
  
Why join
  
We're a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value speed, rigour, and extreme ownership. If you're obsessed with craft, thrive in ambiguity, and want to define how sales professionals experience AI, you'll feel at home.
  
**Design at Spiich is an open field:** agentic software has no established patterns yet. How should a rep review what an autonomous agent did overnight? What does trust look like in an interface? You'll answer questions most designers never get to ask.
  
We're backed by founders and operators behind Lovable, OpenAI, Tandem Health, and Neo4j. Our customers across 10 countries report 90% less prospecting time, 3x market coverage, and 2x customer meetings.
  
What you'll do (responsibilities)
  
**In one sentence:** Own design end-to-end — product UX and company brand.
  
**Design the product across web, mobile, and browser extension:** flows, wireframes, prototypes, and final UI
  
Invent interaction patterns for agentic software — reviewing agent work, voice-first flows, and trust and transparency in AI actions
  
Build and own the design system our engineers ship from
  
**Prototype at the speed of thought:** use AI tools to go from idea to working demo in hours, not sprints
  
**Own the brand:** visual identity, website, decks, and everything the world sees — and shape the next chapter of our brand as we grow
  
Do user research with real customers, iterate daily, and let findings kill your darlings
  
Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers so designs ship fast and ship true
  
  

Who you are
  
Designer with exceptional taste and a portfolio that proves it — both product work and brand/visual work
  
**Strong in UX thinking and UI craft:** typography, spacing, motion, and the details most people miss
  
Proficient in Figma; comfortable prototyping at high fidelity
  
Comfortable with ambiguity, early-stage chaos, and fast iteration
  
Care more about solving problems than polishing abstractions
  
**Fully committed to the mission:** not "just a job"
  
  

**Bonus:** You prototype and ship with AI tools — Lovable, Claude Design, Claude Code, Codex, or similar. Production React is welcome too, but we have engineers for that.
  
What we offer
  
A team of obsessed builders, full of speed, rigour, and grit
  
**Full design ownership:** no design-by-committee, no layers between you and shipped product
  
**Mission-driven, no-BS culture:** experiment, ship, learn
  
Meaningful equity through qualified employee stock options (QESO) from day one
  
Fully on-site in Stockholm - we believe in working together
  
Top-tier compensation package
  
  

Our tools
  
**Design:** Figma
  
AI: Lovable, Claude Design, Claude Code, Codex — use whatever makes you fastest
  
**Product:** React, React Native, TypeScript — built by our engineers, with you if you code
  
**Platforms:** Web app, mobile (iOS & Android), browser extension
  
  

About Spiich Labs
  
Spiich is the agentic platform for sales teams. Reps focus on the human work — building relationships, building trust, and closing deals — while Spiich agents handle everything else: prospecting, lead generation, CRM updates, meeting prep, follow-ups, and everything in between. We're backed by founders and operators behind Lovable, OpenAI, Tandem Health, and Neo4j.
  
How we hire
  
Submit your application
  
Intro call with the team
  
**Portfolio deep-dive:** walk us through work you're proud of and the decisions behind it
  
Design exercise
  
Join us for trial work lasting 2 days on-site. We'll see how you tick and you get to meet the team and explore whether joining Spiich feels right for you.
  
  

We move fast — the full process typically takes under two weeks.
  
How to Apply
  
Drop us a line at filip@spiich.ai with your portfolio, a note on why this excites you, and your proudest work. No CV needed.
