title: UX/UI Engineer ﻿
description:
*Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld.*

  

  

### **Din roll**


Som UX/UI Engineer får du en nyckelroll i vår organisation där du sätter riktningen för användarupplevelsen i våra produkter. Detta är en ny roll som du får möjlighet att forma och utveckla, med stort inflytande över arbetssätt, designstrategi och den långsiktiga utvecklingen av UX-området.

  

  

Du har det övergripande ansvaret för användarupplevelsen genom hela utvecklingsprocessen, från vision, strategi och koncept till färdig lösning. Genom konceptskisser, wireframes och prototyper omsätter du komplexa behov till intuitiva och användarcentrerade lösningar som skapar värde för våra användare.

  

  

I rollen fungerar du som länken mellan användare, verksamhet och utveckling. Du identifierar, analyserar och prioriterar behov från slutanvändare och stakeholders för att säkerställa att våra produkter är relevanta, effektiva och hållbara över tid.

  

  

Du driver utvecklingen av moderna och användarvänliga gränssnitt där design och implementation går hand i hand. Du visualiserar komplex information och hierarkiska datastrukturer på ett sätt som gör dem begripliga och enkla att använda. Du planerar och genomför användartester för att kontinuerligt förbättra användarupplevelsen och säkerställa att våra lösningar möter användarnas behov.

  

  

Som UX/UI Engineer tar du en tydlig ledarroll för UX-området. Du ansvarar för att etablera och vidareutveckla ett gemensamt designsystem som stärker produktens användbarhet, konsekvens och visuella identitet. Du driver UX-frågor strategiskt och säkerställer att UX-principer och GUI best practices blir en naturlig del av utvecklingsarbetet.

  

  

En viktig del av rollen är att vara mentor och kunskapsledare inom UX/UI. Du coachar, inspirerar och vägleder utvecklare och andra kollegor samt arbetar aktivt för att sprida UX/UI-kompetens och skapa en stark användarcentrerad kultur i organisationen.

  

  

Rollen är placerad på vårt kontor i Karlskoga.

  

  

### **Din profil**


Vi söker dig som har en relevant utbildningsbakgrund inom UX/UI, interaktionsdesign, systemutveckling eller motsvarande, alternativt har förvärvat motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Du har en stark teknisk grund och trivs i skärningspunkten mellan användarupplevelse och utveckling. Du har erfarenhet av Qt, C++, Visual Studio och känner dig trygg i att omsätta design till fungerande och användarvänliga gränssnitt. Du har även erfarenhet av moderna UX- och prototypverktyg, exempelvis Figma, och är van att visualisera och kommunicera lösningar genom wireframes, prototyper och designsystem. Erfarenhet av Carmenta är meriterande.

  

  

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av att driva UX-frågor, påverka arbetssätt och skapa förankring i utvecklingsteam. Du trivs i en ledande roll där du kombinerar strategiskt arbete med operativt genomförande och får möjlighet att coacha och utveckla andra.

  

  

Du uppskattar ett agilt arbetssätt och ser värdet i att iterera, testa och förbättra tillsammans med andra. Som person är du kommunikativ, bygger lätt förtroende och engagemang samt kombinerar ett starkt helhetsperspektiv med ett öga för detaljer. Du har förmågan att omsätta komplexa behov till tydliga och användarvänliga lösningar.


Du tar initiativ, driver förändring och skapar struktur även i nya eller otydliga sammanhang. Samtidigt är du lyhörd och inkluderande, vilket gör att du får med dig teamet och kan fungera som mentor inom UX-området.

  

  

Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

  

  

Vi vill gärna se exempel på ditt arbete. Bifoga en portfolio eller presentera relevanta arbetsprover, case eller projekt under intervjun.

  

  

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

  

  

Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

  

  

### **Vad du blir en del av**


Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

  

  

Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

  

  

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här .

title: Product Designer
description:
**About Air Apps**
 At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco - we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
   

  

 Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
   

  

 Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
   

  

****The Role****
 As a
 **Product Designer** 
 , you will be responsible for crafting intuitive, delightful user experiences that seamlessly span mobile (iOS and Android) and web platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Product Management, Engineering, and User Research—to translate complex requirements into elegant, user-centered designs. You will leverage your design sensibilities, storytelling abilities, and understanding of technology constraints to build consistent, scalable solutions that resonate with a wide range of users.
   

  

* This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.


**Responsibilities**
* Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing to deeply understand user needs, pain points, and behaviors. Translate insights into wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups.
* Develop and maintain design systems and component libraries that ensure a cohesive look and feel across iOS, Android, and web interfaces while respecting platform-specific patterns and guidelines.
* Own the entire design process - from concept ideation and user flows to final visual design - ensuring a pixel-perfect, responsive experience across devices and screen sizes.
* Work closely with Product Managers to shape product strategy and define requirements, and partner with Engineers to ensure technical feasibility and a smooth handoff of assets and specifications.
* Continuously refine designs based on user feedback, A/B testing results, and analytics. Strive for iterative improvements that drive measurable increases in user satisfaction, engagement, and retention.
* Advocate for user experience best practices and contribute to the ongoing improvement of design processes, tooling, and team culture.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to less experienced designers, fostering a collaborative and inclusive design environment.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or related field.
* Approximately 3+ years of experience in modern design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD).
* Solid understanding of layout, typography, and color theory, with an eye for detail and usability.
* Familiarity with native mobile design patterns (Human Interface Guidelines for iOS, Material Design for Android) as well as responsive web design principles.
* Experience conducting user research, usability testing, and applying both qualitative and quantitative feedback to improve designs.


**What benefits are we offering?**
* Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
* Annual Bonus
* Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.
* Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.
* Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.
* Childcare support.
* Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
* Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.
* Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.
* Meals 100% free at the hub.


****Diversity & Inclusion****
 At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.
   

  

****Application Disclaimer****
 At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.
   

  

 Compensation Range: €36K - €46K

title: Experience Manager I EY wavespace | Stockholm
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 The EY wavespace Nordic team is looking for a senior Experience Manager. You'll need deep experience leading and designing human-centred design and/or innovation processes. You'll manage and work with both internal and external stakeholders, shepherding them through ambiguity and opportunity to deliver impactful business results.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 At EY wavespace, we like people who are good at the Reframe: taking an initial request and reframing that into a Better Question to solve for. Reframing business challenges as a platform for creating co-creation spaces and experiences is what we are best at. We're also looking for someone who really loves facilitating. Someone who leans into the challenge and messiness of bringing diverse groups of people together to accomplish something greater than the sum of the individuals.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As an Experience Manager part of the EY Nordic wavespace team, you will have three essential responsibilities including 1) Managing projects, 2) Designing exceptional experiences and, 3) Facilitating experiences.
   

  

* Managing projects
+ Managing internal and external stakeholders through our process.
+ Building strong relationships across EY to increase opportunities for wavespace.

* Designing exceptional experiences
+ Uncovering the true client need and desired outcome of a wavespace.
+ Designing workshops and that drive collaboration, creativity, and concrete outcomes.
+ Partnering with Experience Designers to create impactful and memorable experiences.

* Facilitating experiences
+ As lead facilitator you will need to know how to get the best out of people, how to manage time, energy and conflicts, and to hold a room.
+ Balance great structure with improvisation.


**Qualifications**
**Skills and attributes for success**
* University degree in a relevant field
* 5-10 years proven experience in a senior role within innovation, design, transformation, consulting, or a related area
* 5-10 years leading outcome-based workshops using design or innovation methodologies
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Swedish or Danish language skills are considered an advantage as well as experience from experience working in the Nordic Region
* Strong stakeholder and client management skills.


**Meritorious**
* Experience with human-centred design, design thinking, or innovation methodologies.
* Experience facilitating workshops for senior stakeholders and leadership teams.


**As a person you are**
* Eager to with work with diverse teams and personalities
* Someone with varied experiences who can pivot easily
* Ready for a good laugh while taking your responsibilities seriously
* Comfortable playing a role in a creative team.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**
 Please submit your application no later than 18 October 2026. In your application, apart from a detailed CV, we want you to include
   

  

* A Cover Letter explaining why you're the right fit for the role, preferably with personal anecdotes
* Two to three examples (case studies) of your facilitation, co-creation, or engagement work, highlighting the challenge, your role, your approach, and the results achieved.


 If you have questions about the role, please contact Tom Barette at tom.barette@se.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Simon Aspler at simon.aspler@se.ey.com.
   

  

 Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.
   

  

 At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, require assistance, or need adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.
   

  

**EY | Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Senior Principal UX Designer (6 month FTC)
description:
**Craft:**
 UX & UI
   

  

**Job Description:**
 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Principal UX Designer** 
 to help transform the developer experience at King.
 **This is a 6 month fixed-term maternity cover.**
 You’ll work with our Build & Infrastructure teams as we reset King’s continuous integration (CI) orchestration. We’re modernising the foundations of our CI ecosystem while addressing years of accumulated complexity across its workflows.
   

  

 This is more than a technology transformation. It’s an opportunity to understand what our game teams need from CI, simplify critical workflows and create a developer ecosystem that helps teams build and deliver great games effectively.
   

  

 You’ll bring deep user research expertise and senior design leadership to the programme. Initially, you’ll lead a summative study of our current CI workflows, helping the team understand users’ pain points, behaviours and unmet needs. You’ll identify the outcomes and jobs to be done that should shape the future CI experience.
   

  

 You’ll then work closely with engineers, product partners and King’s game teams to translate those insights into clear, efficient CI workflows and coherent end-to-end journeys across our developer ecosystem.
   

  

 This role belongs to part of the Kingdom we call Shared Tech. The teams within Shared Tech work across all the technology that we use to power our live games, including data infrastructure, machine learning, payments infrastructure and the game engine itself.
   

  

 Your role within the Kingdom
   

  

* Define and lead research into King’s existing CI workflows, using appropriate qualitative and quantitative methods.
* Identify pain points, workarounds and unmet needs, translating your findings into prioritised outcomes and clearly articulated user stories, jobs to be done, or similar.
* Map current and future developer journeys across CI and the wider developer ecosystem.
* Work with engineers and game teams to design, prototype and evaluate intuitive, efficient CI workflows.
* Facilitate workshops that build shared understanding, explore solutions and align teams around priorities.
* Communicate complex systems and design decisions clearly, influencing initiative direction through evidence, systems thinking and constructive challenge.
* Help establish sustainable practices for continuing to learn from users as our CI ecosystem evolves.


**Skills And Experience**
**Must have**
* Extensive experience as a senior UX, product or service designer, with a track record of leading complex, high-impact work through expertise and influence.
* Deep user research expertise, including planning and leading substantial studies and turning findings into product direction and practical design decisions.
* Strong interaction and workflow design skills, particularly for complex tools, systems or end-to-end user journeys.
* Experience applying jobs-to-be-done or comparable outcome-led frameworks.
* Confidence working closely with engineers and engaging with technical subject matter.
* Excellent facilitation, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to create alignment around competing needs and constraints.
* The ability to work independently, bring structure to ambiguity and balance user needs with technical and delivery considerations.


**Particularly valuable**
* Experience designing developer tools, internal platforms or other products for technical users.
* Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery, build systems or software-development workflows.
* Experience with Jenkins, Buildkite or comparable CI/CD platforms.
* Experience simplifying legacy systems or supporting large-scale platform transformations.
* Knowledge of service design or systems thinking, particularly when working across interconnected tools, workflows and teams.
* Experience working in a large-scale engineering or game-development organisation.


 Direct experience with Jenkins or Buildkite is not essential. You will, however, need the curiosity and confidence to develop a strong understanding of technical workflows and earn the trust of experienced engineers and developers.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 In this role, you will help King develop:
   

  

* A robust, evidence-based understanding of how game teams experience CI today.
* Clear priorities based on the outcomes users need to achieve, not simply the features of the existing system.
* Simpler, smoother and more coherent CI workflows.
* End-to-end developer journeys that work well across the wider King ecosystem.
* Strong collaboration between Build & Infrastructure teams and the game teams they support.
* A sustainable foundation for continuing to improve the CI experience.


**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Master Thesis: Reimagining Outdoor Experiences for Diverse Audiences
description:
Dometic is a global market leader in the mobile living industry. Millions of people around the world use Dometic products in outdoor, residential, and professional applications. We are on a growth journey – now looking for our next star – a passionate Master's Thesis student with a strong interest in human-centered design, user research, and innovation. Exploring new opportunities and transforming insights into impactful product experiences. You bring creativity, analytical thinking, and a drive to tackle complex challenges.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a Master’s thesis student collaborating across Group Sustainability, Global Design, and Global Marketing, you will investigate how product design, consumer insights, brand positioning, and strategic partnerships can make outdoor products and experiences more accessible, relevant, inclusive, and desirable.
   

  

 Women will serve as the primary research focus and starting point for uncovering overlooked needs and barriers. The ambition is not to design exclusively for women, but to translate these insights into inclusive solutions with broader market relevance. Building on recent Design for Inclusion research, consumer insights, and market segmentation, you will turn research findings into actionable recommendations for future product concepts, experiences, marketing strategies, and collaboration opportunities.
   

  

* Duration: Planned for 6 months (Spring Semester)
* Team: Open to 1 or 2 students working together


**Your Main Responsibilities**
* Conduct qualitative and quantitative user research with diverse user groups, with a particular focus on women, to understand needs, preferences, experiences, and barriers to outdoor participation.
* Evaluate current outdoor gear and translate research findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product design, accessibility, and user experience.
* Develop messaging and brand recommendations that help make outdoor experiences more relevant and welcoming to a broader audience.
* Benchmark how leading brands address inclusiveness and collaborate with Dometic specialists across sustainability, design, marketing, and inclusive design to identify future product, partnership, and innovation opportunities.


**What do we offer?**
 You will join a dynamic, fast-paced global environment with access to real-world data, consumer insights, and industry specialists across Group Sustainability, Global Design, and Global Marketing. Primary mentorship will be provided by our Senior Industrial Designer who is part of the Global Design team.
   

  

 This multidisciplinary setup offers a complete 360-degree view of how a global company transforms user insights into tangible product and brand innovations. Your research will directly inform and influence Dometic’s future product roadmap.
   

  

 ,
   

  

**Suitable Background**
 We are looking for candidates with a solid foundation in user research, product design, or innovation management, along with:
   

  

* Industrial Engineering and Management, Industrial Economics and Management, Technology and Innovation Management, or Technology-based Entrepreneurship.
* Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field, preferably with a focus on design engineering, product development, or product management.
* Industrial Design with focus on user experience, consumer research, or another relevant discipline.
* Academic or practical experience in qualitative user research, such as interviews, surveys, usability testing, or structured feedback analysis, with the ability to translate findings into actionable recommendations.


**To be successful in this role, we believe that you possess the following skills, competencies & characteristics:**
* A genuine interest in the outdoors and hands-on experience with camping-related products, together with a strong drive to make outdoor activities more enjoyable and welcoming for everyone.
* A basic understanding of inclusive design and how products and experiences can be made more accessible.
* The ability to build trust with diverse or underrepresented user groups and uncover genuine, sometimes unstated, needs.
* Curiosity, analytical thinking, strong communication and collaboration skills, and the drive to take ownership of the research scope and navigate ambiguity.


**Dometic's Core Values**
 To thrive and succeed in this role, you understand the importance of our core values – Together We build our future, We play to win, We embrace change and We walk the talk; these values reflect the heart and soul of Dometic and they define what it takes to work here and how we do things.

title: Fullstack Product Engineer
description:
Intric builds a sovereign AI platform for organisations that need to keep their data close: public-sector bodies, municipalities and critical infrastructure. It’s a small team, which means the work is real, the decisions matter and you’ll get close to the systems that actually keep the product running.
   

  

 We are looking for a Full Stack Product Engineer to take direct ownership across our product surface. You will step into a fast-moving engineering setting with high autonomy, working across frontend interfaces, backend logic, and deployment to ship practical solutions directly to users. Our core stack is Python and Svelte, though prior experience with these specific technologies is not required.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own end-to-end product features. You work directly with Product to turn user feedback into working software, building across frontend interfaces, backend services, and deployment pipelines.
* Shorten user feedback loops. You maintain a steady release cadence, shipping frequent improvements and resolving issues without waiting for specialist handoffs.
* Orchestrate parallel development workflows. You use AI coding agents to explore edge cases, draft tests, and scaffold changes concurrently, multiplying what you can ship.
* Choose simple solutions over complex systems. You focus on solving user problems quickly, whether by making a direct update or integrating an existing tool, rather than overengineering the backend.
* Anchor system reliability. You step into unfamiliar or undocumented areas of the codebase with confidence, making safe updates and keeping the product stable as the team grows.


**Who you are**
* You focus on user outcomes. You care about whether an update genuinely helps the user, rather than just writing clean syntax.
* You navigate the full stack. You are comfortable working across modern web technologies, tracing an issue through the application layer to the database or build pipeline.
* You manage parallel work with AI agents. You keep multiple tasks moving at once by delegating to coding tools, and you bring the technical discipline to spot mistakes or bad assumptions in generated code.
* You bring good design taste. You care about how software feels in practice. You notice awkward interactions, rough spacing, and confusing flows.
* You explore without a roadmap. You treat ambiguous code and sparse documentation as an invitation to investigate, read source logic, and map safe paths forward.
* You balance speed with discipline. You know when a simple fix is sufficient and when a system change demands deeper testing and verification.


**Why join**
 You will have broad technical ownership across a product where engineering choices shape the roadmap. Intric operates in high-trust sectors where data sovereignty matters, giving you the opportunity to solve real product problems without bureaucratic delays.
   

  

**About Intric**
 Europe's public sector is facing its biggest challenge in generations. A shrinking workforce must deliver more services to more people, and the gap grows every year. Intric exists to close it. We bring modern AI to the organisations that keep society running, and in doing so, we're defining how public services will work for decades to come.
   

  

 We value ownership, high standards, and thoughtful execution. Titles matter less than contribution. If you see something that can be improved, you take initiative. If something is unclear, you ask questions. If a customer faces a challenge, you lean in.
   

  

 We combine ambition with collaboration. We move fast, but we care deeply about doing things right. As we continue scaling across Europe, every team member plays a meaningful role in shaping both the company and the culture.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Senior Designer — Omoi, Stockholm
 



  





 We’re Omoi — Europe’s design agency for deep tech. Space, aerospace, AI, robotics, energy — we help companies with branding, strategy, design, content, and storytelling. Companies doing hard things that are hard to explain. But also companies that, every day, achieve the near-impossible.
 



  





 Since we started Omoi, we’ve worked with over 25 companies in more than 7 countries, grown from two people to twelve, and helped our clients raise over €750m. 
 



  





 We’re looking for a Senior Designer to shape how these companies show up in the world. You’ll report directly to our Creative Director, lead identity work from first concept to final system, and mentor other designers. 
 



  





 The work spans brand identities, pitch decks, websites, brand films, and more, with in-house 3D, motion, photography, and film at your fingertips.
 



  





 Founders come to us at the moment they’re defining what their company is. We don’t just deliver design; we advise on how to build a brand, and you’ll be in the room for that. The bar is high and the pace is fast. If that sounds like the point rather than the price, we should talk because this is going to be a challenge. We are a startup working for startups and that means that this will be both and effort and time commitment unlike many opportunities in Sweden. 
 



  





 We’re a startup working for startups, and we won’t pretend otherwise. This is not a nine-to-five job. Our clients are racing to build things that haven’t existed before, and we move at their speed. We want someone who treats the work as their own, who’s in early on the days it matters, and who isn’t satisfied until it’s right.
 



  





 It will likely be the most demanding job you’ve had, and the most interesting. If you’re looking for somewhere to settle in, this isn’t it. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who expect the same, we should talk. 
 



  





 You’ll work alongside people who’ve built brands at Bottega Veneta, Ogilvy & Mather, Gin Lane, Great Works, Laird & Partners, Collins, and more. 
 



  





 Our working language is English, and all work happens in our studio in central Stockholm. We believe creative collaboration is best in person, so this role is not remote. 
 



  





 You have:
 



  





 – 8+ years in brand identity, with projects you’ve led end to end
 



 – Impeccable taste in typography, layout, motion, and image
 



 – Experience guiding and developing other designers
 



 – The confidence to present and defend work directly to founders
 



 – Curiosity about science and technology (experience with tech-forward clients is a plus)
 



  





 Send us your CV and portfolio, and a line on the project you’re proudest of and why.
 



**Applications without a portfolio won’t be considered.** 




  




* See our work at omoi.co.

title: Fullstack Product Engineer
description:
**About Centi** 




 At Centi, we’re on a mission to make equity ownership simple. We believe companies that give employees the opportunity to be shareholders create better incentives and outcomes for everyone. Yet managing ownership remains complex to set up, slow to administer, and easy to get wrong.
 



  





 We build software for private equity funds and their portfolio companies to manage cap tables, incentive programmes and corporate actions. Our product sits at the intersection of legal complexity, financial precision, and human trust. Edge cases are common and errors have serious consequences, making this a challenging engineering problem.
 



  





 We combine deep domain expertise with automation and AI to make that complexity easier to manage.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re a team of 14, including five engineers, based in Stockholm. We’re looking for a senior product engineer who can independently lead substantial work and help shape both our product and how we build it.
 



  





 You’ll own features end to end: helping define the problem, exploring solutions, making technical decisions, and taking your work through deployment and iteration. You’ll work closely with product and domain experts, and sometimes directly with customers. There’s room to make decisions and colleagues to work through ideas with when you want another perspective.
 



  





 A major part of the role will be building AI-driven workflows that change how we handle customer requests and carry out ownership-related work. This means deciding where agents can act reliably, where human review is needed, and how to make the whole workflow useful in practice.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 



* Help define problems and shape solutions alongside product, operations, and domain experts.
* Design and build features end to end in our TypeScript-first stack.
* Build AI workflows that help our operations team handle customer requests and prepare actions for review.
* Own technical planning, implementation, deployment, and iteration.
* Improve our architecture, data model, and tooling as the product grows.
* Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor thoughtfully, taking responsibility for the quality of what you ship.
* Help shape our engineering practices and company culture.



  





 In practice, you might build workflows that draft transactions from legal documents alongside our senior legal expert Isabel, improve the valuation engine with our CEO George, or develop our operations agent, which triages incoming customer questions and requests for our operations team and prepares draft actions when it can do so reliably.
 



  





**Our tech stack** 



* TypeScript-first monorepo using Turborepo, hosted on GitHub
* Full-stack applications built with Next.js, tRPC, Inngest, and Prisma, hosted on Vercel
* Vercel AI SDK with Claude
* MySQL databases hosted on PlanetScale
* AWS: S3, Lambda, and Fargate
* Sentry and BetterStack for error tracking and monitoring
* Slack, Linear, and Notion for day-to-day collaboration



  





 Experience with every part of our stack is not required, but a strong foundation in TypeScript and full-stack development is.
 



  





**Who you are** 



* You have substantial experience building modern web applications with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.
* You can independently lead features, from an open-ended problem to a working solution.
* You care about what a feature should do and why, as well as how it’s built.
* You enjoy working through complex domains and care about correctness, maintainability, and user trust.
* You’re interested in building reliable AI-powered products and apply new tools with curiosity and sound judgment.
* You take ownership of your work and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across disciplines.



  





**What we offer** 



* Real influence over the product, technical decisions, and how we work
* Challenging engineering problems with direct access to legal, financial, and operational expertise
* A small team where you can own your work and get input when you need it
* A startup environment with work-life balance
* An office in Gamla Stan, Stockholm
* Competitive salary and equity
* Full wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)
* 30 days of paid vacation



  





**Application** 




 We’d love to hear from you. Please send your CV along with a short introduction to people@gocenti.com.
 



  





*Please note that this role is a full-time position at our Stockholm office* 
 .
 *We are only considering candidates based in Stockholm, Sweden.* 




  





*Centi is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

title: Head of Product
description:
Sleip is entering a growth phase and is looking for a Head of Product to take overall responsibility for its product portfolio and continued development. In this role, you will create structure, sharpen prioritisation and drive product development in close collaboration with leadership, engineering, design and commercial teams.
 



  





**About Sleip** 




 Sleip is a fast-growing startup backed by private and strategic investors, reshaping the equine health industry with cutting-edge AI and mobile technology. We’re on a mission to deliver objective, data-driven gait analysis that transforms how equine health is managed. Headquartered in Stockholm, our innovative app has already empowered over 1000 veterinary professionals worldwide, and we’re just getting started. Our leadership team – including visionary founders with deep expertise in both technology and veterinary science, and a recently appointed CEO from AniCura – is committed to creating impact through relentless innovation and collaboration.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As Head of Product, you will own and further develop Sleip’s product portfolio. Today, this includes the company’s core iOS product, related add-ons, Desktop, and internal tools. Looking ahead, key development areas include Android, expanding core platform functionality, and building out scalable commercial and user management solutions.
 



  





 A central part of the role will be to create a clear and well-anchored product roadmap, establish ways of working for prioritisation, and ensure that product decisions are driven by customer insights, data, and commercial considerations. Larger strategic decisions will continue to be anchored in the leadership team, while the product function will have clear ownership of product-related priorities, processes, and direction.
 



  





 You will also work closely with a current product colleague who brings strong domain expertise from the veterinary side. Over time, you will contribute to clarifying ownership and responsibilities across the product portfolio.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




 In this role, you will:
 


* Own and structure the product portfolio, including product areas, initiatives and priorities.
* Develop and anchor the product roadmap and ways of working for prioritisation.
* Build and scale product capabilities that support the commercial strategy, enabling new packaging models, payment solutions, product-led growth, and emerging business opportunities.
* Lead complex product initiatives from idea to execution, including role-based access control, RBAC.
* Bring a clear product perspective to strategic discussions as part of Sleip’s management team.



  





**Who you are** 




 We are seeking someone with around ten years of experience in product development and product leadership, from SaaS, startup or scaleup environments. You may have worked as Head of Product, Product Director or in a similar role where you have been responsible for complex digital products.
 



  





 You have experience of building structure and creating momentum in environments where everything is not yet fully established. You are pragmatic, commercially minded and able to connect product decisions to business value. You are also used to working with product-market fit, hypothesis-driven development and fast testing of new initiatives.
 



  





 We believe you have:
 


* Solid experience in product leadership within digital products, preferably SaaS.
* Experience from startup or scaleup environments.
* A data-driven approach with hands-on experience in product analytics, user behavior tracking, and A/B testing to drive active user engagement.
* Experience from management team work and close collaboration with senior leadership.
* A hands-on approach and willingness to drive operational work when needed.



  





 It is a plus if you have experience from B2B2C products, medtech, healthtech, animal health, sporttech or similar areas. Experience from international contexts, payment solutions, self-service flows, commercial packaging, equestrian sports or veterinary medicine is also relevant.
 



  





**Personal qualities** 




 To succeed in this role, you need to be both strategic and execution-oriented. You are curious, confident and collaborative, with a low-ego approach to working across functions. You listen actively, consider different perspectives and bring clarity and direction while contributing to a friendly and supportive culture.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 If you are passionate about mobile innovation and eager to make a difference in equine health, we welcome your application. If you would like more information or have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact our recruitment consultant Elin Lidström or Henrik Dellgren at Novare, email: elin.lidstrom@novare.se / henrik.dellgren@novare.se
 



  





 Location: Stockholm, Sweden (Onsite)

title: Product Manager (Agents)
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the Lovable agent end-to-end - owning quality, roadmap, and the feedback loops that make it better. You'll shape how our agent reasons, acts, and delivers for millions of users, directly influencing one of the most consequential product surfaces at Lovable.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 8+ years in the software industry, with direct ownership of an AI or LLM-powered product in a product management or engineering leadership role
* Hands-on experience building and shipping agent-based systems - you understand tool use, planning loops, multi-step reasoning, and how agents fail
* Technical fluency: you program or have programmed, and can read model outputs, traces, and evals with confidence
* Strong product sense and systems thinking - you know when to move fast and when to invest in foundational work, and you have sharp opinions on how agents should communicate, recover from errors, and earn user trust
* Preferred: Deep familiarity with prompt engineering and evaluation frameworks; prior experience operating at the frontier where best practices are still being written


**What You'll Do**
* Represent the user - synthesize findings on agent performance and behavior, and bring them to the team with clarity and conviction
* Run discovery end-to-end: user interviews, competitive research, eval analysis, prompt experimentation, and crafting messaging for upcoming agent capabilities
* Own the quality bar for agent outputs - drive eval infrastructure, monitor regressions, and ensure the agent improves with every release
* Scope ruthlessly - ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn't
* Enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to communicate new agent capabilities effectively
* Projects you'll tackle first: Rebuilding the agent evaluation framework to catch regressions before they ship; running discovery on the biggest gaps in agent reliability and trust; defining and shipping the first iteration of improved agent error recovery and communication


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: IT - Global IT Business Analyst
description:
CCM Hockey is present worldwide, we have offices in Canada, the United States, Sweden, Finland and Taiwan. Our headquarters are located in Montreal, where we create and develop our equipment. Our mission is to inspire dreams and empower every player to fulfill their passion while enjoying their game. Our team's vision is to be the leading brand on and off the ice, by delivering innovative products and outstanding experience to our athletes and partners everywhere, all while putting our employees and communities at the forefront. We aim to unlock the full potential of every CCM athlete from pond to forum by delivering innovation to maximize performance and ignite in them the self-confidence to chase their dream. **At CCM Hockey, we live our values everyday:**  

**Authenticity:** Standing up for who you are, doing what you mean and what you believe in.
  
  

**Empowerment:** Through their unique contributions, each person is different, each person is important, and each person has the opportunity to make a difference.
  
  

**Teamwork:** A team that works together always beats a team of highly skilled individual players.
  
  

**Respect:** Valuing differences and allowing others to express themselves when working together, to achieve common goals, to grow and succeed as a company.
  
  

OBJECTIFS
  
The IT business analyst links the IT teams with the business departments, taking on more responsibility for managing small end-to-end projects, while bringing key expertise in supply chain and EDI integration. * Lead or participate in project planning (scope, timelines, deliverables)

* Analyze, prioritize, and align needs with business goals

* Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure objectives are met
* Track initiative progress and communicate status to stakeholders

* Work closely with the development team and stakeholders

* Degree in computer science, information systems, business analysis, or a related field
* 5 to 10 years of experience in business analysis
* 1 to 2 years of experience in project management or coordination
* Hands-on experience with EDI integrations
* Extensive experience and knowledge in supply chain
* Experience with an ERP (ideally Epicor)


At CCM Hockey, we celebrate the difference for the benefit of our employees, our products and our collaborators. We work to create an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, age or other motives, can give the best of themselves.

title: Nuclear Services Programmer/Site Lead
description:
**ATS** is an industry-leading automation solutions provider to many of the world’s most successful companies. **ATS** uses its extensive knowledge base and global capabilities in custom automation, repeat automation, automation products and value-added services, including pre-automation and after-sales services, to address the sophisticated manufacturing automation systems and service needs of multinational customers in markets such as life sciences, food & beverage, transportation, consumer products, and energy.

  

Founded in 1978, ATS employs over 7,000 people at 65 manufacturing facilities and over 85 offices in North America, Europe, Southeast Asia and China.

  

Join ***ATS Industrial Automation*** team ***Västerås, Sweeden*** and support the innovative nuclear technologies that set us apart. As part of our Nuclear Services team, you will work directly with local customers and global ATS experts to deploy, maintain, and optimize proprietary tooling and automation solutions that enable the safe and reliable operation of nuclear facilities.


**Role Overview**
-----------------


Our Nuclear Services team lives at the intersection of advanced engineering, real world problem solving, and some of the most complex environments in industry. We don’t just design tooling and hand it off—we follow it through its entire lifecycle, from early development to on site execution inside operating nuclear facilities, and then back again to make it better the next time around.
  

  

What makes this team unique is the depth of ownership we have over our work. Team members are involved in designing, commissioning, deploying, troubleshooting, and improving specialized nuclear tooling used for inspection, maintenance, and refurbishment. That means the lessons you learn on site don’t get lost, they directly shape the next generation of tools and processes.
  

  

This is a team for people who enjoy hands on technical challenges, thrive in dynamic environments, and want to see the tangible impact of their work. Our work is highly collaborative. Nuclear Services acts as the bridge between engineering, operations, and our nuclear customers, providing trusted expertise when it matters most. Because nuclear projects are often outage based and time critical, our team plays a key role in ensuring tooling is reliable, well maintained, and ready to perform when the window is tight.

  

As a **Nuclear Services Programmer**, you will be responsible for serving as the **Site Lead** in **Västerås, Sweden**, ensuring the successful delivery of nuclear services projects. The position requires occasional travel to ATS manufacturing facilities in North America to support project activities and collaborate with key stakeholders.  

You will work closely with the customer and ATS engineering teams to support the design, installation, commissioning, startup, validation, and ongoing operation of our customer's Automation System. You will act as the primary local ATS technical representative, providing customer-facing support, coordinating home-office resources, and delivering hands-on controls and automation expertise.

  

You will coordinate cross-functional teams in completing warranty and service work, including upgrades and modifications, in alignment with direction from the Capex team, while taking responsibility for controls software development, troubleshooting, commissioning support, customer communications, and coordination of technical support activities throughout the lifecycle of the automation system.


**Specific Responsibilities**
-----------------------------


**Customer Interface & Technical Leadership**
  

* Serve as the primary ATS technical contact for the customer site and be a regular presence on site.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through professional communication and responsiveness.
* Represent ATS in customer meetings and technical discussions. Support resolution of customer concerns by coordinating with ATS engineering, service, and project teams.
* Escalate technical issues and coordinate additional ATS resources when required.
* Provide regular updates to ATS and customer stakeholders regarding system performance, risks, and issues.
* Act as the local liaison between the customer and ATS engineering teams in North America and Europe. Support local Swedish personnel and facilitate effective communication between customer operations and ATS subject matter experts.
* Support customer training and knowledge transfer activities.

**PLC & Robot Programming Support**
  

* Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Siemens PLC control systems.
* Support integration with ABB 800xA systems and plant automation infrastructure.
* Support integration between PLCs, robots, HMIs, SCADA systems, vision systems, warehouse automation, and AMR systems.
* Perform software validation, testing, and implementation activities.
* Maintain software backups, change records, and configuration control documentation.
* Support automation system upgrades, continuous improvement initiatives, and optimization activities.
* Execute commissioning, startup, SAT, and production support activities.
* Troubleshoot automation system issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
* Identify technical risks and contribute to project decision-making.
* Establish and manage a software change request process to maintain code alignment across repeat cells and programs, ensure software revisions remain current, and support implementation of updates.
* Performing other duties as assigned.

**Documentation & Reporting**
  

* Generate clear technical reports, troubleshooting records, commissioning reports, and issue logs.
* Document software modifications, operational improvements, and corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate turnover and communication records between ATS and customer teams.
* Support compliance documentation and quality records required for nuclear projects.

**Qualifications**
------------------


**Education**
  

* Post-secondary degree, diploma, or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, or related education.

**Experience**
  

* Strong Siemens PLC programming and troubleshooting experience.
* Experience integrating PLC, HMI, SCADA, robotics, field devices, and industrial networks.
* ABB Robot and Cognex Vision experience
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience working directly with customers in a technical support or commissioning role.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Project engineering and/or project management experience is an asset.

**Nuclear & Regulatory Knowledge**
  

* Familiarity with nuclear quality standards and controlled work processes.
* Understanding of 10CFR810 requirements
* Eligible to obtain customer site access and eligible for 10CFR810 qualified.
* Understanding of Nuclear industry quality programs, documentation and traceability requirements.
* Familiarity with CSA, N299, NQA-1, ISO 9001, or equivalent quality standards is considered an asset.

**Language & International Support**
  

* Ability to work effectively in an international project environment, willingness to travel internationally as required.
* Experience supporting customers remotely and on-site across multiple time zones.
* Ability to collaborate with local Swedish support personnel, contractors, and customer representatives. Swedish language capability is a requirement.
* Strong communication and customer facing skills are essential.
* Ability to work independently in a customer-facing role with minimal supervision.

**Health & Safety Requirements**
--------------------------------


All employees have the responsibility to work in a healthy and safe manner, report any health, safety or environmental concern to their manager or supervisor in a timely manner, and participate in the safety culture of the organization.


Employee responsibilities for Health, Safety and Environment include:

  

  

* Work in conformance with divisional health, safety and environmental procedures and compliance to legislative requirements.

title: Teamledare i Utvecklingsteam till IT-Stöd
description:
**Vi är en kraft som binder ihop, håller samman och utvecklar länet. Inom Region Västernorrland är vi alla en del av något större.**

IT Gemensamma funktioner är en central enhet inom IT-stöd med uppdrag att skapa förutsättningar för en säker, effektiv och verksamhetsnära utveckling och förvaltning av Region Västernorrlands digitala lösningar. Inom enheten samlar vi flera kompetenser, bland annat systemutvecklare, IT-arkitekter, projektledare, tjänsteansvariga och andra specialistfunktioner som tillsammans bidrar till att utveckla IT-stöds förmåga.


Vi befinner oss i en utvecklingsfas där vi stärker vår gemensamma systemutvecklingsförmåga och utvecklar strukturer och arbetssätt för framtiden. Hos oss får du därför stort utrymme att påverka, ta ansvar och bidra till hur vi organiserar och utvecklar vårt arbete. Placeringsort kan vara Örnsköldsvik, Sollefteå, Härnösand eller Sundsvall.


Du får en central roll i uppbyggnaden av vårt nya utvecklingsteam. Teamet kommer att bestå av utvecklare med olika erfarenheter och tidigare arbetssätt, och en viktig del av ditt uppdrag blir att tillsammans med teamet skapa gemensamma strukturer och arbetssätt som ger en effektiv och förutsägbar leverans.


Som ledare för vårt agila team jobbar du som scrum master och är teamets coachande ledare. Du arbetar nära både utvecklarna, förvaltningsobjekten och enhetschefen och får möjlighet att påverka hur vi framöver arbetar med bland annat prioritering, planering och uppföljning av utvecklingsarbetet. Teamet äger själv sitt arbetssätt och vågar prova förändra för att sedan lyckas eller misslyckas tillsammans. Att våga prova är viktigt för oss på RVN och vi ser det som en nyckel till att utvecklas. Rollen har inget personalansvar. Tjänsten avser en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Möjligheter till distansarbete finns.


**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


* Samordna och stödja teamets dagliga arbete för att skapa förutsättningar för effektiva leveranser
* Leda arbetet med att etablera, förvalta och utveckla gemensamma arbetssätt, strukturer och rutiner inom teamet
* Identifiera, synliggöra och bidra till att undanröja hinder som påverkar teamets arbete eller leveransförmåga
* Samverka med förvaltningsobjekt och andra intressenter kring behov, planering, kapacitet och leveranser
* Följa upp teamets arbete samt synliggöra kapacitet, framdrift, risker och eventuella hinder
* Bidra till kontinuerlig utveckling av metoder, arbetssätt och samarbetsformer inom utvecklingsområdet
* Teamledarrollen är deltid, vilket innebär att du även bidrar i teamets arbete
### **Vi söker dig som**


* Har relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT/systemutveckling eller annan utbildning och erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
* Är väl insatt i systemutvecklingsprocessen med förståelse för hela livscykeln från behov till avveckling
* Har erfarenhet av att leda team inom IT-branschen och är både kunnig och har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt
* Har arbetslivserfarenhet inom systemutveckling, exempelvis i rollen som kravanalytiker, testledare eller IT-specialist
* Har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i såväl tal som skrift
* Har B-körkort

### **Det är meriterande om du**


* Har utbildning inom ledarskap, agil utveckling, projektledning eller förändringsledning
* Har erfarenhet av att etablera eller utveckla arbetssätt i ett utvecklingsteam
* Har erfarenhet av att leda team genom förändring, exempelvis vid förändrad organisation, sammanslagning av grupper eller införande av nya arbetssätt
* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta i en organisation med flera beställare/intressenter och konkurrerande behov
* Har goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift

### **För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har dessa personliga egenskaper**


* Samarbetsförmåga
* Strukturerad
* Initiativtagande
* Omdöme

**Region Västernorrland**


**Med cirka 7000 medarbetare och över 200 yrken ansvarar vi på Region Västernorrland för flera av de verksamheter som är allra viktigast för invånarnas möjlighet att delta i samhället. Här gör din kunskap och ditt engagemang skillnad inom allt från hälso- och sjukvård till kultur, miljö och hållbarhet. Bli en del av ett lag där alla behövs. Tillsammans för ett växande Västernorrland.**


Regionen arbetar sedan många år med att skapa förutsättningar för att bidra till friska och hälsosamma medarbetare. Att du mår bra och trivs är viktigt för oss. En av våra många förmåner är att vi erbjuder 5000 kronor per år i friskvårdsbidrag. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning enligt gällande kollektivavtal. Läs mer om Region Västernorrland, våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba tillsammans med oss: Region Västernorrland - Att jobba i Region Västernorrland (rvn.se).


Inom Region Västernorrland är ett antal tjänster placerade i säkerhetsklass och säkerhetsprövning kan därför komma att ske. Vi har gjort vårt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

title: Systemspecialist– i gränslandet mellan ekonomisystem och controlling
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla ekonomiarbetet i en verksamhet som påverkar miljoner människors framtid? Letar du efter en möjlighet att kombinera din specialistkunskap inom ekonomisystem med ditt intresse för controlling? Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och göra skillnad på riktigt!  

Vi är i slutfasen av ett av våra mest spännande projekt hittills – implementeringen av vårt nya ekonomisystem Raindance. I detta arbete kommer du som systemspecialist att ha en nyckelroll - både i slutförandet av implementeringen och i den fortsatta driften.

### **Om jobbet**


Som systemspecialist hos oss blir du en del av Ekonomi- och verksamhetsstyrningsenheten – en central stödfunktion med uppdrag att skapa en verksamhetsnära och värdeskapande ekonomistyrning.  

Du kommer att tillhöra gruppen Redovisning, betalningar och systemstöd, som består av experter med hög kompetens och stort ansvar för redovisning, bokslut, betalningar samt ekonomirelaterat IT-stöd. Raindance kommer att vara vårt nya ekonomisystem från och med 2027 och kommer att kräva nya processer, lösningar och arbetssätt för att redovisning, uppföljning och rapportering ska fungera optimalt – ett utvecklingsarbete som du kommer att driva tillsammans med övriga medarbetare i gruppen. I rollen som systemspecialist arbetar du tätt tillsammans med vår systemförvaltare (Product Owner Raindance) samt andra systemspecialister på IT sidan som stöttar dig i uppdraget.


Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden inkluderar:

* Systemspecialistansvar för Raindance viket innebär att konfigurera och anpassa systemets uppsättning så att det stödjer verksamhetens behov.
* Kvalitetssäkra integrationsflöden mellan Raindance och angränsande system.
* Förvalta och administrera behörigheter, register och grunddata i systemet.
* Fungera som andra linjens support till verksamheten i ekonomisystemrelaterade frågor.
* Utreda, prioritera och specificera krav och behov av vidareutveckling tillsammans med Product Owner Raindance samt dokumentera systemprocesser.
* Utveckla och kvalitetssäkra rapportverktyg och analysstöd som underlättar ekonomistyrning, uppföljning och controlling.
* Samarbeta nära redovisnings- och controllingfunktionerna för att säkerställa att Raindance levererar korrekt och tillgänglig ekonomisk information.
* Vara en viktig resurs i myndighetens boksluts- och årsredovisningsarbete genom att säkerställa att systemstödet fungerar och levererar rätt underlag.


Pensionsmyndighetens redovisning omfattar både statlig redovisning samt redovisning för försäkringsföretag avseende premiepensionsverksamheten, vilket ställer höga krav på att Raindance är rätt konfigurerat och kvalitetssäkrat för att kunna efterleva kraven i båda regelverken. Genom att tillsätta en systemspecialist inom Raindance stärker vi myndighetens förmåga att säkerställa ett stabilt och verksamhetsanpassat systemstöd, både i den löpande förvaltningen och i kommande utveckling av ekonomisystemet.  

Du ingår i ett erfaret och hjälpsamt team som arbetar nära varandra och med andra delar av organisationen. Vi samarbetar tvärfunktionellt och har en kultur som präglas av öppenhet, lärande och ansvarstagande. Du rapporterar till chefen för gruppen redovisning, betalningar och systemstöd.

### **Din profil**


Vi söker dig som har en kombination av erfarenhet av kvalificerat systemarbete inom ekonomi och ett intresse för controlling. Du trivs i gränslandet mellan system och verksamhet, där du får både analysera, strukturera och bidra till att driva arbetet framåt tillsammans med andra.


Vi söker dig som har:

* Relevant akademisk examen inom ekonomi, IT/systemvetenskap eller annan utbildning som vi bedömer som likvärdig, alternativt längre dokumenterad erfarenhet.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta som systemspecialist, systemförvaltare eller i en liknande roll med ett kvalificerat ekonomisystem.
* Vana att uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska.


Meriterande om du även har:

* Mycket god erfarenhet av och kännedom om ekonomisystemet Raindance eller Agresso.
* God förståelse för controlling.
* Erfarenhet av att delta i förändrings- eller systemförvaltningsprojekt inom ekonomiområdet.
* Goda kunskaper i Excel samt erfarenhet av rapport- och analysverktyg.
* Vana av arbete med försystem/systemstöd samt administration av behörigheter och register.


För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du:

* Har flerårig erfarenhet av kvalificerat systemarbete kopplat till ekonomi.
* Är strukturerad, noggrann och analytisk.
* Har en god helhetssyn och förmåga att omsätta verksamhetens behov till praktiskt systemstöd.
* Är kommunikativ, samarbetsinriktad och trygg i din yrkesroll, med många kontaktytor både internt och externt.
* Har ett stort intresse för både ekonomisystem och controlling och trivs i gränslandet mellan dessa områden.

### **Vi erbjuder**


Ett myndighetsuppdrag som är viktigt på riktigt! En arbetsplats där vi värnar om att våra medarbetare ska ha en god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Vi erbjuder flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet att jobba delvis hemifrån. Som statligt anställd har du även goda anställningsvillkor och ett förmånspaket med friskvård, lediga klämdagar samt goda semester- och pensionsvillkor.


Du kan läsa mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba hos oss här.

### **Bra att veta**


Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning. Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm. Resor kan förekomma i jobbet.  

Anställningen kan komma att placeras i säkerhetsklass.

### **Din ansökan**


Vi jobbar kompetensbaserat i hela processen och är måna om en inkluderande, rättvis, objektiv och kandidatvänlig process. Därför ber vi dig att besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor istället för att be om personligt brev. Vi kan komma att använda oss av arbetspsykologiska tester.


Har du skyddade personuppgifter kontakta rekryterande chef som hjälper dig med din ansökan.  

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.


Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till annonskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför ytterligare kontakt med media-/annonsförsäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.


Pensionsmyndigheten ansvarar för den allmänna pensionen och informerar om hela pensionen. Varje år betalar vi ut cirka 415 miljarder kronor till 2,3 miljoner pensionärer, genomför cirka 911 000 fondbyten och skickar ut 8 miljoner orange kuvert. Vi har ca 25 miljoner digitala kundkontakter per år. Vi är cirka1700 medarbetare på åtta orter, från Luleå i norr till Halmstad i söder.


Vi gör pensionen enklare.

title: Systemadministratör till forskningsinfrastruktur
description:
**Bygg framtidens diagnostik med oss!**
---------------------------------------


Clinical Genomics tillhandahåller, i nära samarbete med Karolinska Sjukhuset, genetiska analyser till hundratals patienter varje vecka. Vi jobbar ständigt med att förfina, expandera och effektivisera våra analyser för att kunna erbjuda förstklassig vård till fler patientgrupper.

**Om oss**
----------


Clinical Genomics är en nationell forskningsinfrastruktur vid SciLifeLab och Karolinska Institutet. Vårt team består av ca 50 medarbetare med bred kompetens inom genomik, bioinformatik, mjukvaruutveckling och IT. Vi är ett tight team där samarbete och behjälplighet är en självklarhet. Med nya teknologier och patientgrupper ställs vi ständigt inför nya meningsfulla utmaningar för att förbättra vården för fler patienter.

### **Din roll**


Du kommer tillsammans med resten av teamet drifta och vidareutveckla vår IT-infrastruktur. Arbetet omfattar drift av vårt beräkningskluster, autentiserings- och secrets management-verktyg samt våra Linux-servrar. En stor del av arbetet handlar om att modernisera och införa nya verktyg och arbetssätt i takt med att vi migrerar till nya plattformar.

*I rollen ingår att:*

* På ett spårbart och hållbart sätt administrera vår IT-infrastruktur.
* Designa och underhålla DevOps-lösningar för utvecklingsteamet.
* Konfigurera och hantera verktyg för autentisering, secrets management och CI/CD.
* Säkerställa informationssäkerheten inom vår IT-infrastruktur.
* Designa nya skalbara IT-lösningar för att lösa problem som organisationen ställs inför.
* Bidra till och underhålla tydlig dokumentation kring våra system.

### **Vem är du?**

*Krav för tjänsten*

* Examen inom datavetenskap, teknik eller relaterat område, eller motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet.
* Erfarenhet av Linux-administration.
* Erfarenhet av att automatisera systemkonfiguration samt deployment.
* Grundläggande förståelse för CI/CD-koncept.
* Flytande engelska i tal och skrift.
* Erfarenhet av HPC- eller klustermiljöer.
* Erfarenhet av Slurm.
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code-verktyg (Ansible, Terraform eller liknande).
* Erfarenhet av Keycloak.

*Meriterande*

* Erfarenhet av att bygga eller underhålla CI/CD-pipelines.
* Erfarenhet av Vault, OpenBao eller liknande verktyg för secrets management.
* Erfarenhet av övervaknings- och alarmsystem (Prometheus, Grafana eller liknande).
* Dokumentationsfärdigheter.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i ett utvecklingsteam.
* Python-utveckling.
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.
* Erfarenhet av Warewulf för OS-provisionering.

*Personliga egenskaper:*

* Nyfiken på nya lösningar och lär dig snabbt.
* Trivs med att samarbeta och hjälpa andra.
* Kan tydligt formulera och kommunicera idéer och koncept.
* Prestigelös och lösningsorienterad.


Vi kommer lägga stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

### **Vad erbjuder vi?**


En kreativ, internationell och inspirerande miljö fylld av kompetens och nyfikenhet. Karolinska Institutet är ett av världens ledande medicinska universitet. Vår vision är att driva utvecklingen av kunskap om livet och verka för en bättre hälsa för alla. Här bedriver vi framgångsrik medicinsk forskning och har det största utbudet av medicinska utbildningar i Sverige. Som universitet är Karolinska Institutet en statlig myndighet. Det gör att du får goda förmåner genom vårt kollektivavtal. Medarbetare på KI erbjuds också möjlighet till ett flexibelt arbetssätt. Det innebär att om den verksamhet du jobbar i tillåter, så kan du arbeta en del av din arbetstid på distans. Du får även träna fritt i våra moderna friskvårdsanläggningar där utbildad personal finns på plats.

**Placering:** Solna

### **Mer än bara jobb!**


Vi på Clinical Genomics är inte bara kollegor. Många medarbetare uppskattar även att umgås utanför jobbet. Vi arrangerar ofta AWs, tar löpturer tillsammans under friskvårdstimmen, och träffas regelbundet för att diskutera böcker inom bokklubben.

### **Ansökan**


KI tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning enligt våra kollektivavtal RALS och RALS-T.


Ansökan ska göras via rekryteringssystemet Varbi. I denna rekrytering söker du med ditt CV utan personligt brev. I ansökningsformuläret kommer du istället att få svara på några frågor om varför du söker jobbet.


Vid tillsvidareanställning tillämpar Karolinska Institutet 6 månaders provanställning.

title: IT-supporttekniker till Härnösands kommun
description:
Som medarbetare i Härnösands kommun är ditt främsta uppdrag att tillsammans med dina kollegor ge god service till invånare och gäster. Vår kultur ska präglas av tillit, nyfikenhet och lärande och vi vill att du ska ha ett långsiktigt hållbart arbetsliv.
  

Vi är övertygade om att vårt förhållningssätt till varandra och vårt arbete har en direkt koppling till invånarnas upplevelse av våra välfärdstjänster. Vi är också säkra på att jämlikhet och mångfald utvecklar och höjer kvaliteten på våra verksamheter.
  

Vi uppmuntrar ett livslångt lärande och ger dig möjlighet till utveckling och karriär.
  

Härnösand är en del av Höga Kusten med världsarvsnaturen ständigt närvarande. Här har vi havet mitt i staden. Stoltheten för vår plats är stor och gemenskapen stark. Skaparkraften ger innovativa företag och ett förenings- och kulturliv som lever på bredden och levererar på höjden. I Härnösand finns tid för upplevelser tillsammans.
**Om verksamheten**
  

Kommunens IT-avdelningen består av två enheter, IT-drift och support samt verksamhetsutveckling och digitalisering. Tjänsten som supporttekniker är placerad under IT-driftenheten.
  

IT-avdelningen säkerställer en effektiv, säker och ändamålsenlig IT-miljö för hela kommunen, ansvarar för drift och utveckling av den kommunala IT infrastrukturen. Vi leder kommunens digitaliseringsarbete och planerade utveckling och stödjer chefer och medarbetare i både strategiska och operativa IT-frågor. Avdelningen ger IT-relaterad support till både kommunens anställda och förtroendevalda.  

  

  



**Om tjänsten**  

Vi söker en engagerad och kundfokuserad IT-supporttekniker som vill bidra till att våra medarbetare får en stabil, säker och välfungerande IT-miljö. Som IT-supporttekniker är du en viktigt del av vårt team och fungerar som första linjens stöd till kommunens användare. Vi lägger stor vikt vid servicekänsla, hög teknisk kompetens och förmågan att skapa förtroende hos våra kunder.


**Arbetsuppgifter**  



* Ge teknisk support via telefon, fjärrstyrning och personliga besök på plats eller ute i verksamheterna.
* Felsöka och lösa incidenter inom klient-, applikations- och användarstöd.
* Ansvara för livscykelhantering av klientdatorer
* Ge användarstöd surfplattor, mobiltelefoner och andra mobila enheter.
* Installera, konfigurera och underhålla Windows-baserade arbetsplatser.
* Hantera användarkonton, behörigheter och enklare administration i Microsoft-miljöer.
* Dokumentera lösningar och ta fram användarguider och instruktioner.
* Registrera, följa upp och dokumentera ärenden i ärendehanteringssystem.
* Bidra till kontinuerlig utveckling av våra supportprocesser och vår serviceleverans.

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara lyhörd, pedagogisk och kunna anpassa din kommunikation efter mottagarens kunskapsnivå. Din kommunikativa förmåga är avgörande för att kunna vägleda och stötta våra användare på ett professionellt och förtroendeingivande sätt.
  

  

Vi fäster stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och ser det som en självklarhet att du bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat och en positiv laganda.
