title: AI Engineer
description:
****Join Telavox as an AI Engineer 🧪****
 Do you want to be the person who decides which models our AI products run on, and prove it with data? Telavox builds AI into the communication platform our customers already use: transcripts and summaries of their phone calls, AI agents that answer calls and messages, and the quality controls around them. We are looking for an AI Engineer who owns how good all of that is, across every AI product we ship.
   

  

 In this role, placed in Malmö or Stockholm, you'll measure the quality of what our models produce, build the evaluation pipelines that measure it continuously, and choose the models and prompts we run in production. You'll work in a small AI domain with two engineering teams, shaping priorities together with the product manager day to day, and your findings decide what goes live.
   

  

 If you'd like to take the next step in your career and are excited by the challenge of making AI measurably better, this is your opportunity!
   

  

**About The Job**
 Our AI products are live and growing, sold both directly and through telecom operators across Europe. Every one of them depends on models we do not train ourselves, so the choice of model, the prompts, and the quality metrics are decided by evidence from our own calls. This role owns that evidence.
   

  

 You'll work with the backend engineers who run the production services, with the team building our AI agent platform, and with customers and partners whose requirements shape what good means for them.
   

  

**Our stack:** 
 Python for evaluation and analysis, Java and Spring Boot in the production services, Google Vertex AI with Gemini alongside other model providers.
   

  

**Your Day-to-day Work May Include**
* Building and running evaluation pipelines for transcription, summarisation and conversational agents: reference sets from real calls, automated metrics, LLM-as-judge, and validation that the metrics themselves can be trusted.
* Benchmarking candidate models, hosted and open, and making the call on what runs in production, with quality as the gate and cost as the constraint.
* Designing and evaluating the prompts and structured outputs behind our products, including the summary instructions customers can define themselves.
* Evaluating models that can be deployed regionally for customers with data-residency requirements.
* Putting quality measures into production, both ours and the ones customers define themselves, and presenting what they show to engineers, product, and leadership.


**About You**
 You're a hands-on engineer who prefers evidence to opinion, and who is comfortable telling the team that the newer model is not better. You build the tooling you need rather than waiting for it; you can read a distribution and spot when a metric is measuring the wrong thing; and you explain your results so that people who did not run the experiment can act on them. You enjoy a small team where your work is visible in the product within weeks.
   

  

**Key Skills And Experience We're Looking For**
* Hands-on work evaluating LLM or machine-learning model output in a real product: building datasets, defining metrics, running benchmarks, and turning them into decisions.
* Strong Python and data-science tooling, and experience analysing data to make product and business recommendations
* Experience with prompt design and structured outputs for LLMs in production
* The ability to communicate findings clearly, in writing and in presentations
* Proficient in English, both spoken and written


**Good-to-have Skills**
* Speech and audio experience: transcription metrics such as WER and CER, diarization, forced alignment, and timestamp quality
* Java or another backend language, for integrating evaluations into production services
* Experience running open models yourself, such as deploying or evaluating self-hosted speech or language models on GPUs
* Familiarity with conversational AI or real-time voice agents
* Language proficiency in Swedish, Arabic, or other languages spoken in our main markets. Judging the quality of transcripts and agent conversations on customer calls is much easier in a language you speak


****Join us at Telavox 💚****
 Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
   

  

 Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
   

  

 We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
   

  

 Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
   

  

**How to apply!**
 At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.
   

  

 We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.
   

  

  

  

**Learn more about what we do! ⬇️**
 Telavox develops world-leading communications platforms with solutions for smart and efficient telephony, PBX, chat and much more. Regardless of whether it involves an entrepreneur-driven startup or a giant among giants, Telavox contributes to making companies more transparent, efficient and accessible.

title: Program Director
description:
LTM — a Larsen & Toubro company — is an AI-centric global technology services company and the Business Creativity partner to the world’s largest and most disruptive enterprises. We bring human insights and intelligent systems together to help clients create greater value at the intersection of technology and domain expertise. Our capabilities span integrated operations, transformation, and business AI — enabling new ways of working, new productivity paradigms, and new roads to value.
 



  





 Together with over 87,000 employees across 40 countries and our global network of partners, LTM owns business outcomes for our clients, helping them not just outperform the market, but to Outcreate it.
 



  





**Role Purpose:** 




  





 Shape the future of insurance transformation at some of the industry's most important organisations. As a
 **Program Director/Program Delivery Executive (PDE)** 
 you will lead complex, enterprise-wide customer Programmes that sit at the heart of digital and AI-driven change. Partnering with C-suite stakeholders and internal leadership, you'll drive delivery excellence, accelerate customer value, and ensure every project delivers measurable business outcomes.
 



  





 This is a unique opportunity for a seasoned software delivery leader to combine deep insurance/financial services technology expertise, commercial acumen, and AI-native ways of working to influence both customer success and long-term growth.
 



  





 You will be a senior delivery leader with deep insurance and financial services fluency, commercial discipline, and the judgement to run complex, multi-workstream Programmes at pace. Accountable for milestones delivered to agreed exit criteria, risks surfaced before they become crises, and a delivery model that shortens customer time-to-value.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 01 - Programme Delivery & Commercial Outcomes
 



  




* End-to-end delivery ownership: Leads the full Programme lifecycle from initiation through planning, execution, and closure. Accountable for delivery on time, within scope, and within budget across all workstreams – including platform implementation, integration, data migration, and business change.
* Time to Value: Owns the pace at which the customer realises measurable outcomes. Sets the time-to-value baseline at programme initiation, tracks it at every milestone, and uses delivery decisions to shorten it. Accountable for committed implementation timelines - and for turning outperformance into a commercial conversation.
* AI-led SaaS implementation velocity: Moves Programmes toward faster implementation cycles consistent with an AI-led SaaS delivery model. Understands the configuration-over-customisation discipline and applies it to keep Programmes on the standard implementation trajectory that maximises customer time-to-value.
* Commercial Outcomes – In partnership with Customer Success, owns NRR contribution of the customer portfolio. Knows the expansion levers, drives them, and reports against them.
* Growth - Identifies upsell and cross-sell potential during delivery and converts insight into pipeline opportunities.
* AI-native execution model: Operates a delivery model in which AI handles the execution layer: status tracking, risk summarisation, documentation, meeting outputs, and reporting cadences. Directs AI tools, evaluates their output, and uses them to accelerate Programme pace and free team capacity for judgement-intensive work.



  





 02 - Milestone Management & Exit Criteria
 



  




* Milestone ownership: Defines, manages, and tracks Programme milestones with precision. Each milestone has a clear definition of done, an agreed exit criteria, and formal customer acceptance before the Programme advances. This is the primary mechanism for preventing red projects.
* Exit criteria discipline: Works with the customer to agree exit criteria at the start of each phase – not at the end. Any customer request that falls outside accepted exit criteria is a natural change order, not a negotiation. The PDE holds this boundary with clarity and without conflict.
* Milestone-based billing alignment: Ensures that delivery milestones align with commercial billing triggers. Milestone acceptance by the customer is both a delivery gate and a commercial event. The PDE manages both dimensions in coordination with the Customer Success team.
* Risk and dependency management: Maintains a live Programme risk register. Identifies, assesses, and mitigates risks before they become issues. Manages interdependencies across workstreams, vendors, and internal teams. Surfaces conflicts and trade-offs early and drives resolution with pace.



  





 03 - Insurance & Financial Services Industry Fluency
 



  




* Domain depth: Builds and maintains a deep understanding of the customer's business - P&L drivers, operating model, competitive pressures, and regulatory environment. Speaks insurance fluently, or has fluency in financial services technology.
* Insurance Ontology and AutonomousInsurer thesis: Carries our internal point of view into every engagement - articulating why a shared data model across the insurance value chain creates structural advantage, and what the AI-native insurance operating model looks like. Uses both to elevate the conversation beyond current project scope.



  





 04 - Proactive Customer Relationship & Escalation Management
 



  




* Customer relationship ownership at the Programme level: Holds the customer relationship at the C-suite level on substance and trust. Is the person the customer calls when something genuinely matters.
* Proactive escalation management: Acts ahead of the problem, not in response to it. Reads signals early – customer frustration, delivery drift, scope ambiguity – and raises the difficult conversation before it becomes a crisis. Foresees escalations and prevents them through structured, proactive management.
* Partners closely with the account's Customer Success Manager — the PDE owns delivery execution, CS owns the commercial relationship and expansion. Together they own the Customer Value Journey, with a clean, documented handoff. Customer health is a shared metric.



  





 05 - Resource Orchestration & Team Leadership
 



  




* Cross-functional team orchestration: Manages delivery across blended teams: Internal employees, offshore delivery resources, SI partners, and customer-side teams. Ensures alignment, accountability, and pace across all.
* Team leadership and development: Builds capability with intention, treating team development as a commercial lever rather than an HR task. Leads the full talent lifecycle with candour and integrity.
* Leads the Programme's PM team, setting standards and driving accountability. As the account's delivery standard-setter, the PDE defines the level the team performs to.



  





**Desired Skills and Experience:** 




  




* 10–15 years of experience leading complex enterprise software Programmes, with at least 5 years in senior delivery leadership. Proven track record managing multi-workstream Programmes in insurance or financial technology environments.
* Deep insurance domain knowledge: Life & Pension, Property & Casualty, or equivalent specialty lines. Familiarity with Policy Administration Systems and the insurance technology landscape strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in milestone-based delivery governance: exit criteria design, scope control, change order management, and delivery framework design at enterprise scale.
* Experience leading global cross-functional teams including SI partners, offshore delivery resources, and customer-side teams in a matrixed environment.
* AI transformation experience: practical comfort directing AI tools across program management functions, evaluating AI-generated outputs, and operating an AI-native delivery model.
* Program financial management: budget ownership, forecasting, cost-to-serve awareness, and milestone-based billing alignment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Comfortable running steering committees, presenting to senior customer leadership, and managing difficult conversations with clarity.
* Project management certification required: PMP (Project Management Professional), PgMP (Program Management Professional), or PRINCE2 Practitioner certification.
* Preferred: experience with Scaled Agile (SAFe), hybrid delivery models, and SaaS implementation programs. Additional certifications such as SAFe Agilist, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or PMI-ACP are a plus.
* Undergraduate degree required. Relevant technical or business post-graduate qualification is a plus.



  





**What You Can Expect:** 




  




* Become a part of one of the fastest growing IT-services companies in the world
* Organization driven by team spirit and technology
* Entrepreneurial culture where you can influence and grow
* Be in charge of your own career
* Work life balance
* Market benefits

title: SAP P2P Consultant
SAP Project Manager
description:
Scania is a world-leading provider of transport solutions. Together with our partners and customers we are driving the shift towards a sustainable transport system. In 2020, we delivered 66,900 trucks, 5,200 buses as well as 11,000 industrial and marine power systems to our customers. Net sales totaled to over SEK 125 billion, of which over 20 percent were services-related. Founded in 1891, Scania now operates in more than 100 countries and employs some 55,000 people. Research and development are mainly concentrated in Sweden. Production takes place in Europe and Latin America with regional product centers in Africa, Asia and Eurasia. Scania is part of TRATON GROUP. For more information visit: www.scania.com.
   

  

**This Is Us**
 At Scania, we’re embarking on an ambitious journey, transitioning from a renowned truck manufacturer to a holistic provider of sustainable transport solutions. This transformation is both exciting and complex, filled with opportunities to innovate and challenges to overcome.
   

  

 Central to our success is the implementation of a modern, SAP S4-based system platform, which is the cornerstone of our Industrial ERP Backbone program (IEB). Through IEB, we’re crafting the future of Scania, and you could play a pivotal role in this evolution. Within IEB we are looking for talented colleagues for our project who can contribute to the success of the IEB program in the role of SAP Manufacturing Project Manager.
   

  

**SAP Project Manager**
 This role will be allocated in the global IEB program organization working within the Process & Solution area and interacting with Implementation and Support teams. You will be involved in different ongoing SAP global implementations at Scania and facilitate a bridge between our global template organization and implementation teams. You will also work with putting a scope control process in place and the establishment of global standardized End to End processes.
   

  

 This role will be active in one or multiple of the following areas.
   

  

  

* Production planning and Manufacturing
* Warehousing
* Supply Chain including Material and Transport Planning
* Order, Outbound and Export
* Sourcing and Procurement
* Finance


**Main Responsibilities**
 Be part of defining the scope for future implementations and understand the solution built during template phase. Run a team with Architects, Business process owners, and business receivers. Support the Local implementation Lead role understanding the Activate phases and roles needed to be engaged withing receiving organization. Work closely with local implementation team and the local SI counterpart within the area and support during training, test and hyper care phase.
   

  

 The roles will be organized in VI organization in IEB with the Project managers responsible for building the global template and managing the SAP scope control.
   

  

**Your profile**
 You have a university degree in engineering or equivalent and at least five years’ work experience within relevant competence areas.
   

  

 Your background can vary but ideal is that you have experience from Scania business processes in relevant area, have been part of SAP implementation program (at Scania or with other clients).
   

  

 You are open and positive team player with a positive attitude towards problem solving, visualizing easy and understandable ways of working and willing to coach and support colleagues along the journey
   

  

 The position is located at Scania’s HQ in Södertälje, Sweden, but we can also consider applicants from other Scania regions. Travel will be required in the role, sometimes for a longer period connected to key program milestones.
   

  

**More information**
 If you are interested and would like to know more, please contact Sven Coenen – IEB Manager Process & Solution (sven.coenen@scania.com ).
   

  

**Application**
 The application shall contain CV, personal letter and certificates. Please apply through our website HR Inline/Job search at Scania as soon as possible and no later than 2026-10-08.
   

  

 If you feel you have a fair share of the skills for this interesting role, please apply by submitting your CV and certificates by 2026-10-08. Please send your application as soon as possible, screening and interviews will be done continuously.
   

  

 If you possess some (not necessarily all) of the requirements mentioned, we encourage you to apply with confidence. Every application is valued, and we welcome you to join us on this exciting journey of sustainability-driven innovation. Your unique skills and experiences could be a perfect fit for our team!
   

  

 At Scania, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles! We hire for attitude and train for skills.
   

  

 A background check might be conducted for this position.
   

  

 We are looking forward to your application!

title: Engineering Manager
description:

 We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join Lendo Sweden Product & Tech. In this role you will manage two agile teams and work alongside two Engineering Manager peers in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Engineering Manager, you lead two cross-functional agile teams and serve as line manager for the team members. You stay close to the daily operations without being hands-on with code. You understand technical context, keep track of sprint progress and step in to help your teams navigate blockers, balance priorities and refine their delivery flow.
   

  

 You combine empathetic leadership with clear performance guidance. Whether it is coaching engineers to adopt modern tech, supporting individuals through structured growth or actively addressing performance gaps, you ensure every team member thrives.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**People, Growth & Culture**
* Build, recruit and onboard high-performing teams aligned with business needs
* Provide direction, coaching and regular feedback through continuous 1:1s, development talks and career progression planning
* Cultivate a safe, inclusive team culture with high psychological safety where innovation and well-being go hand in hand
* Manage career levels, seniority adjustments and compensation reviews in line with company frameworks
* Support individuals through empathetic performance management, helping everyone reach their full potential
* Responsible for ensuring change management takes place within your teams, given that we live and operate in a changing world


**Operational Leadership & Technical Context**
* Maintain strong operational oversight of your teams, keeping track of sprint status, deadlines and delivery commitments
* Challenge engineers to explore modern tools, leverage technologies like AI/ML and look beyond their immediate scope to collaborate across departments
* Translate complex business objectives into tech priorities, providing transparency around the "why" behind decisions
* Act as an operational bridge between teams, stakeholders and departments to resolve friction and keep work moving seamlessly
* Facilitate agile ceremonies and workshops when needed, continuously improving ways of working


**Delivery, Risk & System Health**
* Partner closely with Product Owners to define team goals, align KPIs and secure steady delivery
* Oversee the post-incident lifecycle, follow-ups, vulnerability management and compliance alignment
* Ensure monitoring, alerting and sustainable on-call rotations are built natively into the development lifecycle
* Collaborate with fellow Engineering Managers to share knowledge, align practices and drive overall engineering efficiency
* Represent Tech in local Sweden leadership forums and coordinate office hub arrangements when needed


****Who You Are****
* Experienced Leader: You have at least 4 years of direct people management experience in tech organisations, with a track record of building and growing software engineering teams.
* Solid Tech Background: You bring at least 10 years of total experience within the tech industry. You do not need to write code daily, but you comfortably understand technical architecture, development processes and sprint dynamics.
* Operational & Present: You stay close to your teams' daily reality, understand sprint flows and know how to support both high performers and individuals needing guidance.
* Empathetic & Direct: You create psychological safety while maintaining clear expectations, open feedback loops and strong accountability.
* Bridge Builder: You communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders, translating business goals into meaningful context for your engineers.


**About The Recruitment Process**
 We perform a mandatory background check on all final candidates. We will always inform you as a candidate before the check is carried out.
   

  

**We look forward to your application!**

 and

 environments is considered highly beneficial.
   

  

**Start Date:**

* Strong self-leadership and ability to work independently.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions.
* Experience with IFS Cloud.
* Background from large enterprise environments.
* Experience working closely with business-critical operational systems.

title: System Test Team Lead
description:
At ASSA ABLOY you will lead the system and functional testing of ARX, a Scandinavian security system combining software and hardware in environments where quality, reliability, and performance are critical.
   

  

 If you enjoy combining test leadership with hands-on system testing, improving automation, and working closely with developers and technical stakeholders — this role will likely resonate.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 For a security system, every part of the solution needs to work together reliably. As
 **System Test Team Lead** 
 , you’ll help ensure new features and system behaviour meet the standards expected by customers, while contributing to the quality of a solution that connects software with real-world security hardware.
   

  

**The role**
 This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll lead an experienced team while staying close to the technology yourself. You’ll set priorities, support and develop the team, and spend part of your time running system and functional tests across the ARX solution.
   

  

 You’ll also influence how testing evolves, working closely with developers and other stakeholders to improve QA practices, automation and ways of working.
   

  

**What You’ll Work On**
* Lead and mentor a team of testers, planning and distributing testing activities
* Plan, prioritise and execute system and functional testing for new features and system behaviour
* Run manual and automated tests across software and hardware-based test environments, system that consists of a Client/Server, Distributed Control Units, Readers, and Motor-locks
* Improve test automation, processes and methodologies using Python, Selenium and Robot Framework
* Troubleshoot issues and defects, working closely with developers and other stakeholders
* Perform functional, performance, stress and reliability testing across the complete system


**What Will Help You Succeed**
* Proven experience leading a test team, combined with solid experience in system and software testing
* Hands-on experience with manual and automated testing, ideally with Python, Selenium and Robot Framework
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with your team, developers and other stakeholders
* A structured, analytical and proactive approach, with the curiosity to learn a complex product and the initiative to improve how things are done
* Fluent English and the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders


**Nice to have:** 
 Experience with hardware-based test environments, Java, Embedded C, access control or security products, experience using AI tools to support test development and automation, and Swedish language skills.
   

  

**Why ASSA ABLOY**
 Take ownership of an experienced test team while staying technically involved in a complex security product and having the freedom to influence how testing evolves.
   

  

* Meaningful mission — Contribute to security technology that needs to perform reliably in real-world access environments
* Innovation & scale — Work across software, hardware and automation within a global access solutions business
* Autonomy & trust — Shape priorities, ways of working and continuous improvement within your area of responsibility
* Growth & development — Expand your expertise across system testing, automation and technical leadership
* Work–life balance — Combine hybrid working with regular access to the Stockholm lab in a collaborative Scandinavian work culture


**Ready to lead system testing where quality really matters?**
 If you’re an experienced test leader who wants to combine people leadership with hands-on system testing, automation and technical problem-solving, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and take the lead in strengthening the quality of ARX.
   

  

 We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner.
   

  

 Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening may need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.
   

  

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
 Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
   

  

 As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
   

  

 As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Konsult inom Defense
description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**
 AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.
   

  

 Nu gör vi en satsning och har bildat försvarssegmentet Defense inom AFRY för att fokusera på strategisk resiliens och säkerhet i Norden. För mer info läs: AFRY stärker sin förmåga att stötta försvarssektorn med nytt segment | AFRY. Var med på vår expansionsresa för ett starkare totalförsvar.
   

  

**Jobbeskrivning**
 Som konsult inom Defense hos AFRY blir du en del av projekt som gör skillnad – för både samhälle och säkerhet. Här får du en dynamisk vardag, där din kompetens värdesätts och din utveckling står i fokus.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som vill jobba inom ett eller flera kompetensområden:**
* Försvarsteknik (markarenan, marina system, flyg och ledningssystem)
* Systems Engineering (systemarbete och ett helhetsperspektiv i att arbeta med tekniska system under hela eller delar av dess livscykel)
* ILS - Integrerad logistiksupport
* Försvarslogistik och teknisk tjänst
* Systemsäkerhet och funktionssäkerhet
* IT-säkerhet och informationssäkerhet


 Du kan antingen verka som teknisk specialist, generalist eller projektledare inom något av ovan beskrivna kompetensområden.
   

  

 Du motiveras av och vill bidra till att skapa ett mer robust och säkert samhälle.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig med engagemang och drivet att lyckas! Erfarenhet som konsult är meriterande, men din inställning är avgörande. För att lyckas som konsult hos oss behöver du ha god initiativförmåga, samarbetsförmåga och vara bra på att kommunicera och ta ansvar för de utmaningar du ställs inför.
   

  

 Vi vill att du har lägst en högskoleingenjörsutbildning samt
 **minst flera års yrkeserfarenhet** 
 från en tekniknära roll från försvar eller försvarsnära områden. Du har också längre arbetslivserfarenhet av att jobba med systemens livscykelprocess, inkluderat erfarenhet av kravhantering, kravverifiering och ILS. Då merparten av våra kunder är svensk försvarsindustri och myndigheter bör du kunna uttrycka dig väl både på svenska och engelska.
   

  

 Beroende på uppdrag så utförs arbetet antingen från kontoret eller hos kund. Tjänsteresor kan förekomma.
   

  

 Placeringsorter: Stockholm/Solna, Enköping, Uppsala, Skövde, Karlskoga, Malmö och Örnsköldsvik
   

  

**Säkerhetsprövning & Utbildningsverifiering**
 Våra uppdrag är varierande och många finns inom säkerhetsklassade områden, vilket innebär att du kan behöva genomgå en säkerhetsprövning innan du börjar hos oss. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav. För samtliga rekryteringar på AFRY genomförs som grund alltid en ID-kontroll, referenstagning samt verifiering av utbildning innan anställning.
   

  

**Ytterligare information**
 På AFRY erbjuder vi en modern arbetsplats med globalt perspektiv, kollektivavtal och en rad personalförmåner. Vår personalklubb Club AFRY organiserar sociala aktiviteter för att stärka gemenskapen.
   

  

 Vi är övertygade om att mångfald stärker oss och strävar efter att skapa en kreativ och framgångsrik arbetsplats. Vi satsar på våra medarbetares utveckling med individuella utvecklingsplaner och möjlighet att ta kurser och certifieringar.
   

  

 Vi tror på balans mellan arbets- och privatliv och strävar efter att skapa en hälsosam arbetsmiljö. Det är kanske därför vi rankas som en av Sveriges mest populära arbetsgivare.
   

  

 Läs mer om vårt försvarsområde här: https://afry.com/sv/erbjudande/forsvar
   

  

**Vi ser fram emot din ansökan, inkluderat CV och några ord om dig själv samt vilket eller vilka områden du är mest intresserad av att arbeta inom. Du söker via länken nedan, då vi inte tar emot ansökningar via e-post.**
**Sista ansökningsdag 30 september 2026.** 
 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Under sommarperioden sker fördröjning pga semestertider.
   

  

 Kontaktuppgifter för frågor:
   

  

 Stefan Oscarsson, Market Area Manager, stefan.oscarsson@afry.com
   

  

 Ellinor Danielsson, Talent Acquisition Partner, ellinor.danielsson@afry.com
   

  

*Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.*
*På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen*

title: Android Developer
description:
**Are you passionate about creating a great gaming experience and developing a scalable product? Come help us build the best geography game! You will be a part of a team with huge impact, shaping the experience for our amazing 100 million players.** 




  





 At GeoGuessr, we’ve been doing more than just making a game - we’ve created an experience that turns the world into a playground for the curious and knowledge-hungry, letting everyone explore in a fun and engaging way. During the last couple of years we have focused on building an incredible team, now just over 80 people, and craft new ways for our dedicated players to experience our fantastic geography games. GeoGuessr is widely played all around the world and have a large and dedicated community.
 



  





**The role** 




 We’re looking for an Android Developer to join our tech team. As part of a collaborative group of developers, you’ll be responsible for writing clean, high-quality code and working on new features and experiments to support the growth and development of our platform.
 



 Together, we develop a fantastic gaming experience in a fast-moving environment where you and your team have overall responsibility for the delivery.
 



 You understand the value of delivering weekly improvements and new features to our millions of players. With your technical skills and player-first mindset, you’ll strike the perfect balance between crafting features people love and maintaining a top-tier product.
 



  





 Why not check out the app yourself?!
 



  





**What we hope you’ll bring:** 



* Minimum 3 years experience building high fidelity custom Kotlin components
* Implementing custom animations
* Comfort and familiarity with REST and Websockets
* A university degree in computer science or equivalent experience



**It's a bonus if you have experience in:** 



* Design and UX

* Game development (on any platform)

 We're offering a package of perks to keep you charged up and ready to create wonders:

* Pension and insurance as per ITP1 guidelines.
* 50,000 SEK education benefit.
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance.

 We encourage exercise during working hours. We provide a large selection of snacks and drinks for recovery. A home to simply enjoy.
 



  





 This role is based in Stockholm where we have invested in creating our unique home at Katarinavägen 17, in the glass house by Slussen.

title: Delansvarig IT Förvaltningsmodell (PM3)
description:
Techster Solutions söker nu för kunds räkning en erfaren
 **Verksamhetsutvecklare inom IT** 
 med stark kompetens inom
 **PM3** 
 och förvaltningsstyrning. Kunden är en samhällsviktig statlig myndighet med ansvar för Sveriges elöverföringssystem och energinät.
   

  

**Om uppdraget**
 Som Delansvarig IT Förvaltningsmodell kommer du att ingå i enheten för IT Leveransstyrning. Enhetens uppdrag är att förvalta och vidareutveckla IT-divisionens operativa modell baserad på PM3, i syfte att skapa mervärde som utgår från verksamhetens strategier och mål.
   

  

 I rollen samverkar du med kollegor på enheten för att säkerställa att förvaltningsstyrningsmodellen är ändamålsenlig och att förvaltningsorganisationen får rätt stöd. Eftersom förvaltningsstyrningen har starka beroenden till portfölj-, projekt- och produktionsmodeller arbetar du i nära dialog med hela organisationen.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:**
* Driva och facilitera forum inom IT-styrning (t.ex. operativ IT-ledningsgrupp och förvaltningsledarforum).
* Bereda placeringsbeslut tillsammans med projekt och förvaltning, hålla förvaltningsobjektarkitekturen (FOA) aktuell samt ta fram beslutsunderlag vid förändringar.
* Introducera, utbilda och stötta objektägare och förvaltningsledare inom både IT och verksamheten.
* Driva kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete och effektivisering av förvaltningsstyrningsmodellen.
* Stötta IT-ledningen i diverse förvaltningsstyrningsfrågor, däribland ekonomisk uppföljning.


**Kvalifikationskrav (Obligatoriska)**
 För att vara aktuell för uppdraget behöver du uppfylla följande krav (Kompetensnivå 3, 5–9 års erfarenhet):
   

  

* Utbildning: Högskole- eller universitetsutbildning (minst 120/180 hp).
* PM3: Minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom PM3 förvaltningsstyrning.
* Införande & Styrformer: Minst 3 års erfarenhet av att driva införande av IT-processer och styrformer för förvaltning (t.ex. PM3 eller ITSM).
* Beslutsunderlag: Påvisad erfarenhet av att ta fram dokumentation och beslutsunderlag kopplat till förvaltningsstyrning.
* Facilitering: Erfarenhet av att facilitera och leda forum inom IT-styrning (t.ex. operativa ledningsgrupper eller förvaltningsledarforum).
* Språk: Flytande svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.


**Meriterande erfarenheter (Mervärdeskrav)**
 Vi ser det som starkt meriterande om du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet från arbete i både offentlig och privat verksamhet.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i stora organisationer (minst 500 anställda).
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att hålla i utbildningar (lärarledda kurser eller interna utbildningsinsatser).
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet i leveransroller såsom Service Manager, Application Manager, Utvecklingsledare eller motsvarande.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av förbättringsarbete kopplat till styrmodeller inom IT.


**Personliga egenskaper**
 Vi söker dig som är utåtriktad, tydlig i din kommunikation och har lätt för att skapa förtroende i organisationen. Du har stark initiativförmåga, arbetar målinriktat och trivs lika bra med självständigt arbete som i grupp. Rollen ställer även krav på god struktur och fallenhet för administrativa uppgifter.
   

  

**Säkerhetsprövning**
 Då kunden bedriver säkerhetskänslig verksamhet krävs godkänd säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll innan uppdragsstart. Processen beräknas ta cirka 8–10 veckor.
   

  

**Ansökan & Kontakt**
 Låter uppdraget intressant? Skicka in ditt CV och en kort beskrivning av hur du matchar kraven till oss på Techster Solutions så snart som möjligt.
   

  

*Vid ansökan är det viktigt att dina erfarenheter kopplade till de obligatoriska kraven tydligt framgår i ditt CV.*

title: Asset Manager Core Networks
description:
Tre spelar en samhällsviktig roll i att hålla människor, företag och samhällsfunktioner uppkopplade varje dag. I Core Networks ansvarar vi för hjärtat i mobilnätet, den del av infrastrukturen som säkerställer att våra kunder kan ringa, skicka meddelanden och surfa.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en
 **Asset Manager Core Networks** 
 som vill vara med och utveckla arbetet med asset management, riskhantering och regulatorisk efterlevnad inom Core Networks.
   

  

 Rollen passar dig som gillar att skapa struktur, driva förbättringar och omsätta krav till arbetssätt som fungerar i praktiken. Du kommer att arbeta nära både verksamheten och flera centrala funktioner inom Tre.
   

  

**Det här kommer du att göra**
 Kraven på säkerhet, dokumentation och efterlevnad blir allt högre. Samtidigt behöver arbetet fungera i vardagen för de chefer och specialister som ansvarar för våra system och plattformar.
   

  

 I den här rollen hjälper du verksamheten att omsätta regulatoriska krav till konkreta aktiviteter och arbetssätt som fungerar i praktiken. Du skapar struktur, följer upp aktiviteter och bidrar till att Core Networks arbetar effektivt, strukturerat och hållbart över tid.
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta genom andra och skapa förutsättningar för att organisationen ska lyckas, snarare än att själv ta över ansvaret för leveranserna.
   

  

 Du rapporterar till Head of Core Networks och ingår i Core Networks Leadership Team. Du arbetar nära chefer och specialister inom Core Networks samt samarbetar med funktioner som Security, Legal, Enterprise Architecture och Strategy & Governance.
   

  

**Bland Annat Kommer Du Att**
* Ansvara för struktur, styrning och utveckling inom asset management
* Säkerställa att Core Networks har en korrekt och aktuell inventering av sina tillgångar
* Omsätta regulatoriska krav till konkreta aktiviteter och arbetssätt
* Driva initiativ kopplade till NIS2, ISO27001 och andra relevanta kravområden
* Stötta verksamheten inom riskhantering, dokumentation och kontinuitetsplanering
* Projektleda och samordna förbättringsinitiativ inom governance och compliance
* Bidra till utvecklingen av processer inom exempelvis access management
* Säkerställa att Core Networks behov tas tillvara i gemensamma processer och verktyg
* Utforska hur AI och andra digitala verktyg kan användas för att förenkla och effektivisera arbetssätt


**Några viktiga fokusområden under det första året:**
* Vidareutveckla arbetet kring NIS2 och ISO27001
* Utveckla arbetssätt inom asset management
* Säkerställa effektiva processer för riskhantering och efterlevnad
* Stötta verksamheten i att möta regulatoriska krav i Sverige och Danmark


**Du Kan Se Fram Emot Att**
* Vara en del av Core Networks Leadership Team
* Arbeta nära ledare och specialister inom en verksamhet som ansvarar för samhällskritisk infrastruktur
* Driva och samordna viktiga initiativ inom governance, riskhantering och compliance
* Samarbeta med många olika delar av organisationen
* Få stort eget ansvar och goda möjligheter att påverka hur arbetet bedrivs
* Vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work


**Magnus beskriver sitt ledarskap**
 "Jag ger gärna stort ansvar till mina medarbetare och uppskattar personer som tar initiativ och driver sina områden framåt. Samtidigt vill jag vara en chef som finns nära till hands när det behövs stöd eller vägledning. Hos oss blir du en viktig del av ledningsgruppen och får stor möjlighet att påverka hur vi arbetar framåt."
   

  

 ,
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Du är en självgående person som trivs i komplexa miljöer där många olika krav och intressen behöver vägas samman.
   

  

 Du är strukturerad, har god samarbetsförmåga och tycker om att driva frågor från idé till genomförande. Du är bra på att skapa förtroende och kan få människor att samlas kring gemensamma arbetssätt och mål.
   

  

**Vi Tror Att Du Har**
* Arbetat inom telekom eller annan reglerad verksamhet med samhällskritisk infrastruktur
* God förståelse för områden som asset management, governance, riskhantering eller compliance
* Vana att driva förändringsarbete, projekt eller verksamhetsutveckling i komplexa organisationer
* Förmåga att omsätta krav och regelverk till praktiska arbetssätt som fungerar i verksamheten
* Lätt för att bygga förtroende och skapa resultat tillsammans med olika intressenter
* Relevant högskole-, universitets- eller YH-utbildning
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska


**Det Är Meriterande Om Du Har**
* Arbetat med NIS2, ISO27001 eller liknande regulatoriska ramverk
* Kunskap inom revision, riskhantering eller efterlevnadsfrågor
* Bidragit till utveckling av processer, styrning eller kvalitetsarbete
* Erfarenhet från infrastruktur- eller teknikintensiva verksamheter
* Intresse för eller praktisk användning av AI och digitala verktyg i förbättringsarbete


**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Vi tar emot ansökningar via denna annons och håller intervjuer löpande. Personligt brev behövs inte, men vi vill gärna att du bifogar ditt CV och besvarar frågorna i ansökan.
   

  

 Vi använder tester för att säkerställa objektiva bedömningar i urvalet. Säkerhetsprövning och bakgrundskontroll kommer att genomföras på slutkandidat. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

title: IRIS² Security Officer – EU Communication Gateway (COMM GW Lot)
description:
**Description**
 This role is critical to safeguarding programme delivery, ensuring that security risks are identified, assessed, controlled, and resolved before they impact system integrity, availability, compliance, or operational acceptance.
   

  

 In this role, you will act as the security authority for SSC’s COMM GW lot within IRIS², leading and coordinating end-to-end security and resilience management across a complex, multi-partner ground segment environment.
   

  

 You will ensure that security requirements, controls, and risk management activities are consistently implemented across engineering, operations, suppliers, and programme delivery.
   

  

 You will operate within established programme governance, ensuring that security risks, incidents, and compliance gaps are properly escalated and addressed. You will also ensure alignment with contractual requirements, regulatory frameworks, and SSC Space internal security and resilience governance.
   

  

 You will balance delivery objectives with security and compliance requirements in a highly regulated environment, ensuring effective coordination without compromising programme integrity.
   

  

 You will work closely with programme leadership, engineering, operations, and customer stakeholders, acting as the focal point for security-related coordination and reporting.
   

  

**This Role Is For You If You**
* Have experience managing security and resilience in complex technical or infrastructure programmes
* Are comfortable working across cybersecurity, physical security, and information security domains
* Can coordinate structured risk management, compliance, and assurance activities
* Are confident managing stakeholders and escalating security issues where needed
* Thrive in regulated environments with strong requirements on evidence and traceability


**Requirements**
* Minimum 7 years of experience in security and resilience management
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, information security, physical and/or personnel security
* Experience with contractual security requirements, audits, accreditation, and customer-facing governance
* Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, and suppliers
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, reporting, and escalation skills
* Structured approach to security management, compliance tracking, and documentation


**Highly Valuable**
* Experience in satellite communications, ground segment, or secure infrastructure environments
* Experience working with EU institutional programmes or ESA-related activities
* Familiarity with accreditation processes or regulated environments
* Experience overseeing supplier and subcontractor security compliance


**Responsibilities**
* Analyse, assess, implement, and continuously improve the security and resilience posture across the COMM GW lot
* Coordinate security risk management, including threat identification, mitigation planning, prioritisation, and residual risk reporting
* Lead security governance activities, including analysis, reporting, and decision support
* Ensure incident and crisis reporting, including notification and escalation
* Manage, track, and escalate security incidents, vulnerabilities, and non-conformities
* Coordinate integration of security across design, implementation, verification, deployment, and operations
* Oversee supplier and subcontractor security compliance within the COMM GW lot
* Support audits, assessments, accreditation activities, and customer security reviews
* Maintain security deliverables, evidence, and traceability required by the programme


**What success looks like**
* Security risks clearly identified, tracked, and mitigated across the programme
* Consistent implementation of security requirements across engineering, operations, and suppliers
* Effective visibility and control over security incidents, vulnerabilities, and compliance status
* Strong coordination across teams, leading to reduced security-related delivery risks
* Successful audits, accreditation activities, and customer reviews with minimal findings


**Benefits**
 Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.
   

  

 With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.
   

  

 SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.
   

  

 Are you driven by security, resilience, and protecting mission-critical systems?Are you ready to take a defining role in safeguarding one of Europe’s most ambitious space infrastructure programmes?
   

  

 If you answer yes, we invite you to make a significant impact as IRIS² Security Officer. We are looking for someone who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.

title: First Line Supporttekniker
description:
**Om oss** 




 Winassist är en ledande leverantör av affärssystem för fordonsbranschen. Vi gör vardagen enklare för våra kunder och stärker deras konkurrenskraft med en produkt vi är stolta över. Vi är cirka 50 medarbetare med högt i tak, stark laganda och en kultur där eget ansvar och samarbete är centralt.
 



 Vi befinner oss i en spännande utvecklingsresa där vi moderniserar vår produkt och fortsätter vår satsning mot molnet. Samtidigt vill vi stärka våra kundrelationer och skapa fler affärsmöjligheter.
 



 Därför söker vi nu en Customer Success-medarbetare som vill kombinera service, problemlösning och kundutveckling.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Som First Line Supporttekniker är du ofta den första personen våra kunder kommer i kontakt med när de behöver hjälp. Men rollen handlar om mer än att svara på frågor och lösa problem.
 



 Du hjälper våra kunder att arbeta smartare genom att förstå deras behov, guida dem i systemet och rekommendera funktioner, arbetssätt och moduler som kan effektivisera deras verksamhet och skapa större affärsvärde. Rollen är därför en viktig del av vårt Customer Success-arbete.
 



 Genom dina kunddialoger hjälper du våra kunder att få ut mer av Winassist, bygga långsiktiga relationer och identifiera möjligheter att utveckla sin verksamhet med hjälp av våra lösningar.
 



  





**Du kommer bland annat att:** 



* Ge support och vägledning via telefon, mejl och supportsystem.
* Felsöka och lösa kundernas frågor kring Winassist.
* Coacha kunder i hur de kan använda systemet på ett mer effektivt sätt.
* Hålla enklare utbildningar och genomgångar.
* Identifiera behov hos kunder och rekommendera relevanta funktioner, moduler och tjänster.
* Fånga upp affärs- och merförsäljningsmöjligheter och samarbeta med Customer Success och Sales.
* Dokumentera och följa upp kundärenden.
* Vara kundens röst internt och bidra med förbättringsförslag till produkt- och utvecklingsteamet.



  





**Vi söker dig som** 




 Gillar kombinationen av kundkontakt, problemlösning och affärsutveckling. Du tycker om att hjälpa människor, är nyfiken på hur verksamheter fungerar och har lätt för att se hur teknik kan lösa kundens utmaningar.
 



 Du behöver inte kunna allt från dag ett, men du behöver ha ett starkt kundfokus och en vilja att förstå kundens verksamhet.
 



  





**Vi tror att du har** 



* Erfarenhet av kundservice, support eller Customer Success.
* God dator- och systemvana.
* Förmåga att förklara komplex information på ett enkelt sätt.
* Förmåga att upptäcka kundbehov och skapa värde genom rådgivning.
* Intresse för verksamhetsprocesser och affärssystem.



**Det är meriterande med** 




 Erfarenhet från SaaS-bolag eller affärssystem
 



 Erfarenhet av ekonomi, fakturering, bokföring eller administrativa processer
 



  





**För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är** 




**Serviceminded:** 
 Du drivs av att hjälpa kunder och strävar alltid efter att ge en professionell och positiv kundupplevelse.
 



**Nyfiken:** 
 Du vill förstå kundens verksamhet, ställer frågor och ser möjligheter att skapa ännu större värde för kunden.
 



**Kommunikativ:** 
 Du har lätt för att skapa förtroende och kan förklara både tekniska och verksamhetsrelaterade frågor på ett enkelt och pedagogiskt sätt.
 



**Lösningsorienterad** 
 : Du trivs med att analysera utmaningar, hitta vägar framåt och hjälpa kunden att komma vidare.
 



**Affärsmässig:** 
 Du förstår sambandet mellan kundens behov och våra lösningar, och ser möjligheter att utveckla kundens verksamhet genom Winassists produkter och moduler.
 



 En lagspelare: Du samarbetar gärna med kollegor, delar med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till att teamet når gemensamma mål.
 



  





**Varför Winassist?** 




 Hos Winassist får du arbeta nära våra kunder och se den direkta effekten av ditt arbete varje dag. Du blir en del av en familjär organisation med korta beslutsvägar, högt engagemang, hög arbetsglädje och stark laganda.
 



  





 Du får dessutom:
 



 Hybridarbete med två kontorsdagar per vecka.
 



 Konkurrenskraftig tjänstepension.
 



 Friskvårdsbidrag
 



 Friskvårdstimme (kostnadsfritt gym i byggnaden)
 



 Möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med ett växande bolag.
 



  





 Rollen är baserad i Häggvik norr om Stockholm, med möjlighet till hybridarbete. För mer information om hur det är att arbeta hos oss och våra förmåner, se https://winassist.se/karriar/
 



  





 Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Ansökan är öppen till och med 1 november.

title: Senior Solution Sales Executive – Stockholm
description:
Devoteam is a leading cloud and technology consulting partner, empowering businesses to harness the full potential of modern cloud technologies and digital solutions.
   

  

 With 20+ years of successful cloud implementations and a team of certified experts, we drive digital transformation across various industries. We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, providing you with the tools and support you need to excel in your career.
   

  

 At Devoteam, we champion a revolutionary "New Way of Work" that prioritizes flexibility, personal growth, and joint success.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Accelerate Your Career: Solution Sales Executive – Cloud & Technology**
 Are you a seasoned sales professional with a strong track record in IT consulting, technology solutions, and cloud services? Do you have an established network within the cloud ecosystem and experience working with hyperscalers such as Microsoft and/or AWS?
   

  

 Devoteam is seeking a highly motivated Solution Sales Executive to join our expanding cloud and technology practice. In this role, you will drive new business acquisition and revenue growth by selling consulting services, cloud solutions, software and technology products, with a strong focus on professional services and value-added solutions.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Develop and execute a strategic sales plan: Target key accounts, identify opportunities, build a strong pipeline, and achieve ambitious sales and revenue targets.
* Drive solution and license sales: Identify opportunities to sell technology products, software licenses, subscriptions and cloud solutions alongside professional services, creating comprehensive solutions that deliver business value to our clients.
* Leverage your cloud ecosystem network: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across the cloud ecosystem, particularly within Microsoft and/or AWS. Existing relationships with sales representatives, account executives, partner managers and other key ecosystem stakeholders are highly valued.
* Understand partner programs and funding: Stay informed about relevant Microsoft and AWS products, partner programs, incentives and funding opportunities, and understand how these can be leveraged to create value for customers and support successful sales engagements.
* Become a Trusted Advisor: Conduct in-depth needs assessments, understand client challenges, and position Devoteam as a strategic technology partner.
* Deliver Winning Presentations: Craft and deliver compelling sales presentations that clearly communicate the business value of our cloud, technology and consulting offerings.
* Collaborate with Experts: Work closely with technical consultants, architects and delivery teams to design tailored solutions that address client requirements and create successful outcomes.
* Negotiate and Close Deals: Lead complex negotiations and secure favorable commercial terms while maximizing revenue, profitability and long-term customer value.
* Stay Ahead of the Curve: Maintain a strong understanding of evolving cloud technologies, software licensing models, hyperscaler offerings and market trends.


**Qualifications**
* Proven Sales Success: A demonstrable track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets within IT consulting, technology services, software or cloud.
* Cloud & Technology Expertise: Strong understanding of cloud computing and modern technology solutions, with experience in one or more major cloud ecosystems.
* License & Software Sales: Experience selling software licenses, subscriptions, cloud consumption or other technology products is highly desirable.
* Hyperscaler Network: An established network within Microsoft and/or AWS is a strong advantage. We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience working with sales, account management, and partner management stakeholders within these ecosystems.
* Partner Programs & Funding: Understanding of Microsoft and/or AWS partner programs, products, incentives and funding mechanisms, and the ability to identify opportunities to use these to support customer engagements.
* Enterprise Focus: Experience selling to enterprise clients, with the ability to navigate complex sales cycles and build relationships with key decision-makers.
* Communication & Presentation Excellence: Exceptional communication, presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and commercial concepts clearly.
* Negotiation & Closing Prowess: Strong negotiation and closing skills, with a proven ability to secure favorable deals.
* Team Player: Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in business, technology or a related field.


**Additional Information**
 Devoteam is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We encourage applications from individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive compensation package with an uncapped commission structure, rewarding your hard work and success.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Benefit from comprehensive health insurance, a retirement plan and generous paid time off.
* Growth Opportunities: Take advantage of excellent opportunities for professional development and career advancement within our growing cloud and technology practice.
* Cutting-Edge Technology: Work with the latest cloud and technology solutions and contribute to impactful projects that transform businesses.
* Dynamic Culture: Be part of a dynamic, supportive and collaborative team culture that values innovation and personal growth.
* Flexible Work Arrangements: Enjoy flexible work arrangements that allow you to balance your professional and personal life.


 We do plenty of activities, including meet-ups, hackathons and partnerships.
   

  

 Please submit your resume and cover letter. We are excited to hear from you!

title: Product Owner - Core Automation

Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.*
*As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.*
**About The Job**
 The Incubator within Alfa Laval’s Core Automation organization explores new platforms, technologies and development initiatives that shape the future of Alfa Laval’s control systems offering. As Product Owner, you will turn the technology roadmap into coordinated, meaningful deliveries, from early research into new toolkits, platforms and technologies to development initiatives that will serve as the foundation for next-generation control system applications.
   

  

 Working at the intersection of the Technology Manager, stakeholders and development teams, you will create clarity, align priorities and help the team move forward without unnecessary obstacles. You will translate complex needs into well-defined work items, guide initiatives across the OT platform portfolio and ensure that users, customers and their everyday challenges remain central throughout the design and development process.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver initiatives supporting the direction in the technology roadmap for the initiatives’ relevant stakeholders.
* Refine work items and translate stakeholder needs into clear user stories and backlog items.
* Maintain and prioritize the development backlog in line with agreed commitments for development, rollouts and support.
* Align stakeholders and product groups across the OT platform portfolio.
* Prepare teams for incremental deliveries by clarifying scope, setting objectives and supporting demos.
* Bring contributors together, facilitate alignment and create momentum across initiatives.
* Collaborate with the Agile Team Coach and Focus Manager to improve team performance and share effective ways of working.
* Drive product, technology and platform evaluation initiatives.


**Who Are You**
 You are passionate about turning complex needs into contemporary solutions that provide an excellent user experience. You create clarity by listening carefully, structuring information and communicating in a way that helps stakeholders and technical teams understand one another. You are comfortable orchestrating several perspectives, aligning people around priorities and keeping initiatives moving without imposing unnecessary processes. With strong business acumen, analytical thinking and a customer-centric mindset, you are also able to build trusted relationships across teams, departments and organizations.
   

  

**What You Know**
 To succeed in this role, you combine practical Agile experience with an understanding of product management and complex operational technology environments.
   

  

* 2–4 years of experience as a Product Owner or Scrum Master.
* Solid understanding of product management and complex OT solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
* Experience working with product roadmaps, backlog prioritization and user stories.
* Experience aligning stakeholders and development teams around shared objectives.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, data science or equivalent experience.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* Knowledge of control systems, embedded software or electrical design deliveries is appreciated but not required.


**What’s in It for You?**
 You will join a highly motivated team working with the latest OT technologies while developing solutions that have not been built before. This is an opportunity to influence Alfa Laval’s future automation offering, work across technology and product domains, and help transform early ideas and research initiatives into solutions that create value for our customers and users.

title: IRIS² Engineering Manager – EU Communication Gateway (Ground Segment)
description:
**Description**
 This role is critical to ensuring that the system is technically coherent, verifiable, and ready for acceptance in a high-complexity, multi-partner delivery environment.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the full engineering delivery for SSC’s contribution to IRIS² as prime contractor. You will act as the overall technical authority, owning the engineering baseline and ensuring the integrated system is coherent, compliant, secure, and deliverable across a multi-disciplinary ground segment.
   

  

 You operate with end-to-end engineering authority within programme governance, driving and owning technical decision-making, trade-offs, and cross-discipline alignment across the programme. You will resolve conflicts, steer technical direction, and ensure delivery readiness at every major milestone.
   

  

 You will operate at programme leadership level, engaging senior stakeholders across SSC, partners, and customer organisations.
   

  

**This Role Is For You If You**
* Have led large, multi-disciplinary engineering delivery in complex system environments
* Thrive in integrating multiple engineering domains into a coherent solution
* Are comfortable making and owning high-impact technical decisions
* Bring experience from ESA, ECSS, or similarly governed environments
* Can lead teams and suppliers under demanding timelines and technical complexity


**Requirements**
* Proven experience leading engineering delivery within complex space, defence, telecommunications, or infrastructure programmes
* Strong systems engineering background including architecture, requirements, interfaces, and verification
* Experience working in prime contractor or system integrator environments
* Strong knowledge of ECSS engineering processes and lifecycle reviews
* Experience managing engineering teams across multiple disciplines and locations
* Excellent communication skills and ability to engage senior stakeholders


**Highly Valuable**
* Experience with satellite communications, ground segment, or secure infrastructure
* Experience leading SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and acceptance reviews
* Knowledge of RF systems, infrastructure, software-intensive systems, or cybersecurity
* Experience with RAMS, ILS, or operations engineering


**Responsibilities**
* Own and drive the engineering baseline, ensuring technical integrity, consistency, and delivery readiness
* Lead and scale the integrated engineering organisation across all relevant disciplines
* Drive and own technical governance, decision-making, trade-offs, and cross-discipline alignment
* Ensure alignment between engineering, programme schedule, cost, and subcontractor delivery
* Lead verification, validation, qualification, and review readiness across the lifecycle
* Own the technical integration of subcontractor deliverables in close collaboration with the Subcontractor Manager
* Ensure compliance with ECSS, contractual requirements, and programme-level standards


**What Success Looks Like**
* A coherent, stable, and fully traceable engineering baseline
* Strong alignment across engineering disciplines, suppliers, and programme stakeholders
* Successful delivery of design milestones and lifecycle reviews
* High confidence in system readiness, verification evidence, and acceptance preparation


**Benefits**
 Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.
   

  

 With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.
   

  

 SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.
   

  

* Are you driven by technical excellence and motivated to deliver complex systems at scale?
* Are you ready to take on the technical leadership of one of Europe’s most ambitious space programmes?


 If you answer yes, we invite you to make a significant impact as IRIS² Engineering Manager. We are looking for someone who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.

title: AI Business Partner
description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can identify the opportunities worth pursuing, improve the underlying processes, and help build an AI Hub that creates measurable value across the business.
 



  





 The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you shape can be live in weeks. This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and influence how more than 250 people work.
 



  





 At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.
 



  





**About the AI Hub** 




 The AI Hub is a new function within People & Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.
 



  





 We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.
 



  





 The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Business Partner, you'll help shape how this function develops and where it focuses its efforts.
 



  





**The role** 




 Your focus is how CatalystOne itself operates: the processes our consultants, support teams, sales organisation and back-office functions use every day.
 



  





 AI adoption is already broad across the company, and we have solutions in production today. Requests for new initiatives now arrive from every part of the business. We need someone who can work out which opportunities are worth pursuing, improve the process behind them, and ensure the result is adopted and delivers the value we expected.
 



  





 You'll run the intake process together with the IT Manager, helping decide where the AI Hub should focus its efforts. You'll spend time with the people doing the work, understanding how it happens today, where the bottlenecks are, and what should change before anything gets built.
 



 Sometimes the answer will be AI. Sometimes it will be a better process. Often it will be both.
 



  





 Some examples of what is already live
 



 This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:
 


* An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
* Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
* Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.



  





 The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




 You'll typically have a small number of initiatives running at the same time. For each one, you'll work with the department involved to understand the current process, establish a baseline, define what success looks like and help determine the best way forward. Your work will include:
 


* Prioritising opportunities that create meaningful business value.
* Mapping processes and identifying root causes rather than treating symptoms.
* Working directly with colleagues to understand how work really gets done.
* Helping teams adapt when new solutions are introduced.
* Leading our AI Champion Network and supporting AI adoption across the company.
* Measuring outcomes and following through when adoption or results fall short.



  





 You'll work closely with the
 
 AI Operations Engineer
 
 throughout every initiative. Together you'll assess opportunities before committing to them. They lead technical design, engineering and operations. You lead process improvement, organisational adoption and value measurement. Both of you stay involved after launch.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




 We're less interested in your exact background than the impact you've had improving how work gets done. You'll likely bring:
 


* Experience improving business processes and delivering measurable results.
* Strong business understanding and the ability to see how work flows across teams and functions.
* Confidence building baselines, challenging assumptions and measuring outcomes.
* Experience working with stakeholders and helping people navigate change.
* Curiosity about AI and a practical understanding of where it can create value and where it can't.
* Enough technical understanding to discuss solutions and implementation approaches, even if you're not the person building them.
* The ability to balance analytical thinking with empathy, bringing people with you as ways of working evolve.



  





 You may have gained this experience in business analysis, operations, organisational development, HR transformation, agile coaching, change management or a similar field.
 



  





**What success looks like** 




 The first month is about understanding CatalystOne and how work happens across the business.
 



  





 By month two, you'll begin taking ownership of the AI Champion Network and help manage the flow of opportunities entering the AI Hub.
 



  





 By day 90, we'd like to see one or two key business processes thoroughly mapped, agreed baselines established with the owning departments, and clear recommendations on what should happen next.
 



  





 Getting the first cases right matters more than getting them done quickly.
 



  





**Why join CatalystOne?** 




 This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning while working at the intersection of business, people and technology. You'll have the chance to:
 


* Influence how nearly 250 colleagues work.
* Help shape a new function at an exciting stage of its development.
* Work directly with stakeholders across the business.
* See ideas move from concept to reality quickly.
* Combine process improvement, organisational change and AI in a role with visible impact.



  





**Benefits** 




 As well as your salary, you’ll receive:
 


* Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
* Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
* Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
* Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.
* Flexible work setup: A hybrid model that supports your work life balance, with at least three days a week in the office.
* And more: Local benefits vary slightly by office, and we are happy to walk you through the details.



  





  





 If you're curious about how organisations work and excited by the opportunity to combine people, process and AI to create meaningful change, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





*CatalystOne does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. CatalystOne will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to the specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to CatalystOne on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.* 




  





*We would like to inform you that all candidates who receive a job offer will be subject to a background check.*

title: Project Manager - Development
description:
