title: Quality Assurance Lead
description:
**About the role** 




 We're looking for a Product Quality Owner to take ownership of a question nobody at Zendr owns today: what we validate before we ship, in what order, and why. As we roll out the next generation of our B2B freight platform through late 2026 - shipping continuously behind feature flags - you'll build and defend the risk model of our product, decide where validation effort goes, and stand behind every release decision with real evidence rather than gut feel or a completed checklist.
 



  





 This is a strategy and ownership role with hands-on validation at its core. It's deliberately not a test-execution role, a QA engineering role, or a team lead role - our development teams own automated unit and integration testing, written and maintained with modern AI tooling. Your time goes to the judgment work automation can't do: risk thinking, release readiness, and deep exploratory and regression testing of the flows that matter most.
 



 You'll work closely with the Head of Product and the Head of Engineering in a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, collaboration and craft matter more than buzzwords. Your recommendation is what every release decision is based on, so this role comes with real mandate - and the accountability that goes with it. This is a role for someone who reasons analytically about risk and generates structure in ambiguity - not someone who waits to be told what to test.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Own and maintain the product's risk model - what can break, what it costs the customer, and where validation effort should go
* Own release readiness: your recommendation is the basis for every release decision - you define what "ready" means per release and back each ship-or-hold call with documented evidence
* Drive bug refinement on a regular cadence and keep the backlog honest and prioritised against real customer and business impact
* Inventory, risk-triage and validate features shipped behind feature flags before they roll out to customer segments
* Run exploratory testing of new functionality and regression on critical flows - carrier integrations, rates, labels and the messy real-world edge cases of a logistics product
* Drive the regression automation you need through the development teams rather than building it all yourself
* Bring risk thinking into product discovery, acceptance criteria and definition of done, before development starts



  





**About you** 




 You came up through testing and have since moved well beyond manual test execution into analytical, risk-based quality work, with genuine product sense. You reason about risk, impact and probability, and you can justify what deserves testing effort and what doesn't. You're comfortable owning decisions, setting your own testing agenda, and turning ambiguity into structure. You communicate clearly - making risk tangible for both technical and non-technical people - and you build trust across product and engineering as a force multiplier, never a bottleneck.
 



  





**We're looking for someone who has:** 



* A relevant degree - at least 3 years of higher education
* 5+ years in QA or testing, with a clear move beyond manual test execution into analytical, risk-based quality work
* Strong analytical ability - you reason about risk, impact and probability and can defend what to test and what to skip
* A track record of owning quality or release decisions, not just working through test cases
* The ability to generate structure in ambiguity and set a testing agenda without being told what to test
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to align both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Hands-on experience with exploratory and regression testing of complex, integration-heavy products
* Fluency with AI tooling as a working instrument for test generation, maintenance and analysis
* Fluent English, both spoken and written (Swedish is a plus, but not a requirement)



  





**High value if you also bring:** 



* Experience with B2B SaaS in logistics or another operationally complex, integration-heavy industry
* Familiarity with feature-flag / dark-launch release models
* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman and reading system integrations



  





**About Zendr** 




 Zendr is a fast-growing SaaS company developing cloud-based solutions for B2B freight. We take pride in our innovative platform and the passionate team that contributes to our success every day. At Zendr, collaboration and well-being are key – we offer a workplace where you can truly make an impact. We're proud of what we do and of our commitment to making our customers' work easier. We believe it's important that you feel valued, engaged, and empowered to influence our journey. At Zendr, you can grow quickly – both professionally and personally – while being part of building something meaningful.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Direct impact on our core product - your work will shape the next generation of our B2B freight platform
* High ownership and autonomy - you own the quality and risk function end to end
* A culture where ideas are welcomed and your input truly matters
* Flexible working conditions
* A competitive salary in the range of 50’–60’ SEK per month, tailored to your background, skills and experience, along with a locally adapted benefits package designed to support your well-being and growth



  





**Our hiring process** 




 We respect your time and aim to make the recruitment journey fast, transparent and enjoyable:
 


* Application review – We'll review your application promptly and get back to you within a few days.
* First conversation – An informal video call to learn more about you and share who we are.
* Case & discussion – A practical case followed by a conversation where you walk us through your reasoning and approach. We'll share the details with you once you reach this step.
* Final meeting – Meet the team, talk through the role in detail, and see if we're the right fit for each other.



  





 From first contact to final decision, you can expect clear communication, timely feedback, and respect for your time – because great talent deserves a great candidate experience.
 



  





**Additional information** 




 We review applications on a rolling basis, which means the position may be filled before the closing date.
 



**Start date:** 
 As soon as possible
 



**Scope:** 
 Full-time, permanent position
 



**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Linköping or Jönköping
 



**Language:** 
 English required; Swedish is a plus

title: Master thesis: ML Model of network data traffic
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Join Ericsson for a master thesis focused on investigating and implementing global statistical models of live 5G mobile network data traffic. Your work will support the dimensioning of future hardware and software architectures, helping balance capacity, performance, and cost. Finding the right tradeoff has the potential to save Ericsson hundreds of millions of SEK annually and forms part of our continuous efforts to improve network dimensioning methodologies.
   

  

**What you will do:**
 You will explore supervised learning approaches, including probabilistic classification and regression, for modeling millisecond-level network data traffic. Your work will cover algorithm selection and parameter tuning, data rebalancing for highly imbalanced datasets, class selection or clustering, feature selection and dimensionality reduction, synthetic data generation using SMOTE-like methods, and the selection of suitable model performance and evaluation metrics. You will also investigate how well models generalize across different geographical areas and address big-data implementation constraints related to processing and storage. The expected outcome is a report describing the selected processing pipeline and the reasoning behind it, together with an application for model generation and inference, including performance evaluation.
   

  

**The skills you bring:**
* Strong foundation in mathematics and supervised learning, including model selection, probabilistic classification, and probabilistic regression
* Familiarity with data rebalancing, class selection, feature selection and reduction, model evaluation, and model generalization
* Good at working with big-data processing and storage constraints
* Interest in applying machine learning to real-world 5G network challenges

description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens rekrytering under din praktik?
   

  

 Är du nyfiken på hur AI, data och moderna digitala verktyg förändrar HR och rekrytering? Vill du få praktisk erfarenhet inom Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding och HR-analys i en organisation med verksamhet över hela Sverige?
   

  

 Nu erbjuder vi en praktikplats för dig som studerar HR, personalvetenskap eller ett närliggande område och som vill få praktisk erfarenhet inom Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, analys och AI.
   

  

**Om oss**
 ECIT är en nordisk koncern som erbjuder tjänster och lösningar inom ekonomi, lön, HR, IT och affärssystem. Vi befinner oss på en spännande utvecklingsresa där kompetensförsörjning, employer branding och digitalisering är viktiga områden för vår fortsatta tillväxt.
   

  

 Hos oss får du arbeta nära vår rekryteringsansvariga och få insyn i hela rekryteringsprocessen, från attraktion och search till analys, uppföljning och strategisk kompetensförsörjning. Vi arbetar aktivt med talent communities, employer branding och AI-stöd i våra processer.
   

  

 Placering är på vårt huvudkontor i Stockholm på Kungsholmen.
   

  

**Om praktiken**
 Under din praktik får du möjlighet att arbeta inom flera olika områden:
   

  

**Talent Acquisition**
* Stöd i rekryteringsprocesser
* Search och kandidatarbete
* Kandidatkommunikation
* Uppdatering och underhåll av kandidatdatabaser
* Arbete med talent communities


**Employer Branding**
* Skapa innehåll för LinkedIn och andra digitala kanaler
* Genomföra medarbetarintervjuer och skriva artiklar
* Vidareutveckla vår karriärsida
* Delta i employer branding-kampanjer
* Omvärldsbevakning och trendspaning


**Data & Analys**
* Statistik och KPI-uppföljning
* Rekryteringsanalyser
* Datainsamling och rapportering
* Arbete i Excel och Power BI
* Analys av kandidat- och rekryteringsdata


**AI & Digitalisering**
* Utforska och använda Microsoft Copilot
* Arbeta i Teamtailor och andra digitala verktyg
* Bidra till automatisering av arbetsflöden
* Delta i utvecklingen av AI-stöd inom rekrytering


**Vem är du?**
**Vi Tror Att Du Studerar Inom Exempelvis**
* Personalvetenskap
* HR
* Rekrytering
* Systemvetenskap
* Business Intelligence
* Digital marknadsföring
* Kommunikation
* Dataanalys


 För att trivas hos oss tror vi att du:
   

  

* Har ett stort intresse för människor, teknik och utveckling
* Är nyfiken på AI och digitala verktyg
* Arbetar strukturerat och noggrant
* Har god systemvana
* Är analytisk och tycker om att arbeta med data
* Uttrycker dig väl på svenska i både tal och skrift


**Meriterande erfarenheter**
 Det är ett plus om du har erfarenhet av eller kommit i kontakt med:
   

  

* Excel
* Power BI
* Teamtailor
* Canva
* Microsoft Copilot
* LinkedIn


**Vad erbjuder ECIT?**
**Hos Oss Får Du**
* Praktisk erfarenhet av modern Talent Acquisition
* Arbeta med AI och digitalisering inom Rekrytering
* Utveckla dina kunskaper inom employer branding
* Delta i utvecklingen av KPI:er, analyser och dashboards
* Få erfarenhet av moderna rekryteringssystem
* Insyn i både operativ och strategisk kompetensförsörjning
* Arbeta i en organisation som befinner sig i en spännande tillväxt- och utvecklingsfas


**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen och vill göra din praktik hos oss? Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.
   

  

**Placering:** 
 Stockholm
   

  

**Omfattning:** 
 Praktik enligt utbildningens upplägg
   

  

**Tillträde:** 
 Enligt överenskommelse
   

  

 Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt. För att säkerställa att dina personuppgifter hanteras i enlighet med GDPR tar ECIT inte emot ansökningar via e-post.
   

  

 Har du frågor om praktiken är du varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.
   

  

**Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!**

title: SEB Corporate & Investment Banking Summer Internship 2027: FICC Risk Management and XVA | SEB, Stockholm
description:
Are you ready to dive into the dynamic world of banking and finance? SEB’s Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) division offers talented students an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience and grow their potential over a few intense summer months. If you have the ambition, we will support you every step of the way!
   

  

**The internship in short**
 The programme kicks off with an engaging Introduction Week, where you’ll get to know SEB, meet professionals across the CIB division, get to know other interns and start building your network. During the introduction you will participate in learning and networking activities. We wrap up the experience with a Closing Day to reflect on, share, and celebrate your internship journey.
   

  

 As an intern, you are recruited to a specific job role where you will be involved in daily business activities and have a great opportunity to explore the environment of banking. You will be guided by at least one tutor during your internship.
   

  

 For more details visit our webpage here.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 You will join the XVA desk and support activities related to derivative pricing, risk management and analytics across Fixed Income, Currencies and Commodities (FICC) markets.
   

  

 The role combines quantitative analysis, Python development, AI-driven solutions and data-driven problem solving to enhance pricing, risk management and analytics capabilities. Depending on business needs, you may also contribute to projects focused on capital efficiency, risk management and the development of new analytical tools and technologies.
   

  

 Working in a dynamic trading floor environment, you will gain hands-on insight into financial markets, derivative products and the day-to-day activities of a global trading business.
   

  

**Who Are You?**
 We're looking for a curious and motivated student with a genuine interest in financial markets.
   

  

 You enjoy exploring data, spotting patterns, and thinking analytically.
   

  

 You’re detail-oriented, thrive in fast-moving environments, and work well with others to solve problems and share ideas.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Currently pursuing a master's degree in a quantitative field.
* Excellent analytical skills
* Very good programming skills (Python) and experience of using AI to solve problems
* Knowledge in machine learning is a plus
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* A curious and proactive mindset


**Learn more about working at SEB** 
**www.sebgroup.com/career**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

**Welcome with your application**
 We look forward to receiving your application! Please make sure to include the following documents as
 **one combined file** 
 :
   

  

* Your CV (not a LinkedIn profile), with your GPA clearly stated
* Grade transcripts from university
* A 100-word paragraph outlining your motivation and interest (space dedicated for it in the application form)


 Please note that applications submitted without a CV will not be considered.
   

  

 Submit your application as soon as possible, but
 **no later than 12th October 2026** 
 at 23:59 CET.
   

  

 If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact career@seb.se
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Är du en driven Talent Acquisition Specialist som brinner för search, networking och att hitta de mest eftertraktade kompetenserna på marknaden? Har du erfarenhet av att rekrytera utvecklare, AI-specialister eller andra tekniska profiler där konkurrensen om kandidaterna är hård? Då kan detta vara uppdraget för dig.
 



  





 Vi söker nu en Talent Acquisition Specialist till ett spännande konsultuppdrag hos en teknikintensiv verksamhet i stark tillväxt. Här får du en nyckelroll i att attrahera och rekrytera framtidens teknikkompetens inom områden som mjukvaruutveckling, AI, systemutveckling och avancerad ingenjörskompetens.
 



  





 Rollen som Talent Acquisition Specialist
 



 I den här rollen kommer du att arbeta i gränslandet mellan rekrytering, search och talent intelligence. Du blir en strategisk partner till rekryterande chefer och ansvarar för att identifiera, attrahera och engagera kandidater inom några av marknadens mest konkurrensutsatta kompetensområden.
 



  





 Du driver rekryteringsprocesser från start till mål men förväntas också arbeta mycket proaktivt med search och nätverksbyggande för att skapa långsiktiga kandidatpipelines.
 



  





 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter
 


* Driva rekryteringsprocesser från behovsanalys och kravprofil till anställning
* Arbeta proaktivt med search, sourcing och headhunting av tekniska specialistroller
* Bygga och underhålla långsiktiga nätverk av utvecklare, ingenjörer och tekniska specialister
* Genomföra kompetensbaserade intervjuer, personbedömningar och referenstagningar
* Fungera som rådgivande partner till rekryterande chefer genom hela rekryteringsprocessen
* Arbeta datadrivet och aktivt utveckla search- och rekryteringsstrategier
* Bidra med omvärldsbevakning och kunskap kring kandidatmarknaden inom tech och AI



  





 Vem är du?
 



 Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för teknik och som motiveras av att hitta kandidater som andra missar. Du trivs med search, research och kandidatdialoger och drivs av utmaningen att attrahera personer som sällan aktivt söker nya jobb.
 



  





 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
 


* Minst 3-5 års erfarenhet av Talent Acquisition eller rekrytering
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av search och sourcing inom teknikområdet
* Erfarenhet av att rekrytera utvecklare, systemingenjörer, AI-specialister eller andra tekniska profiler
* Erfarenhet av rekryteringar inom exempelvis mjukvara, systemutveckling, embedded, AI eller närliggande områden
* Förmåga att självständigt driva flera parallella rekryteringsprocesser
* Erfarenhet av kompetensbaserad rekrytering
* Relevant akademisk utbildning inom HR eller motsvarande
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska



  





 Meriterande
 


* Erfarenhet från försvars-, teknik- eller industriverksamhet
* Erfarenhet av säkerhetsklassade rekryteringar
* Certifiering inom arbetspsykologiska tester eller assessment
* Bakgrund från rekryterings- eller konsultbranschen



  





 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är en person som har ett genuint intresse för teknik och gillar att sätta dig in i nya kompetensområden. Du är proaktiv, driven och motiveras av att leverera resultat i en miljö med högt tempo och många parallella processer. Vidare är du kommunikativ och relationsskapande med en naturlig förmåga att bygga förtroende hos både kandidater och rekryterande chefer. Du arbetar självständigt, tar egna initiativ och har en god struktur som hjälper dig att prioritera och behålla fokus även när tempot är högt. Framför allt drivs du av utmaningen att identifiera och attrahera kandidater som inte aktivt söker nya möjligheter och ser värdet i att bygga långsiktiga nätverk inom tech- och AI-området.
 



  





 Bra att veta
 



 Detta är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid med start i november 2026 och som löper till och med den 31 oktober 2027. Uppdraget är placerat i Solna. Säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras enligt verksamhetens säkerhetsskyddsbestämmelser.
 



  





 Ansökan
 



 Ansök genom att klicka på "Ansök nu", ladda upp ditt CV och svara på några korta frågor. Vi arbetar med löpande urval och ser därför gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.
 



 Vid frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta ansvarig konsultchef
 **Evelina Thimper** 
 på
 **evelina.thimper@jurek.se** 
 .

title: SEB Corporate & Investment Banking Summer Internship 2027: FX Quant Trader | SEB, Stockholm
description:
Are you ready to dive into the dynamic world of banking and finance? SEB’s Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) division offers talented students an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience and grow their potential over a few intense summer months. If you have the ambition, we will support you every step of the way!
   

  

**The internship in short**
 The programme kicks off with an engaging Introduction Week, where you’ll get to know SEB, meet professionals across the CIB division, get to know other interns and start building your network. During the introduction you will participate in learning and networking activities. Throughout the internship, you will be involved in daily business activities. We wrap up the experience with a Closing Day to reflect on, share, and celebrate your internship journey.
   

  

 As an intern, you are recruited to The FX Quant Team within FICC Markets — a global business area offering top-tier services in Foreign Exchange across major financial hubs like Stockholm, London, New York, and Hong Kong. You will be tasked with a real project that will either be based on a new strategy or an improvement on an existing one. You will be guided by at least one tutor during the internship.
   

  

 For more details visit our webpage here.
   

  

**About The Position**
 You will be joining a team of Quantitative Traders and be based in Stockholm. The FX Spot Quant team are responsible for pricing, trade execution and risk management for the FX spot product. This is done through a combination of statistics, optimization and machine learning where the goal is to take as many decisions algorithmically as possible to increase the speed and scale of the decisions one can make in a day.
   

  

 As an intern you will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of quantitative development and financial markets, by using programming, problem-solving and mathematical skills on real-world problems. You will be working closely with all parts of the organization, including Sales, Trading and Technology and are encouraged to make real contributions to our trading.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 You are likely on your way to a M.Sc in engineering or natural science, with a passion for problem solving, mathematics and programming. Also, you are fluent in both written and spoken English.
   

  

 As a person, you are motivated by working in an ever-changing landscape where the cumulative effect of frequent small improvements makes a real difference over time.
   

  

 You are an open-minded and committed candidate with a collaborative spirit and strong work ethic, have good communication skills, and the ability to work independently with confidence.

title: Key Account Manager | Stockholm
description:
**About Infront** 




 At Infront, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace, recognizing our diverse team as one of our most valuable assets.
 



  





 For 25 years, Infront has been empowering financial market experts to make faster, smarter, compliant decisions. Over time, we have expanded our foundation by bringing together companies with more than 75 years of combined market experience and trust.
 



  





 Our strength lies in market data, delivering reliable, accurate information through a powerful suite of tools, spanning Data Intelligence, Wealth Management solutions, and Trading & Investor solutions, that our users depend on every day. Today, we are one of Europe’s leading providers of market data and financial software, helping professionals navigate markets with confidence and speed.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a commercially driven Key Account Manager to develop existing client relationships and win new business across the Nordic markets. The role has focus on expanding relationships with current medium-to-large clients and identifying, pursuing, and converting new logos.
 



  





 Based in Stockholm, you will build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across the financial services sector and help clients maximise the value of Infront’s full range of solutions, including market data terminals and trading, digital, and data feed solutions. Working across both the buy-side and sell-side, you will combine account management, client advisory and business development while coordinating internal teams and identifying solutions that support client retention, growth and new business.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic Nordic clients, with a strong focus on both existing-client growth and new business development.
* Build trusted relationships with senior decisionmakers and key stakeholders across buy-side and sell-side institutions.
* Own client satisfaction, retention, account development, revenue growth, and new logo acquisition within the assigned market.
* Develop a strong understanding of clients’ business models, strategic priorities, market environments, and technology needs.
* Identify and develop opportunities for clients to adopt or expand their use of Infront’s full range of solutions, including market data terminals, and trading, digital, and data feed solutions.
* Prospect, qualify and pursue new business opportunities, from initial engagement through proposal and negotiation.
* Lead or support renewals, pricing discussions, tenders, proposals and commercial negotiations with existing and prospective clients.
* Coordinate client requirements and solution development with Sales, Client Success, Consulting Services, Project Management, Client Service and Product teams.
* Plan and participate in client meetings, workshops, presentations, service reviews, and relevant events.
* Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, and pipeline information, while sharing client feedback, market insights, and emerging needs internally.



  





**Who you are** 




 You are a commercially minded relationship builder with a strong interest in financial markets, trading, and technology. You build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders; understand client needs and translate them into valuable solutions. Organised, proactive and collaborative, you are comfortable developing existing accounts, pursuing new business, leading commercial discussions and coordinating internal teams, while working independently in an international and dynamic environment.
 



  





**Requirements** 



* 8+ years of experience in Key Account Management, Account Management, Sales or a similar client-facing commercial role.
* Experience managing and developing relationships with clients in the financial services industry, ideally across the Nordic markets.
* A proven track record of both growing existing accounts and identifying, pursuing and winning new business.
* Experience selling or supporting solutions related to financial markets, market data, terminals, digital services, quantitative analysis or data feeds.
* Strong interest in financial markets and the business needs of banks, asset managers, wealth managers, brokers and other financial institutions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills, combined with a structured, proactive and client-focused approach.
* Fluent Swedish and very good written and spoken English are required. Speaking another Nordic language is considered an advantage.



  





**Our offer** 




**Health & wellness:** 
 Benefit from wellbeing initiatives tailored to local needs, including access to an employee assistance programme that provides confidential support to employees and their families.
 



**Holiday:** 
 Enjoy competitive holiday entitlement aligned with local markets, so you can rest and recharge.
 



**Pension:** 
 Plan for your long-term financial wellbeing through our pension scheme, supported by employer contributions.
 



**Remote work:** 
 Enjoy the opportunity to work two days a week from home, with flexible working hours where possible. You may also request to work up to four weeks per year from a different location.
 



**Learning & development:** 
 Support your career progression with access to learning resources, ongoing conversations with your manager, and opportunities to share the knowledge you gain with your team.
 



**Culture & impact:** 
 Be part of an international team with a startup mindset and play a key role in making a meaningful impact.
 



**Our offices:** 
 Work from Europe’s leading financial centres and be at the heart of where finance happens.
 



  





**Additional notes** 




 All candidates selected for employment are subject to Pre-Employment Screening. This process includes professional reference and background checks conducted by our third-party partner, ZINC. These screenings are part of our commitment to ensuring a secure, compliant, and trustworthy workplace.
 



  





 We kindly ask that you submit your CV in English.

title: Senior projekteringsledare till datacenter & industri
description:
**Job Description**
 Vi på WSP Property & Buildings är rådgivande konsulter för våra kunders varierande behov inom byggprocessens alla skeden. I vårt jobb utreder, projekterar, samordnar, beräknar, dokumenterar, kontrollerar och besiktar vi tekniska system inom segmenten Fastighet, Industri och Energi. Genom att vara delaktiga i tidiga skeden kan vi både utveckla och tillföra mer i projekten vi verkar igenom vår expertis.
   

  

 Vår grupp inom projekteringsledning har många spännande projekt på gång, bland annat inom datacenters i hela Sverige, större multidisciplinära uppdrag där vi samarbetar med kollegor från olika länder samt även projekt inom grön omställning. Det finns alla möjligheter för dig som vår nästa kollega att vara med och påverka samt utveckla verksamheten.
   

  

 Vi är utspridda på några kontor runt om i Sverige och det är viktigt för oss att man har någon kollega nära. Därför rekryterar vi till de kontor där vi redan finns.
   

  

**Vårt erbjudande**
 Hos oss får du möjlighet till en ansvarsfull och utvecklande roll. Du kommer vara med i utvecklingen av våra tjänsteutbud nationellt likväl internationellt och arbeta i en miljö som präglas av kunskapsdelning, utveckling samt innovation.
   

  

 Vårt team har hög arbetsglädje. Vi lägger stor vikt vid bra kombination av hjärta och hjärna i hur vi förhåller oss till varandra och våra kunders utmaningar samt starkt lagarbete för att utvecklas tillsammans. Vi värdesätter ett hållbart arbetsliv, en balans mellan arbete och fritid. Din framtid är viktig för WSP!
   

  

**Ansvarsområde**
 Som projekteringsledare och konsult på WSP kommer du arbeta i större uppdrag där du blir den samordnande parten i projektorganisationen. Det är meriterande med erfarenhet från projekt relaterade till datacenters eller industri.
   

  

 Du kommer ha ansvar för att leveranser sker i tid, kvaliteten och tidsplanen hålls samtidigt som du strukturerar arbetet och engagerar kollegorna i teamet. Det är viktigt för rollen att du får med dig hela gruppen i arbetet och aktivt arbetar med kommunikationen, för att samarbetena ska flyta på så smidigt som möjligt. Utöver det förväntas du ta del av de globala dialogerna och samarbetena inom WSP.
   

  

 En stor del i din roll som projekteringsledare är att du kommer vara den naturliga kontakten mellan WSP och våra kunder, såväl som kollegor inom WSP i stort. Du förväntas kunna ta en affär från första kundkontakt till ett konkret uppdrag, och på så vis även hjälpa kunden att formulera sina behov. Samarbete är en viktig del i vårt arbetssätt, vilket också gör oss fortsatt framgångsrika och ser till att vi har roligt på jobbet. En tredjedel av arbetet blir att aktivt arbeta med anbudsarbetet.
   

  

 Resor kan förekomma i uppdragsarbetet, även om mycket kan ske på distans.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som har åtminstone 10 års erfarenhet som projekteringsledare och har arbetat i en konsultverksamhet med multidisciplinära uppdrag. Genom arbetslivet ser vi även gärna att du har erfarenhet från anbudsarbete och arbetat i flera eller längre projekt för datacenter.
   

  

 Du har sannolikt en högskole- eller universitetsutbildning, eller har förvärvat dig likvärdiga kunskaper genom arbetslivet.
   

  

 Det är meriterande, men inget krav, om du har erfarenhet från projekt inom industri och internationellt samarbete, likaså om du har erfarenhet från el-,vvs- eller styrteknisk projektering.
   

  

 Ett krav för tjänsten är att kunna uttrycka sig på svenska i tal och skrift, då mycket av vår dagliga kontakt med våra kunder och de handlingar vi levererar är på svenska. Goda kunskaper i engelska är också en förutsättning, då WSP tillhör en global koncern där dialog på engelska förekommer ofta både inom projekt och med våra kollegor globalt.
   

  

 För oss är det viktigt att du ska trivas så därför lägger vi stor vikt vid din personlighet. Du värdesätter att ha kontakt med andra, samt att bygga och vårda relationer. Särskilt viktigt är att du tycker om att samarbeta med andra och är proaktiv i ditt arbete. Ditt engagemang i projekten smittar av sig och du sprider en positiv aura i dina projekt.
   

  

**Kontakt**
 Vi vill gärna veta mera om dig så tveka inte att höra av dig till oss om du har frågor eller funderingar!
   

  

 Rekryterande chef: Sara Wennergren, sara.wennergren@wsp.com.
   

  

 HR-rekrytering: Therese Galvez, therese.galvez@wsp.com.
   

  

**Sista ansökningsdag:**
 Urval sker löpande där rollen kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, men vi vill senast få in din ansökan 2026-10-31.
   

  

 Kontakt från rekryteringsföretag, CV- och annonssäljare undanbedes.
   

  

 Besök gärna vår hemsida för mer information om vad WSP arbetar med och hur vi framtidssäkrar världen: www.wsp.com

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
**About the role** 




 Tandem Health is scaling across multiple markets, and we are looking for a Head of Customer Success to define what world-class customer success looks like at Tandem.
 



 This role is not primarily about building a traditional Customer Success team. Instead, you will set up the foundations, processes, playbooks, rhythms, and standards that enable our teams in every market to deliver an excellent customer experience.
 



 You will work closely with our Medical Operations Specialists, Product Delivery Managers, Sales, Product and leadership to ensure customers are successfully onboarded, deeply engaged, continuously supported, and able to realise clear value from Tandem throughout their journey.
 



 You will be responsible for turning Customer Success into a repeatable, high-quality discipline across Tandem - helping us retain customers, drive expansion, increase engagement, and create consistently excellent customer relationships across markets.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Define what excellent Customer Success looks like at Tandem
* Rebuild the Customer Success foundations from scratch, including processes, playbooks, rituals, tools, and standards
* Create a clear customer journey across onboarding, adoption, engagement, retention, expansion, and renewal readiness
* Develop practical playbooks for customer onboarding, QBRs, success plans, health checks, escalation management, upsell opportunities, sales collaboration and ongoing engagement
* Coach and train Medical Operations Specialists on how to deliver excellent Customer Success in their markets
* Set the standards for how teams build trust, create value, manage relationships, and keep customers engaged
* Help teams identify opportunities to upsell, expand, and deepen customer adoption
* Create customer health frameworks that help teams spot risk, engagement gaps, and expansion opportunities early
* Build rhythms for customer reviews, internal account discussions, feedback loops, and market-level performance tracking
* Work with Product to ensure customer feedback is captured, structured, and translated into useful insight
* Partner with Sales and Country teams to ensure a strong handover from sale to onboarding and long-term success
* Evangelise Customer Success best practices across all Tandem markets



  





**What you bring** 



* You have built or significantly shaped a Customer Success function at a high-growth B2B SaaS scaleup
* You have created CS processes, playbooks, operating rhythms, system setup and standards from scratch
* You know what great customer onboarding, adoption, retention, engagement, and expansion look like
* You have experience coaching and enabling others to deliver excellent Customer Success
* You are commercially sharp and understand how Customer Success drives upsell, expansion, retention, and customer happiness
* You are highly structured and can turn ambiguity into clear, repeatable ways of working
* You understand SaaS metrics such as adoption, churn, retention, expansion, customer health, time to value, NRR, and GRR
* You are excellent at stakeholder management and can influence teams across countries and functions
* You are comfortable operating across multiple markets and adapting best practices to local contexts



  





**Bonus points** 



* Experience in healthcare, healthtech, clinical software, or another regulated industry
* Experience working with complex B2B customers where success depends on workflow change and behaviour change
* Experience enabling non-CS teams to deliver Customer Success as part of their role
* Experience building customer health scoring, QBR frameworks, onboarding journeys, and renewal processes
* Experience using AI, automation, analytics, or customer intelligence tools to improve Customer Success workflows
* Experience scaling Customer Success best practices across several countries or markets



  





**Location** 




 We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a
 **full-time role based in Stockholm** 
 where you will work primarily in order to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
 



 Our interview process consists of stages:
 


1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
2. First interview with Head of Commercial Excellence
3. Second interview with our CEO
4. Working Day - Join us in the Stockholm office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.



  





**Benefits** 



* Competitive salary & company stock options
* 30 days/year of paid vacation
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives
* Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents
* Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
* Mental health support through our partner Mindler
* Pension program
* Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.



*We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.* 




  





**Culture at Tandem** 




 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
 



 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
 



 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
 



 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
 



  





*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Subject Matter Expert inom QRS - Quality, Risk & Security
description:
Deloitte är en globalt ledande leverantör av Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal och Consultative Services. Med mer än 470 000 medarbetare i över 150 länder hjälper vi våra klienter och vår omvärld att lösa komplexa problem och nå ambitiösa mål genom områdes- och branschexpertis, global räckvidd och allianser med de största tech-leverantörerna. Det som definierar Deloitte är vår strävan efter att göra en meningsfull skillnad. För oss innebär det långsiktig utveckling och resultat för våra klienter och deras företag, idéer och handlingar som också bidrar till en positiv samhällsutveckling. Det handlar även om att stärka våra medarbetare och främja deras utveckling.
   

  

  




**Jobbeskrivning**

 Du kommer att bli en del av vår Quality, Risk & Security-avdelning där vårt uppdrag är att säkerställa regulatorisk efterlevnad för Deloitte som revisionsfirma. Det spänner över allt från riskvärdering och godkännande av nya klienter, compliance, konsultationer samt efterlevnad av policyer, regler och lagar.
   

  

  





 Som Subject Matter Expert i vårt dynamiska QRS-team får du ansvaret för att värdera, kvalitetssäkra och godkänna våra klient- och leverantörsrelationer – en uppgift som är både utmanande och omväxlande. Du kommer att fungera som rådgivare till vår organisation och som kvalitetsexpert mellan våra konsulter och vårt delivery center. Du har som ansvar att säkerställa att vi följer de senaste regelverken och branschpraxis.
   

  

  





 I rollen ingår också att driva internutbildningar som stärker hela organisationens medvetenhet kring risk och efterlevnad. Du kommer att bygga starka, professionella relationer med kollegor både i Sverige och i Norden, och vara en viktig del i vårt nätverk av experter.

* Du är analytisk, strukturerad samt har god prioriterings- och problemlösningsförmåga
* Du behärskar svenska och engelska obehindrat både i tal och skrift, då rollen innebär att du kommer att använda både svenska och engelska i din dagliga kommunikation.
* God systemvana
* Svenska är ett krav


**Ytterligare information**

**Vi erbjuder** 
  

  

  





 Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk med kollegor världen över som du kan nyttja för att utveckla både dig själv och vår verksamhet. Du får arbeta med spännande, komplexa uppgifter, både på global och nordisk nivå, i ett team som alltid värderar ditt perspektiv och som är i framkant av digitaliseringen. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att erbjuda dig möjligheter att driva din personliga utveckling genom praktisk erfarenhet, en personlig coach som stöttar dig i din karriär samt kontinuerlig feedback från erfarna kollegor.
   

  

  





 Du får möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag som hjälper andra aktörer i deras resa mot en mer hållbar organisation, samtidigt som vi arbetar målmedvetet med våra egna ambitioner inom klimat, miljö och socialt ansvar. title: Executive Director PO&T Asset Management
description:
We are looking for an experienced and strategic leader to join our Pharmaceutical Operations & Technologies organization as Executive Director PO&T Asset Management.
   

  

 In this role, you will help translate business and functional strategies into clear priorities and an integrated portfolio of high-impact initiatives. You will work closely with senior leaders across Pharmaceutical Operations, Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory and Finance to ensure that strategic initiatives are effectively prioritized, resourced, governed and executed.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Strategy & Business Leadership
   

  

* Provide input to the strategic roadmap for Pharmaceutical Operations & Technologies in alignment with overall company objectives.
* Translate corporate and functional strategies into actionable priorities, programs, and measurable outcomes for PO&T by project.
* Lead strategic planning processes, including annual operating plans, multi-year roadmaps, and strategic investment priorities.
* Provide executive-level recommendations regarding priorities, resource allocation, investments, risks, and organizational capabilities.
* Establish and lead an integrated portfolio management framework for all projects within PO&T.
* Oversee a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs from strategy and business case development through implementation and benefits realization for PO&T.
* Ensure projects are appropriately prioritized based on strategic value, business impact, risk, complexity, and resource requirements for PO&T.
* Establish governance structures, decision-making forums, performance metrics, and escalation mechanisms for PO&T.
* Monitor portfolio performance, milestones, dependencies, risks, financial commitments, and resource utilization for PO&T.
* Provide clear executive reporting and recommendations to ensure timely decisions and successful execution for PO&T.


 Operations & Technology Transformation
   

  

* Lead strategic transformation initiatives designed to improve pharmaceutical operations, organizational effectiveness, technology capabilities, and business performance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage digital technologies, data, automation, analytics, and innovative operating models for PO&T.
* Partner with technology and business leaders to develop technology strategies that support operational and strategic objectives for PO&T.
* Drive adoption of standardized processes, tools, governance, and best practices across PO&T.
* Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, compliance, scalability, and business value for PO&T.


 Organizational Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high-performing team of portfolio and strategy professionals for PO&T.
* Establish a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and disciplined execution.
* Mentor project and program leaders and develop future organizational talent.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and career development pathways.
* Serve as a trusted strategic partner to the executive leadership team and senior functional leaders for PO&T.
* Facilitate alignment across business functions and resolve competing priorities, dependencies, and resource constraints.
* Prepare executive-level presentations, portfolio reviews, strategic recommendations, and investment proposals for PO&T.
* Represent Pharmaceutical Operations & Technologies in enterprise-level planning and governance forums.
* Build strong relationships across internal stakeholders and external strategic partners.


 Financial & Resource Management
   

  

* Partner with Finance and functional leaders to develop business cases, budgets, investment proposals, and financial forecasts.
* Optimize allocation of people, capital, technology, and external resources across the strategic portfolio for PO&T.
* Establish financial and value-delivery metrics for major programs for PO&T.
* Ensure PO&T initiatives remain aligned with approved business cases and expected benefits.


 Risk, Compliance & Governance
   

  

* Ensure strategic PO&T initiatives operate within applicable pharmaceutical, regulatory, quality, compliance, cybersecurity, and corporate governance requirements.
* Establish proactive risk-management practices across the PO&T portfolio.
* Identify and escalate significant risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions requiring executive intervention for PO&T.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, governance, and accountability throughout the project lifecycle.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, life sciences, technology, operations, or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare, technology, operations, or a related industry.
* Significant experience leading complex, enterprise-level programs and strategic initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience in portfolio management, program management, operational strategy, or business transformation.
* Proven ability to influence and lead across a complex, matrixed organization.
* Experience presenting strategic recommendations and portfolio performance to senior executives.
* Strong financial, analytical, organizational, and strategic-planning capabilities.


**Preferred**
* Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, or equivalent preferred
* Experience establishing or maturing a Project Management Office (PMO) or Enterprise Portfolio Management function.
* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program/project management certification.
* Experience with enterprise transformation, organizational change, or operating-model design.


 As a global organization, we are open to considering candidates in multiple locations. The position can be based either at our Stockholm, Sweden office or at our Cary, North Carolina office, depending on the selected candidate and the position reports to the Senior Vice President and Head of Pharmaceutical Operations & Technologies.
   

  

**About Calliditas Therapeutics**
 The Asahi Kasei Group operates with a commitment of creating for tomorrow. Our business sectors, Material, Homes, and Health Care, contribute to the development of society by anticipating the changing needs of those around the world. We look for candidates that offer a fresh perspective and a variety of skills to help us achieve our commitment.
   

  

 Calliditas is an Asahi-Kasei Group Company based in Stockholm, Sweden.
   

  

 Calliditas’ lead product, developed under the name Nefecon, has received full approval by the FDA under the trade name TARPEYO® and by the European Commission under the trade name KINPEYGO®. TARPEYO/KINPEYGO® is the first treatment approved for IgA nephropathy by the FDA and EMA, respectively.

title: Experienced Consultant in Principal level within Industrial Operations
description:
**Experienced Consultant in Principal level within Industrial Operations** 




  





**Your mission** 




 At EFESO, we help leading Nordic companies improve performance across manufacturing, operations, and supply chains. We work hands-on with management teams and operational leaders to deliver measurable results through Operations Excellence, Value Chain transformation, and Industrial AI.
 



  





 We are now strengthening our Nordic team with an
 **experienced consultant on Principal level** 
 who knows industrial operations from the inside, either from Discrete Manufacturing or Forest & Packaging Industry. Whether your background is in manufacturing/operations excellence (MAKE) or Value Chain, and whether you come from consulting or from an industrial role, what matters most is your credibility, drive, and ability to deliver real results.
 



  





**The role** 




 As a Consultant / Senior Consultant at EFESO Nordics, you will:
 


* Deliver and manage client engagements within Operations Excellence (WCOM/TPM/Lean) and/or Value Chain (S&OP, planning, footprint, inventory, cost-to-serve)
* Lead project workstreams end-to-end; scoping, delivery, quality, and impact
* Coach client teams and junior colleagues in our tandem delivery model
* Build trusted, long-term relationships with client stakeholders
* Contribute to proposals, business development, and thought leadership in your industry
* Apply data and Industrial AI as accelerators of operational excellence



  





**Your profile** 




 You are an experienced professional who combines deep industry understanding with strong delivery capability. You are likely to have:
 


* Around 10+ years of relevant experience within Discrete Manufacturing or Forest & Packaging industry
* A background in either MAKE or Value Chain, both are equally welcome
* A track record of delivering measurable operational improvements
* At least one clear area of spike expertise, combined with a broad understanding of industrial operations
* Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills, credible from shop floor to boardroom
* Experience of project or workstream management, ideally in a consulting environment



 We value industry credibility, personal drive, and a solution-oriented mindset over a specific consulting pedigree or an exact MAKE-vs-Value-Chain profile.
 



  





**Requirements** 



* Master of Science in Industrial Engineering & Management, Engineering, or equivalent, or strong industrial experience that compensates for formal background
* Fluent English; Swedish, Finnish, or German at working level is a strong advantage
* Proficient in Excel and standard consulting tools
* Driver's licence and willingness to travel within the Nordics



  





 Experience with WCOM, TPM, Lean, Six Sigma, S&OP/IBP, Industry 4.0, advanced analytics, or Industrial AI is considered an advantage.
 



  





**Why us?** 




 We offer:
 


* The chance to work with leading industrial clients across the Nordic region
* A role at the forefront of Operations Excellence and Industrial AI
* Mentorship, coaching, and access to EFESO's global expertise (800+ colleagues, incl. ROI-EFESO and ARGO-EFESO)
* An open, entrepreneurial, and non-hierarchical culture where you can influence the direction of the company
* Competitive terms and genuine long-term development opportunities



  





 At EFESO, you will not be sitting on the sidelines. You will lead real projects, work alongside experienced consultants, and help create measurable value for our clients.

title: Merchant CRM Manager
description:
What we do at Qliro
   

  

 At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people who together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We're now scaling our business here in Sweden and across the Nordics.
   

  

 What your team does
   

  

 You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales and Marketing, embedded in our Merchant Experience and Payment Platform domains and reporting to Head of Merchant Experience. You join sales standups, hear where deals stall or onboarding gets stuck, and decide what to do about it — sometimes that's a HubSpot fix, sometimes a training session, sometimes a nudge to Product.
   

  

 What you will get to do
   

  

* Focus on our commercial agenda and spot recurring bottlenecks —, stalled deals, and onboarding friction.
* Take ownership of challenges by going directly to the right stakeholders, bringing the right teams together and driving cross-functional solutions from idea to execution.
* Own HubSpot as our commercial engine: build and maintain flows, sequences and campaigns so the tool serves the sales process, not the other way around.
* Design and run training for the Sales team to close knowledge gaps.
* Research the competitive landscape and turn it into material Sales can pitch from and merchants can use to understand why Qliro is the right choice.
* Move sign rate, onboarding rate, product adoption rate and churn — these four are your scoreboard


 What you'll bring to the team
   

  

* Hands-on experience running HubSpot or a comparable CRM/marketing automation platform — building flows, managing pipelines, creating campaigns. This matters more to us than formal sales training
* 3–5+ years in a cross-functional role spanning product, sales and/or marketing, ideally in fintech, payments, SaaS or e-commerce
* A background either as a marketing automation specialist who's grown into a broader commercial remit, or as someone technically minded within consulting or engineering who's moved toward sales
* Enough technical grounding to hold your own in a product conversation and brief a PM on how a checkout API or payment integration works
* A track record enabling sales teams: training, collateral, competitive positioning
* Comfortable without a fixed playbook, you diagnose problems and design your own interventions rather than waiting for a request
* Fluent in English; Swedish and/or Finnish a strong plus


 Sound like your next role? We'd love to hear from you — apply now.
   

  

*Qliro is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual orientation or age.*

title: Director, Account Manager
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
   

  

 The Account Manager will be responsible for establishing and maintaining relationships with Broadridge’s Capital Markets clients in the Nordics region. Based in city centre of Stockholm, with regular regional travel, the Account Manager will focus on retaining 100% of the client base and developing account plans based on a cross-Broadridge understanding of the client as well as identifying opportunities to drive new sales opportunities. He/she will focus on cultivating relationships across the firm with a focus on senior client executives and decision makers.
   

  

 The individual in this role must have strong leadership and influencing skills and must partner closely with and look to influence business leaders and key decision makers both internal and with our clients organizations. Negotiation & communication skills and the ability to work successfully in a fast-paces environment are critical to this individual’s success.
   

  

 The Account Management is responsible for:
   

  

**Client Relationship Management**
* Establish and maintain relationships with senior client executives
* Cultivate relationships at a higher level than exist today
* Build and foster additional relationships across all areas of the firm (Operations, IT, compliance, risk, etc. across all products traded)
* Solidify existing relationship
* Meet with client's senior management team on a regular basis to understand their business needs and to provide BR updates on our strategic initiatives
* Ensure Broadridge is an integral part of any business decision
* Communicate changes in the business environment at either the client or Broadridge to management at all levels where appropriate
* Draft thorough client profiles for all accounts
* Publish trip reports in a timely manner
* Prepare / execute annual client strategic plans
* Escalation on Client Projects
* Visit clients on a regular basis to address all open projects, etc.


**Product Sales (Value Added Products - VAP's)**
* Identify and close additional revenue opportunities within existing client base
* Introduce new products and services to existing clients to increase their operational efficiency
* Work with sales to produce and maintain a product sales pipeline (updated at least monthly according to agreed timeline)
* Conduct and coordinate product presentations when/where necessary
* Working with sales, negotiate pricing on product sales
* Finalize all the appropriate documents in conjunction with Legal and Finance


**Consultancy and Product Development Sales (Event-based)**
* Identify and close additional revenue opportunities within existing client base for consultancy and product development sales
* Working with sales, produce and maintain a product sales pipeline (updated at least monthly according to agreed timeline)
* Working with sales, negotiate pricing on such sales
* Finalize all the appropriate documents in conjunction with Legal and Finance


**Contract Negotiations**
* Renew all existing client agreements (prior to existing contract end date)
* Conduct and coordinate negotiations on contact terms and conditions
* Work with Finance and Legal on preparation of all pricing proposals and legal documents
* Prepare and negotiate Service Level Agreements


**Contribute to the Client Satisfaction Surveys process**
* Work with Client Service Management team to review survey results with the client
* Contribute to action plans / Review action plans with client where applicable
* Monitor performance and update plan to ensure all tasks have been accomplished


**Metrics**
* Review metrics w/ client on a monthly basis, where appropriate
* Suggest modifications to metrics as needed to address the changing conditions
* Contribute to action plans (part of survey action plans) to remedy poor performing areas with updates monthly on current status


**Qualifications:**
* Degree-level
* Have a minimum 5 years of Account Management experience within the Financial Services Industry
* Have a strong understanding of the financial market, with knowledge of the Nordics
* Have the ability to build trusting relationships
* Be able to communicate and influence
* Exceed client expectations
* Fluency in a Nordic(s) language preferred


 We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
   

  

**Use of AI in Hiring**
 As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

title: Nämndsekreterare, vikariat
description:
Vi har bestämt oss! Vi ska bli en kommun i framkant – och har allt som krävs för att lyckas. Korta beslutsvägar, samarbete över verksamhetsgränser och viljan att våga mer. Våra höga ambitioner ger dig med eget driv möjligheter att växa och skapa positiv förändring för medborgarna. Som medarbetare i Ekerö kommun får du en värdefull roll i vår unika övärld – och vi ser fram emot din ansökan.
   

  

 Jobba i Ekerö kommun
   

  

**Arbetsbeskrivning**
 Vi tror på dig och din förmåga – därför ger vi dig stort utrymme i din roll. Många som jobbar hos oss uppskattar förtroendet och ansvaret de får i vår kommun, eftersom det bidrar till mycket lärande och utveckling i vardagen. För att lyckas är du trygg i dig själv, ditt yrke och har förmågan att både ta för dig – och sätta gränser.
   

  

 På kanslienheten hanterar vi alla politiska nämnder, utskott och råd. Här arbetar även arkivarier och systemförvaltare. Under valår är vi valkansli och genomför allmänna val.
   

  

 Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att som nämndsekreterare– förutom att agera sekreterare på möten – ansvara för hela mötesprocessen från beredningar inför sammanträden till efterbehandling. Detta innebär att du ansvarar för all administration kring nämnd- och utskottsprocesserna, bland annat granskning av tjänsteskrivelser, skapande av kallelse, protokollföring under sammanträden och skapande av protokoll. Du registrerar nämndens ärenden i vårt ärende-och dokumenthanteringssystem samt är länken mellan tjänstemännen och politiken och har dagligen kommunikation med handläggarna och våra förtroendevalda.
   

  

 Du stöttar tjänstemännen i skapandet av tjänsteskrivelser och i nämndprocessen.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig med för tjänsten lämplig utbildning och erfarenhet, till exempel socionom, jurist eller statsvetare.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete i en politiskt styrd organisation och/eller arbetat inom socialtjänstens område antingen direkt mot klienter eller som nämndsekreterare. Det är också meriterande om du har hanterat sekretessärenden förut och har kännedom om SoL och LSS. Erfarenhet av rollen som sekreterare med kunskap om sammanträdesteknik och protokollskrivande är ett krav. Är du intresserad av utredningsarbete är det ett plus.
   

  

 Som person är du van att ta initiativ och involvera de personer som behövs i de olika processerna. Du ska kunna arbeta självständigt men också ha en god samarbetsförmåga och visa tillit till dina kollegor. Arbetet involverar många personer det är viktigt att ha ett nära samarbete med både handläggare och förvaltningschefer. Att ge mycket god service är viktigt för dig. För att hålla ihop arbetet inom dessa områden krävs en problemlösande analysförmåga. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.
   

  

**Tillträde**
 Vi har behov av att tillsätta tjänsten omgående och ser därför gärna att du kan påbörja anställningen så snart som möjligt. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.
   

  

**Omfattning:** 
 Heltid
   

  

**Anställningsform:** 
 Visstid vikariat
   

  

 Så tar du dig till Ekerö kommun
   

  

**Om Ekerö kommun**
 Vi är en mängd olika verksamheter som tillsammans skapar en unik kommun – där vi alla hjälps åt över enhets- och verksamhetsgränser.
   

  

 Vi lever vår värdegrund som innebär ett stort engagemang, god kommunikation med öppen dialog och ett professionellt förhållningssätt. Som en mindre kommun i stockholmsregionen kan vi både erbjuda närhet till varandra och en ambitiös utvecklingsresa. För att bli en kommun i framkant behöver vi fylla på med nya perspektiv, och vi hoppas att du vill vara med och bidra med dina.
   

  

 Ekerö kommun vill vara en attraktiv arbetsgivare och strävar efter ett tydligt fokus på hållbarhet. Under förutsättning att verksamhetens möjlighet att uppfylla sina mål kvarstår, har kommunen en positiv inställning till distansarbete när så är möjligt.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder t.ex. friskvårdsbidrag, löneväxling till pension, växling av semesterdagstillägg till lediga dagar och rökfri arbetstid.
   

  

 För att kvalitetssäkra vår rekryteringsprocess ber vi dig att skicka in ansökan digitalt, och inte via e-post eller post.
   

  

 Vi har redan tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring och vill inte ha kontakt med mediasäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

title: Inbound Sales Representative
description:
**Inbound Sales Representative at atNorth**
 atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.
   

  

 With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.
   

  

 Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.
   

  

 We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.
   

  

 By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.
   

  

**Inbound Sales Representative at atNorth**
 This role is positioned at the center of our inbound commercial flow, acting as the first point of contact for new opportunities and playing a key role in ensuring a structured, efficient, and scalable sales process. You will enable the broader Sales organization to focus on larger and more complex deals, while independently managing smaller, standardized opportunities.
   

  

 You will be responsible for qualifying inbound leads and leading sales opportunities up to a defined size, using standardized solutions, pricing, and agreements. The role requires a combination of commercial understanding, structured execution, and strong communication skills.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
 A key focus of the role is to ensure a fast, consistent, and high-quality handling of inbound opportunities. You will assess and qualify leads, manage standardized proposal processes, and ensure efficient handover across the organization.
   

  

 You will be responsible for initial qualification of all inbound opportunities in accordance with atNorth’s qualification framework and dispatch relevant opportunities to the appropriate Sales representatives based on customer segment and scope.
   

  

 You will own the full proposal process for smaller colocation opportunities, utilizing predefined templates, solutions, and pricing models to ensure efficiency and quick turnaround times. This includes managing client communication throughout the bid process, clarifying requirements, presenting solutions, and addressing any questions.
   

  

 From a commercial and contractual perspective, you will adapt standard colocation agreements within predefined thresholds, ensuring alignment with atNorth’s pricing policies and deal structures.
   

  

 Beyond execution, you will ensure proper documentation of all proposals and customer interactions, manage contract closure, and drive the formal handover to Operations and Finance.
   

  

 You will also contribute to continuous improvement of the standardized bid process and support outbound initiatives, including targeted outreach and preparation of sales materials in collaboration with the high-density colocation team.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who thrives in a structured sales environment and enjoys working with standardized solutions while maintaining a strong customer focus.
   

  

**Your profile**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar
* Minimum 2 years of experience working with customer contracts within IT, infrastructure, or real estate
* Experience with digital sales, inbound handling, or standardized solution selling is an advantage
* Strong digital understanding, including experience with IT systems, platforms, and AI tools
* Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken


 You are detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality outputs. You are a quick learner with a strong ability to work with new systems and tools, and you bring a service-minded and responsive approach to your work. You are able to work under pressure, manage multiple tasks, and meet tight deadlines while maintaining a strong commercial mindset.
   

  

**Decision-making & impact**
 You will have responsibility for managing and closing standardized proposal processes within defined commercial frameworks and authority limits. You will operate in accordance with atNorth’s Bid Process, Sales Strategy, and Delegation of Authority, while actively contributing to improving how we manage and scale smaller colocation opportunities.
   

  

**About The AtNorth Culture**
 We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.
   

  

 We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.
   

  

 We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging.
   

  

 At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.
   

  

 #99

title: Channel & System Integrator Account Manager
description:
