With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Channel & System Integrator Account Manager drives sustainable sales growth through Rockwell Automation's ecosystem of Distributors and System Integrators. You will develop and execute market access strategies, partner enablement plans, and commercial initiatives that increase market share, expand the installed base, and improve sales coverage across a defined territory.
   

  

 You will be a trusted business advisor to partners and work with Rockwell Automation sales teams to align resources, identify growth opportunities, and accelerate results. You will combine commercial accountability with partner development responsibilities to ensure long-term, scalable growth through indirect sales channels.
   

  

 Reporting to the Territory Sales Manager, and based in Sweden, the Channel & System Integrator Account Manager is responsible for coaching, enabling, and developing Distributors and System Integrators to increase demand generation, pipeline creation, and revenue growth.
   

  

 You will be the primary commercial interface between Rockwell Automation and ecosystem partners, ensuring execution of business plans, commercial programs, go-to-market initiatives, and strategic growth objectives. Through regular partner engagement, joint customer visits, opportunity reviews, and sales coaching, you will help partners strengthen their market position while increasing Rockwell Automation market share.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Coach and develop Distributors and System Integrators to grow their business
* Conduct joint customer visits and support opportunity development
* Drive sales through partners while maintaining pipeline and forecast ownership
* Participate in the full sales cycle
* Own and execute commercial programs and strategic initiatives
* Collaborate across internal sales, technical and business teams
* Formulate and execute territory-level partner growth strategies
* Drive partner enablement, onboarding, certifications and best-practice sharing
* Review partner performance and develop joint action plans
* Monitor sales performance and provide strategic and tactical recommendations.


**The Essentials - You Will Have**
* Experience in sales, channel management, partner management or business development
* Experience with industrial operations, automation or manufacturing environments
* 3+ years of experience working with distributors and system integrators
* Commercial acumen and forecasting discipline


**The Preferred - You Might Also Have**
* Manage stakeholders across a matrix organization
* Experience establishing communication and engagement with prospects


**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* On-demand digital course library for professional development.
* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Thesis Worker - Digital Factory (layout planning)
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Are you passionate about optimization and smart manufacturing? At Scania, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the next generation of digital factory planning by developing innovative optimization solutions that improve material flow, workplace efficiency, and factory layout design.In this master's thesis, you will explore how Plan for Every Part (PFEP) data can be leveraged to jointly optimize line-side material presentation and factory layouts within a virtual production environment. Working on a real industrial challenge, you will develop and evaluate advanced optimization methods that support data-driven decision making across production and logistics operations.This thesis offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a global manufacturing company while building valuable connections for your future career.
   

  

**Job** 
**Responsibilities**
 As part of this thesis project, you will:
   

  

  

* Review existing PFEP-based rack generation solutions and layout optimization frameworks.
* Formulate a station- or area-level multi-objective optimization problem.
* Design, implement, and evaluate suitable optimization algorithms and methodologies.
* Optimize the configuration and positioning of line-side resources, including racks, shelves, and material presentation solutions.
* Consider real-world constraints such as geometry, package fit, accessibility, and material flow requirements.
* Assess objectives including: Worker well-being and ergonomics, Material flow efficiency, Walking distance reduction, Logistics handling performance, Area utilization, Reconfiguration effort
* Compare optimized solutions against a PFEP baseline using industrial case studies.
* Evaluate solution quality, robustness, and computational performance.
* Develop structured and traceable PFEP change proposals for resource relocation, rack reconfiguration, and article reassignment.


**Who You Are**
 We are looking for one or two highly motivated Master's students who are eager to apply analytical thinking and optimization techniques to real-world manufacturing challenges.
   

  

 You are currently pursuing a Master's degree in:
   

  

  

* Applied Mathematics
* Industrial Engineering
* Computer Science
* Artificial Intelligence
* Production Engineering
* Or a related field


 Additionally, you have:
   

  

  

* A strong interest in optimization, operations research, algorithms, simulation, or industrial AI.
* Programming skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.
* Strong analytical and quantitative abilities.
* An interest in manufacturing, logistics, and digitalization.
* The ability to work independently while collaborating with experts across disciplines.


**T** 
**his Is Us**
 At Scania, we are driving the transformation towards sustainable transport solutions. By combining engineering excellence, digital innovation, and a strong focus on continuous improvement, we create products and production systems that make a real difference.The department behind this thesis is developing the digital capabilities needed to enable future factory planning. Through the use of PFEP data, virtual factory environments, and advanced optimization techniques, we are building smarter and more connected production systems.Many of our employees started their Scania journey through a thesis project. This is your opportunity to gain valuable industry experience, collaborate with experienced professionals, and contribute to solutions that have a direct impact on our operations.
   

  

**Scania Offers**
 We offer a dynamic, flexible workplace with hybrid work options, including Scania Sergel and Midway hubs. With a structured development plan and courses, Scania supports your career growth both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include training at our health center Gröndal or wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible hours, and company car leasing. Scania also hosts events for employees and their families, and Stockholm residents enjoy direct access to Södertälje via Scania Job express buses.
   

  

**Application**
 Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-08. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
   

  

 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
   

  

 Andreas Lind, andreas.lind@scania.com
   

  

 We look forward to your application!

title: Drivna arkivassistenter
description:
Nu söker vi drivna och strukturerade arkivassistenter. Har du liknande erfarenhet och vill arbeta med uppgifter som säkerställer att vi bidrar till att göra Sverige och världen säkrare? Då kan du vara den vi letar efter.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Som arkivassistent arbetar du i vårat centralarkiv och i tjänsten ingår arbete i såväl digitala som fysiska arkiv. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår bland annat att plocka ut handlingar från arkiv, insortera inkommande handlingar, ordna och förteckna arkiv samt att rensa och gallra handlingar. Bitvis är arbetsuppgifterna repetitiva men här finns också möjlighet att vara med och utveckla hur vi arbetar med informationsförvaltning och arkiv. I rollen ger du även stöd och rådgivning inom informationsförvaltningsområdet till handläggare i organisationen och hanterar förfrågningar inom myndigheten. Som arkivassistent förekommer det också att du stöttar registratorsfunktionen med diverse arbetsuppgifter, t.ex. posthantering, diarieföring och hantering av ärenden via mail.
   

  

 Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Vi söker dig som har gymnasiekompetens samt aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av arbete som arkivassistent alternativt annan erfarenhet av administration och informationshantering. Du har också God kunskap i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift samt goda kunskaper i Microsoft Office.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du har utbildning inom offentlighets - och sekretesslagen, förvaltningslagen och arkivlagen. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av arbete som arkivassistent eller liknande i offentlig förvaltning. Har du tidigare erfarenhet av arbete i diarieföringssystem, förteckningssystem och digitala arkiv samt erfarenhet av arbete i verksamhet som omfattas av offentlighets - och sekretesslagen, förvaltningslagen och arkivlagen ser vi även det som en fördel.
   

  

 Personliga egenskaper är av stor vikt för oss. Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter och söker dig som trivs med att arbeta med andra och har god samarbetsförmåga.
   

  

 Vi ser också att du är strukturerad, kvalitetsmedveten och initiativtagande för att passa i rollen.
   

  

**FMV – Försvarets materielverk**
 På FMV är du med och bidrar till att göra Sverige och världen säkrare. Vi har i uppdrag att förse det svenska försvaret med den senaste tekniken och kunskapen så att de kan försvara vårt land och våra allierade. Tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor får du vara med och utveckla och upphandla det som ibland inte existerar än. Du driver utvecklingen, hela vägen från behov till leverans. Från idé till verklighet.
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta på infrastrukturstaben som ansvarar för IT, lokaler och annan verksamhetskritisk infrastruktur som möjliggör ett effektivt och säkert arbete.
   

  

 Hos FMV erbjuds du en trygg anställning med bra förmåner:
   

  

* Kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter
* Tjänstepension och friskvårdsbidrag


 Läs mer om FMV som arbetsgivare och om de förmåner vi erbjuder på vår hemsida: Arbeta på FMV.
   

  

 Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens försvar? Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 15 oktober 2026.
   

  

**Bra att veta**
* Du ansöker genom att bifoga ditt CV, betyg och intyg på svenska.
* I ditt CV beskriver du tydligt på vilket sätt du uppfyller efterfrågade kvalifikationer och meriter. För att skapa en mer inkluderande rekryteringsprocess ber vi dig att inte skicka personligt brev eller inkludera bild i ditt CV.
* Vi rekryterar kompetensbaserat och bedömer kandidater utifrån rollens krav på erfarenhet, kunskap och personliga egenskaper.
* Våra fackliga företrädare är SACO-S Stefan Hållander, OFR/S Lena Sköld Gunnarsson, OFR/O Ann-Carol Wallgren Falk och SEKO Peter Andersson. Alla nås på telefon 08-782 40 00 (FMV Växel). Alla nås via FMV:s växel: 08-782 4000.
* Vid frågor om tjänsten kan du kontakta Marie Näslund på telefon 08-782 40 00 (FMV Växel) eller via Marie.Naslund@fmv.se. Kontakta Emma Hellström på emma.hellstrom@fmv.se vid frågor om rekryteringsprocessen.


 För att jobba hos oss behöver du vara svensk medborgare och genomgå en säkerhetsprövning i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen. Vi tillämpar provanställning och som anställd kommer du att krigsplaceras utifrån totalförsvarets behov. Ansökningar till befattningen tas endast emot via FMV:s webbplats eller registratur. Vi har gjort vårt medieval och undanber oss därför försäljning av annons- och rekryteringstjänster.

title: Director Project Control
description:
**Project Controls Lead | Sweden | Data Centres** 




  





 One of the Nordics’ most ambitious emerging data centre businesses is entering a significant new phase of growth.
 



  





 Founded by six highly respected leaders from across the Nordic data centre industry, the business has now secured funding to support its next stage of development, with an ambitious pipeline of opportunities progressing across the region.
 



  





 As the business continues to build its senior delivery capability, we are looking for an experienced
 **Project Controls Lead** 
 , based in Sweden (with travel to Norway and other sites), to take ownership of project controls across major data centre developments and help build the function as the organisation scales.
 



  





 This is an opportunity to join at a genuinely formative point.
 



  





 Initially, there will be a strong focus on
 **planning and scheduling** 
 , establishing robust programmes, challenging delivery schedules and providing the visibility needed to drive successful project execution.
 



  





 However, the opportunity is considerably broader than that.
 



  





 You will have the opportunity to help shape and develop the wider project controls capability, bringing together
 **planning, cost, risk, change, forecasting and reporting** 
 to create a consistent controls framework across the business and its growing Nordic portfolio.
 



  





 Working closely with Project Directors, the founders and wider leadership team, you will also become involved early in
 **preconstruction, bids and tenders** 
 , helping assess programmes, delivery strategies, risk and project viability before projects move into execution.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Take ownership of project controls across major data centre developments.
* Lead the development, management and challenge of detailed project programmes and integrated master schedules.
* Establish project controls processes, standards, reporting and governance as the business grows.
* Provide clear visibility of programme performance, critical path, milestones, dependencies and emerging risks.
* Work closely with Project Directors and delivery teams to identify delays, constraints and recovery strategies.
* Challenge contractor and subcontractor programmes and ensure alignment with the overall project schedule.
* Develop the wider controls capability across cost, forecasting, risk, change and reporting.
* Support preconstruction, bids and tenders with programme development, sequencing, risk analysis and delivery planning.
* Work across CSA, MEP, procurement, commercial and commissioning teams to ensure fully integrated project controls.
* Help build and develop the project controls team as the portfolio expands.
* Provide clear, accurate reporting and insight to senior leadership and key project stakeholders.



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



 You will need significant experience within
 **project controls, planning or scheduling on large scale data centre or mission critical projects** 
 , with a strong understanding of complex construction programmes and how they translate into successful project delivery.
 



  





 You may currently be operating as a
 **Lead Scheduler, Planning Lead, Project Controls Manager or Project Controls Lead** 
 , but importantly, you will be looking for the opportunity to take on broader ownership and help build a function.
 



  





 Strong planning and scheduling capability is essential, ideally with advanced experience of
 **Primavera P6 and/or Safran** 
 , alongside an understanding of cost, risk, change, forecasting and project reporting.
 



  





 You will be commercially aware, comfortable challenging senior contractors and project stakeholders, and able to turn complex project information into clear insight for leadership.
 



 Just as importantly, this role will suit somebody who wants to
 **build, shape and influence** 
 , rather than simply inherit an established controls function.
 



  





 You will need to be
 **based in Sweden, or genuinely able to relocate** 
 .
 



  





 Why Join?
 



 This is an opportunity to join an ambitious Nordic data centre business at the point where
 **funding, pipeline and delivery are coming together** 
 .
 



 You will work closely with an exceptionally experienced founding and project leadership team, have visibility across the wider business and become involved considerably earlier than project execution alone.
 



  





 Most importantly, there is the opportunity to
 **build the project controls capability as the organisation scales** 
 . What begins with strong ownership of planning and scheduling has the potential to develop into a much broader leadership position across the controls function.
 



  





 For somebody who wants to move beyond simply managing a programme and have a genuine influence on
 **how projects and ultimately an entire portfolio are controlled and delivered** 
 , this is a particularly exciting opportunity.
 



  





**For a confidential discussion, please get in touch.**

title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

title: Release Coordinator
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.


We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.


Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.


Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

### **The Role**


We are expanding the Release Team to support an evolving deployment pipeline as we scale toward 8 production releases per week across international markets. As a Release Coordinator / Officer, you will play a central operational role in managing production environments and deployment lifecycles for code that powers our core International Business engine.


This role bridges release operations with internal tool engineering, shifting away from legacy terminal-based deployment scripts toward modern, automated deployment platforms. You will work closely with Release Management, Platform Services, DBA, and DevOps teams to maintain high availability, orchestrate hotfixes, and handle deployment pipelines.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Release Operations & Monitoring: Coordinate, approve, and execute production deployments across the IBE release train. Monitor business-critical release channels and maintain deployment guardrails.
* Incident & Hotfix Management: Handle urgent hotfix, bugfix, and delayed-picking requests; maintain operational readiness to manage production rollbacks and mitigate incident risks.
* Tool Development & Automation: Assist in building and maintaining internal deployment applications, replacing terminal-based processes by integrating Jenkins, release collectors, and internal developer tools.
* Cross-Team Collaboration: Facilitate communication between Development, Platform Services, Database (DBA), and Deployment (DO) teams to ensure seamless releases.
* Documentation & Metrics: Maintain release notes, manage Jira deployment flows, and contribute to Incident Post-Mortem reviews.

### **Requirements**

* Strong technical background with direct experience in the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, Jira).
* Developer-platform hybrid skillset capable of writing scripts and contributing to internal developer tooling.
* Proven ability to perform under pressure with a calm, analytical mindset during live production incidents.
* Excellent cross-functional communication skills in English to align technical teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders.

**Meritorious**

* Prior hands-on experience as a Release Officer or within the IBE release ecosystem.
* Familiarity with Docker, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), or database script execution.
* Experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).

**Employment Structure:**


50% to 100% Allocation


Initial Onboarding & Integration (First 9 Months): 100% Full-Time Commitment


Ongoing Role: Flexible allocation (a minimum of 50%) based on team needs and candidate capacity.

##### **Diversity disclaimer**

*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.* *During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.*

description:

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

As a Data Scientist, you will support product development from idea generation to production transfer. In this role you will help to discover, design, and implement scientific workflows and data-driven use cases across R&D, including development of data pipelines, advanced analytics, and AI/ML solutions. This role sits at the intersection of science, data engineering, and data science, working closely with researchers, domain experts, and platform teams to turn experimental data into reliable, reusable, and scalable assets.

  

You will play a key role throughout the full lifecycle of scientific use cases, from early discovery and feasibility assessment, through design and proof-of-concept, to production-grade implementation and adoption. Perform data analysis, troubleshoot development projects, and develop, implement, and tune predictive models.

 **What You'll Do :**

* Support experimental design (DoE) and planning
* Drive and foster a data-driven culture within R&D
* Work with R&D SMEs to understand scientific workflows and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and AI/ML
* Design and document maintainable solutions and data flows in collaboration with stakeholders and IT architects
* Develop applications, tools, and interfaces that help researchers access, visualize, and analyze data efficiently
* Support production deployment, monitoring, and operation with IT, DevOps, and platform teams
* Document and present results clearly, both orally and in writing
* Identify and implement relevant new techniques while following technical developments in the field

 **Who you are:**

* Master's degree in a technical discipline with expert competency in data science/data engineering/bioinformatics or equal experience
* Proficient in Python, comfortable with R
* Proficient in explorative data analysis, cleaning, and transformation
* Experience with modern AI/ML techniques
* Experience in the SQL language and databases
* Experience with solutions for data management
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and Azure) and their data services
* Knowledge of version control/Git
* Well versed in multivariate statistics and predictive modelling .

* Experience with image analysis and/or computer vision
* Experience with protein/DNA sequence alignment methodologies
* Experience in Design of Experiments (DoE)
* Experience with Web development
* Experience with DevOps and CI/CD
* Practical wet lab experience and experience with analytical chemistry

  

This is an onsite role and we therefore see that you who apply are resident in Uppsala or a nearby area with the flexibility to commute from our site on a daily basis

  

Interviews and selection will take place on an ongoing basis, so please do not wait to submit your application to us.


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.


For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

description:
**Job Description** **Hej QA Engineering Leader,**

**Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?**


With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilites, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our QA Engineering Leader, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

 **Your new job**


We’re looking for a QA Engineering Leader who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on leading and continuously refining the quality and test automation approach within Range experience together with the other Software Engineering Leaders and Specialists.


You will also be sharing your work in the wider Range Areas and you’ll report to the Quality Platform QA Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world.


On a typical day, you will:

* Develop QA test plans and define acceptance criteria for both built and purchased software solutions.
* Plan, coordinate, and lead QA activities to ensure testing is executed effectively and delivered on time.
* Coach and mentor members of digital product teams on QA frameworks, methodologies, and best practices.
* Drive clarity, consistency, and quality in requirements across product and platform teams.
* Champion test data creation, mocking, and test automation as the preferred testing approach, always balancing cost, value, and efficiency.
* Provide coaching and constructive feedback to engineering and platform communities to strengthen quality practices and a quality-first mindset.
* Collaborate closely with engineering and platform leaders to ensure features are implemented with quality assurance built into the delivery process.
* Support product and platform teams in working in a decoupled way to improve software quality and enable effective interface-level testing.
* Act as the subject matter expert on specialist QA disciplines such as performance testing, penetration testing, and high-availability assurance when needed.
* Support Engineering Managers in follow-ups, reviews, and quality discussions with consultancy partners.

As a person you see the joy of sharing your knowledge and experience with your colleagues across different teams. Being curious and innovative is at the core of everything you do, and you know that making mistakes sometimes is part of your own development and learning journey.


You bring extensive experience and knowledge in software development and are fully familiar with agile/DevOps practices and tooling, and how the quality aspect is an integrated part of the development. Ideally, you have experience in building test automation frameworks and building their usage in an organization of cross-functional product teams.


You are an experienced leader with the ability to coach our product teams, testers and developers alike around test automation as an integrated part in software development, helping to ensure that we use our resources in the best way to achieve the strongest outcome.


You enjoy an agile, iterative and structured way of working and achieving results together with a team in a flexible environment but also have a strong individual drive to deliver high-quality results on time. You have great communication and networking skills and are fluent in written and spoken English.


The role as a QA Engineering Leader requires you to:

* Hold a degree in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience.

* Have at least 5 years of hands-on experience working with QA processes, testing methodologies, and QA tooling.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of modern digital product development principles, including aligned autonomy, Conway’s Law, product decomposition, DevOps, automation, blue-green deployments, and automated regression testing.

* Using Sentry, Splunk or similar tools for monitoring and real-time error tracking
* Procurement processes and quality assurance of off-the-shelf or SaaS solutions.
* Non-functional requirement (NFR) quality assurance and performance testing practices.

 **Qualifications** **What we’d like you to bring to the table**


As a 3D Platform Engineer, you combine strong software engineering with practical knowledge of 3D data, pipelines, and runtime needs. You can work across the full flow—from CAD and PLM sources to optimized assets and scalable services. You should also bring:

* A strong understanding of computer graphics, real-time and offline rendering, and production-ready 3D asset pipelines.
* Hands-on experience developing software products for 3D, computer graphics, or VFX workflows.
* Knowledge of product-development workflows from CAD tools such as Revit, SolidWorks, or CATIA through digital content creation, visualization, and rendering.
* Understanding of asset creation, materials, texturing, lighting, rigging, and scene composition; experience with OpenUSD, MaterialX, or glTF is a plus.
* A platform and DevOps mindset, with experience building, operating, and improving business-critical services in an agile environment.
* A degree in computer science, media technology, digital media, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong C++ skills, including native SDK integration, performance profiling, debugging, and maintainable adapters for third-party libraries.
* Practical knowledge of CAD data, assembly structures, exact geometry, tessellation, and conversion to polygonal meshes in a PLM or PDM context.
* Experience with mesh repair, topology, normals, tangents, UVs, materials, instancing, simplification, and automated LOD generation—balancing fidelity with file size, processing time, memory, and rendering performance.


Our technology landscape includes Azure, Terraform, Docker, OpenAPI, Three.js, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++, Python, MongoDB, Neo4j, PLM platforms, CAD and geometry SDKs, and mesh-processing libraries. You do not need to know them all- curiosity and a willingness to learn matter just as much.


It’s a plus if you also bring:

* Experience with enterprise PLM or PDM platforms, CAD translation, or geometry SDKs.
* Experience with mesh-processing or optimization libraries and open 3D formats such as OpenUSD or glTF.

 **Additional Information** **Be yourself, a 3D Platform Engineer, and more!**


Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.


Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

 **We welcome your application**


Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 15th of October.


This is a full-time position located in Malmö (Hyllie). We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important. If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruiter vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com If you have questions about the position, please contact the hiring manager taco.van.der.maden1@inter.ikea.com.


At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.


If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

*We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.*

title: Systemtekniker med DevOps-profil
description:
**Systemtekniker med DevOps profil** 




 Säkerhetspolisen arbetar för att skydda den nationella säkerheten, det demokratiska systemet samt medborgarnas fri- och rättigheter. Vi söker personer som bidrar med kompletterande perspektiv, kunskaper och erfarenheter som sammantaget gör oss bättre. Som medarbetare på Säkerhetspolisen kan du förvänta dig ett ledarskap som bygger på helhetssyn, handlingskraft, goda relationer och lärande.
 



  





 Vi behöver bli fler som vill bidra till att skydda Sverige och säkra framtiden för demokratin. Välkommen med din ansökan.
 



 Vårt uppdrag är Sveriges säkerhet.
 



  





 Ort: Stockholm
 



 Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-15
 



  





**Det här är ditt uppdrag** 




 På Säkerhetspolisen arbetar specialister, sakkunniga och samhällsintresserade. Vi vet att saker inte alltid är som de ser ut att vara vid första anblick. Det finns många olika yrken och kompetenser hos oss, och oavsett roll kommer du att samverka med och lära mycket av andra.
 



  





 I rollen som Systemtekniker med DevOps profil kommer du att ingå i ett team med helhetsansvar för integrationslösningar. I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår det att arbeta med kravinsamling, design, utveckling, test, dokumentation, drift, förvaltning och felsökning.
 



  





 Våra motståndare följer inte regler eller givna mönster. Därför tar vi ingenting för givet och förväntar oss det bästa från varandra, varje dag. Därför kommer din vardag att vara en kombination av arbetsuppgifter som är både händelsestyrda och planerade och rollen har flertalet olika kontaktytor såväl internt som externt.
 



  





 Dina insatser har stor betydelse för dina kollegor i den operativa verksamheten. Du kommer att hantera lösningarnas driftmiljö och säkerställa att de uppfyller höga tillgänglighets- och säkerhetskrav samt att de håller en hög grad av automatisering.
 



  





 Din placering är på huvudkontoret i Solna och arbetet utförs på plats, vilket innebär att du inte har möjlighet att arbeta på distans. Resor inom och utanför Sverige kan förekomma.
 



  





  





**De här kvalifikationerna söker vi hos dig** 




  





 Det är endast du som uppfyller nedanstående krav som kan bli aktuell för tjänsten.
 



  





**Krav:** 



* Akademisk examen eller yrkeshögskola inom it-området, alternativt motsvarande kunskap inhämtad genom arbetslivserfarenhet som Säkerhetspolisen bedömer som likvärdig.
* Minst två års erfarenhet som systemtekniker eller DevOps engineer som innefattar exempelvis applikationsdrift, CI/CD pipelines, uppgraderingar, felsökning av it-miljö och övervakning.
* God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift



  





 Anställningen kräver svenskt medborgarskap.
 



  





 Du som söker kan också ha kompetens som tillför bredd och kompletterande perspektiv. Kan du bidra med något eller flera av följande är det
 **meriterande** 
 :
 


* Erfarenhet av automation och skriptning i exempelvis bash, powershell eller yaml
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD pipelines
* Erfarenhet av serveradministration i Windows eller Linux
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i ett agilt team i nära samarbete med systemutvecklare
* Erfarenhet av behörighetsstyrning
* Erfarenhet av redundans, prestanda och integration som en del av applikationsdrift
* Erfarenhet av applikationstestning
* Erfarenhet av arbete i en organisation med höga säkerhetskrav



  





  





**Det här är kollegan vi söker** 




 Du arbetar med ett stort egenansvar i en verksamhet som växlar mellan att vara planerad och händelsestyrd, där särskilda händelser inträffar och ställer krav på din förmåga att vara flexibel.
 



 Din höga grad av struktur hjälper dig i dina dagliga arbetsuppgifter. Din förmåga att balansera gott omdöme, ansvarskänsla och säkerhetstänk underlättar dina prioriteringar och beslut.
 



  





 Du kommer att ställas inför utmaningar och vi välkomnar såväl ditt driv, initiativförmåga samt din konstruktiva problemlösning.
 



  





 Då rollen har flertalet olika sociala kontaktytor är det viktigt att du har en god kommunikationsförmåga samt är bekväm med att såväl initiera som upprätthålla goda kontakter och relationer över tid.
 



  





 Säkerhetspolisen ställer höga krav på säkerhet och sekretess, därför förutsätter vi att du har ett högt säkerhetsmedvetande.
 



  





**Anställningsvillkor och förmåner** 




 Anställning vid Säkerhetspolisen innebär inplacering i säkerhetsklass som kräver svenskt medborgarskap. För anställning krävs också godkänt resultat i säkerhetsprövningen med registerkontroll, som genomförs i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen.
 



  





 Det här är en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras.
 



  





 På vår hemsida, www.sakerhetspolisen.se, kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss samt om våra förmåner.
 



  





**Så tar du kontakt med oss** 




 För information om rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta ansvarig rekryterare, tfn 070-860 81 75
 



 Fackliga företrädare: Polisförbundet, tfn 010-568 70 03, SACO, tfn 010-568 70 04 och ST, tfn 010-568 70 02.
 



  





**Så ansöker du** 




 Ansökan sker via vår hemsida, www.sakerhetspolisen.se
 



 Ansökan ska ha kommit in senast
 **2026-10-15** 




  





**Urvalsfrågor** 
 : Ansök genom att bifoga ditt CV (i den här rekryteringsprocessen önskar vi inget personligt brev) och besvara urvalsfrågorna nedan. Frågorna utgår från kravprofilen för den här rekryteringen och dina svar ligger till grund för det urval som sker i processen. Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett. Det är därför viktigt att du svarar tydligt och utförligt på frågorna och inte hänvisar till andra handlingar t.ex. CV.
 



  





**Vänligen bifoga ett separat dokument (pdf eller word) med svar på urvalsfrågorna nedan som du skickar in i samband med din ansökan.** 




 Urvalsfrågor:
 


1. Har du svenskt medborgarskap?
2. Har du akademisk examen eller yrkeshögskola inom it-området, alternativt motsvarande kunskap inhämtad genom arbetslivserfarenhet som Säkerhetspolisen bedömer som likvärdig? Om ja, vänligen beskriv din utbildning eller erfarenhet.
3. Har du minst två års erfarenhet som systemtekniker eller DevOps engineer som innefattar exempelvis applikationsdrift, CI/CD pipelines, uppgraderingar, felsökning av it-miljö och övervakning? Om ja, vänligen beskriv din erfarenhet.
4. Har du god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift? Om ja, vänligen beskriv din erfarenhet.
5. Har du erfarenhet av automation och skriptning i exempelvis bash, powershell eller yaml? Om ja, vänligen beskriv din erfarenhet.
6. Har du erfarenhet av CI/CD pipelines? Om ja, vänligen beskriv din erfarenhet
7. Har du erfarenhet av serveradministration i Windows eller Linux? Om ja, vänligen beskriv din erfarenhet.
8. Har du erfarenhet av att arbeta i ett agilt team i nära samarbete med systemutvecklare? Om ja, vänligen beskriv din erfarenhet.
9. Har du erfarenhet av behörighetsstyrning? Om ja, vänligen beskriv din erfarenhet
10. Har du erfarenhet av redundans, prestanda och integration som en del av applikationsdrift? Om ja, vänligen beskriv din erfarenhet.
11. Har du erfarenhet av applikationstestning? Om ja, vänligen beskriv din erfarenhet
12. Har du erfarenhet av arbete i en organisation med höga säkerhetskrav? Om ja, vänligen beskriv din erfarenhet.



  





 Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande.
 



  





**Övrig information** 




 Du bör inte berätta att du sökt tjänst hos Säkerhetspolisen för andra personer än dina närmast berörda. Det beror på att vi har tjänster som omfattas av sekretess.
 



 I våra rekryteringar använder vi arbetspsykologiska tester.
 



 Vi har redan gjort våra val av annonskanaler. Vi undanber oss därför samtal från rekryteringsföretag och annonsförsäljare.

title: PLATFORM ENGINEER TILL BANKGIROT
description:
**Vill du vara med och bygga en modern, container- och tooling-plattform som Sveriges betalflöden är beroende av – varje dag, i alla lägen?** 
**Hos Bankgirot får du arbeta med grunden för en modern och samhällsviktig betalinfrastruktur.**
 Bankgirot har sedan 1959 stått för den tekniska strukturen som binder samman Sveriges banker och säkerställer att betalningar fungerar tryggt och effektivt. Organisationen befinner sig i en omfattande modernisering där dagens system förvaltas parallellt med utvecklingen av en framtidssäkrad betalinfrastruktur med höga krav på säkerhet, stabilitet och tillgänglighet.
   

  

 Efter att ha stärkt teamet med två Platform Engineers söker Bankgirot nu en senior Platform Engineer som vill ta en nyckelroll i den fortsatta utvecklingen av den moderna container- och toolingplattform som utgör grunden för Sveriges framtida betalinfrastruktur.
   

  

 Hos Bankgirot får du
   

  

* Vara med och bygga en modern, open source-baserad plattform som är avgörande för Sveriges betalflöden
* Arbeta i gränslandet mellan infrastruktur, utveckling, säkerhet med cloud native-teknik
* Påverka arbetssätt, teknikval och arkitektur i en plattform ständigt under uppbyggnad
* Vara en del av en samhällsviktig verksamhet med höga krav på tillgänglighet, stabilitet och säkerhet


 Om rollen
   

  

 Som Platform Engineer ingår du i teamet
 **Cloud, Container, Platform & Tooling** 
 . Rollen innebär arbete i en redan produktionssatt plattform som utvecklas vidare mot en mer mogen, robust och lättkonsumerad lösning. Bankgirot äger och driftar själv sina plattformskomponenter, vilket ger stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka helheten. Du kommer att få arbeta i en modern teknikmiljö som inkluderar bland annat en containerplattform baserat på vanilla kubernetes omgiven av en service mesh, samt tooling bestående av GitLab, ArgoCD och Jfrog Artifactory & Xray.
   

  

**I rollen ingår att:**
* Designa, drifta och vidareutveckla containerplattformen, både on‑prem och i cloud
* Automatisera plattforms- och driftprocesser samt vidareutveckla CI/CD- och GitOps‑flöden
* Arbeta med verktyg som GitLab, ArgoCD och Ansible
* Samarbeta med användare kring onboarding, stöd och kontinuerlig förbättring av plattformen
* Samarbeta med säkerhets- och driftorganisationen för att säkerställa krav på tillgänglighet, prestanda och säkerhet
* Arbeta proaktivt med robusthet, observability, säkerhet och incidenthantering


 Vi vill att du
   

  

 Är T-formad med solid grund inom Linux och har vidareutvecklat din kompetens inom någon del av den moderna cloud native-världen. Oavsett om din spets ligger inom Kubernetes, CI/CD tooling, automation, observability eller säkerhet har du en naturlig nyfikenhet och vilja att fortsätta utvecklas.
   

  

* Har erfarenhet av containerteknik och CI/CD tooling i produktionsmiljö, on-prem eller cloud
* Vill ersätta varje manuellt flöde med automation
* Trivs i en dynamisk miljö under uppbyggnad och vill aktivt bidra till arkitektur, teknikval och plattformsutveckling, med ett pragmatiskt förhållningssätt och stark samarbetsförmåga


 Så arbetar vi tillsammans
   

  

 Hos Bankgirot arbetar man gärna tillsammans på kontoret – det stärker samarbete, lärande och den gemensamma kulturen. Här finns goda möjligheter att utvecklas i yrkesrollen och ta nästa steg över tid. Du erbjudes också förmåner som gör skillnad i vardagen, som eget gym, generöst friskvårdsbidrag, cykelförmån samt trygga pensions- och försäkringslösningar.
   

  

 Säkerhetsprövning
   

  

 För rollen genomförs säkerhetsprövning innan anställning i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) – en naturlig del av ansvaret att värna tryggheten i Sveriges betalsystem.
   

  

 Övrig information
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning baserad i Liljeholmen i Stockholm. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Du behöver ha goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.
   

  

 Intresserad?
   

  

 I denna rekrytering samarbetar Bankgirot med Nexer Recruit.
   

  

 Har du frågor eller funderingar? Kontakta gärna rekryteringskonsult Johanna Värmfors: johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com eller +46 730 821 230
   

  

 alternativt Jenny Nilsson: jenny.nilsson@nexergroup.com eller +46 (0)70 301 82 79.
   

  

 Läs om fler lediga tjänster från Bankgirot här.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

 Om Bankgirot
   

  

 Sedan starten 1959 har Bankgirot stått för den tekniska strukturen som binder samman Sveriges banker i det nationella betalsystemet. Företagets historia präglas av innovation, engagemang och stolthet över sitt samhällsviktiga uppdrag. Genom expertkunskap och en stark kultur arbetar man varje dag för att säkerställa att varje transaktion sker sömlöst och effektivt.
   

  

 Tillsammans med kunder och samarbetspartners skapas långsiktigt värde för marknaden och samhället. Som en förenande kraft formar Bankgirot en modern och framtidssäkrad svensk betalinfrastruktur. Bankgirot förenar, förvaltar och förnyar betalsverige.
   

  

 Läs mer på www.bankgirot.se

**Övriga krav**

**Vill du göra skillnad?**
 Om du söker en spännande och modern miljö där du kan ta stort ansvar och utvecklas tillsammans med engagerade kollegor, vill vi höra från dig. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och hur du passar in i vårt team.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
**About Keyfactor** 





 Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!
 




**Title** 
 : Senior Cloud Engineer
 



**Location** 
 : Stockholm, Sweden
 



**Experience** 
 : Senior
 



**Job Function** 
 : Cloud Operations 
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Full-Time
 



**Industry** 
 : Computer and Network Security 
 



**About the position**





 The Senior Cloud Engineer designs, implements, and evolves complex cloud infrastructure and automation solutions with a high degree of autonomy. This role owns systems and solutions that have significant impact on service reliability, security posture, and operational scalability. Senior Cloud Engineers act as technical leaders within the team, contributing to standards, mentoring peers, and supporting cross-functional initiatives.
 




**The position can based in our Stockholm, we follow a hybrid work model with excellent flexible working practices. Applicants must hold a valid Right to Work in Sweden.**

  
 




**Responsibilities**




**Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**



* Owns and evolves complex Infrastructure as Code solutions across the cloud environment
* Makes independent design decisions within established architectural standards
* Delivers improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, and team efficiency
* Provides technical guidance and review for less senior engineers



**Configuration**



* Designs and maintains complex configuration management solutions
* Defines configuration patterns and best practices used across the environment
* Reviews and guides configuration work performed by other engineers



**Data Center Operations**



* Maintains an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all physical hardware within the data center, such as HSMs, USBs, Smartcards, SSDs and Shock-Proof cases. Informs supervisor when certain materials are running low.
* Maintains detailed records of all data center operation activities, including changes to tamper evident bag numbers, incidents, and access to client materials. Follows proper procedures on strict guidelines for Root Signings, Disaster Recovery, CRLs and CSR signings. Ensures proper asset disposal procedures are followed.
* Is able to follow documented procedures on how to properly handle sophisticated hardware security modules and KVM devices. Can perform configurations of the hardware security module and KVM with supervision from more senior peers.



**Task Automation**



* Designs and builds advanced automation solutions using scripting, APIs, and Azure-native services
* Drives automation initiatives that improve operational consistency and efficiency
* Supports process improvement through tooling and automation



**Networking**



* Designs and implements cloud networking solutions within approved security and compliance constraints
* Applies deep knowledge of networking protocols and standards to support hosted services
* Participates in compliance audits and provides technical input



**Monitoring & Alerting**



* Defines
 

 and improves monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies
* Ensures monitoring logic supports service reliability and rapid incident detection
* Mentors peers on monitoring best practices



**Patch Management**



* Leads patch management strategies and execution
* Resolves escalated patching issues and drives process improvements
* Contributes to the evolution of patching standards and practices



**PKI Knowledge**



* Applies strong understanding of PKI concepts in support of customer and hosted environments
* Performs PKI tasks for custom deployments
* Contributes to strategy and design discussions for hosted PKI services
* Produces technical documentation for PKI designs and processes
* Participates in cross-functional certificate reviews



**Product Knowledge**



* Serves as a subject matter expert on Keyfactor’s hosted products
* Troubleshoots complex product issues across hosted environments
* Participates in strategy and design discussions for new product offerings
* Supports testing of new product versions and provides feedback to product teams
* Interfaces with customers on hosted architecture and security posture when required



**Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills**



* High School Diploma or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of related work experience and strong knowledge within their functional area
* Expert-level knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including native services and tooling
* Deep hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management tools
* Advanced proficiency in PowerShell scripting (high complexity)
* Extensive experience with Windows systems administration, including Windows Roles & Features
   

 and Active Directory
* Advanced problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional demeanor
* Strong organizational, time-management, and attention-to-detail skills
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively within and across cross-functional teams
* Self-motivated, able to manage complex work and projects to completion with minimal oversight
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment



**Travel Requirements**



* Up to 15% travel time required



  
 





**Compensation** 




 Salary will be commensurate with experience.  
 



**Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits** 




 We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas.  
 



 Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:   
 


* Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.

* Competitive time off globally.

* DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
* The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
* Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
* Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
* Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
* Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.



**Our Core Values** 




 Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:
 



**Trust** 
**is paramount.** 
  
 



*We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.* 




**Customers** 
**are core.** 
  
 



*We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.* 




**Innovation** 
**never stops, it only accelerates.** 
  
 



*The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.* 




**We deliver with** 
**agility** 
**.** 
  
 



*We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.* 
  
 



**United by** 
**respect** 
**.** 
  
 



*Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.*

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About the role** 




 We're looking for hands-on Fullstack Developers to join our mission of building the next generation of our B2B freight platform. As part of our ambitious tech team you'll work within a team led by a tech lead, collaborating closely with product owners, QAs, UX, and fellow developers to deliver scalable, reliable and user-focused solutions that create real value for our customers.
 



 In this role you'll take ownership of end-to-end development, from backend services and APIs to frontend experiences, and play a key part in delivering and improving our platform. You'll join a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, collaboration and clean engineering are what move us forward.
 



 This is a role for someone who enjoys building, iterating and solving real problems, not just talking about them.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Play a central role in designing, building, and shaping our new platform
* Develop scalable and efficient solutions using TypeScript and Node.js
* Design and implement REST APIs to power our platform's core features
* Work with modern frontend frameworks to deliver smooth user experiences
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality solutions
* Build automated tests to ensure performance, reliability and maintainability
* Contribute to technical discussions and help drive engineering best practices
* Stay on top of modern technologies and identify opportunities to improve our stack



  





**About you** 




 You're an experienced fullstack engineer who has worked effectively within teams and takes pride in delivering real value, not just shipping code. You thrive in a collaborative environment and aren't afraid to take ownership. You value simplicity, clean code and real impact. You enjoy working across the stack, are comfortable making sound technical decisions within an established architecture and take pride in delivering high quality solutions.
 



 You communicate clearly, enjoy working with others and are motivated by seeing your work make a difference, for both users and the team.
 



  





**We're looking for someone who has:** 



* A completed three-year bachelor's degree or a five-year master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Science or a related technical field
* At least 4 years of professional software development experience
* Recent, hands-on experience building and owning backend services in a typed language — TypeScript, C#, Java, Go or similar
* Professional experience with TypeScript/JavaScript
* Strong backend proficiency, ideally with Node.js and Express.js
* Experience designing and implementing REST APIs
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS)
* Experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Svelte, Angular, Vue)
* Practical experience with SQL and NoSQL databases



  





**High value if you also bring:** 



* Production observability and monitoring (logging, metrics, tracing)
* Familiarity with CI/CD and containerization (Docker)



  





**About Zendr** 




 Zendr is a fast-growing SaaS company developing cloud-based solutions for B2B freight. We're an established business with a stable customer base relying on us every day, which gives us a solid foundation as we continue to scale. We're proud of our innovative platform, of the passionate team behind it, and of our commitment to making our customers' work easier. Collaboration and well-being are central to how we work, and we want you to feel valued, engaged, and able to influence our journey. At Zendr, you can grow quickly, both professionally and personally, while being part of building something meaningful.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Direct impact on our core product, your work will shape the next generation of our B2B freight platform
* Work with a modern tech stack
* High ownership and autonomy in how you deliver, within a clear technical direction set by your team
* A culture where ideas are welcomed and your input truly matters
* Genuine room to grow, we invest in our people's development as the company scales
* A competitive salary tailored to your background, skills, and previous experience, along with a locally adapted benefits package designed to support your well-being and growth



  





**Our hiring process** 




 We respect your time and aim to make the recruitment journey fast, transparent and enjoyable:
 


* **Application review:** 
 We'll review your application promptly and get back to you within a few days.
* **First conversation:** 
 An informal video call to learn more about you and share who we are.
* **Coding assignment:** 
 A practical task to help us understand your technical expertise.
* **Technical interview:** 
 We'll spend the session with your coding assignment open. You'll make a small change to it on your own machine, using whatever tools you normally work with, and we'll talk through your reasoning, your design decisions and how you would take the solution further.
* **Final meeting:** 
 Meet the team, talk through the role in detail, and see if we're the right fit for each other.



  





 From first contact to final decision, you can expect clear communication, timely feedback, and respect for your time, because great talent deserves a great candidate experience.
 



  





**Additional information** 




 We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to get back to you promptly.
 



**Start date:** 
 As soon as possible
 



**Scope:** 
 Full-time, permanent position
 



**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Jönköping and Linköping

title: Staff Engineer
description:
**About Mynt**
 Mynt is an all-in-one corporate card and spend management platform. We’re on a mission to simplify company spend management by automating manual financial administration. Over the past year, Mynt's revenue has grown by more than 90%, making us one of the fastest-growing fintech companies in the Nordics.
   

  

 As a tech-first company with a dedicated product mindset, we build empowered teams that solve complex problems and build solutions that reduce our customers' cognitive load and administrative needs. We have established strategic partnerships with leading players across banking, ERP, fleet, and mobility, across all Nordic markets.
   

  

 Join Mynt to become part of an ambitious, curious and high-performing engineering team. With 110+ employees in Sweden, Finland and Norway, and strong momentum across the business, we are entering an exciting new phase of growth, scale, and increased international expansion.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Backend Staff Engineer** 
 , you are part of our 40+ engineering organization. You will lead the re-architecture of our Expense system, which sits at the core of Mynt's product line. Many teams build customer-facing products on top of it, which makes clear API contracts and scalability critical. As our product matures and we move into new markets, the requirements are growing. It needs to support advanced features like mileage, reimbursements, agentic workflows and custom spend rules, and adapt to what we have not seen yet. You will do this in the Expense team and in close collaboration with its stakeholders.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced engineer who is passionate about tackling architectural challenges and managing work that spans multiple teams and highly complex domains. You enjoy working in an entrepreneurial environment where you will influence both the product and the company’s direction. Together with Product Managers and other functions, you set long-term goals and break them down into manageable parts. Alongside your peers in similar roles, you identify requirements and set the technical roadmap. You are a strong and driven collaborator and can mentor junior colleagues. Throughout, you deliver user value and robust solutions iteratively.
   

  

 We believe in teams with high responsibility, autonomy and clear missions. Our development process is rooted in agile principles, clean architecture, and CI/CD. Automatic testing, TDD, daily deployments and automation are integral parts of how we ensure quality and maintain speed. We operate in the financial sector under an EMI license, which sets a high bar for quality and compliance. In this environment, you will lead architectural decisions, contribute to product design and guide software development.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
* A high level of experience in backend development using Java, with a proven track record of building robust, long-term software solutions with very high availability and accuracy demands.

*The position will be filled as soon as we find a suitable candidate. Please reach out to us as soon as possible if you believe this for you!*
