title: Sales Manager - Dynamics
description:
Job Location: Stockholm
   

  

 Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
   

  

 Req Id: 12081
   

  

 Posting Start Date: 9/16/26
   

  

 At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
   

  

 With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
   

  

 The role – from opportunity to business outcome
   

  

 We are looking for a commercially driven Sales Manager who wants to grow with our Microsoft Dynamics 365, Data and AI team at Fujitsu.
   

  

 You may see yourself as a salesperson, business advisor, solution leader or strategist. What matters most is that you are passionate about understanding our customers’ business, challenging their thinking and turning opportunities into successful end-to-end business outcomes.
   

  

 Fujitsu Sweden continues to grow within Microsoft Dynamics 365, Data & AI and we are now looking for an experienced, business-oriented professional within ERP, CRM and Data & AI. You will play a key role in developing new customer relationships and building long-term partnerships with companies.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who wants to go beyond selling technology – someone who can shape the solution, build the business case, mobilize the right capabilities and lead the customer from opportunity through implementation and business transformation.
   

  

 As a key member of the Sweden Sales Team, you will:
   

  

* Own the end-to-end sales and business development process – from identifying and qualifying opportunities through solution development, negotiation and closing, to successful implementation and further development of the customer relationship.
* Develop and sell end-to-end solutions and commitments, combining technology, consulting, implementation, business process development and managed services.
* Understand the customer’s business and business processes in depth, identify opportunities for improvement and translate these into tangible business outcomes.
* Lead the customer through transformation, from the initial business case and solution design to implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Build and lead the right team around each opportunity, bringing together Fujitsu specialists, partners and customer stakeholders to create a differentiated and winning solution.
* Develop compelling business cases that demonstrate the value of the proposed transformation – both for the customer and internally within Fujitsu.
* Lead complex commercial and solution discussions, managing risks, dependencies, objections and competing interests throughout the sales and delivery journey.
* Act as the customer’s trusted advisor and commercial lead, challenging the customer when appropriate while ensuring that the agreed value is delivered.
* Work closely with our delivery organization to ensure a seamless transition from sales to implementation and long-term service delivery.


 Our portfolio includes Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, Data & AI, providing a powerful foundation for modernizing and transforming our customers’ business processes through automation, data and AI.
   

  

**What We Believe You Bring**
* Strong commercial acumen and experience in complex, consultative solution sales.
* A deep understanding of business processes and the ability to translate customer challenges into business value.
* Experience owning end-to-end customer commitments, from opportunity and business case through solution design and implementation.
* The ability to build and lead multidisciplinary teams across Fujitsu, partners and customers.
* Strong business case and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to manage risks, objections and competing interests.
* The drive to challenge, influence and build trusted customer relationships – always with the customer’s business outcome in focus.


 Why Fujitsu?
   

  

 You will become part of an experienced and ambitious team that challenges and supports each other while combining professionalism with energy, warmth and a genuine passion for what we do.
   

  

 Fujitsu is one of the world’s leading technology companies, combining strong local capabilities in Sweden with global expertise and resources. With around 500 employees in Sweden, we help our customers accelerate their digital transformation through a broad portfolio of services, solutions and technology.
   

  

 We value diversity and welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We recruit continuously and look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

*For the consultant/employee selected for the role, checks of public registers and records relating to financial and legal status will be conducted. By submitting an application, the candidate consents to such checks being carried out.*
 Relocation Supported: No
   

  

 Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
   

  

 At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Partner Manager
description:
Vill du bidra till att göra en direkt skillnad för miljontals människor och företag? Vår affär bygger på insamling och förädling av data och hur den kan användas för att hjälpa våra kunder att fatta intelligenta beslut. Våra medarbetare beskriver vår kultur som vänlig, professionell och där vi genom olika samarbeten utvecklas och uppmuntrar varandra att växa.
 



  





**Vi söker en Partner Manager för att driva UC och Enentos partnertillväxtstrategi i Sverige** 




  





 Detta är en ny och betydelsefull kommersiell roll hos UC, där du både arbetar strategiskt och bygger nya partnerskap både inom data och produktdistribution. Du samarbetar nära både interna team och externa partners för att bygga skalbar tillväxt och stärka vår position som en pålitlig dataleverantör.
 



  





**Vad kommer du göra?** 




  





 I din roll ingår att:
 


* Du samarbetar nära försäljning, produkt och leveransspecialister på UC. Du är duktig på att skapa engagemang hos dina medarbetare.
* Du utvecklar och genomför partnerförsäljningsstrategier och tillväxtplaner.
* Du förhandlar avtal och hanterar partnerrelationer.
* Du genomför UC:s partnerprogram, kartlägger nya möjligheter, bygger en partnerbaserad säljpipeline.
* Du kommer arbeta i Commercial Development teamet och rapporterar till Head of Commercial Development, Petter Alvsten.



  





**Vem är du?** 




 För att lyckas som Partner Manager har du erfarenhet av exempelvis partner- och kanalförsäljning, ledning av kommersiella projekt samt strategisk tillväxt. Du har god kommersiell förståelse samt god insikt i datadrivna affärsmodeller.
 



  





 Vi värdesätter även kunskap om prissättningsmodeller samt erfarenhet av kredit- och företagsinformationstjänster, riskhantering, master data och compliance-tjänster.
 



  





 Vid rekrytering lägger vi särskild vikt vid attityd och personliga egenskaper. Vi söker en proaktiv person som samarbetar smidigt, arbetar över organisationsgränser och kan leda komplexa helheter. Du har en stark vilja att lära dig samt goda förhandlingsfärdigheter. För att lyckas i rollen krävs att du är flytande svenska och engelska.
 



  





**Praktisk information** 




 Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning med 6 månaders provanställning
 



 Startdatum: Enligt överenskommelse
 



 Kontor: Waterfront Building, Klarabergsviadukten 63, Stockholm
 



  





**Vad du kan förvänta dig av oss** 




 Eftersom du har läst så här långt ner i annonsen gissar jag att du finner rollen ganska intressant, vad kul! Nu är det dags för oss att berätta lite om vad vi erbjuder dig mer än en utmanande och rolig roll att växa i.
 



  





 Oavsett hur bra vi trivs på jobbet tycker vi att det är viktigt att det finns en balans mellan jobb och ledig tid, för att stötta det har vi en hybrid arbetsmodell (du kan läsa mer här) som ger möjlighet att kombinera fördelarna med kontorsarbete och att arbete från andra platser och på så sätt få en bättre balans i livet. Inom UC och Enento Group arbetar vi kontinuerligt med välmående och hälsa som förbättrar människors välbefinnande och bidrar till att våra anställda får de förutsättningar de behöver för att prestera när de är på jobbet och kunna koppla av när dagen är slut. Titta gärna på vår film för att få en känsla av vilka vi är.
 



  





 UC är en del av Enento Group, ett nordiskt bolag med engelska som arbetsspråk - därför bör du vara flytande i engelska i såväl tal som skrift.
 



 Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef
 **Petter Alvsten (petter.alvsten@uc.se)** 
 om du har frågor om positionen eller om oss som företag.
 



 Vi ser fram emot att ta del av din ansökan!
 



**\_\_** 




  





***Nyfiken på rekryteringsprocessen?***




*Vi vill säkerställa att du som kandidat får en rättvis bedömning där alla bedöms utifrån vad som är relevant och önskat för den aktuella rollen. Vi* 
*använder Alva Labs assessmentmetoder i våra rekryteringsprocesser för att hjälpa oss att identifiera kandidater med störst sannolikhet att trivas och passa rollen, i tillägg till screening, intervjuer och referenser. Du kan läsa mer om vår rekryteringsprocess här.* 




  





***Arbetsgivare som främjar mångfald***




*Enento Group är en arbetsgivare som värdesätter mångfald och är engagerad i att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmiljö för alla anställda. Vi uppmuntrar ansökningar från alla kvalificerade kandidater oavsett religion, kön, könsidentitet eller uttryck, sexuell läggning, ålder nationalitet, etnicitet eller funktionsnedsättning.*

title: Senior riskanalytiker IKT-risk
description:
*Vill du vara med och säkra framtidens digitala bank? Här får du en nyckelroll i att proaktivt kontrollera och följa upp vår digitala operativa motståndskraft. Du kliver in ett högpresterande team inom operativ risk, där din kompetens inom IKT-risk gör verklig skillnad- varje dag.*
**Om jobbet**
 Här får du en nyckelroll i att proaktivt kontrollera och följa upp vår digitala operativa motståndskraft.
   

  

 Du kliver in i ett högpresterande team inom operativ risk, där din kompetens inom IKT-risk gör verklig skillnad – varje dag.
   

  

 Teamet består av sex specialister och en chef som tillsammans säkerställer att operativa risker hanteras strukturerat och tydligt genom hela verksamheten.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:
   

  

* Genomföra översyner av IKT-riskhanteringsramverket och säkerställa att det är ändamålsenligt
* Genomföra granskningar av hur IKT-riskhanteringsramverket implementeras i verksamheten
* Utveckla och förvalta Risk Managements riskramverk för IKT-risk
* Bidra till utveckling, förvaltning och implementering av riskmått (riskaptit, risklimiter och riskindikatorer) för att mäta IKT-risk
* Bidra till uppföljning av inträffade incidenter kopplade till IKT och operativ risk
* Bidra till uppföljning av implementerade riskmått inom IKT-risk
* Bidra till utvärdering av IKT-risker inom bland annat Risk- och kontrollutvärderingsprocessen och Godkännandeprocessen
* Bidra till Risk Managements rapportering av operativa risker med fokus på IKT-risk
* Fungera som expert och bollplank till verksamheten vid tillämpningen av IKT-riskhanteringsramverket


 Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:
   

  

* Universitets- eller högskoleexamen med inslag av matematik, till exempel ingenjörs-, data- och systemvetenskaplig eller ekonomisk examen
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av arbete inom eller mot bank eller finans med fokus på riskanalys, riskkontroll, IKT-risk, informationssäkerhet, cybersäkerhet eller it-revision
* God kunskap om regulatoriska krav som styr bankverksamhet, exempelvis DORA, CRR III, CRD IV, Finansinspektionens föreskrifter och allmänna råd samt riktlinjer från EBA
* Kunskap om branschstandarder för informationssäkerhet och IT-styrning såsom NIST och ISO
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
* Förmåga att förklara regler och utmaningar inom IKT-riskhantering på ett sätt som är lätt att förstå och omsätta i praktiken


 Meriterande är även om du har:
   

  

* Certifieringar såsom CISM, CRISC, CISA eller CISSP
* Praktisk erfarenhet av it-processer kopplade till exempelvis incidenthantering, kontinuitetsplanering (BCP/DRP) samt informations- och cybersäkerhet
* Praktisk erfarenhet av riskanalys och riskkontroll
* Erfarenhet av arbete i en kontrollfunktion


 Som person trivs du med att arbeta tillsammans med andra och bidra till gemensamma mål. Du har hög integritet och vågar utmana när det behövs, samtidigt som du är lösningsorienterad och pragmatisk i ditt arbetssätt. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med olika delar av organisationen – från första försvarslinjen till regelefterlevnad och internrevision – och du drivs av att skapa ordning, struktur och tydlighet i komplexa frågeställningar.
   

  

**Fackliga kontaktpersoner**
 Facklig representant Forena: joar.lind@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: anna.skarpman@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Länsförsäkringar AB är en inkluderande arbetsplats där mod, möjligheter och engagemang står i centrum. Vi erbjuder ett hållbart arbetsliv med flexibla villkor och satsar på att alla medarbetare ska kunna växa och trivas, oavsett bakgrund.
   

  

 Länsförsäkringar Bank är en av Sveriges största och mest omtyckta banker, med ett brett utbud av tjänster inom betalningar, sparande, bolån och fonder. I arbetet mot vår vision "Tillsammans skapar vi trygghet och möjligheter" hoppas vi att du vill bidra med ditt engagemang och nyfikenhet för effektivisering, AI samt omvärldsspaning av moderna verktyg och metoder för att driva vår utveckling framåt.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
At Airpelago, we are pioneering the inspection of power grids with drones. We combine modern drone technology, proprietary software, and expertise in drone regulations to help grid owners inspect and get insights about their assets, which our society is dependent on. As we continue to scale, we are seeking a people-focused Engineering Manager to lead and develop our growing engineering team.
   

  

**Your mission**
 You will create an environment where autonomous engineers can do their best work. You will coach individuals, develop the team, lead hiring and onboarding, strengthen our culture, and continuously improve how engineering operates. As the organization grows, you will help shape technical strategy, turn decisions into executable plans, and introduce clear structures while preserving ownership and speed.
   

  

**The team**
 Today, our engineering team consists of 12 members across our headquarters in Gothenburg and our Stockholm office. It currently brings together Software Engineers and a Product Manager, with the clear ambition to broaden the team with additional specialized roles moving forward.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach and develop engineers through effective 1:1s and regular feedback.
* Own people management, performance development and team health.
* Lead engineering recruitment, onboarding and workforce planning.
* Design an organization that scales from today’s team toward 15+ people.
* Improve engineering processes, tools and collaboration while keeping them lightweight.
* Identify and remove blockers and bottlenecks.
* Drive technical strategy together with the CTO and senior engineers.
* Translate strategic technical decisions into practical plans and execution.
* Establish clear ownership across teams, domains and technical leads.
* Partner closely with Product on prioritization, planning and delivery.
* Strengthen engineering culture and contribute to the Stockholm office community.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Proven experience leading and developing software engineers, ideally within an international, fast-growing scale-up.
* A technical background, ideally as a software engineer.
* Experience scaling teams and introducing structure without excessive bureaucracy.
* Strong coaching, listening and communication skills.
* Ability to make clear decisions while involving the people closest to the work.
* Experience leading complex technical initiatives from direction through implementation, with a pragmatic and business-minded approach.
* Full proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and verbal.


 Active coding experience is not a strict requirement, but highly beneficial. Leadership maturity, technical judgment, and the ability to help others succeed matter more than being the strongest individual contributor.
   

  

**Why join Airpelago?**
 You will play a central role in transforming an industry with automated aerial data. We are currently on an exciting growth journey, and you will become part of a driven, passionate, and highly skilled team. We believe in achieving great things while having fun along the way - including an annual winter office abroad and recurring company gatherings. We offer a dynamic, high-trust environment where our technical innovations directly impact real-world operations and commercial success.

title: IT-Support på Finska
description:
Vi söker fler kollegor till vår Servicedesk i Stockholm
   

  

 Nu söker vi nya medarbetare till vår
 **Servicedesk i Stockholm.** 
 Oavsett om du är i början av din IT-karriär, vill ta steget in i branschen eller redan har erfarenhet av support vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig. För den här rollen behöver du
 **tala finska flytande.**
 Vi uppskattar olika erfarenheter, perspektiv och bakgrunder. Det är en viktig del av hur vi bygger starka team som trivs, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Då är det kanske dig vi söker och vi ser fram emot att berätta mer om möjligheterna hos oss! 💜
   

  

 Rollen som IT-supporttekniker
   

  

 Som IT-supporttekniker i Advanias Servicedesk hjälper du användare i våra kunders IT-miljöer. Du tar emot ärenden via telefon och e-post, felsöker, guidar användare och följer upp tills problemet är löst.
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i olika IT-miljöer och utvecklas i takt med att din erfarenhet växer. Du blir en del av ett team som delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och vill se dig lyckas.
   

  

 Inom vår servicedesk arbetar vi utan en tydlig uppdelning mellan första och andra linjen. Vi hjälps åt att lösa så många ärenden som möjligt nära användaren, vilket ger dig bred erfarenhet och stora möjligheter att utvecklas.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att arbeta i miljöer som Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Intune och andra vanliga plattformar inom modern IT-support.
   

  

 Rollen är placerad i Stockholm och du utgår från vårt kontor i Liljeholmen.
   

  

 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter
   

  

  

* Ta emot ärenden från användare och ge ett professionellt och tryggt bemötande.
* Felsöka och lösa problem i användarnas IT-miljö.
* Hjälpa användare med klienter, mobila enheter, konton och behörigheter.
* Administrera användare och grupper i Active Directory.
* Följa upp och slutföra ärenden med fokus på kvalitet och kundnöjdhet.
* Identifiera återkommande problem och bidra till förbättringar i supportleveransen.


 Så lyckas du i rollen hos oss
   

  

 I servicedeskrollen är du ofta kundens första kontakt med Advania. Det viktigaste för oss är inte att du kan allt från dag ett, viljan att utvecklas och jobba tillsammans betyder mer. Vi tror att du kommer trivas och lyckas om du tycker om att hjälpa människor, är nyfiken på teknik och gillar att lösa problem tillsammans med andra.
   

  

 Hos oss får du stöd att utveckla sådant som gör skillnad i kundmötet, till exempel att:
   

  

  

* Skapa förtroende genom ett lugnt, tydligt och hjälpsamt bemötande.
* Förstå vad användaren faktiskt behöver och ställa rätt frågor.
* Förklara lösningar så att mottagaren hänger med, oavsett teknisk nivå.
* Ta initiativ och driva ärendet framåt även när det är många saker på gång.
* Be om hjälp i tid, samarbeta och dela kunskap så att teamet lyckas tillsammans.


 Det här är färdigheter som ofta förknippas med konsultmässighet och självledarskap. Om du inte känner igen dig i de begreppen än är det helt okej. Vi hjälper dig att växa in i rollen och utveckla de förmågor som gör skillnad för våra kunder.
   

  

 Vad du har med dig ✨
   

  

 För att trivas i rollen är du serviceinriktad, noggrann och gillar att samarbeta. Du uppskattar en miljö där vi delar kunskap med varandra och där du får möjlighet att utvecklas över tid.
   

  

 För att kunna göra ett riktigt bra jobb i rollen behöver du:
   

  

  

* Behärska svenska, finska och engelska i tal och skrift.
* Kunna kommunicera tydligt och professionellt, även när tempot är högt eller problemet är komplext.


 Har du dessutom något av det här med dig ser vi det som ett extra plus:
   

  

  

* Erfarenhet av IT-support, servicedesk eller teknisk support.
* Erfarenhet från serviceyrken där bemötande och problemlösning varit en viktig del av arbetet.
* Kunskap inom exempelvis Windows Server och klient, macOS, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Endpoint Manager, nätverk, hårdvara och ärendehanteringssystem, gärna ServiceNow.
* Vana att felsöka och lösa problem med ett logiskt arbetssätt.
* Gymnasial examen eller motsvarande utbildning.


 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! 👋
   

  

 Visa gärna ditt intresse så snart som möjligt då vi intervjuar löpande. Vi välkomnar sökanden med olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och synsätt, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och stärker såväl effektivitet som kreativitet i vårt arbete.
   

  

 Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en obligatorisk bakgrundskontroll, en för oss kvalitativ kontroll inför ett anställningsbeslut. Advania samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg i ärenden kopplat till alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad "Proaktiv Arbetsplats".
   

  

 Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor eller funderingar.☀️
   

  

 Det är du som arbetar nära kunden som vet vad dem behöver och vad som blir den bästa lösningen för just deras unika behov, både i dag och i morgon. Därför tycker vi att det är du som ska fatta besluten. Det är genom att erbjuda säkra, hållbara och kundanpassade lösningar som vi skapar värde för kunderna och samhället i stort.
   

  

 Vi bryr oss om hur våra medarbetare mår – på riktigt. Därför samarbetar Advania med Ljung & Sjöberg för att skapa en trygg, proaktiv arbetsmiljö med stöd kring alkohol-, drog- och beroenderelaterade frågor. Tillsammans bygger vi en hållbar arbetsplats där det är okej att be om hjälp, och där förebyggande arbete gör skillnad – för individen, teamet och företaget.
   

  

 I en miljö präglad av stort kundfokus och frihet under ansvar blir det extra viktigt för oss att bygga starka team bestående av ödmjuka stjärnor. Att arbeta i en inkluderande miljö, med kollegor och kunder som vill utvecklas, ger oss möjligheten att trivas och ha riktigt roligt på jobbet. Vi tror på en platt organisation med agilt arbetssätt och flexibilitet. Detta är det enda sättet för en hållbar framtid.
   

  

 Advania Sverige, ”The tech company with people at heart”, har kontor över hela landet, från Luleå i norr till Malmö i syd. Dagligen hjälper våra 1 700 specialister våra kunder, både inom privat och offentlig sektor, i deras ambitioner och mål att digitalisera sina verksamheter. Genom långsiktiga relationer, ledande teknologier, moderna plattformslösningar och strategiska partnerskap formar vi framtidens IT-landskap. Vårt syfte sträcker sig bortom teknik: att ge människor kraften att skapa hållbara värden.
   

  

 Advaniagruppen levererar tjänster till kunder i Sverige, Norge, Storbritannien, Island, Finland och Danmark inom hållbar och säker digitalisering.

title: Account Executive - SMB
description:
**About Us**
 Soundtrack is a B2B scale-up company that originated through a partnership with Spotify, previously powering the ‘Spotify Business’ service, and now provides its own music streaming platform for businesses. We serve small customers like the café around the corner, and much bigger brands like IKEA, Barbour, Espresso House and Hard Rock Cafe..
   

  

 On the inside, we're a team of talented, motivated, and humble individuals, including our dedicated Sales, Customer Success, and Partner teams, alongside our expert Designers, Engineers, and Music specialists.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for a self-motivated, collaborative and curious Account Executive to join our Sales team in Stockholm.
   

  

 You’ll focus on handling inbound leads from small businesses that have 1–5 locations, with the goal of converting them into happy paying customers. You’ll be working with a high volume of around 250 leads per month, using email and short 15-minute calls to close deals through a scalable process.
   

  

 This role is perfect for someone who thrives on structure, velocity, and the satisfaction of closing many wins, all while delivering a great customer experience.
   

  

 You’ll report directly to our VP Sales.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Convert leads to customers efficiently at scale
* Talk to prospects via email or video calls
* Use automation and AI to enable closing at scale
* Tailor the pitch to each lead’s use case — from restaurants to bars and retail stores
* Track your pipeline, forecast monthly MRR, and report on key conversion metrics
* Work collaboratively with the Sales team to continuously improve the process and playbook; your efforts will shape how we scale SMB sales globally
* Work independently while staying closely aligned with the wider Sales team


**About You**
 You take ownership, act with purpose, and thrive on making things happen. You're driven by results and consistently aim to exceed expectations. Motivated by impact and revenue, you bring a strong performance mindset to everything you do, all while maintaining a sharp focus on delivering an exceptional customer experience.
   

  

 You're goal-oriented and proactive, yet thoughtful and empathetic in your approach. High-volume sales energize you, and you know how to balance speed with precision. You take pride in guiding prospects through the decision-making process with clarity, care, and confidence.
   

  

 Naturally curious, you ask questions, look for smarter ways to work, and see feedback as an opportunity to grow. You love closing deals, and you're passionate about delivering proven results that move the business forward.
   

  

 And if you love music like we do, even better!
   

  

**Requirements**
* 2+ years of experience in SaaS sales, preferably inbound or SMB-focused
* Experience working with CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive
* Excellent communication skills — fast, clear, and empathetic
* Experience improving and optimizing sales and operational processes
* Fluency in English and at least one of the following languages: German, French, or Spanish. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential.
* Based in Stockholm, Sweden.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting customers with audio hardware setups
* Experience improving and optimizing sales and operational processes


**Employee Benefits**
* We offer a flexible workplace with the possibility to work remotely
* Generous pension plan
* Yearly budget for health, wellness and personal development
* Laptop and mobile phone of your choice with included cellular subscription
* Regular social activities such as team events, meet ups, after works and off-sites
* Daily breakfast served at the office


 At Soundtrack, we believe that diversity fuels creativity and innovation. We're committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We welcome applications from individuals of all races, ethnicities, genders, ages, abilities, religions, sexual orientations, and identities.
   

  

 We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we identify a suitable candidate before the application deadline. To ensure consideration, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
   

  

 Please note that we only accept applications submitted via our career page and do not accept applications by e-mail.

title: Purchase Manager IT & Info Sec
description:
ValueOne rekryterar en Purchase Manager till Swedbank. Vi söker dig som är en erfaren inköpare med erfarenhet av att driva komplexa, strategiska upphandlingsprocesser inom kategorin IT & Info sec. Rollen är central för att säkerställa att banken uppnår de bästa möjliga villkoren på marknaden, samtidigt som transparens och rättvis konkurrens upprätthålls i alla processer. Det är en tillsvidareanställning med placering på huvudkontoret i Sundbyberg.,
   

  

 Swedbank söker en erfaren Purchase Manager med huvudansvar för att driva professionella upphandlingsprocesser inom kategorin IT & Info Sec, i enlighet med bankens standarder för kostnadseffektivitet, kvalitet och regelefterlevnad. Tjänsten är placerad i Sundbyberg med möjlighet till visst distansarbete, och tillsättning sker snarast möjligt.
   

  

*Swedbank är en av Nordens ledande banker med en stark position på den svenska och baltiska marknaden, och erbjuder ett brett utbud av finansiella tjänster till privatpersoner, företag och organisationer inom en starkt reglerad och komplex verksamhetsmiljö.*
**Om rollen**
 Som Purchase Manager hos Swedbank ansvarar du för att driva professionella upphandlingsprocesser inom kategorin IT & Info Sec med syfte att säkerställa kostnadseffektivitet, kvalitet och regelefterlevnad i enlighet med bankens standarder. Rollen är central för att stärka bankens inköpsfunktion och bidrar direkt till att skapa värde genom välstrukturerade och transparenta upphandlingar.
   

  

* Driva flera parallella, kompletta upphandlingsprocesser i samarbete med affärsenheter och koncernfunktioner, inklusive faser som RFI, RFQ och RFP
* Vägleda och stötta interna intressenter genom hela upphandlingsprocessen för att säkerställa efterlevnad av relevanta regelverk och interna policys, såsom GDPR, informationssäkerhet och DORA
* Genomföra faktabaserade förhandlingar med leverantörer för att uppnå bästa möjliga villkor och produktkvalitet
* Bidra till optimering och kvalitetssäkring av inköp för att säkerställa konkurrenskraftiga marknadsvillkor för banken
* Samarbeta med Category Managers och Vendor Managers för att stärka och förvalta relationer med strategiska leverantörer
* Säkerställa att upphandlingsprocesserna genomförs med rättvis konkurrens och transparens, i nära samarbete med kontrollfunktioner såsom risk, integritet, säkerhet och juridik


**Erfarenhet och kompetens**
 Vi söker dig med högskoleutbildning inom ekonomi, teknik eller juridik och dokumenterad erfarenhet av strategiskt inköp, gärna inom IT-upphandling och internationell affärsverksamhet inklusive förhandlingar och avtalsskrivning, med förmåga att driva flera parallella upphandlingsprocesser i en komplex, processorienterad storbolagsmiljö. Obehindrade kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift samt goda IT-kunskaper krävs, och erfarenhet från en reglerad bransch såsom bank och finans, telekom eller offentlig sektor är meriterande.
   

  

 Du är en självgående och driven person med hög relationsförmåga som effektivt engagerar leverantörer, intressenter och kollegor mot gemensamma mål, och du kombinerar detta med en stark analytisk problemlösningsförmåga som gör att du strukturerat och tidseffektivt hanterar komplexa beslutsprocesser och datamängder.
   

  

**Ansökan**

title: Staff Software Engineer, Motion Planning
description:
****Who We Are****
 AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an experienced Staff Software Engineer who can design and build best-in-class planning systems for autonomous driving in structured, low-speed environments.
   

  

 In this role, you'll be the technical backbone of the planning stack — owning the design and implementation of production-grade mission planning, behavior planning, and motion planning software. You'll work across the full planning pipeline to achieve category-defining vehicle autonomy for the airside, tackling hard problems in trajectory optimization, decision-making under uncertainty, and real-time constraint optimization.
   

  

 This opportunity offers a deeply technical engineer the chance to shape a market-defining enterprise product that combines autonomous vehicle technology with a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) business model. This role reports to our Planning Tech Lead and works closely with the autonomy engineering team.
   

  

 You Will:
   

  

* Design, implement, and iterate on the mission planner, behavior planner, and motion planner for autonomous ground support equipment operating in airport airside environments.
* Drive key technical decisions across the planning stack — selecting algorithms, defining interfaces, and establishing the architecture that the team builds on.
* Prototype and evaluate new planning approaches (e.g., optimization-based methods, search-based planners, learning-augmented pipelines) and bring the best ideas to production.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with perception, controls, localization, and systems engineering teams to deliver an integrated autonomous driving system.
* Establish and promote best practices in software development, functional safety, and systems engineering as they apply to the planning domain.
* Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, code review, and design discussions.


 You Have:
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Math, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Physics, or a related field.
* Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing planning modules for autonomous systems shipped to production or deployed in real-world operations.
* Strong programming skills in C++ (preferred) or Python, and experience with Linux-based operating systems.
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous technical problems and drive them to well-architected solutions independently.
* Excellent communication skills, proactiveness, and a strong sense of ownership.


 We Prefer:
   

  

* MS or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.
* Mastery of Modern C++ (14 and beyond) and safety-critical coding practices (e.g., MISRA, ISO 26262).
* 5+ years of industry experience in planning for robotic ground vehicles.
* In-depth understanding of DDS frameworks like ROS/ROS2 or other networking middleware.
* Experience in startup environments, demonstrating adaptability to rapidly changing priorities.

title: Group Legal Counsel
description:

**The Role**
 We are looking for a commercially minded and solution-oriented Group Legal Counsel to join Enea's Legal team. The role is primarily focused on supporting Enea's global commercial operations, with a particular emphasis on software, SaaS and other technology-related agreements. You will work closely with stakeholders throughout the organization, providing practical and business-focused legal advice.
   

  

 This is a broad, hands-on role offering close collaboration with senior management and key stakeholders in a global technology company.
   

  

 This role reports to the General Counsel.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As Group Legal Counsel, your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead the drafting, review, negotiation and execution of complex technology agreements.
* Act as a trusted legal advisor to Sales, Product, Management and other business stakeholders, providing practical advice that balances legal risk and commercial objectives.
* Provide legal support across a broad range of commercial, regulatory, compliance and corporate matters.

* Contribute to the continuous development and improvement of legal templates, playbooks, processes, ways of working and knowledge-sharing across the organization.


**Qualifications And Experience**
 We believe you will bring:
   

  

* A law degree from a recognized university.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience as a practicing lawyer, including at least 2 years working in-house at a technology company.
* Significant experience independently drafting, negotiating and managing complex commercial agreements.

* An excellent communicator who can explain complex legal issues in a clear, concise and practical way.

 At Enea, you will join a collaborative legal team supporting innovative software and technology businesses worldwide. You will work on complex commercial and strategic matters and partner closely with business leaders across the organization.
   

  

 This is an opportunity for a lawyer who enjoys combining high-quality legal work with commercial thinking, business partnership and international exposure.

 Enea is one of the world's leading specialists in software for telecommunications and cybersecurity. Our solutions are used by many of the world's largest communications service providers, network equipment vendors and enterprises. title: Senior Risk Officer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Senior Risk Officer is a critical role within the second line of defense for the Merchant Services (MS) Division within Worldline. In this role you will be a part of the team leading the charge in strengthening our company's internal controls and risk management processes. If you're someone with an ability to explain risk concepts, a liking for facilitating risk workshops and a keen interest in ICT risk management, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

  

  

 Reporting directly to the Entity’s Chief Risk and Compliance Officer, and also supporting your local entity’s management team and senior specialists, you'll play an integral role in driving the effective operation of our operating environment. You will be supported by the global entity risk officer network and will also participate in global risk initiatives to ensure that risk management industry best practices are rolled-out across the Merchant Services Division.
   

  

 You will be part of a team with many experienced and dedicated risk officers spread across the world that would love for you to work with them! We are committed to continuous improvement and are always looking for new talents to join our group of trusted risk advisors to the business.
   

  

**Day-to-day Responsibilities**
* Advocate for a sound risk management culture through awareness and stakeholder engagement within Sweden, ensuring inter-departmental collaborations
* Develop tools, processes and procedures for operational risk management, with focus on ICT-risk including Third-party risk.
* Providing risk expertise and collaborate with the local management team and senior specialists to design an effective control environment.
* Facilitate enterprise wide operational risk and control assessments as well as specific ICT and Third Party risk assessments across the company's operations
* Coordinate and independently challenge risk assessments of new products, services, organizational units, and significant changes
* Analyze the effectiveness of controls and other mitigating measures and suggesting improvements
* Develop and oversee compliance with operational risk policies, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, both locally and in our business globally.


**Success in the Role**
* As a successful hire, you focus on becoming a trusted risk advisor who maintains strong relationships with business partners and cultivates a strong risk culture.
* Excellent organizational, planning and communication skills.
* Strong team player with a “can-do” attitude.
* Comfortable working independently, with a self-starter mindset, and results driven.
* Sound knowledge of regulatory requirements relating to risk management.
* Multicultural and flexible mindset with the ability to multi-task and work in an international environment.


**Who Are We Looking For**
* 4+ years within a 2nd line Risk Management and/or Control Function role.
* Excellent knowledge and awareness related to enterprise and operational risk management industry best practices and frameworks (e.g., COSO, ISO 31000).
* Knowledge about DORA, incl incident- and third party risk management.
* Experience in or with strongly regulated institutions and industries.
* Self-driven ethics and initiative in assignments and stakeholder management.
* Ability to present and influence decision making with executive audiences.
* Experience working in matrix organizations.

* Industry experience in payment and/or banking
* Bachelor’s Degree (Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent)
* Industry Risk Management Certifications (CRMA, CRISC, CISA etc.)
* Risk Management / GRC tool experience
* Experience with analytics and automation tooling (Power BI, Power Apps)

title: Product Manager - Alarms
description:
*Do you want to develop products and services that help protect people, property and critical functions around the clock? As Product Manager for Smart Alarms, you will turn customer needs, market insight and technical possibilities into strong solutions and bring them successfully to market across Europe.*
 AddSecure is strengthening its Smart Alarms product team, and we are looking for a
 **Product Manager** 
 in Stockholm who enjoys combining product development, customer insight and commercial thinking with a hands-on understanding of technology.
   

  

**AddSecure** 
 is a leading European provider of secure IoT connectivity and end-to-end solutions. We help customers optimise operations, create business value, and secure vital functions. Our solutions are used in buildings, alarms, transport and logistics, personal safety, elderly care, construction, municipalities, schools, rescue services, power grids, retail and more.
   

  

 Within our Smart Alarms business, we provide secure solutions for monitored alarm transmission and reliable crisis communication, supporting organisations and emergency teams when it matters most.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As Product Manager, you will own and develop a portfolio at the heart of our alarm signaling business, spanning lift alarm services, fire and intrusion alarm services, and new products and services brought to market.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer and market needs, shaping the roadmap and working closely with R&D to develop solutions that create clear customer value. You will also play an important role in bringing products successfully to market through positioning, packaging, pricing and go-to-market activities.
   

  

 This is a hands-on product role. Particularly within lift alarms and integrations with third-party products, you will work closely with the technology, testing and verifying solutions to understand how they perform in practice.
   

  

 You will report to the Product Director for Smart Alarms and work in an international team of Product Managers, close to Sales, Marketing, R&D, Operations and our country teams.
   

  

 AddSecure works according to a 3/2 hybrid model. You work from the office a minimum of three days per week and remotely up to two days, with Telefonplan in Stockholm as your base and the option to work from other AddSecure offices. The role involves some travel, mainly to our offices, customers and partners across Europe.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own and develop the roadmap for your portfolio, translating customer needs, market insight and technical opportunities into clear priorities.
* Grow and develop our lift alarm, fire and intrusion alarm offerings and identify opportunities for new products, services and markets.
* Work closely with R&D throughout the product lifecycle, from concept and requirements to testing, launch and continuous improvement.
* Lead the market introduction of new products and services together with Sales, Marketing, Operations and country teams, including positioning, packaging, pricing, sales enablement and launch material.
* Build strong relationships with customers and partners and use their feedback to shape existing and future solutions.
* Set prices within agreed guardrails and support the development and maintenance of price lists across our markets.
* Follow revenue, margin, adoption and other relevant product performance indicators and use the insights to support priorities and business cases.
* Drive digital initiatives related to the portfolio, including customer-facing tools and solutions used to install and commission products.
* Represent AddSecure at relevant trade fairs and industry events and bring market insight back into the product roadmap.


**About You**
 You are a hands-on Product Manager who enjoys being close to both customers and technology. You are curious about how products work in practice and comfortable moving between technical discussions, customer needs and business priorities.
   

  

 You can create structure in a complex environment, make decisions based on incomplete information and bring different stakeholders together around clear product priorities. You are also comfortable taking products all the way from idea and development to launch and continuous improvement.
   

  

**We believe you have:**
* At least 3 years of experience in product management, product ownership or a similar role within B2B technology.
* Experience working with technically complex products or services, ideally within alarms, security, connected hardware or other safety-critical environments.
* Experience taking hardware, software or connected services from development to market.
* Strong product and commercial judgement, with the ability to balance customer value, technical feasibility and business impact.
* The ability to work effectively across R&D, Sales, Marketing, Operations and international teams.
* Technical fluency to work confidently with connected hardware, software and cloud services, together with a willingness to test and understand products hands-on.
* Experience engaging directly with customers and partners and translating their needs into product priorities and requirements.
* A relevant academic background or equivalent professional experience.
* Fluent English, spoken and written.


**It would be valuable if you also have:**
* Professional Swedish or another Nordic language.
* Familiarity with European alarm standards such as EN 50131, EN 54, EN 81-28 or EN 50136.
* Experience from IoT connectivity, telecom or SaaS.
* Experience working through channel partners such as distributors, wholesalers or installers.
* Experience working across several European markets.


**We offer**
 Our employees are our greatest asset and for us it is of great importance to build a culture where our employees thrive and want to perform. You will be part of a motivated team in an international company. In addition, we offer:
   

  

* Wellness allowance
* Occupational pension
* Enhanced parental pay
* Health checks
* Parking


 Start: preferably as soon as possible / according to agreement
   

  

**We're all change makers!**
 If you're looking for an organisation where you can be yourself, have fun at work, and contribute to a safer, smarter, and more sustainable world, AddSecure may be the place for you. Join our growing international team, where every day offers an opportunity to make a real difference.
   

  

 Would you like to take part in our journey? Please apply by submitting your CV and answering a few short questions. We look forward to receiving your application.
   

  

 We use a competence-based recruitment process that may include psychometric assessments, interviews, reference checks, and background checks. As part of the process, candidates may complete assessments provided by Alva Labs to support a fair and structured evaluation.
   

  

 We conduct background checks for all our employees, and you must be eligible to work in Sweden.
   

  

 #addsecure #joinaddsecure #forasaferandsmarterworld #smartertogether #ProductManager #SmartAlarms #IoT #ConnectedTechnology #ProductManagement #AlarmSystems #SecurityTechnology #TechJobs
   

  

 AddSecure is a leading European provider of secure IoT connectivity and end-to-end solutions. We help customers optimise their operations, drive business value, and secure vital functions. By combining connected, data-driven, and sensor-based solutions with best-in-class expertise, we meet our customers’ needs regardless of industry. Our secure IoT solutions are used within the areas of buildings, alarms, transportation and logistics, personal safety and security, elderly care, construction, municipalities, schools, rescue services, power grids, and more.

title: Thesis work within AI & Embedded Systems
description:
**Last date to apply:**


15 October 2026**Thesis work within Embedded Software and AI**

 *Agent-Based Generation of Release Documentation*

*We are looking for bachelor or master’s students in software engineering, computer science, artificial intelligence, or a related field who are interested in completing their thesis project within our embedded systems organization.*

 **Background:**

  

Release documentation is traditionally produced by engineers who review changes since the previous software release, identify what matters to users, and translate technical implementation details into clear descriptions of changed behavior, configuration, and limitations. This requires substantial contextual understanding and is difficult to automate with conventional rule-based methods.

  

This thesis explores whether an AI-based agent can generate reliable release documentation by combining evidence from a software repository with a document template and project-specific instructions for terminology, style, tone, and exclusions. The solution will be evaluated as part of an existing release process, with particular attention to documentation quality, traceability, robustness, and computational cost.

 **The objective**

  

* Design, implement, integrate, and evaluate an AI-based agent that automatically generates human-readable release documentation for a software product.
* Investigate how much repository context is required to produce reliable documentation without excessive token consumption or loss of relevant information.
* Enable documentation for earlier releases to be reconstructed from repository history, including patches and re-releases.
* Evaluate whether the generated documentation is comparable in practical usefulness to documentation written by an experienced engineer, while clearly exposing uncertainty instead of inventing unsupported product knowledge.

 **Your skills and background**

  

* Bachelor or Master’s studies in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Embedded Systems, Data Science, or a related program.
* Interest in software repositories, release processes, generative AI, large language models, agent workflows, and prompt or context engineering.
* Experience with software development, version control, and structured testing. Familiarity with CI/CD, technical writing, or evaluation of AI systems is beneficial.
* An analytical mindset and the ability to distinguish externally observable product changes from internal implementation details.

 **The thesis will include work such as**

  

* Analyze the existing release process, documentation expectations, repository structure, metadata, and representative historical releases.
* Establish a baseline solution and develop methods for extracting and selecting relevant commits, diffs, configuration changes, and other repository evidence.
* Design an agent workflow that identifies significant changes, reasons about external impact, verifies statements against repository evidence, and creates the final document using the required template and metadata.
* Integrate the agent into the release workflow with defined inputs, outputs, configuration, and failure handling.
* Create a repeatable evaluation framework and acceptance-test dataset covering bug fixes, configuration changes, larger features, internal refactoring, and poorly documented commits.
* Measure documentation quality, omissions, unsupported additions, traceability, token usage, computational cost, limitations, and engineering trade-offs.
* Document the architecture, implementation, experiments, results, assumptions, and known limitations, and present the completed thesis.

 **Scope and expected outcome**

  

The work focuses on release documentation derived from repository and release process evidence. Sourcecode documentation, marketing material, requirements verification, general-purpose document generation, and release approval are outside the scope. A project-specific prototype is acceptable; the primary outcome is well-supported knowledge about feasibility, architecture, limitations, quality, and cost.

  

Expected deliverables include a working agent prototype, release-process integration, configurable project-specific style rules, template and metadata support, repository-change extraction, historical reconstruction, an acceptance-test dataset, an evaluation framework with results, technical documentation, and the thesis report.

 **How to apply**

  

Please submit your application with CV and cover letter as soon as possible. Due to GDPR, applications are not accepted by email.

  

Start date: To be agreed, but spring 2027, Q1 or Q2, depending on the size of the work.

title: MedTech Device Field Service Engineer or Technician Flexible/Part Time - Sweden
description:

Our **MedTech Field Service Engineer or Technicians** experience a unique opportunity to employ their technical experience by collaborating with healthcare professionals and leading technical initiatives in medical device technology.


You will be responsible for installing hardware for automated medication dispensing systems within healthcare facilities throughout the United States. This is a great opportunity for you to advance your technical and leadership skills, while building a career path with strong growth opportunities with a leading medical device company!


This position requires you to travel 100% locally, regionally, and nationally. Due to the travel, the role requires open availability Monday through Friday. Work is assignment based, with a typical week including 16-30 hours worked, plus travel time.

* Conduct routine checks and record data from product tests after installation and configuration.
* Ensure work is completed in accordance with quality compliance requirements.
* Partner with a team of support staff, manage project timelines and customer needs.
* Training for this role will be provided and is paid

Schedule:


* Per-diem, assignment-based position requiring travel and open flexibility.

Required Qualifications:


* **An Upper Secondary Education is Required or higher**
* English and Swedish spoken language is required
* Minimum 1 year related electronics, hardware, software or mechanical experience required.
* Professional business acumen and communication skills required.
* Must be comfortable with basic software programs and Microsoft operating systems.
* Ability to work with design engineers, project managers & healthcare personnel to identify equipment layout, operations, and workflow required.
* Ability to clear hospital vendor credentialing requirements, including proof of vaccination status, required.
* Position may/will require up to date immunizations.
* Ability to sit and stand for long periods of time and lift up to 50 pounds required.

**Travel Requirement:**

* An active and unrestricted driver’s license is required.
* Will have a personal vehicle and willing to use it for job related assignments.
* Ability to travel locally, regionally, and nationally weekly to support customer needs required.
* Needs to be located within 30 miles of a major airport.
* Travel, and your time traveling is paid, as is mileage.

Preferred Qualifications:


* Military veterans with experience in electronics related MOS are encouraged to apply!
* Ability to work independently in customer settings with minimal supervision.

IQVIA MedTech CFS takes the approach to helping customers drive healthcare forward in this challenging and fast-paced environment. We help customers accelerate results, improve patient outcomes, and unleash new opportunities.


Benefits:


* This position is not eligible for our Medical Benefits.

**Vaccine/Immunization/Hospital Credentialing Requirement:** A required function of this job requires individuals to enter various healthcare facilities. Thus, upon selection, individuals must complete healthcare facility credentialing process. To obtain credentials, individuals must meet the immunization requirements specified by the facility. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
* Permanent
* Experienced Professionals
* Products & Systems Engineering
* ID 564900-en\_US
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Din roll**


Vi söker nu en mekanikingenjör eller mekanikkonstruktör till vårt Capgemini Engineering kontor i Malmö. I denna roll kommer du att arbeta med utveckling av avancerade produkter och tekniska system inom försvarsindustrin. Du blir en del av ett engagerat projektteam där du bidrar genom utvecklingskedjan, från koncept och detaljkonstruktion till verifiering, dokumentation och produktionsstöd.


*I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckeroll i:*


* Mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling av komponenter, delsystem och kompletta installationer
* Framtagning av 3D-modeller, tillverkningsritningar och teknisk dokumentation
* Hantering av konstruktionsändringar, konfigurationsstyrning och kravuppfyllnad
* Produktionsstöd samt förbättrings- och vidareutvecklingsarbete
* Deltagande i designgranskningar och tekniska utredningar.

**Din profil**


* Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik, produktutveckling eller motsvarande.
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling samt flytande svenska och engelska.
* God vana av CAD-verktyg såsom Creo Parametric, Autodesk Inventor eller motsvarande.
* Erfarenhet av ritningsframtagning och teknisk dokumentation samt god förståelse för toleranser, material och tillverkningsmetoder.
* Erfarenhet av produktionsstöd, tekniska förbättringsarbeten och/eller försvarsindustrin. Erfarenhet av komplexa tekniska system, stora sammanställningar, konstruktion i aluminium/stål samt PDM/PLM-system som Autodesk Vault och IFS är meriterande.

*Note: Denna tjänst kräver svenskt medborgarskap samt är säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att säkerhetsprövning kommer ske enligt svensk lagstiftning.*

**Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas**


* **Innovativ miljö:** Hos oss får du chansen att jobba med den senaste tekniken och vara en del av ett dynamiskt team som älskar att skapa värde genom innovation.
* **Karriärutveckling:** Vi bryr oss om din framtid och erbjuder utvecklingsprogram och certifieringar i de senaste teknologierna, så att du kan växa och bli den bästa versionen av dig själv.
* **Flexibelt arbete:** Vi förstår att livet är mer än bara jobb. Därför erbjuder vi möjligheter till distansarbete och flexibla arbetstider för att du ska må bra och trivas.
* **Teamkänsla:** Vi är som en stor familj med en härlig teamkänsla. Genom att leva efter våra värdeord som mod, passion, laganda och entreprenörskap - skapar vi en arbetsmiljö där alla kan trivas.

**Ansökan**


Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.

title: Integration Specialist ﻿
description:
*Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact – and your part matters.*

  

  

### **Your****role**


The newly established **Platforms & Software** section within **SAAB BU Surveillance, PU Digital Battlespace** is responsible for several of SAAB's Battle Labs, where experimentation, development, research, and evaluation of both current and future **C2 (Command and Control)** and **C5ISR** solutions take place. title: Fluid System Engineer
description:
##### **What we do at Blykalla**


Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com.

##### **What you’ll get to do**


As Fluid System Engineer you will own one or more of the fluid systems of SEALER, from concept through qualification. Depending on where the department needs support at the time of your joining, this could mean the cover gas system, the lead conditioning and purification circuits, the depressurisation system, other safety-classified reactor auxiliaries, or systems on the secondary side. In every case you will act as the system-responsible engineer: defining what the system must do, how it should be designed, and how it integrates into the plant.

##### **What you'll get to do**

* Own the functional and design requirements, design basis, and system architecture for the fluid systems assigned to you.
* Lead trade-off studies on system configuration, and drive the design forward through concept, preliminary, and detailed design phases.
* Define the scope of supporting analyses (thermohydraulic, structural, chemical), provide inputs to specialists, and critically review their results. Use hand calculations to sanity-check outputs and steer the design.
* Define supplier work packages, evaluate proposals, and manage the technical dialogue with suppliers and partners from concept through qualification.
* Ensure system requirements are traceable to plant-level and safety objectives, and that the system integrates correctly with neighbouring systems and disciplines.
* Contribute to system-level documentation, chair or participate in design reviews, and maintain the plant technical baseline for your systems.
* Support commissioning and testing activities as the plant progresses toward operation.

##### **Who you’ll get to work with**


The Fluid System Engineer sits in the Fluid Systems Engineering Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Manager of Fluid Systems Engineering. You will collaborate daily with the other system engineers in the team, and interface closely with the Mechanical, Nuclear and Safety, Test and Validation, Quality, Material, Layout and Piping, and Electrical and I&C teams, as well as with external suppliers and research partners. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla.

##### **Who you are**


You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are:

* More than 3 years of professional experience as a system, process, or fluid engineer on complex power, process, or industrial plants.
* Degree in mechanical, energy, chemical, nuclear, or a closely related engineering discipline.
* Solid working knowledge of applied thermodynamics, thermohydraulics, and heat and mass transfer.
* Working understanding of P&IDs, PFDs, piping and instrumentation conventions, and how a fluid system connects with layout, electrical, and I&C scope.
* Comfort writing clear technical specifications, reviewing supplier deliverables critically, and managing a multi-vendor technical dialogue.
* Familiarity with applicable industrial codes and standards (ASME, PED, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with CAD tools and engineering software; comfort scripting in Python or MATLAB is a plus.
* Fluent in English, spoken and written.
* Fluency in Swedish is a plus.

**Meritorious skills:**

* Nuclear industry experience, ideally in reactor system design or in nuclear auxiliary systems.
* Familiarity with heavy liquid metal or sodium technology.
* Experience with fluid systems for gas conditioning, chemistry control, or purification.
* Prior involvement in supplier or partner codevelopment of complex equipment.
* Experience with plant engineering tools (AVEVA, Hexagon, AutoPlant, Kadmatic, or equivalent) and PLM systems.
* Experience contributing to a nuclear licensing submittal.

 **Location**


This position is for our office in Stockholm.

**So, what do you think?**


Don't miss the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team as Fluid System Engineer and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. Apply today with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements.


We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply!

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
#### **About the Company**


Nordic Tyre Group is the largest tyre wholesaler in the Nordic countries and the Baltics. We use the power of technology to connect leading retailers and their customers with the world's best tyres. We offer products for passenger cars, trucks, construction and agricultural machinery. Learn more about the company at nordictyregroup.com.


We are currently present in six markets: Norway, Sweden, Finland, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. The group has about 500 employees and a turnover of 4,3 mdkr.


Join our team of great talents!

#### **Why this role exists**


Nordic Tyre Group is transforming a decades-long, successful tyre wholesaling business into a modern, data-driven one. We believe our future is in data, and we have ambitious growth goals that depend on it.


Over the past two years we have standardised finance across all business units on Microsoft Business Central, rebuilt our B2B portal, and put demand forecasting, churn, cross-sell and segmentation models into the business. The foundations are in place. What we need now is someone to turn that foundation into a coherent analytics capability — and to make the rest of the group fluent in it.

#### **The role**


We are looking for a curious-minded Analytics Engineer to build, maintain and optimise our analytics stack, which runs on Microsoft Fabric and is built on dbt.


The hands-on engineering is half the job. The other half is the analytics framework itself: the metric definitions, modelling standards and ways of working that let the group ask better questions and trust the answers. This is a role for someone who is as interested in what the numbers mean as in how they are produced.

#### **What you will do**

#### **Analytics engineering**


– Build and maintain modular, well-tested dbt models on Microsoft Fabric.


– Optimise existing transformations for performance, cost and maintainability.


– Own data models end to end — from source through to the semantic layer.

#### **Build the analytics framework**


– Define and document the metrics that matter across the group, so that one metric has one definition everywhere.


– Set modelling standards, naming conventions and testing practice — and hold the line on them.


– Build reusable structures so that new questions do not each require a new pipeline.

#### **Turn data into decisions**


– Develop Power BI datasets and reports that stakeholders genuinely use.


– Go past reporting into analysis: identify what the numbers mean and what should change as a result.


– Work directly with commercial, supply chain and finance teams to frame the questions worth answering.

#### **Bring people with you**


– Explain analytical work to non-technical stakeholders clearly and without condescension.


– Raise data literacy across the group and make self-service genuinely usable rather than nominally available.

#### **Protect the foundation**


– Build testing, monitoring and documentation into the pipeline as standard.


– Treat data quality as a feature of the product, not a cleanup task.

#### **Skills we are looking for**


Levels below describe where we need you on day one, not where we expect you to stay.

##### **SQL -** **Extremely competent**


The core of the role. Complex modelling, performance tuning, and comfort in a warehouse of meaningful size.

##### **dbt -** **Competent**


Our transformation layer. You should be at home with models, tests, macros, and version-controlled analytics.

##### **Power BI -** **Competent**


Our reporting layer. Semantic models and reports that stakeholders trust and actually open.

##### **Python -** **Familiar**


Enough to automate, glue, and prototype. You are not expected to be a software engineer.

##### **Microsoft Fabric -** **Advantageous**


Where our stack runs. Direct experience helps, but a strong candidate from an equivalent stack will not be ruled out.

#### **Beyond the tooling**


Two qualities matter more to us than any single technology on the list above.


– Analytics. A genuine instinct for what a number is telling you, what it is hiding, and which question to ask next.


– Pedagogy. The ability to teach — to make an analytical result land with a stakeholder who has no interest in how it was built.


Alongside those: curiosity, comfort with the ambiguity of a business mid-transformation, and the judgement to know when a pragmatic answer today beats a perfect one next month.

#### **Background we would expect**


– Experience building analytics metrics that were adopted and used, not just delivered.


– A track record of adding value through insight, communicated pedagogically to key stakeholders.


– Comfort working across multiple markets, entities and source systems.


– Wholesale, distribution, retail or logistics experience is an advantage, though not a requirement.

#### **Practical details**


– Location: Riga or Stockholm.


– Team: joins the group data and analytics team, working alongside our data scientist and data engineer.


– Language: English is the working language of the group.

#### **What success looks like in the first year**


– An agreed, documented metric framework in active use across the business units.


– A dbt project with real test coverage, clear ownership and no undocumented corners.


– Stakeholders answering their own routine questions — and bringing you the harder ones.

title: Support & Testing Engineer
description:
At Airpelago, we are pioneering the inspection of power grids with drones. We combine modern drone technology, proprietary software, and expertise in drone regulations to help grid owners inspect and get insights about their assets, which our society is dependent on. As we continue to scale, we are looking for a Support & Testing Engineer to be the link between our users in the field and the engineers building the software.

**Your mission**
----------------


Your main focus will be making sure our users succeed with our software - understanding their problems, solving them, and translating recurring issues into concrete input for engineering. You will also spend time in the field, running large-scale tests of our drone automation software to ensure that new software features, drone platforms, or payloads actually work in the real world before release.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support our users - pilots, operators and grid owners - with our software, from first question to resolution.
* Help onboard new users and customers on our system.
* Feed structured insights from the field back into product and engineering priorities.
* Plan and execute large-scale field testing of our drone automation software.
* Document, reproduce and prioritize bugs, with enough technical detail that engineers can act on them.
* Build and maintain test procedures, checklists and reporting so results are comparable over time.
* Maintain support documentation, guides and internal knowledge.
* Make smaller fixes, scripts and tooling yourself, using AI-assisted development tools where helpful.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Experience in a technical and customer-facing support role.
* Post-secondary education in a relevant field.
* A genuine service mindset - you take full ownership of the user's problem until it is solved.
* Tech-savvy and hands-on - you enjoy digging into logs, configurations, and data to find root causes, and you're comfortable making smaller code changes or using AI tools to solve problems.
* Structured and methodical mindset, especially when testing at scale.
* A valid B driver’s license, with comfort working outdoors and travelling for field testing.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Swedish and English, with the ability to explain technical things clearly to non-technical users.

  

As we work with grid owners across Europe, additional languages (especially French, German, or Spanish) are a big plus. Experience with drones, a pilot certificate, or a background in field service/QA will make us even happier. However, your attitude, curiosity, and problem-solving ability are what matter most to us!

**Why join Airpelago?**
-----------------------


You will play a central role in transforming an industry with automated aerial data. We are currently on an exciting growth journey, and you will become part of a driven, passionate, and highly skilled team. We believe in achieving great things while having fun along the way - including an annual winter office abroad and recurring company gatherings. We offer a dynamic, high-trust environment where our technical innovations directly impact real-world operations and commercial success.
