title: Thesis Work – Applied probability and statistics for robot dimensioning
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.


This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.


This Position reports to:


R&D Department/Local Unit Lead **Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the**  

**transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.**

 **At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all**  

**dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each and every one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences.**

  

At ABB, you can be sure you are helping to create a better world. Why not take the chance to do this while working in one of the most fascinating technology areas in modern industry – Robotics!


ABB Robotics is a leading supplier of industrial robots and robot software, in addition to its equipment, and complete application solutions. We are found in 53 countries and have installed more than 500,000 robots, supported by the broadest service network, and offering in the industry.


Now we are offering an exciting master thesis within Mechanical Analysis R&D.


You can be a part of our team responsible for simulation, optimization and calculations on the robots.


The loads used for dimensioning of the robots are retrieved with simulations where not just a certain load level, but also the probability for that load is retrieved. At the same time the criteria for the material limits are based on statistical evaluation of material tests. However, these are often evaluated conservatively in isolation, resulting in over-dimensioned designs that add unnecessary weight, cost, and environmental impact.


We need a fresh perspective on how to integrate probability and statistics into our dimensioning process – decreasing conservatism while maintaining safety and quantifying failure probability for informed engineering decisions.

***Details:***
--------------

* ### ***January-June 2027***
* ### ***30 ECTS/högskolepoäng(hp)***
* ### ***One student***
* *Most time on site in Västerås*

**Your responsibilities**

* Literature study on probabilistic mechanical design and reliability engineering.
* Deep dive into ABB Robotics' current in-house dimensioning criteria and load calculation methods
* Development and testing of improved methodologies to predict failure probability
* Documentation and recommendations for implementation
* Living ABB’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your background**

* Engineering student in Mechanical engineering, Technical physics, Mathematics or program with similar profile.
* Knowledge in Mechanical dimensioning and statistics / probability theory.
* Experience with Python, MATLAB, or statistical software
* Self-driven, structured and analytical mindset.
* Fluent English in speaking and writing, English is the corporate language and used for all documentation
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with the team

**More about us**  



Bring your very own sense of pride and purpose as you help us drive forward the Fourth Industrial Revolution – creating a sustainable future for our planet, and your career. Apply with your CV, academic transcripts and a cover letter in English

title: Product Engineer, Growth Acquisition
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.



We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

**Why this role exists**
------------------------



The web is changing.



For twenty years, websites have been built around content management systems, where people manually create, edit, and publish every page. We think that era is ending. AI is changing how digital experiences are designed, built, optimized, and discovered, and websites are becoming composable systems built on structured content, reusable components, data, and AI.



We’ve already started building that at Mentimeter, moving to a Markdown-based system with a bespoke CMS and agentic workflows. Now we’re looking for an engineer who’ll help us take it to the next level.



Our website is our storefront. It’s where millions of people meet Mentimeter for the first time, and it sits in the middle of almost everything we do: product, marketing, sales, brand, search. Your job is to own the technical foundation underneath it and keep making it better at one thing: helping people find Mentimeter, understand it, and sign up.



In practice, that means evolving the Growth Operating System—the platform that lets engineers, designers, marketers, copywriters, and AI agents work on world-class digital experiences together. This isn’t a job maintaining a marketing website. It’s building the machine that produces one.


**What you'll own**
-------------------



You'll own the technical foundation behind web acquisition, and not only the building of it. You'll help decide what's worth building, ship it, measure it, and interpret what the results actually mean.


### **Web platform**



Frontend architecture, the component library, deployment pipeline, performance, and the foundations everything else sits on.


### **Growth Operating System**



The systems, workflows, and automation that let people and AI work together across the whole web lifecycle. Design systems, structured content, experimentation, analytics, and AI, connected into something coherent instead of a CMS with bolted-on features.


### **Discoverability**



Technical SEO, structured data, AI search, and whatever comes next for being found, both by search engines and by AI assistants.


### **Measurement and attribution**



Analytics, event instrumentation, server-side tracking, Conversion APIs, attribution and marketing measurement. If we can't trust the numbers, we can't learn anything from them.


### **Experimentation**



The infrastructure behind fast experiments, personalization, feature flags and continuous optimization, and making that infrastructure usable by people who don't write code.


### **Internal platform**



Tooling, automation and AI-assisted workflows that make life easier for marketers, designers, copywriters, editors and localization teams.


### **Design system**



Working with Design on a component system that scales, stays consistent and accessible, and doesn't slow anyone down.


### **AI enablement**



The knowledge and context layer that gives AI agents what they need to generate, improve, and localize content well. That includes turning product analytics, marketing data, and experiment results into context a model can actually use, and having the judgment to know when the output is good enough to ship.


**How you'll work**
-------------------



We call this a Product Engineer role, and we mean something specific by it.


### **Start with the outcome**



You'll work with our Growth PM, Design, Marketing, and Analytics to clarify the problem we're solving and how we'll know it worked before much gets built. If a brief doesn't hold up, we expect you to say so, and to bring your own ideas about where the leverage is.


### **Finish the loop**



Get clear on the outcome, ship, watch what happens, learn, adjust. Shipping is the middle of the job, not the end. The experiment that failed is often more interesting than the one that worked, as long as somebody bothers to find out why.


### **Be clear about trade-offs**



A growth team moves fast, and a lot of what we build is meant to be thrown away. Knowing which parts aren't is the real craft. We'd rather you weigh speed against quality, scale, and risk out loud, with reasons, than default to one end of it.


### **Keep the standard where it counts**



Testing, observability and sensible security defaults aren't the opposite of speed on a surface this exposed. They're what makes speed survivable. When you ship something, you check that it works for real people in production.


### **Use AI properly**



AI-native development is how this team works, and we want someone fluent in it who'll keep pushing the rest of us. You're still on the hook for what ships. Read it, test it, understand it, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft.


### **Build for the people who use what you build**



Your users aren't only visitors to the site. They're marketers, copywriters, designers, localization teams, and other engineers. The questions worth asking include: how do we make publishing easier, automate the boring parts, improve the quality of what AI produces, take friction out of editing, and put experimentation in more hands? Good platforms disappear into the background. When this one works, everyone else gets faster.


**What success looks like**
---------------------------



Not lines of code. Business results, and how quickly we learn.


* More visitors turning into signups
* Faster experimentation
* Better discoverability across search engines and AI assistants
* A faster website
* Attribution we can trust
* Less manual work and quicker publishing
* A better experience for the engineers and editors who use the platform
* More leverage from automation and AI

**Who you are**
---------------



You live and breathe the web. You find it interesting how modern sites get built, found, measured and improved, and you like understanding the whole stack, from browser rendering and frontend architecture through to search engines, analytics, AI and experimentation. You care about the systems behind the experience as much as the experience itself, and you think in platforms rather than projects.



You're curious about users and customers, and comfortable having an opinion about what we should build, not only how to build it. The future of AI excites you, and so does the unglamorous engineering that makes AI useful in practice.



You share what you know. You write things down, you give people context, and the people around you get better for working with you.


**You'll probably have experience with**
----------------------------------------


* React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend engineering
* Technical SEO and modern search technologies
* AI search, structured content and discoverability
* Web analytics and event instrumentation
* Server-side tracking and Conversion APIs
* Marketing attribution and analytics
* Experimentation platforms and A/B testing
* Core Web Vitals and frontend performance
* APIs, integrations and automation
* Headless CMS platforms and component-driven architectures
* AI-assisted software development
* Modern deployment platforms such as Vercel
* Building internal tooling and developer platforms


Nobody has all of this. Tell us which parts you'd be picking up along the way.


**How we work, and who this suits**
-----------------------------------



We're an outcome-oriented team. We work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Analytics to find opportunities, test ideas and build things that move the business. We'd rather be fast and learn than be perfect.



Two honest things about the team, because they're the difference between enjoying this job and not.



The website is everyone's front door, so plenty of work gets pushed at us from outside. There's more ad hoc work and more context switching here than on a core product team. Some engineers love that and some find it draining. Both are reasonable, and it's worth knowing which one you are before you apply.



Some of the most valuable work also takes months to show up in a graph. SEO, measurement, platform foundations. You need to invest in what you believe in before the numbers move, and be honest enough to stop when the evidence says you got it wrong.


**Why you'll love this role**
-----------------------------



You'll help shape one of the world's leading product-led growth companies while it goes through a real transformation. Modern web technology, AI-native ways of working, and a small team that likes curiosity, experimentation, and good craft.



And you'll build the operating system behind how millions of people discover Mentimeter.


### **Compensation**


*At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you. The salary range for this role is SEK 60,000–SEK 80,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.*  

  

*Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements. We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.*  

  

***In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here:*** https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm***.***

**What Mentimeter can offer**  

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.



All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions.


**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**  

At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.

AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
**Culture at Mentimeter**  

At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

title: System Test Engineer – Network Test Automation
description:
**System Test Engineer – Network Test Automation**


*Location: Lund, Sweden | On-site | Security Clearance Required*


Join us as a System Test Engineer! Build the automated framework that tests our secure IP-VPN platform across real switches, firewalls, and networks. Apply now!


At Asperiq, we build secure communication systems designed to protect sensitive data in critical environments. We're now looking for a system test engineer to join our system test team and help build the automated test framework behind our IP-VPN platform — covering everything from framework architecture to the network setups it runs against.


You'll work at the intersection of networking, test automation, and software development. If you enjoy solving hard problems with a curious and methodical mindset, and you'd rather find the bug before the customer does, this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

**What you'll be doing**


You'll join our system test team and work on both our test framework and the test cases that run on it. Your responsibilities will include:

* Designing and building an automated system test framework capable of testing our product across a range of network setups.
* Integrating and automating tests against a variety of switches, firewalls, and network equipment.
* Modeling realistic and adversarial network topologies to validate product behavior under varied conditions.
* Writing and maintaining automated test cases, and executing manual testing where automation isn't (yet) the answer.
* Diagnosing and root-causing failures across the network, system, and application layers.
* Participating in agile team rituals like stand-ups and planning meetings, and being actively involved in technical decision-making.
* Collaborating across disciplines — from software developers to embedded hardware engineers — to deliver robust and secure solutions.

**What we're looking for**

*Required experience:*

* Deep knowledge of networking — routing, switching, firewalls, and common protocols.
* Solid programming skills, with the ability to build and maintain a test framework, not just write test cases.
* Hands-on experience with system or integration testing in a networked or product environment.

*Additional skills we appreciate:*

* Experience with test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or similar).
* Familiarity with networking equipment from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, or similar.
* Experience with Python, Go, or similar languages for tooling and automation.
* Confidence working in Linux environments.
* Understanding of VPN, cryptography, or secure networking concepts.

**What we value in you**

* You're adaptable and open to exploring new technical areas.
* You enjoy complex challenges and take a structured approach to solving them.
* You're curious, continuously learning, and eager to improve both product and process.
* You document well and communicate clearly — both in code and conversations.
* You pay attention to detail without losing sight of delivery goals.

**What we offer**

* A chance to shape how a mission-critical secure communication system is tested and validated.
* A collaborative team where your input matters and your work has visible impact.
* A mix of deep technical work and product-level influence.
* A flat organization that values learning, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* An onboarding program and dedicated mentor to support your transition.


Apply today and join us in building the future of secure digital infrastructure. We're excited to meet our next team member.


For more information, visit www.asperiq.com

* Manage the configuration of software components and watchdogs to align with project specifications and requirements.

* Contribute to software design, collaborating with team members to develop innovative and effective solutions.

* Perform technical reviews on software component design, code, and testing strategies, including integration test planning.

You bring a structured, quality-minded way of working and a calm approach when priorities shift.  *Requirements:*

* A bachelor's degree or master's degree in computer science, Electronics or Mechatronics Engineering
* 10+ years of experience working with Embedded Software
* Proficient in programming languages such as Python and C, with solid experience in software development.
* At least 6 years of experience working with AUTOSAR on platform level, demonstrating a strong understanding of its architecture and components.
* Familiarity with software testing methodologies and tools, including CANoe, to ensure high-quality software delivery.
* Self-driven, with a strong eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies.
* Familiarity with automotive communication protocols, network management concepts, bootloaders and functional safety development with ISO 26262 automotive standards.
* Security design using Hardware Security Modules (HSM) for bootloader implementation, to ensure secure booting and secure flashing processes are in place.
**Ready for the next move?**
----------------------------


We value the uniqueness of every individual and the diverse backgrounds and experiences they bring and ignite curiosity.

  

If you’re looking to increase your expertise and broaden your responsibility, this is a fantastic opportunity within Volvo Group.

 *Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to apply.*

 **Location:** Gothenburg, Sweden.

  



**Last application date:** October 18th, 2026.

 **Who we are and what we believe in**  

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.


Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

 **Trucks Technology & Industrial Division** hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.  

Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer

* Deploy Intric in on-prem and private cloud environments with strict security requirements
* Debug what no one else can figure out, in environments with limited tooling and high constraints
* Turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions customers rely on daily
* Prioritize ruthlessly across competing demands, from a position of knowledge rather than whoever is loudest
* Feed real-world deployment insights back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap


**Who you are**
 You've shipped things that other people depend on. You've been on-call when they broke. You've dealt with real production risk, real failure, and end-to-end ownership without a safety net. That background is what makes the rest of this possible.
   

  

* You work across the full stack without needing to hand off: frontend, backend, infrastructure, AI layer, GitOps, networking, protocols, raw API work
* You take ownership of customer outcomes, not individual tasks. If the customer isn't reaching their goal, that's your problem to solve.
* You can say no to the wrong thing and yes to the right one, even under pressure from the customer.

**Fluent** 
**Swedish and English are both required for this role.**
 Your title might have been Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or something else entirely. What matters is what you actually did: owning delivery in customer environments, end to end, with real stakes attached.
   

  

**What You'll Gain**
 You'll build a combination that's hard to find elsewhere: production-level AI deployment experience in high-security environments, across multiple industries, with direct ownership of customer outcomes from start to finish.
   

  

* Hands-on experience deploying AI in production-critical, high-security environments
* Exposure to complex enterprise architectures across sectors and countries

title: AI- lösningsarkitekt inom Dynamics 365 & Power Platform
description:
Som lösningsarkitekt får du kombinera verksamhetsförståelse med teknisk konfigurering, automatisering och utveckling av AI-stödda CRM-lösningar i Microsofts moderna molnplattform. Du arbetar nära kundens verksamhet för att omsätta affärsbehov till effektiva och säkra lösningar baserade på Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM), Power Platform, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Services och Microsofts agentplattformar.
 



 En viktig del av rollen är att hjälpa kunder att etablera och utveckla AI-funktionalitet genom Copilot Studio, AI-agenter, generativ AI och automatiserade processer samtidigt som du säkerställer governance, säkerhet, identitetshantering och efterlevnad av organisationens regelverk. Du blir en nyckelperson i implementations- och förvaltningsprojekt där du hjälper kunder att digitalisera, automatisera och AI-förstärka sina verksamhetsprocesser med hjälp av Microsofts ekosystem och Power Platform.
 



**I rollen kommer du bland annat:** 



* Leda workshops, kravinsamling och verksamhetsanalyser för att identifiera hur AI-agenter, Copilot-lösningar och generativ AI kan skapa affärsvärde och stödja verksamhetsprocesser.
* Designa AI- och agentarkitekturer baserade på Microsofts plattform, inklusive Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Dynamics 365, Power Platform och Dataverse.
* Identifiera och definiera användningsfall för AI-agenter samt omsätta affärsbehov till lösningsarkitekturer med fokus på automatisering, beslutsstöd, självbetjäning och produktivitet.
* Ansvara för den tekniska lösningsdesignen av AI-agenter, inklusive orkestrering mellan agenter, integrationsmönster, datakällor, kunskapsbaser, RAG-lösningar (Retrieval Augmented Generation), agentinstruktioner och eskaleringsmekanismer.
* Utforma säkra och skalbara lösningar med fokus på governance, säkerhet, identitetshantering (Microsoft Entra ID), dataskydd, regelefterlevnad och ansvarsfull AI.
* Leda implementation och kvalitetssäkring av lösningar genom nära samarbete med utvecklare, verksamhetsexperter och lösningsarkitekter inom Dynamics 365 och Power Platform.
* Driva innovation och rådgivning kring nya möjligheter inom agentbaserad AI, Copilot Studio, Azure AI och Microsofts AI-plattformar.
* Stötta kunder i deras AI-resa genom utbildning, förändringsledning, arkitekturrådgivning och etablering av best practices för AI och agentutveckling.



**Vi söker dig med:** 



* Mycket goda kunskaper i konfigurering av Dynamics 365 CE/CRM och/eller Power Platform-verktygen, exempelvis Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse och Power BI.
* 2-4 års erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 och/eller Power Platform, exempelvis som konsult, systemansvarig eller superuser.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla AI-agenter och Copilot-lösningar med hjälp av Copilot Studio, Azure AI och Microsofts AI-plattformar. Förståelse för agentarkitektur, generativ AI, orkestrering, integrationsmönster och ansvarsfull AI.
* God verksamhetsförståelse inom områden som försäljning, kundservice, marknadsföring eller ekonomi.
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.



**Om oss:** 




 Vi är ett ledande nordiskt IT-bolag som stärker våra kunders IT-förmåga i en allt mer komplex digital värld. Med bred och djup kompetens hjälper vi organisationer att skapa stabila, säkra och moderna lösningar från applikationsutveckling och integration till infrastruktur, drift och säkerhet. Vi tar ett helhetsansvar för IT och arbetar långsiktigt, både med våra kunder och med varandra. Hos oss är gemenskap, engagemang och utveckling en självklar del av vardagen. När vi trivs och växer tillsammans skapar vi också större värde.

title: Finnish Speech & Audio AI Specialist
description:
**Job Description** 




  





**About the Role** 




 As a Finnish Speech & Audio AI Specialist in our Global AI Community, you evaluate and validate speech AI systems—ensuring machine-generated voices sound natural, speech recognition captures intent accurately, and voice AI models learn from high-quality datasets. Your work directly impacts millions of users' voice-based AI experiences.
 



 What You'll Do
 



  





**Audio Evaluation & Quality Assessment** 



* Evaluate AI-generated speech (TTS) for naturalness, pronunciation, rhythm, tone, and emotion
* Identify transcription errors, pronunciation issues, and linguistic nuances in speech recognition (ASR) outputs
* Conduct audio quality checks (loudness, noise, clipping, distortion, compliance)
* Analyze audio using waveform and spectrogram tools to identify quality issues
* Provide structured feedback for model improvement



**Audio Editing & Technical Proficiency** 



* Perform professional audio editing (segmentation, trimming, noise reduction, enhancement)
* Apply audio restoration techniques to optimize speech samples
* Prepare and validate speech content for training pipelines



**Speech Linguistics & Dataset Validation** 



* Apply phonetics and linguistics expertise to identify speech variations across accents and languages
* Review voice recordings for clarity, consistency, and technical quality
* Support creation and validation of high-quality speech datasets
* Perform audio annotation and labeling for dataset integrity



**Voice AI Project Support** 



* Support TTS, ASR, voice similarity, voice generation, and conversational AI evaluation projects
* Contribute to quality assurance workflows for voice technology projects
* Document findings to inform model improvement



  





**Qualification path** 




  





**Mandatory Qualifications** 




***Education / Professional Background***




 One of the following:
 



 Bachelor's degree in Audio Engineering, Sound Engineering, Music Technology, Linguistics, Phonetics, Speech-Language Pathology, Computational Linguistics, or Computer Science (Speech/AI focus)
 



 OR 2+ years professional experience in: audio production, dialogue editing, voice recording, podcast/audio post-production, speech dataset creation, or AI speech projects
 



**Language Requirements** 




 Native-level Finnish (C1/C2+) – Required for pronunciation and linguistic accuracy
 



 Professional English (B1+) – Required for technical instructions and documentation
 



***Technical Competency***




 Hands-on experience with at least one professional audio tool: Adobe Audition, iZotope RX, Pro Tools, Reaper, Audacity, Logic Pro, Cubase, or equivalent DAW
 



 Working knowledge of: audio editing/restoration, noise reduction, spectrogram analysis, waveform interpretation, and audio quality assessment
 



  





**Assessment & Verification Requirements** 




 Completion of subject-specific qualification assessment (practical audio/speech evaluation)
 



 Identity verification (IDV) process – Required as soon as possible after application completion
